title.id: Tumis Jagung dan Daging Cincang Vegan

description.zh:
今天分享一道超簡單又超下飯的 純素肉末炒玉米！🌽
颱風天抗漲料理！！！
香甜玉米搭配凍豆腐一起快炒，每一口都有濃郁香氣，不論配白飯、拌麵、便當都超適合，而且只要幾分鐘就能完成，是忙碌上班族、學生和新手都能輕鬆完成的純素家常料理。
description.en:
Today's super simple and rice-friendly vegan mince and corn stir-fry! 🌽
Budget-friendly typhoon-day dish!!
Sweet corn paired with frozen tofu stir-fried quickly, every bite has rich aroma. Perfect with white rice, noodles or bento boxes. Ready in minutes—easy for busy professionals, students and beginners to make this vegan home-style meal.
description.id:
Hari ini berbagi tumis jagung dan daging cincang vegan yang sangat sederhana dan cocok disantap dengan nasi! 🌽
Hidangan hemat untuk hari topan!!
Jagung manis dipadukan dengan tahu beku digoreng cepat, setiap gigitan memiliki aroma kaya. Cocok disajikan dengan nasi putih, mie atau kotak bento. Siap dalam menit—mudah bagi profesional sibuk, mahasiswa dan pemula untuk membuat hidangan rumahan vegan ini.

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐退冰後擠乾水分，剝成小塊。若沒有凍豆腐，可用板豆腐代替並壓碎炒乾。
instruction.en: Thaw frozen tofu, squeeze out excess water, and break into small pieces. If frozen tofu is unavailable, substitute with firm tofu, crush it, and stir-fry until dry.
instruction.id: Keluarkan es dari tahu beku, peras air berlebihan, dan hancurkan menjadi potongan kecil. Jika tidak ada tahu beku, ganti dengan tahu keras, hancurkan, dan tumis hingga kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view in a warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen: hands squeeze thawed frozen tofu dry and crumble it into small pieces beside finely chopped green water-snowflake stems. Natural daylight, realistic ingredients, clean cookware, no faces, no text, no labels, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 將水蓮切細，用以取代蔥的口感和顏色。
instruction.en: Chop white water snowflake stems into fine pieces to replace the texture and color of scallions.
instruction.id: Potong batang sayur water snowflake menjadi potongan halus untuk mengganti tekstur dan warna bawang daun.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, close overhead view in a warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen: a cook finely chops crisp green water-snowflake stems on a wooden board, with a neat pile of thin green pieces visible. Natural daylight, photorealistic food, no faces, no text, no labels, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入少許油，將凍豆腐煸至金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to the pan and fry the frozen tofu until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Tuangkan sedikit minyak ke wajan lalu tumis tahu beku hingga keemasan dan renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: crumbled frozen tofu is stir-fried in a dark skillet with a small amount of oil until the irregular pieces are visibly golden and crisp at the edges. Warm Taiwanese home kitchen, realistic steam and texture, no people, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 將玉米罐頭的水倒出，倒入鍋中。炒至聞到烤玉米香氣或玉米微焦黃時，下調味料。
instruction.en: Drain water from the canned corn and add to the pan. Stir-fry until you smell roasted corn aroma or corn turns slightly golden.
instruction.id: Tuang air dari kaleng jagung dan tambahkan ke dalam wajan. Tumis hingga tercium aroma jagung bakar atau jagung berwarna keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: drained bright yellow canned corn is being added to a skillet of golden crumbled tofu, with several kernels beginning to toast and brown. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, realistic food and gentle steam, no faces, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、胡椒鹽和咖哩粉，翻炒均勻。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, pepper salt, and curry powder. Stir-fry until well combined.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, garam lada, dan bubuk kari. Tumis hingga rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead close view: soy sauce, warm yellow curry powder and seasoned pepper salt are being added to a skillet of toasted corn and crumbled tofu, then folded together with a wooden spatula. Photorealistic Taiwanese home cooking, no packaging, no text, no watermark.

title.en: Add the white water snowflake stems and reduce
title.id: Tambahkan batang water snowflake dan susutkan saus

instruction.zh: 倒入少量水，讓凍豆腐吸收醬汁；剩少量水分時加入切碎水蓮，快速翻炒至熟。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of water and let the frozen tofu absorb the sauce. When little liquid remains, add the chopped white water snowflake stems and stir-fry briefly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit air agar tahu beku menyerap saus. Saat cairan tinggal sedikit, masukkan batang sayur water snowflake yang sudah dicincang lalu tumis sebentar.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: finely chopped green water-snowflake stems are tossed into the seasoned corn and golden tofu mixture while the last small amount of sauce reduces and glazes the food. Warm kitchen light, realistic steam and vivid texture, no faces, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 最後淋上香油，大火翻炒後即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Drizzle with sesame oil, stir-fry over high heat until ready to serve.
instruction.id: Siram dengan minyak wijen, tumis dengan api besar hingga siap disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: a thin glossy stream of sesame oil is drizzled over the finished vegan corn, golden crumbled tofu and chopped green stems in a hot skillet just before serving. Appetizing photorealistic Taiwanese home cooking, no faces, no text, no watermark.

title.id: Nasi Terong Satu Panci dengan Rice Cooker

description.zh: 先將香菇、茄子與花椒炒香並以醬油調味，再與白米、黃豆芽一起放進電鍋蒸煮，最後拌入九層塔的全素燜飯。
description.en: A vegan rice-cooker meal where shiitake, eggplant and Sichuan peppercorns are sautéed and seasoned, then cooked with rice and soybean sprouts and finished with basil.
description.id: Hidangan vegan rice cooker: shiitake, terong, dan lada Sichuan ditumis serta dibumbui, lalu dimasak dengan nasi dan kecambah kedelai, kemudian diselesaikan dengan kemangi.

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇切片，茄子切成粗長條。
instruction.en: Slice the fresh shiitake mushrooms and cut the eggplant into thick long strips.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake segar dan potong terong menjadi batang panjang tebal.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms and thick long purple eggplant strips arranged in separate groups on a wooden cutting board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, sprouts, sauce, cooked vegetables, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油炒香菇至金黃乾香，加入少許花椒與茄子，炒至茄子吸油。
instruction.en: Oil a pan and sauté shiitake until golden and dry-fragrant; add a little Sichuan peppercorn and eggplant, cooking until the eggplant absorbs the oil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dan tumis shiitake hingga keemasan serta harum; tambahkan sedikit lada Sichuan dan terong, masak hingga terong menyerap minyak.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of shiitake slices turning golden and thick eggplant strips softening in a lightly oiled wok with a few Sichuan peppercorns and gentle steam. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, soybean sprouts, dark sauce, finished dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、醬油膏與香油，倒水後煮至茄子吸收醬汁、湯汁收乾。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, soy sauce paste and sesame oil; add water and cook until the eggplant absorbs the sauce and the liquid reduces.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus kecap kental, dan minyak wijen; tambahkan air lalu masak hingga terong menyerap saus dan cairan menyusut.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of eggplant strips and shiitake mushrooms simmering in a wok as a glossy dark soy-based sauce reduces and is absorbed, nearly no loose liquid remaining. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, soybean sprouts, basil, finished bowl, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 內鍋放入洗好的兩杯白米與兩杯水，鋪上炒料和黃豆芽；外鍋加半杯水後蒸煮。
instruction.en: Put two cups of washed rice and two cups of water in the inner pot, top with the sautéed mixture and soybean sprouts, then cook with half a cup of water in the outer pot.
instruction.id: Masukkan dua cangkir beras yang telah dicuci dan dua cangkir air ke panci dalam, tambahkan tumisan dan kecambah kedelai, lalu masak dengan setengah cangkir air di panci luar.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no basil yet, no finished rice, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 跳起後再燜約10分鐘，開蓋拌入九層塔並拌勻。
instruction.en: After the cooker switches off, steam for about 10 minutes, then fold in basil and mix evenly.
instruction.id: Setelah rice cooker selesai, diamkan sekitar 10 menit, lalu masukkan kemangi dan aduk rata.

description.zh: 薑末、孜然、十三香、辣椒粉與白芝麻以熱油分次潑香，再拌入煮軟年糕和酸甜醬汁的香辣小食。
description.en: Minced ginger, cumin, thirteen-spice, chili, and sesame are bloomed with hot oil, then tossed with softened rice cakes and a tangy savory sauce.
description.id: Jahe cincang, jintan, bumbu tiga belas, cabai, dan wijen disiram minyak panas lalu diaduk dengan kue beras lembut serta saus gurih asam.

instruction.zh: 將薑末、孜然粉、十三香、辣椒粉與白芝麻放入耐熱碗中混合，為熱油分次潑香做好準備。
instruction.en: Combine minced ginger, cumin, thirteen-spice, chili powder, and white sesame in a heatproof bowl, ready for hot oil blooming.
instruction.id: Campurkan jahe cincang, bubuk jintan, bumbu tiga belas, bubuk cabai, dan wijen putih dalam mangkuk tahan panas untuk disiram minyak.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of minced ginger, cumin, chili powder and white sesame arranged in a heatproof bowl, no text.

title.en: Bloom the spices with hot oil in batches
title.id: Siram rempah dengan minyak panas bertahap

instruction.zh: 將油加熱至160–170°C，分次倒入香料碗中，每次都讓熱油接觸香料後再攪拌，形成香辣油潑醬。
instruction.en: Heat oil to 160–170°C and pour it into the spice bowl in batches, letting each addition bloom the aromatics before stirring into a fragrant chili oil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga 160–170°C lalu tuang bertahap ke mangkuk rempah; biarkan tiap tuangan mengeluarkan aroma sebelum diaduk menjadi minyak cabai harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of shimmering hot oil being poured in batches over chili, sesame and spices in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Soften and drain the rice cakes

instruction.zh: 將年糕放入水中煮到柔軟後瀝乾，讓年糕表面保持溫熱並能吸附後續醬汁。
instruction.en: Cook the rice cakes in water until soft, then drain them so their warm surfaces can absorb the dressing.
instruction.id: Rebus kue beras dalam air hingga lembut, lalu tiriskan agar permukaannya yang hangat dapat menyerap saus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of soft glossy rice cake slices draining in a metal colander over a pot, steam rising, no text.

title.en: Toss with the tangy spicy sauce

instruction.zh: 將煮軟年糕加入油潑香料醬，再拌入醬油、味醂、檸檬汁與香菜，翻拌至每片年糕均勻裹上醬汁。
instruction.en: Add softened rice cakes to the bloomed spice oil, then toss with soy sauce, mirin, lemon juice, and cilantro until every piece is coated.
instruction.id: Masukkan kue beras lembut ke minyak rempah, lalu aduk dengan kecap asin, mirin, jus lemon, dan ketumbar hingga semua terlapisi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food photograph of glossy spicy oil-splashed rice cakes tossed with cilantro and sesame in a serving bowl, no text.

title.en: Miso Soy-Milk Tofu Meat-Sauce Dipping Noodles
title.id: Mi Celup Saus Miso Susu Kedelai Tahu

description.zh: 凍豆腐炒出金黃嚼勁後，以味噌、豆漿和調味料熬成濃稠肉醬，搭配冷麵沾食的全素料理。
description.en: Golden sautéed frozen tofu is simmered with miso and soy milk into a thick vegan meat sauce for dipping chilled noodles.
description.id: Tahu beku yang ditumis keemasan direbus dengan miso dan susu kedelai menjadi saus daging vegan kental untuk mi dingin.

title.en: Mince ginger and prepare frozen tofu
title.id: Cincang jahe dan siapkan tahu beku

instruction.zh: 老薑切成細末；將凍豆腐擠去多餘水分後剝碎，做出接近肉醬的顆粒口感。
instruction.en: Mince the mature ginger; squeeze excess water from frozen tofu and crumble it into small pieces resembling minced meat.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua; peras air berlebih dari tahu beku lalu hancurkan menjadi butiran kecil seperti daging cincang.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油，先炒薑末，再放入凍豆腐碎持續翻炒至水分蒸散、表面金黃並帶有嚼勁。
instruction.en: Heat oil, sauté the ginger first, then keep stirring the crumbled frozen tofu until moisture evaporates and the pieces turn golden and chewy.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak, tumis jahe terlebih dahulu, lalu aduk tahu beku hancur sampai air menguap dan butirannya keemasan serta kenyal.

title.en: Simmer miso and soy milk into sauce
title.id: Rebus miso dan susu kedelai menjadi saus

instruction.zh: 加入味噌、醬油、味醂、豆漿與水拌勻，小火煮約5分鐘，使醬汁濃稠並讓凍豆腐吸收味噌豆乳風味。
instruction.en: Add miso, soy sauce, mirin, soy milk, and water, then simmer gently about 5 minutes until thick and absorbed by the tofu.
instruction.id: Tambahkan miso, kecap asin, mirin, susu kedelai, dan air, lalu rebus perlahan sekitar 5 menit hingga kental dan meresap.

title.en: Finish with chili and serve with noodles
title.id: Tambahkan cabai dan sajikan dengan mi

instruction.zh: 醬汁濃稠後加入辣椒片拌勻；將煮好的麵條盛盤，讓麵條沾取濃郁味噌豆乳肉醬食用。
instruction.en: Stir in sliced chili once the sauce thickens; plate cooked noodles and dip them into the rich miso soy-milk tofu sauce.
instruction.id: Aduk irisan cabai setelah saus mengental; sajikan mi matang dan celupkan ke saus tahu miso susu kedelai yang kaya.

description.zh: 豆漿、嫩豆腐與花生醬打成冰涼湯底，搭配煸香凍豆腐素肉燥、冰鎮烏龍麵與小黃瓜絲。
description.en: Soy milk, silken tofu, and peanut butter are blended into a chilled broth, served with crisp frozen-tofu crumble, iced udon, and cucumber.
description.id: Susu kedelai, tahu sutra, dan selai kacang diblender menjadi kuah dingin, disajikan dengan remahan tahu beku, udon dingin, dan mentimun.

instruction.zh: 將豆漿、半塊嫩豆腐、花生醬與少量鹽打勻，放入冰箱冷藏，讓湯底變得冰涼濃滑。
instruction.en: Blend soy milk, half a block of silken tofu, peanut butter, and a little salt until smooth, then chill the broth in the refrigerator.
instruction.id: Blender susu kedelai, setengah blok tahu sutra, selai kacang, dan sedikit garam hingga halus, lalu dinginkan di kulkas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of creamy pale soy milk broth blending in a glass blender with tofu and peanut butter, no text.

title.zh: 切黃瓜絲並剝碎凍豆腐
title.en: Shred cucumber and crumble frozen tofu
title.id: Serut mentimun dan hancurkan tahu beku

instruction.zh: 小黃瓜切成細絲；將凍豆腐剝碎成不規則小顆粒，準備炒成帶有肉燥口感的配料。
instruction.en: Cut cucumber into fine shreds and crumble frozen tofu into irregular small pieces for a meat-sauce-like topping.
instruction.id: Iris mentimun tipis dan hancurkan tahu beku menjadi butiran kecil tidak beraturan untuk topping mirip saus daging.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of fine cucumber shreds and crumbled frozen tofu separated in small bowls, no text.

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐碎放入鍋中煸炒至金黃酥脆、聽到乾爽沙沙聲，再加入醬油、味醂和少量水。
instruction.en: Sauté the crumbled frozen tofu until golden and crisp with a dry sizzling sound, then add soy sauce, mirin, and a little water.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu beku hancur hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu tambahkan kecap asin, mirin, dan sedikit air.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of golden crisp frozen tofu crumbles sizzling in a skillet with savory sauce, no text.

title.en: Reduce the sauce into a topping

instruction.zh: 持續翻炒至鍋中水分收乾，使醬油味醂醬汁被凍豆腐吸收，形成鹹香乾爽的素肉燥。
instruction.en: Keep stirring until the liquid reduces completely and the soy-mirin seasoning is absorbed, forming a savory dry tofu crumble.
instruction.id: Terus aduk hingga cairan menyusut habis dan bumbu kecap-mirin terserap, menjadi remahan tahu gurih yang kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of glossy savory tofu crumble reduced dry in a dark skillet, visible crisp golden edges, no text.

instruction.zh: 將烏龍麵放進滾水煮熟後撈出，立刻冰鎮，讓麵條降溫並保持Q彈。
instruction.en: Cook udon in boiling water, drain it, and chill immediately so the noodles cool down and remain springy.
instruction.id: Rebus mi udon dalam air mendidih, tiriskan, lalu dinginkan segera agar mi tetap kenyal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thick udon noodles being chilled in a bowl of ice water, clear cubes and steam fading, no text.

instruction.zh: 碗中放冰鎮烏龍麵，倒入冷藏豆乳湯底，鋪上凍豆腐素肉燥與黃瓜絲，最後依喜好淋辣椒油或辣椒醬。
instruction.en: Place chilled udon in a bowl, pour over the cold soy-milk broth, add tofu crumble and cucumber, then finish with chili oil or sauce to taste.
instruction.id: Masukkan udon dingin ke mangkuk, tuang kuah susu kedelai, tambahkan remahan tahu dan mentimun, lalu beri minyak atau saus cabai secukupnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food photograph of iced soy-milk udon topped with golden tofu crumble, cucumber shreds and chili oil, no text.

description.zh: 沖洗浸泡去澱粉的馬鈴薯絲，和酸菜、香菇、薑絲及乾辣椒炒出鹹香爽脆口感。
description.en: Rinsed, soaked potato shreds are stir-fried with pickled mustard greens, shiitake, ginger, and dried chili for a crisp savory dish.
description.id: Kentang serut yang dibilas dan direndam ditumis dengan sawi asin, shiitake, jahe, dan cabai kering hingga gurih renyah.

title.zh: 將酸菜與香菇處理成絲

instruction.zh: 乾香菇泡發後切絲；酸菜稍微洗淨並泡水後切絲，降低鹹度並保留發酵香氣。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake and slice it; rinse and briefly soak the pickled mustard greens before slicing to soften their saltiness while keeping their fermented aroma.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake lalu iris; bilas dan rendam sebentar sawi asin sebelum diiris agar asin berkurang tetapi aroma fermentasi tetap ada.

steps.imagePrompt: 16:9 photorealistic vegan cooking tutorial photograph, step 1. Overhead on a pale wood surface: two separate small glass bowls, one with soaked shiitake sliced into thin strips, the other with fine ribbons of rinsed pickled mustard greens. Clean natural light, only these plant ingredients, no text or labels. Strictly no meat, poultry, fish, seafood, eggs, dairy, or unrelated foods.

title.zh: 刨馬鈴薯絲並洗去澱粉
title.en: Shred potatoes and rinse away starch

description.zh: 凍豆腐、蓮藕、日本山藥、豆薯與菇類做成獅子頭，於160–170°C油炸定型後再燉20分鐘。

description.id: Tahu beku, akar teratai, ubi yam Jepang, bengkuang, dan jamur dibentuk menjadi bakso kepala singa, digoreng pada 160–170°C hingga set, lalu direbus selama 20 menit.

title.en: Prepare the Mushrooms and Root Vegetables

instruction.zh: 乾香菇泡軟後切碎，金針菇、鴻喜菇和豆薯切碎，老薑切末。蓮藕與日本山藥磨成泥，擠去蓮藕泥多餘水分；凍豆腐擠乾後剝碎，娃娃菜和青江菜洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Soak and mince the dried shiitake; finely chop the enoki, shimeji, and jicama, and mince the ginger. Grate the lotus root and Japanese yam, then squeeze excess moisture from the lotus-root pulp. Press the frozen tofu dry and crumble it; wash the baby napa cabbage and bok choy.
instruction.id: Rendam lalu cincang shiitake kering; cincang halus enoki, shimeji, dan bengkuang, serta cincang jahe. Parut akar teratai dan ubi yam Jepang, lalu peras kelebihan air dari parutan akar teratai. Peras tahu beku hingga kering dan hancurkan; cuci sawi putih muda serta pakcoy.

title.en: Brown the Mushrooms and Frozen Tofu

instruction.zh: 鍋中放少量炸油，先把乾香菇、老薑、金針菇和鴻喜菇煸至金黃出香，再加入剝碎凍豆腐，持續炒至水分蒸散、表面金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a little frying oil in a wok. Brown the shiitake, ginger, enoki, and shimeji until fragrant, then add the crumbled frozen tofu and continue cooking until its moisture evaporates and the pieces turn golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak goreng dalam wajan. Tumis shiitake, jahe, enoki, dan shimeji hingga harum dan keemasan, lalu masukkan tahu beku hancur dan lanjutkan menumis sampai airnya menguap serta permukaannya keemasan.

instruction.zh: 把炒香的菇類和凍豆腐倒入蓮藕泥、日本山藥泥與豆薯中，加入獅子頭調味用的醬油、醬油膏、胡椒粉、十三香、香油和玉米粉，拌至產生黏性。分成手掌大小的圓球，輕摔排出內部空氣。
instruction.en: Combine the browned mushrooms and frozen tofu with the lotus-root pulp, Japanese-yam paste, and jicama. Add the meatball-seasoning soy sauce, thick soy sauce, pepper, thirteen-spice, sesame oil, and cornstarch; mix until sticky. Form palm-size balls and gently knock out trapped air.
instruction.id: Campurkan jamur dan tahu beku yang sudah ditumis dengan parutan akar teratai, pasta ubi yam Jepang, dan bengkuang. Tambahkan kecap asin, kecap asin kental, merica, bumbu tiga belas rempah, minyak wijen, dan maizena untuk bumbu bakso; aduk hingga lengket. Bentuk bulatan sebesar telapak tangan lalu hentakkan perlahan untuk mengeluarkan udara.

instruction.zh: 炸油加熱至160–170°C，放入獅子頭炸至外層金黃、結實定型後撈起；此時內部毋須完全熟透，稍後會再紅燒。
instruction.en: Heat the frying oil to 160–170°C. Fry the lion's-head balls until the outside is golden and firmly set, then drain; the centres do not need to be fully cooked because they will be braised next.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 160–170°C. Goreng bakso kepala singa sampai bagian luar keemasan dan kokoh, lalu tiriskan; bagian tengah belum perlu matang sepenuhnya karena akan direbus lagi.

instruction.en: Heat a little frying oil in a deep pot and bloom the Sichuan peppercorns and star anise. Layer in the baby napa cabbage and set the fried meatballs on top. Add the shiitake water, water, soy sauce, thirteen-spice, and sugar for the braising liquid; cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until cooked through.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak goreng dalam panci dalam, lalu tumis lada Sichuan dan bunga lawang hingga harum. Susun sawi putih muda dan letakkan bakso goreng di atasnya. instruction.zh: 將杏鮑菇從中間手撕成兩半，再切成滾刀塊，保留撕開的粗糙表面；青椒切小片。
instruction.en: Tear the king oyster mushrooms in half from the centre, then cut them into rolling chunks while keeping the torn surface; cut the green pepper into small pieces.

title.en: Sauté tofu strips and bamboo shoots

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入食用油，先將乾絲煸至金黃酥香；加入香菇、金針菇和薑絲煸炒至金黃，再放入筍絲炒至聞到鮮甜香氣，必要時補少量油。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a pot and fry the shredded tofu until golden and crisp. Add shiitake, enoki, and ginger shreds and sauté until golden, then add bamboo shoots and cook until their sweet aroma emerges, adding a little more oil if needed.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam panci dan tumis tahu iris hingga keemasan serta renyah. Tambahkan shiitake, enoki, dan irisan jahe lalu tumis hingga keemasan, kemudian masukkan rebung dan masak sampai aromanya manis keluar; tambahkan sedikit minyak bila perlu.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, broth, celery, finished congee, meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Add rice and simmer into congee
title.id: Tambahkan beras lalu masak jadi bubur

instruction.zh: 白米洗淨；如想縮短熬煮時間，可先浸泡30至60分鐘。把生米加入鍋中拌炒，倒入醬油和白胡椒炒出醬香；再加入水與香菇水，米和總液體約按一比九。煮滾後轉小火，期間攪拌避免黏鍋，煮至米粒熟透。
instruction.en: Rinse the white rice; to shorten the simmer, optionally soak it for 30–60 minutes first. Stir the raw rice into the pot, then add soy sauce and ground white pepper and fry until aromatic. Add water and shiitake soaking water at about one part rice to nine parts total liquid. Bring to a boil, reduce to low heat, stir occasionally to prevent sticking, and cook until tender.
instruction.id: Cuci beras putih; agar waktu memasak lebih singkat, beras boleh direndam 30–60 menit terlebih dahulu. Tumis beras mentah dalam panci, lalu tambahkan kecap asin dan lada putih hingga harum. Tuang air serta air rendaman shiitake dengan perbandingan sekitar satu bagian beras dan sembilan bagian total cairan. Didihkan, kecilkan api, aduk sesekali agar tidak lengket, lalu masak sampai lunak.

instruction.zh: 試吃粥的米粒與鹹度，按需要補鹽；關火前淋少量香油，拌入芹菜珠後盛碗享用。
instruction.en: Taste the congee for rice tenderness and saltiness, adding salt if needed. Before turning off the heat, drizzle in a little sesame oil, fold in the diced celery, and serve in bowls.
instruction.id: Cicipi bubur untuk mengecek kematangan beras dan rasa asin, lalu tambahkan garam bila perlu. Sebelum mematikan api, tuang sedikit minyak wijen, aduk seledri cincang, lalu sajikan dalam mangkuk.

title.en: Chilled Udon Noodles in Tea Broth

description.zh: 以濃茶湯加醬油、味醂與香油調味，倒入冰鎮烏龍麵，搭配豆包、蒟蒻、番茄、檸檬與海苔酥的清爽全素冷麵。
description.en: A refreshing vegan chilled udon bowl with a strong tea broth seasoned with soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil, topped with tofu skin, konjac, tomato, lemon, and seaweed crisps.
description.id: Udon dingin vegan yang menyegarkan dengan kuah teh pekat berbumbu kecap asin, mirin, dan minyak wijen, dilengkapi kulit tahu, konnyaku, tomat, lemon, serta serpihan rumput laut.

instruction.zh: 小番茄對半切，檸檬切厚片，香菜切末，豆包切絲；蒟蒻依包裝處理並備用。
instruction.en: Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the lemon into thick slices, chop the cilantro, and shred the tofu skin. Prepare the konjac according to its package and set aside.
instruction.id: Belah dua tomat ceri, iris lemon agak tebal, cincang daun ketumbar, dan potong kulit tahu memanjang. Siapkan konnyaku sesuai petunjuk kemasan lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, chopped cilantro, tofu skin strips, and konjac prepared for a chilled noodle bowl, no text.

title.en: Brew a strong tea broth and cool it
title.id: Seduh kuah teh pekat lalu dinginkan

instruction.zh: 以茶包煮或沖約500毫升茶湯，選烏龍、玄米或麥茶皆可；泡得比平常飲用更濃，試喝後取出茶包並放涼。
instruction.en: Brew or steep about 500 ml of tea using a tea bag; oolong, genmaicha, or barley tea all work. Make it stronger than regular drinking tea, taste it, remove the bag, and let it cool.
instruction.id: Seduh atau rebus sekitar 500 ml teh dengan kantong teh; oolong, genmaicha, atau teh jelai semuanya cocok. Buat lebih pekat daripada teh minum biasa, cicipi, keluarkan kantong teh, lalu biarkan dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a clear pot of deeply colored tea broth with a tea bag being lifted out, cooling beside ice, no text.

title.zh: 燙熟豆包蒟蒻與烏龍麵

instruction.zh: 另煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，將豆包與蒟蒻燙熟，再煮烏龍麵至熟；關火後立刻將烏龍麵放入冰水冰鎮。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of water with a little salt to a boil. Blanch the tofu skin and konjac, then cook the udon until tender; turn off the heat and immediately chill the udon in ice water.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air terpisah dengan sedikit garam. Rebus sebentar kulit tahu dan konnyaku, lalu masak udon hingga matang; matikan api dan segera dinginkan udon dalam air es.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of udon noodles being transferred into a bowl of ice water after cooking, with tofu skin and konjac nearby, no text.

instruction.zh: 在放涼的濃茶湯中加入少許醬油、味醂和香油，攪拌均勻；若仍偏溫，加入冰塊使湯底冰涼。
instruction.en: Add a little soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil to the cooled strong tea broth and stir well. If it is still warm, add ice cubes to chill the broth.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit kecap asin, mirin, dan minyak wijen ke kuah teh pekat yang telah dingin lalu aduk rata. Jika masih hangat, tambahkan es batu untuk mendinginkan kuah.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of chilled amber tea broth with soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and floating ice cubes in a glass bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 冰鎮烏龍麵瀝乾放入碗中，擺上豆包、蒟蒻、番茄與檸檬，倒入茶湯；撒香菜和海苔酥，喜辣可另加七味粉、柚子胡椒或芥末。
instruction.en: Drain the chilled udon into a bowl, arrange tofu skin, konjac, tomato, and lemon on top, then pour in the tea broth. Finish with cilantro and seaweed crisps; add shichimi, yuzu kosho, or wasabi if you like heat.
instruction.id: Tiriskan udon dingin ke dalam mangkuk, susun kulit tahu, konnyaku, tomat, dan lemon di atasnya, lalu tuang kuah teh. Akhiri dengan daun ketumbar dan serpihan rumput laut; tambahkan shichimi, yuzu kosho, atau wasabi bila suka pedas.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished chilled udon in clear tea broth topped with tofu skin, konjac, cherry tomatoes, lemon, cilantro, and seaweed crisps, no text.

title.zh: 純素醬燒豆腐煲 無肉也香

description.zh: 煎香板豆腐以味噌、芝麻醬、醬油和味醂燜煮，再加入粉絲吸收濃郁醬汁的全素豆腐煲。
description.en: Golden-seared firm tofu is braised in a rich miso, sesame paste, soy sauce, and mirin broth, then paired with glass noodles to absorb the savoury sauce.
description.id: Tahu padat yang dipanggang keemasan direbus dalam kuah kaya miso, pasta wijen, kecap asin, dan mirin, lalu dipadukan dengan soun yang menyerap saus gurih.

instruction.zh: 老薑切末，板豆腐切厚片；粉絲泡軟後瀝乾。鍋中倒入食用油，將豆腐兩面煎至金黃色後先盛起。
instruction.en: Mince the mature ginger and cut the firm tofu into thick slices; soak the glass noodles until soft and drain. Heat cooking oil in a pan, sear both sides of the tofu until golden, and set aside.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua dan potong tahu padat tebal-tebal; rendam soun hingga lunak lalu tiriskan. Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan, panggang kedua sisi tahu hingga keemasan, kemudian sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of thick firm-tofu slices seared golden on both sides in a pan, with drained soaked glass noodles and a small pile of minced mature ginger visible beside the pan. Constraints: strictly vegan; no sauce, basil, finished stew, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將醬油、芝麻醬、味醂、味噌和白胡椒粉拌勻成醬汁。原鍋再加少量油，煸炒薑末至邊緣微焦、香氣釋出。
instruction.en: Mix soy sauce, sesame paste, mirin, miso, and ground white pepper into a sauce. Add a little more oil to the same pan and fry the minced ginger until its edges are lightly browned and fragrant.
instruction.id: Aduk kecap asin, pasta wijen, mirin, miso, dan lada putih bubuk menjadi saus. Tambahkan sedikit minyak lagi ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe cincang hingga pinggirannya sedikit kecokelatan serta harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead-close preparation photograph of a smooth tan miso-sesame sauce freshly whisked in a small bowl beside fragrant minced ginger browning lightly in a clean pan. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tofu, glass noodles, basil, finished dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 倒入調好的醬汁和三百毫升水，大火煮滾後放回煎豆腐燜煮。約三分鐘後加入瀝乾粉絲，讓粉絲吸收湯汁至入味。
instruction.en: Pour in the prepared sauce and 300 ml water, bring to a boil over high heat, then return the seared tofu to braise. After about three minutes, add the drained glass noodles and let them absorb the broth.
instruction.id: Tuang saus yang sudah disiapkan dan 300 ml air, didihkan dengan api besar, lalu masukkan kembali tahu panggang untuk direbus. Setelah sekitar tiga menit, tambahkan soun yang ditiriskan dan biarkan menyerap kuah.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no basil or chilli yet, no finished plated dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 粉絲吸飽醬汁後加入九層塔，煮出香氣即可關火；起鍋前沿鍋邊淋香油，喜辣可再放辣椒片。
instruction.en: When the noodles have absorbed the sauce, add Thai basil and cook just until fragrant before turning off the heat. Drizzle sesame oil around the pan edge before serving, adding sliced chilli if desired.
instruction.id: Saat soun sudah menyerap saus, masukkan kemangi Thailand dan masak hanya sampai harum sebelum mematikan api. Tuang minyak wijen di tepi wajan sebelum disajikan, lalu tambahkan irisan cabai bila diinginkan.

title.zh: 宵夜私房吃法豆豉辣椒拌麵

description.zh: 將豆豉、老薑與辣椒以小火炒成鹹香辣醬，拌入煮熟麵條並撒上香菜的快速全素拌麵。
description.en: A quick vegan noodle dish: fermented black beans, mature ginger, and chili are slowly fried into a savory spicy sauce, then tossed with cooked noodles and cilantro.
description.id: Hidangan mi vegan cepat: kacang hitam fermentasi, jahe tua, dan cabai ditumis perlahan menjadi saus gurih pedas, lalu diaduk dengan mi matang dan daun ketumbar.

title.en: Chop the black beans and prep aromatics
title.id: Cincang kacang hitam dan siapkan aromatik

instruction.zh: 將一半乾豆豉切碎，另一半保留整顆以增加口感；大辣椒切小段，老薑切末，香菜洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Finely chop half the dried fermented black beans and leave the other half whole for texture. Cut the large chilies into small pieces, mince the mature ginger, and wash the cilantro.
instruction.id: Cincang halus setengah kacang hitam fermentasi kering dan biarkan sisanya utuh untuk tekstur. Potong cabai besar kecil-kecil, cincang jahe tua, lalu cuci daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of chopped and whole fermented black beans, chopped red chilies, minced ginger, and cilantro on a prep board, no text.

title.en: Start black beans in cold oil
title.id: Mulai kacang hitam dalam minyak dingin

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入較充足的油，冷油即放入豆豉，以小火慢慢煸炒；用木匙將豆豉壓入油中，讓香氣逐漸釋放。
instruction.en: Pour a generous amount of oil into a wok and add the fermented black beans while the oil is still cold. Fry gently over low heat, pressing the beans into the oil with a wooden spoon to slowly release their aroma.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak cukup banyak ke wajan dan masukkan kacang hitam fermentasi saat minyak masih dingin. Tumis perlahan dengan api kecil sambil menekan kacang ke dalam minyak memakai sendok kayu agar aromanya keluar perlahan.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of fermented black beans slowly frying in oil in a wok, a wooden spoon pressing them gently, no text.

instruction.zh: 豆豉部分變得半透明時加入薑末，炒至薑末金黃；再加入辣椒小火炒軟，讓辣椒釋出甜香並慢慢蒸發水分。
instruction.en: When some black beans turn translucent, add minced ginger and fry until golden. Add the chili and cook over low heat until soft, releasing sweetness and slowly evaporating its moisture.
instruction.id: Saat sebagian kacang menjadi agak transparan, tambahkan jahe cincang dan tumis hingga keemasan. Masukkan cabai dan masak dengan api kecil hingga lunak, mengeluarkan rasa manis dan menguapkan kelembapannya perlahan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of ginger, red chili, and black beans sizzling together in fragrant oil, gently softened and golden, no text.

title.en: Season and reduce the chili sauce

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、胡椒粉、冰糖與少許鹽，持續小火翻炒至冰糖融化、醬油水分收乾且鍋中只剩濃郁香氣；關火放涼備用。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, ground pepper, rock sugar, and a little salt. Keep stirring over low heat until the rock sugar dissolves and the soy sauce moisture cooks off, leaving a fragrant concentrated sauce; turn off heat and cool slightly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, lada bubuk, gula batu, dan sedikit garam. Terus aduk dengan api kecil hingga gula batu larut dan kelembapan kecap menguap, menyisakan saus pekat yang harum; matikan api dan dinginkan sebentar.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of glossy reduced fermented black bean chili sauce in a wok, rich red-brown oil and no excess liquid, no text.

title.en: Cook noodles and toss with sauce
title.id: Masak mi lalu aduk dengan saus

instruction.zh: 另煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，依麵條種類煮熟後瀝乾；盛入碗中，放上豆豉辣椒醬並撒香菜拌勻，喜歡可改用芹菜。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of water with a little salt to a boil and cook the noodles according to their type, then drain. Put them in a bowl, top with the fermented black bean chili sauce and cilantro, and toss; celery may replace cilantro if preferred.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air terpisah dengan sedikit garam dan masak mi sesuai jenisnya, lalu tiriskan. Masukkan ke mangkuk, beri saus cabai kacang hitam fermentasi dan daun ketumbar, lalu aduk; seledri dapat menggantikan daun ketumbar bila diinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished fermented black bean chili noodles topped with glossy spicy sauce and fresh cilantro in a bowl, dramatic warm food photography, no text.

description.zh: 將豆包、根莖蔬菜和菇類逐一煎香，以低筋麵粉、植物奶與水煮成濃滑醬汁，最後加入花椰菜燉煮。
description.en: Tofu puffs, root vegetables, and mushrooms are browned in stages, then made into a creamy sauce with low-protein flour, plant milk, and water before finishing with broccoli.
description.id: Tahu puff, sayuran akar, dan jamur dipanggang bertahap, lalu dibuat menjadi saus lembut dengan tepung rendah protein, susu nabati, dan air sebelum diselesaikan dengan brokoli.

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔去皮切均勻塊；蘑菇切四等份，豆包切塊，花椰菜切成小朵。若花椰菜梗較粗，削去外皮後一併切片使用。
instruction.en: Peel potatoes and carrots and cut into even chunks. Quarter the mushrooms, cut tofu puffs into pieces, and divide broccoli into small florets. If the broccoli stems are thick, peel their outer skin and slice them for the stew.
instruction.id: Kupas kentang dan wortel lalu potong menjadi ukuran seragam. Potong jamur menjadi empat, potong tahu puff, dan pisahkan brokoli menjadi kuntum kecil. Jika batang brokoli tebal, kupas kulit luarnya lalu iris untuk digunakan dalam semur.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Overhead view of peeled potato and carrot chunks, quartered button mushrooms, cubed tofu puffs, broccoli florets with sliced peeled stems, and shelled edamame arranged separately on a wooden board for a vegan Japanese cream stew. Raw preparation only, no pot, sauce, cooked food, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 燉鍋倒入食用油，先將豆包煎至金黃酥香後盛起；再煎馬鈴薯、紅蘿蔔和蘑菇，讓各面帶有金黃色的油煎香氣。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a stew pot and first brown the tofu puffs until golden and crisp, then set them aside. Sear the potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms until their surfaces develop golden fried flavour.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam panci semur dan panggang tahu puff terlebih dahulu hingga keemasan serta renyah, lalu sisihkan. Panggang kentang, wortel, dan jamur sampai permukaannya berwarna keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. No sauce or cream yet; strictly vegan, no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 待蘑菇縮小並釋出水分後，撒入低筋麵粉拌炒；倒入植物奶和水攪勻，加入黑胡椒、鹽和月桂葉調味，煮至湯汁濃滑。
instruction.en: Once the mushrooms have shrunk and released their moisture, sprinkle in low-protein flour and stir. Pour in plant milk and water, season with black pepper, salt, and bay leaf, then cook until the sauce turns creamy.
instruction.id: Setelah jamur menyusut dan mengeluarkan cairan, taburkan tepung rendah protein lalu aduk. Tuang susu nabati dan air, bumbui dengan lada hitam, garam, serta daun salam, lalu masak hingga saus menjadi lembut.

title.en: Add broccoli and finish the stew

instruction.zh: 放回煎好的豆包，加入花椰菜和毛豆；煮滾後轉小火燉約五分鐘，至花椰菜熟而仍保有口感即可盛出。
instruction.en: Return the browned tofu puffs and add broccoli and edamame. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low for about five minutes, until the broccoli is cooked but still has texture, before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali tahu puff yang telah dipanggang, lalu tambahkan brokoli dan edamame. Didihkan, kemudian rebus dengan api kecil sekitar lima menit sampai brokoli matang tetapi masih bertekstur, lalu sajikan.

description.zh: 以白金針菇與薑片少油煸香，加入薑黃、豆腐、黃豆粉與絲瓜煮成的清爽全素湯品。
description.en: A light vegan soup of loofah and tofu, built by lightly sautéing white beech mushrooms and ginger, then simmering with turmeric and soybean powder.
description.id: Sup vegan ringan dari gambas dan tahu, dibuat dengan menumis ringan jamur beech putih serta jahe, lalu dididihkan bersama kunyit dan bubuk kedelai.

instruction.zh: 白金針菇撕成細束；老薑切片，豆腐切塊。絲瓜先沖洗再削皮，保留些許綠皮並切滾刀塊。
instruction.en: Pull white beech mushrooms into thin clusters, slice mature ginger, and cube the tofu. Rinse the loofah before peeling, leave a little green skin, and cut into rolling chunks.
instruction.id: Suwir jamur beech putih menjadi rumpun kecil, iris jahe tua, dan potong tahu dadu. Bilas gambas sebelum dikupas, sisakan sedikit kulit hijau, lalu potong serong besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of white beech mushroom clusters, sliced ginger, tofu cubes, and partially peeled loofah chunks on a prep board, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加入少許油，以中火煸香白金針菇和薑片，炒至菇類帶金黃香氣。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of oil to a pot and sauté the white beech mushrooms and ginger over medium heat until the mushrooms become fragrant and lightly golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak ke panci dan tumis jamur beech putih serta jahe dengan api sedang hingga jamur harum dan agak keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of white beech mushrooms and ginger slices gently sautéing in a small amount of oil, no text.

title.en: Bloom turmeric and build the broth

instruction.zh: 加入少許薑黃粉快速拌炒至沒有粉感，立即倒入1000毫升水；加入豆腐、少許鹽與黃豆粉，攪勻煮滾。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of turmeric powder and stir quickly until no dry powder remains, then immediately pour in 1000 ml water. Add tofu, a little salt, and soybean powder, stir well, and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit bubuk kunyit dan aduk cepat hingga tidak ada bubuk kering, lalu segera tuang 1000 ml air. Masukkan tahu, sedikit garam, dan bubuk kedelai, aduk rata, lalu didihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of golden turmeric broth with tofu cubes and soybean powder being stirred in a soup pot, no text.

instruction.zh: 湯滾後放入絲瓜，煮至內側白色部分剛變軟即可，約兩分鐘；喜歡更軟可稍延長，但避免久煮至纖維變老。
instruction.en: Once the soup boils, add loofah and cook until its pale inner flesh just softens, about two minutes. Cook a little longer if desired, but avoid overcooking until fibrous.
instruction.id: Setelah sup mendidih, masukkan gambas dan masak hingga bagian dalamnya yang pucat baru lunak, sekitar dua menit. Masak sedikit lebih lama bila suka, tetapi hindari terlalu lama hingga berserat.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of fresh green loofah chunks simmering in clear golden tofu soup, just tender and vibrant, no text.

title.en: Finish with black pepper and serve
title.id: Akhiri dengan lada hitam dan sajikan

instruction.zh: 關火前撒少許黑胡椒粉提香，試味後盛入湯碗，趁熱享用或搭配麵條、粥品食用。
instruction.en: Before turning off the heat, sprinkle in a little ground black pepper for aroma. Taste, ladle into bowls, and serve hot alone or with noodles or porridge.
instruction.id: Menjelang api dimatikan, taburkan sedikit lada hitam bubuk untuk aroma. Cicipi, tuang ke mangkuk, dan sajikan hangat sendiri atau dengan mi maupun bubur.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished loofah and tofu soup with white beech mushrooms in a simple ceramic bowl, clear golden broth and black pepper, no text.

title.zh: 滷高麗菜神招不用大量醬料也能香到不行
title.en: Fragrant Braised Cabbage with Less Soy Sauce
title.id: Kol Rebus Harum dengan Sedikit Kecap

description.zh: 先煎出高麗菜焦香，再以薑、香菇、昆布、香菇水和少量醬油小火滷出清甜風味。
description.en: Cabbage is first seared for deep fragrance, then gently braised with ginger, shiitake, kombu, mushroom soaking water, and a small amount of soy sauce.
description.id: Kol dipanggang terlebih dahulu untuk aroma panggang yang kuat, lalu direbus perlahan dengan jahe, shiitake, kombu, air rendaman jamur, dan sedikit kecap asin.

title.en: Prepare ingredients and reserve mushroom water
title.id: Siapkan bahan dan simpan air jamur

instruction.zh: 乾香菇以冷水泡發，保留香菇水；香菇與老薑切絲。紅蘿蔔切半月片，高麗菜保留菜心切成三等份後洗淨。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake in cold water and reserve the soaking water; shred the shiitake and mature ginger. Cut the carrot into half-moons, and cut the cabbage into three wedges with the core intact before washing.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake kering dalam air dingin dan sisihkan air rendamannya; iris memanjang shiitake serta jahe tua. Potong wortel berbentuk setengah bulan, lalu potong kol menjadi tiga bagian sambil menjaga bonggolnya tetap utuh sebelum dicuci.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of three pale-green cabbage wedges with cores intact beside carrot half-moons, fine mature-ginger shreds, soaked sliced shiitake, and a small clear bowl of mushroom soaking water. Constraints: strictly vegan; no kombu, soy sauce, cooked cabbage, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入食用油，鋪上高麗菜並撒少量鹽，煎至表面深褐、菜葉出水軟化後取出。
instruction.en: Pour cooking oil into a flat pan, lay in the cabbage, and sprinkle with a little salt. Sear until the surface is deep brown and the leaves release moisture and soften, then remove.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak goreng ke wajan datar, letakkan kol, lalu taburi sedikit garam. Panggang hingga permukaannya cokelat tua dan daun mengeluarkan air serta lunak, kemudian angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of thick cabbage wedges searing in a lightly oiled skillet, with deeply caramelized brown cut surfaces and softened leaf edges. Constraints: strictly vegan; no carrot, mushrooms, broth, finished plated dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 原鍋補少量油，煸炒薑絲、香菇絲和紅蘿蔔至微焦。放回高麗菜，加入昆布、香菇水、水和醬油，讓液體約至高麗菜一半高度並將昆布浸在湯中。
instruction.en: Add a little more oil to the same pan and fry ginger, shiitake, and carrot until lightly browned. Return the cabbage, add kombu, mushroom soaking water, water, and soy sauce, bringing the liquid to about halfway up the cabbage and submerging the kombu.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak lagi ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe, shiitake, serta wortel hingga sedikit kecokelatan. Masukkan kembali kol, tambahkan kombu, air rendaman jamur, air, dan kecap asin hingga cairan mencapai kira-kira setengah tinggi kol dan kombu terendam.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of browned cabbage wedges beginning to braise in a shallow pan of clear amber broth with submerged kombu, carrot half-moons, ginger shreds and sliced shiitake, liquid reaching halfway up the cabbage. Constraints: strictly vegan; no finished bowl, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 蓋鍋煮滾後轉小火滷十五分鐘。開蓋夾出昆布，即可連同清甜湯汁盛盤。
instruction.en: Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and braise for fifteen minutes. Uncover, remove the kombu, and plate the cabbage with its lightly sweet broth.
instruction.id: Tutup panci dan didihkan, lalu kecilkan api dan rebus perlahan selama lima belas menit. Buka tutupnya, angkat kombu, lalu sajikan kol bersama kuahnya yang manis ringan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of finished tender braised cabbage wedges served with carrot and shiitake in a shallow bowl of light amber broth, glossy caramelized edges still visible. Constraints: strictly vegan; no kombu strip, meat, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 將五穀飯與茄子、白花椰菜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒和蘆筍分批炒香，加入紫菜、白芝麻與鹽完成的全素能量飯。
description.en: Multigrain rice is stir-fried with eggplant, cauliflower, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and asparagus in stages, then finished with nori, white sesame, and salt.
description.id: Nasi multibijian ditumis bertahap bersama terong, kembang kol, wortel, paprika kuning, dan asparagus, lalu diselesaikan dengan nori, wijen putih, serta garam.

instruction.zh: 將茄子、黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、白花椰菜和蘆筍全部切成小丁，讓它們受熱均勻；老薑切末，紫菜捏碎備用。
instruction.en: Cut eggplant, yellow bell pepper, carrot, cauliflower, and asparagus into small even pieces for even cooking. Mince the mature ginger and crumble the nori for later.
instruction.id: Potong terong, paprika kuning, wortel, kembang kol, dan asparagus menjadi dadu kecil yang seragam agar matang merata. Cincang jahe tua dan remukkan nori untuk digunakan kemudian.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Overhead view of colourful small dice of eggplant, cauliflower, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and asparagus arranged with minced mature ginger and crumbled nori on a wooden board, ready for vegan multigrain energy rice. Raw preparation only, no wok, no cooked rice, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Fry ginger and firm vegetables first
title.id: Tumis jahe dan sayur keras terlebih dahulu

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入食用油，先煸炒薑末至香氣釋出；加入紅蘿蔔和白花椰菜，炒至表面微黃、帶有煸香。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a wok and fry the minced ginger until fragrant. Add carrot and cauliflower, then stir-fry until their surfaces are lightly golden and aromatic.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan dan tumis jahe cincang hingga harum. Masukkan wortel serta kembang kol, lalu tumis hingga permukaannya sedikit keemasan dan harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Tight three-quarter overhead view inside a wok: minced mature ginger sizzling in a little oil with diced carrot and cauliflower, their edges just lightly golden. No eggplant, pepper, asparagus, nori, rice, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入茄子、黃甜椒和蘆筍，持續翻炒至茄子變軟、蔬菜熟透。放入捏碎紫菜拌炒，讓海苔香氣融入薑油與蔬菜。
instruction.en: Add eggplant, yellow bell pepper, and asparagus, continuing to stir-fry until the eggplant softens and the vegetables are cooked. Add crumbled nori and toss so its sea aroma combines with the ginger oil and vegetables.
instruction.id: Masukkan terong, paprika kuning, dan asparagus, lalu terus tumis hingga terong lunak serta sayuran matang. Tambahkan nori yang diremukkan dan aduk agar aroma lautnya menyatu dengan minyak jahe serta sayuran.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. No rice or sesame yet; strictly vegan, no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Fold in multigrain rice and season

instruction.zh: 加入煮好的五穀飯拌炒至均勻受熱，撒入白芝麻和鹽，炒香後立即盛盤。
instruction.en: Add cooked multigrain rice and stir-fry until evenly heated. Sprinkle in white sesame seeds and salt, toss until fragrant, and plate immediately.
instruction.id: Masukkan nasi multibijian matang dan tumis hingga panas merata. Taburkan biji wijen putih serta garam, aduk hingga harum, lalu segera sajikan.

title.id: Hidangan Tinggi Protein untuk Defisit Lemak

description.zh: 以汆燙豆包搭配黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、番茄與九層塔，拌入芥末烏醋醬汁的清爽高蛋白全素涼拌菜。
description.en: A refreshing high-protein vegan salad of blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, tomato, and Thai basil, tossed in a wasabi-black-vinegar dressing.
description.id: Salad vegan tinggi protein yang menyegarkan dari kulit tahu rebus, paprika kuning, wortel, tomat, dan kemangi Thailand, diaduk dengan saus wasabi cuka hitam.

title.zh: 切成一致的蔬菜與豆包條
title.en: Cut tofu skin and vegetables into strips
title.id: Potong kulit tahu dan sayuran memanjang

instruction.zh: 豆包切成粗條；黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔與九層塔切絲，番茄切小丁，大辣椒切末，讓食材大小容易一起拌勻。
instruction.en: Cut tofu skin into thick strips. Julienne yellow bell pepper, carrot, and Thai basil; dice the tomato and mince the large chili so the ingredients can be tossed evenly.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu memanjang agak tebal. Iris tipis paprika kuning, wortel, dan kemangi Thailand; potong tomat dadu kecil dan cincang cabai besar agar bahan mudah diaduk rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of tofu skin strips, julienned yellow pepper and carrot, Thai basil, diced tomato, and minced chili on a prep board, no text.

title.en: Blanch and chill the tofu skin
title.id: Rebus sebentar dan dinginkan kulit tahu

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，放入豆包汆燙約30至40秒後撈起；想馬上吃冰涼口感時，將豆包放入冰水冰鎮。
instruction.en: Bring water with a little salt to a boil and blanch the tofu skin for about 30 to 40 seconds, then remove it. For an immediately chilled texture, transfer the tofu skin to ice water.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dengan sedikit garam dan rebus kulit tahu sekitar 30 hingga 40 detik, lalu angkat. Untuk tekstur dingin, pindahkan kulit tahu ke air es.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of tofu skin strips being lifted from boiling water toward a bowl of ice water, no text.

instruction.zh: 將汆燙後瀝乾的豆包與黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、九層塔、番茄丁和辣椒末全部放入大碗。
instruction.en: Place the drained blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, Thai basil, diced tomato, and minced chili together in a large bowl.
instruction.id: Masukkan kulit tahu rebus yang telah ditiriskan, paprika kuning, wortel, kemangi Thailand, tomat dadu, dan cabai cincang ke dalam mangkuk besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of colorful tofu skin salad ingredients gathered in a large mixing bowl before dressing, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、烏醋、香油和糖；喜歡微嗆清爽感可加入少許芥末，不吃辣則省略。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar. Add a little wasabi for a refreshing pungent note if desired, or omit it if you do not eat spicy foods.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, dan gula. Tambahkan sedikit wasabi bila ingin rasa segar yang menyengat, atau hilangkan jika tidak makan pedas.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of dark vinegar-soy dressing with sesame oil and a small dab of wasabi being mixed in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Toss thoroughly and chill before serving
title.id: Aduk rata lalu dinginkan sebelum disajikan

instruction.zh: 將所有食材與醬汁充分拌勻，讓豆包和蔬菜均勻入味；可立刻享用，或冷藏後再吃以獲得更冰涼開胃的口感。
instruction.en: Toss all ingredients thoroughly with the dressing so the tofu skin and vegetables are evenly seasoned. Serve immediately, or refrigerate before eating for a colder, more appetizing texture.
instruction.id: Aduk semua bahan hingga rata dengan saus agar kulit tahu dan sayuran berbumbu merata. Sajikan segera, atau dinginkan terlebih dahulu untuk tekstur yang lebih dingin dan menggugah selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished high-protein tofu skin salad with yellow pepper, carrot, tomato, Thai basil, and glossy dressing in a glass bowl, no text.

description.zh: 以豆包、杏鮑菇和腐皮捲做出植物版雞肉，搭配椰奶薑黃飯與薑蓉、甜醬油、辣椒三款醬料。
description.en: Tofu puffs, king oyster mushrooms, and tofu skin rolls form plant-based chicken, served with coconut turmeric rice and three sauces: ginger, sweet soy, and chilli.
description.id: Tahu puff, jamur king oyster, dan gulungan kulit tahu membentuk ayam nabati, disajikan dengan nasi kunyit santan serta tiga saus: jahe, kecap manis, dan cabai.

instruction.zh: 杏鮑菇切薄片，豆包與腐皮撕成相近大小。與醬油、味醂、胡椒粉和椰漿抓拌均勻，靜置醃約十五分鐘。
instruction.en: Slice king oyster mushrooms thinly and tear tofu puffs and tofu skin into similar-sized pieces. Toss with soy sauce, mirin, ground pepper, and coconut milk, then marinate for about fifteen minutes.
instruction.id: Iris tipis jamur king oyster dan sobek tahu puff serta kulit tahu berukuran serupa. Aduk dengan kecap asin, mirin, lada bubuk, dan santan, lalu marinasi sekitar lima belas menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead-close preparation photograph of thin king oyster mushroom slices, torn tofu puffs, and torn tofu skin in a ceramic mixing bowl, evenly coated with a pale-brown marinade of soy sauce, mirin, ground pepper, and coconut milk and resting for fifteen minutes. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice paper, frying pan, cooked roll, rice, sauce bowls, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將兩杯白米加入一點八杯水與零點二杯椰漿，再加入薑黃粉、胡椒粉、香油和鹽拌勻，放入電鍋蒸熟。
instruction.en: Combine two cups of white rice with 1.8 cups water and 0.2 cup coconut milk. Mix in ground turmeric, ground pepper, sesame oil, and salt, then cook in an electric cooker until done.
instruction.id: Campurkan dua cangkir beras putih dengan 1,8 cangkir air dan 0,2 cangkir santan. Aduk kunyit bubuk, lada bubuk, minyak wijen, dan garam, lalu masak dalam penanak listrik hingga matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no plant-chicken roll, sauces, vegetables, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Wrap and pan-fry the plant chicken

instruction.zh: 將兩張泡濕米紙疊起，放入醃好的豆包和杏鮑菇捲緊，外層再包腐皮並用醃汁封口。平底鍋加油，以小火慢煎至表面金黃、內餡熟透。
instruction.en: Stack two moistened rice-paper sheets, fill with marinated tofu puffs and king oyster mushrooms, roll tightly, then wrap in tofu skin and seal with marinade. Pan-fry in oil over low heat until the surface is golden and the filling is cooked through.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua lembar kertas nasi yang dibasahi, isi dengan tahu puff serta jamur king oyster yang dimarinasi, gulung rapat, lalu bungkus dengan kulit tahu dan rekatkan memakai marinade. Panggang dengan minyak di api kecil sampai permukaannya keemasan dan isi matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of tightly wrapped vegan Hainanese plant-chicken rolls made from moistened rice paper, tofu puffs, king oyster mushrooms, and an outer tofu-skin layer, slowly pan-frying in a lightly oiled skillet until evenly crisp and golden. Constraints: strictly vegan; rolls remain whole and uncut, no rice, sauce bowls, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 薑泥與香菜末用油小火加熱，加胡椒鹽成薑蓉醬。醬油、味醂、香油和胡椒拌成甜醬油；辣椒、蘋果醋、味醂和醬油打碎成辣椒醬。將植物雞切片，配薑黃飯和三款醬上桌。
instruction.en: Gently heat ginger paste and chopped cilantro in oil with pepper salt for ginger sauce. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and pepper for sweet soy sauce; blend chilli, apple cider vinegar, mirin, and soy sauce for chilli sauce. Slice the plant chicken and serve with turmeric rice and all three sauces.
instruction.id: Panaskan perlahan pasta jahe dan daun ketumbar cincang dalam minyak bersama garam lada untuk saus jahe. Campurkan kecap asin, mirin, minyak wijen, dan lada untuk saus kecap manis; haluskan cabai, cuka apel, mirin, serta kecap asin untuk saus cabai. Iris ayam nabati dan sajikan bersama nasi kunyit serta ketiga saus.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no real chicken, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 以長糯米、紫米與紅藻苔芝麻醬蒸成香Q米糕，切塊後刷醬油膏並沾花生粉、香菜的全素夜市風點心。
description.en: A vegan night-market-style rice cake made by steaming long-grain glutinous rice and purple rice with a red-algae sesame sauce, then brushing with soy sauce paste and coating with peanut powder and cilantro.
description.id: Kue beras gaya jajanan malam vegan yang dibuat dengan mengukus beras ketan panjang dan beras ungu bersama saus alga merah wijen, lalu dioles pasta kecap asin dan dilapisi bubuk kacang serta daun ketumbar.

title.en: Soak and combine the two rices
title.id: Rendam dan campurkan dua jenis beras

instruction.zh: 將1杯長糯米和半杯紫米分別洗淨泡水至少4小時，天熱可冷藏浸泡；瀝乾後混合備用。
instruction.en: Wash and soak 1 cup long-grain glutinous rice and 1/2 cup purple rice separately for at least 4 hours; refrigerate while soaking in hot weather. Drain and combine them.
instruction.id: Cuci dan rendam 1 cangkir beras ketan panjang serta 1/2 cangkir beras ungu secara terpisah setidaknya 4 jam; simpan di lemari es saat cuaca panas. Tiriskan lalu campurkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of soaked white glutinous rice and purple rice being combined in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Blend the red algae sesame sauce

instruction.zh: 將紅藻苔、芝麻粉和糯米粉放入調理機，加入香油、胡椒鹽、胡椒粉與水，攪打成均勻細緻的醬汁。
instruction.en: Put red algae, sesame powder, and glutinous rice flour in a blender. Add sesame oil, seasoned pepper salt, ground pepper, and water, then blend into a smooth, even sauce.
instruction.id: Masukkan alga merah, bubuk wijen, dan tepung ketan ke blender. Tambahkan minyak wijen, garam lada berbumbu, lada bubuk, dan air, lalu haluskan menjadi saus yang rata serta lembut.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a deep purple-red sesame algae sauce blending smooth in a blender, no text.

title.zh: 拌勻米粒並入抹油容器
title.en: Coat rice and fill an oiled container
title.id: Lumuri beras dan masukkan ke wadah berminyak

instruction.zh: 將打好的醬汁倒入瀝乾的兩色米中，充分攪拌讓每粒米都吸收醬汁；耐熱容器抹少許油後，倒入米料並整平。
instruction.en: Pour the blended sauce over the drained mixed rices and stir thoroughly so every grain absorbs it. Lightly oil a heat-safe container, then add the rice mixture and level it.
instruction.id: Tuang saus halus ke dalam campuran beras yang sudah ditiriskan dan aduk rata agar setiap butir menyerap saus. Olesi tipis wadah tahan panas, lalu masukkan campuran beras dan ratakan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of purple rice and glutinous rice coated in savory sauce being packed into a lightly oiled heat-safe glass container, no text.

title.en: Steam with two cups of water and rest
title.id: Kukus dengan dua cangkir air lalu diamkan

instruction.zh: 電鍋內放隔熱架和容器，外鍋加入2杯水蒸至跳起；跳起後再燜約10分鐘，取出後讓米糕冷卻並逐漸定型。
instruction.en: Place a trivet and the container in an electric cooker, add 2 cups water to the outer pot, and steam until it switches off. Rest for about 10 more minutes, then remove and let the rice cake cool and firm.
instruction.id: Letakkan tatakan dan wadah di rice cooker listrik, tambahkan 2 cangkir air ke panci luar, lalu kukus hingga alat mati. Diamkan sekitar 10 menit lagi, kemudian keluarkan dan biarkan kue beras mendingin serta mengeras.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a purple steamed rice cake in a heat-safe container inside an electric cooker with rising steam, no text.

instruction.zh: 米糕表面凝結後，以抹油小刀沿邊脫模，切成三角或喜歡的形狀；刷醬油膏，可加辣椒醬，再沾花生粉並撒香菜享用。
instruction.en: Once the surface has set, run an oiled knife around the edge to unmold and cut into triangles or preferred shapes. Brush with soy sauce paste, add chili sauce if desired, coat with peanut powder, and finish with cilantro.
instruction.id: Setelah permukaan mengeras, gunakan pisau berminyak di sekeliling tepi untuk mengeluarkan kue lalu potong menjadi segitiga atau bentuk pilihan. Oles pasta kecap asin, tambahkan saus cabai bila diinginkan, lapisi bubuk kacang, dan akhiri dengan daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan purple rice blood cake triangles brushed with glossy sauce, coated in peanut powder, and topped with cilantro, no text.

description.zh: 以豆腐、百頁豆腐、金針菇、馬蹄和天貝做成扎實內餡，以千張包捲後半煎炸至金黃酥脆。
description.en: A substantial filling of tofu, tofu sheets, enoki, water chestnuts, and tempeh is wrapped in tofu skin and shallow-fried until golden and crisp.
description.id: Isian padat dari tahu, tofu lembaran, enoki, bengkuang air, dan tempeh dibungkus kulit tahu lalu digoreng dangkal hingga keemasan serta renyah.

instruction.zh: 板豆腐先吸乾水分後搗碎；百頁豆腐切小塊。將金針菇、紅蘿蔔、馬蹄、芹菜和香菜全部切碎，天貝切成長條。
instruction.en: Press moisture from firm tofu and crumble it; cut tofu sheets into small pieces. Finely chop enoki, carrot, water chestnuts, celery, and cilantro, then cut tempeh into long strips.
instruction.id: Keringkan tahu padat lalu hancurkan; potong tofu lembaran kecil-kecil. Cincang enoki, wortel, bengkuang air, seledri, dan daun ketumbar, kemudian potong tempeh memanjang.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Overhead view on a wooden board of crumbled pressed tofu, small cubes of hundred-page tofu, finely chopped enoki mushrooms, carrot, water chestnuts, celery, and cilantro, plus long tempeh strips arranged separately for a vegan Taiwanese chicken-roll filling. Raw preparation only, no wrappers, no wok, no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋煎天貝至每面金黃酥脆，撒胡椒鹽後盛起。原鍋炒豆腐和金針菇至水分收乾，再加入百頁豆腐與紅蘿蔔炒至金黃；以醬油、胡椒、香油、糖和鹽調味，拌入芹菜、馬蹄、香菜與玉米粉。
instruction.en: Pan-fry tempeh until golden and crisp on every side, season with pepper salt, and set aside. In the same pan cook tofu and enoki until dry, add tofu sheets and carrot until golden, season with soy sauce, pepper, sesame oil, sugar, and salt, then mix in celery, water chestnuts, cilantro, and cornstarch.
instruction.id: Panggang tempeh sampai keemasan serta renyah di setiap sisi, bumbui garam lada, lalu sisihkan. Di wajan yang sama masak tahu dan enoki sampai kering, tambahkan tofu lembaran serta wortel hingga keemasan, bumbui kecap asin, lada, minyak wijen, gula, serta garam, lalu campurkan seledri, bengkuang air, daun ketumbar, dan tepung maizena.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Close three-quarter overhead view of a skillet: two long tempeh strips are golden and crisp at the side, while a dry, fragrant vegan filling of crumbled tofu, enoki, hundred-page tofu, carrot, celery, water chestnuts, and cilantro cooks separately. No wrappers or fried rolls yet; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 麵粉加水和少量鹽調成可黏合的麵粉糊。千張抹上麵粉糊，鋪餡料並在中間放兩條天貝，兩側各預留約十公分；捲緊後封口，將兩端扭緊回收。
instruction.en: Mix flour with water and a little salt into a sticky paste. Brush tofu skin with paste, spread on filling, and place two tempeh strips in the centre, leaving about ten centimetres at both sides; roll tightly, seal, and twist the ends inward.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung, air, dan sedikit garam menjadi pasta perekat. Oleskan pada kulit tahu, ratakan isian, lalu taruh dua strip tempeh di tengah dan sisakan sekitar sepuluh sentimeter di kedua sisi; gulung rapat, rekatkan, lalu putar ujungnya ke dalam.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. One cutaway shows its tofu-and-vegetable filling and central tempeh strip. No oil, no frying pan, no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入約半鍋高度的油，加熱至約一百四十至一百五十度。放入雞捲以中低溫慢慢半煎炸，至千張外皮金黃酥脆後撈出切片。
instruction.en: Fill a flat pan with oil to about halfway and heat to roughly 140–150°C. Shallow-fry the rolls slowly over medium-low heat until the tofu-skin exterior is golden and crisp, then lift out and slice.
instruction.id: Isi wajan datar dengan minyak hingga kira-kira setengah tinggi dan panaskan sekitar 140–150°C. Goreng dangkal gulungan perlahan dengan api sedang-kecil sampai kulit tahu berwarna keemasan serta renyah, lalu angkat dan iris.

title.zh: 全素海鮮什錦炒麵，簡單快炒出餐廳級美味
title.en: One-Pan Vegan Seafood-Style Mixed Fried Noodles
title.id: Mi Goreng Campur Gaya Seafood Vegan Satu Wajan

description.zh: 以香菇、杏鮑菇、豆乾片和多種蔬菜模擬海鮮外觀口感，與油麵一鍋快炒的全素什錦炒麵。
description.en: A one-pan vegan seafood-style mixed fried noodle dish using mushrooms, king oyster mushrooms, tofu sheets, and vegetables to mimic seafood looks and textures.
description.id: Mi goreng campur gaya seafood vegan satu wajan yang memakai jamur, jamur tiram raja, lembaran tahu, dan sayuran untuk meniru tampilan serta tekstur seafood.

title.zh: 切配海鮮感蔬菜與菇類
title.id: Siapkan sayuran dan jamur gaya seafood

instruction.zh: 香菇切片，木耳和紅蘿蔔切絲，高麗菜切寬絲，芹菜去葉切段；杏鮑菇切片後挖去中央，做成圈狀口感。
instruction.en: Slice the shiitake mushrooms; julienne the wood ear mushrooms and carrot; cut cabbage into wide shreds; remove celery leaves and cut stems into segments. Slice king oyster mushrooms and remove their centers to make ring-like pieces.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake; iris tipis jamur kuping dan wortel; potong kol menjadi irisan lebar; buang daun seledri dan potong batangnya. Iris jamur tiram raja lalu keluarkan bagian tengahnya agar berbentuk cincin.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of sliced shiitake, shredded vegetables, celery stems, and ring-shaped king oyster mushrooms prepared for vegan seafood-style noodles, no text.

title.en: Cut tofu sheets into squid-style strips

instruction.zh: 豆乾片切成較寬的長條，保留些許厚度，讓快炒後有類似魷魚條的咀嚼感；杏鮑菇挖出的中心也保留使用。
instruction.en: Cut tofu sheets into fairly wide strips, keeping some thickness so they develop a squid-strip-like chew when stir-fried. Reserve the removed king oyster mushroom centers as well.
instruction.id: Potong lembaran tahu menjadi potongan memanjang cukup lebar dan agak tebal agar setelah ditumis terasa kenyal seperti potongan cumi. Simpan juga bagian tengah jamur tiram raja yang dikeluarkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of wide tofu sheet strips and king oyster mushroom centers arranged as vegan seafood-style components, no text.

title.id: Tumis shiitake dan bagian tengah jamur

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少許油，放入鮮香菇與杏鮑菇中心煸炒至金黃香氣出來，作為炒麵的鮮味基底。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to a wok and sauté the fresh shiitake and king oyster mushroom centers until golden and fragrant to build the savory base for the noodles.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak ke wajan dan tumis shiitake segar serta bagian tengah jamur tiram raja hingga keemasan dan harum sebagai dasar gurih mi.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of shiitake mushrooms and king oyster mushroom centers browning in a wok with a little oil, no text.

title.zh: 分批炒軟蔬菜與素海鮮配料
title.en: Stir-fry vegetables and vegan seafood components
title.id: Tumis sayuran dan komponen seafood vegan

instruction.zh: 先加入紅蘿蔔絲與豆乾片炒至紅蘿蔔變軟，再加入高麗菜、木耳與杏鮑菇圈翻炒至蔬菜軟化但仍保有口感。
instruction.en: First add carrot shreds and tofu sheet strips and stir-fry until the carrot softens. Then add cabbage, wood ear mushrooms, and king oyster mushroom rings, tossing until tender while retaining texture.
instruction.id: Masukkan terlebih dahulu wortel serut dan potongan lembaran tahu, lalu tumis hingga wortel lunak. Tambahkan kol, jamur kuping, dan cincin jamur tiram raja, lalu aduk hingga lunak tetapi tetap bertekstur.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of colorful vegetables, tofu sheet strips, and king oyster mushroom rings stir-frying together in a wok, no text.

title.en: Add oil noodles and stir-fry until absorbed
title.id: Masukkan mi minyak dan tumis hingga meresap

instruction.zh: 加入油麵與芹菜段翻炒，視鍋中乾濕度加入少量水，持續拌炒至麵條均勻吸附鍋中香氣並熱透後盛盤。
instruction.en: Add the oil noodles and celery segments and stir-fry. Add a small amount of water if the pan is dry, then keep tossing until the noodles evenly absorb the wok flavors and are heated through before plating.
instruction.id: Masukkan mi minyak dan potongan seledri lalu tumis. Tambahkan sedikit air jika wajan kering, kemudian terus aduk hingga mi menyerap rasa dari wajan secara merata dan panas sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished one-pan vegan seafood-style mixed fried noodles with tofu strips, mushroom rings, vegetables, and celery in a deep plate, no text.

title.zh: 純素羹湯口感一模一樣
title.id: Sup Sirip Hiu Gaya Taiwan Vegan

description.zh: 乾香菇、乾絲與紅蘿蔔煸香後，加入粉絲、木耳和金針菇煮成濃郁滑順的全素羹湯。
description.en: Dried shiitake, shredded tofu, and carrot are sautéed before glass noodles, wood ear, and enoki become a rich, silky vegan Taiwanese soup.
description.id: Shiitake kering, tahu iris, dan wortel ditumis sebelum soun, jamur kuping, dan enoki menjadi sup Taiwan vegan yang kaya serta lembut.

instruction.zh: 乾香菇和粉絲泡水，保留香菇水；香菇擠乾後與木耳、紅蘿蔔切絲，香菜切末。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake and glass noodles, reserving the shiitake soaking water. Squeeze the shiitake dry, then shred it with wood ear and carrot; chop the cilantro.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake kering dan soun, sisihkan air rendaman shiitake. Peras shiitake hingga kering, lalu iris bersama jamur kuping dan wortel; cincang daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: preparation for Taiwanese vegan thick soup, with shredded shiitake mushrooms, shredded black wood ear mushrooms, thin carrot matchsticks, soaked translucent glass noodles, and chopped cilantro arranged in separate tidy piles on a clean wooden board, overhead food photograph. Constraints: fully vegan; only those ingredients; no tofu, enoki, broth, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 湯鍋倒油，先煸香香菇、紅蘿蔔和乾絲。加入香菇水、水、木耳、金針菇與粉絲，蓋鍋煮滾。
instruction.en: Heat oil in a soup pot and sauté shiitake, carrot, and shredded tofu until fragrant. Add shiitake soaking water, water, wood ear, enoki, and glass noodles, then cover and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dalam panci sup dan tumis shiitake, wortel, serta tahu iris hingga harum. Tambahkan air rendaman shiitake, air, jamur kuping, enoki, dan soun, lalu tutup serta didihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: fully vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, cilantro garnish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 蓮藕粉與勾芡用水調勻，湯滾後慢慢倒入並持續攪拌至滑順濃稠。加入醬油、醬油膏、胡椒、香油、烏醋、香菜與少量鹽，拌勻盛碗。
instruction.en: Mix lotus root starch with slurry water; once the soup boils, pour it in slowly while stirring until silky and thick. Add soy sauce, soy paste, pepper, sesame oil, black vinegar, cilantro, and a little salt, then serve.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung akar teratai dengan air larutan; setelah sup mendidih, tuang perlahan sambil diaduk hingga lembut serta kental. Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap, lada, minyak wijen, cuka hitam, daun ketumbar, dan sedikit garam, lalu sajikan.
