instruction.zh: 將加熱好的麻婆豆腐與芝麻醬拌勻；嗜辣者可加入香辣辣椒油。若覺得辣，可加入嫩豆腐或喜歡的蔬菜調整。
instruction.en: Mix the heated mapo tofu with sesame paste; add fragrant chili oil if desired. If it is too spicy, add soft tofu or preferred vegetables.
instruction.id: Campurkan mapo tofu yang sudah dipanaskan dengan pasta wijen; tambahkan minyak cabai aromatik bila suka. Jika terlalu pedas, tambahkan tahu sutra atau sayuran pilihan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix red-oil dan dan noodle sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 滾水中加少量鹽，燙熟青菜後撈起；再將麵條煮熟。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water, cook the greens and remove them, then cook the noodles.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, masak sayuran hijau lalu angkat, kemudian masak mi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook noodles and greens”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Selesaikan mi dan dan minyak cabai

instruction.zh: 將一匙麵水加入麻婆芝麻醬，放入煮好的麵條拌勻，搭配青菜與堅果碎；可再淋香辣辣椒油。
instruction.en: Add 1 spoonful of noodle water to the mapo-sesame sauce, toss in the cooked noodles, and serve with greens and crushed nuts; add fragrant chili oil if desired.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 1 sendok air rebusan mi ke saus mapo-wijen, aduk bersama mi matang, lalu sajikan dengan sayuran hijau dan kacang cincang; tambahkan minyak cabai aromatik bila suka.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish red-oil dan dan noodles”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 滾水加入少量鹽與植物油，將義大利麵煮至約七分熟、中心仍略硬後撈起。不同品牌可依包裝時間調整。
instruction.en: Add a little salt and vegetable oil to boiling water. Cook spaghetti until about 70% done, with a slightly firm center, then remove; adjust for the package directions of the brand used.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam dan minyak nabati ke air mendidih. Masak spageti hingga sekitar 70% matang, dengan bagian tengah masih sedikit keras, lalu angkat; sesuaikan dengan petunjuk kemasan merek yang digunakan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook pasta until 70% done”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 以少量植物油將番茄炒軟，加入麻婆豆腐調理包與一匙煮麵水，煮至滾。
instruction.en: Soften tomato in a little vegetable oil, add the mapo tofu pouch and 1 spoonful of pasta water, then bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tumis tomat hingga lunak dengan sedikit minyak nabati, tambahkan pouch mapo tofu dan 1 sendok air rebusan pasta, lalu didihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook tomato mapo sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 收汁完成麻婆義大利麵

instruction.zh: 加入七分熟義大利麵，不斷翻炒至醬汁濃郁、收汁後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add the partially cooked spaghetti and toss continuously until the sauce becomes rich and reduced, then serve.
instruction.id: Tambahkan spageti yang setengah matang dan aduk terus hingga saus menjadi kaya serta menyusut, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Reduce and finish mapo pasta”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將紅蘿蔔、香菇與青菜切成小丁；備好熟飯。
instruction.en: Dice carrot, shiitake mushrooms, and greens; prepare cooked rice.
instruction.id: Potong dadu wortel, jamur shiitake, dan sayuran hijau; siapkan nasi matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare fried-rice components”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入少量植物油，先炒香紅蘿蔔與香菇至金黃；加入麻婆豆腐調理包與青菜，煮至青菜變軟，並以少量鹽調味。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok, sauté carrot and shiitake until golden, then add the mapo tofu pouch and greens. Cook until the greens soften and season with a little salt.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan, tumis wortel dan shiitake hingga keemasan, lalu tambahkan pouch mapo tofu dan sayuran hijau. Masak hingga sayuran lunak dan bumbui dengan sedikit garam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Stir-fry vegetables and mapo tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將處理好的麻婆豆腐蔬菜與熟飯拌炒，作為麻婆豆腐炒飯食用。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the prepared mapo tofu vegetables with cooked rice to serve as mapo tofu fried rice.
instruction.id: Tumis campuran sayuran mapo tofu yang telah disiapkan bersama nasi matang untuk disajikan sebagai nasi goreng mapo tofu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make mapo tofu fried rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: One-Pot Vegan Taro and “Lean Meat” Congee
title.id: Bubur Talas dan “Daging” Vegan Satu Panci

description.zh: 以冷凍豆腐做出純素瘦肉口感，配上芋頭、金針菇、老薑及1:8米水比例，一鍋煮成濃郁暖胃的古早味粥品。
description.en: Frozen tofu supplies the vegan “lean meat” texture in this warming taro congee, cooked with enoki, ginger and a 1:8 rice-to-water ratio.
description.id: Tahu beku memberi tekstur “daging” vegan pada bubur talas yang hangat ini, dimasak bersama enoki, jahe, serta perbandingan beras dan air 1:8.

title.zh: 炒香純素瘦肉與金針菇

instruction.zh: 把冷凍豆腐切成小塊，以少量植物油炒至表面乾身酥香，做出純素瘦肉口感；金針菇另炒至金黃，做出類似油蔥酥的香氣。
instruction.en: Cut the frozen tofu into small pieces and sauté in a little vegetable oil until dry and crisp on the outside, creating a vegan lean-meat texture. Separately brown the enoki until fragrant like fried shallots.
instruction.id: Potong tahu beku kecil-kecil lalu tumis dengan sedikit minyak nabati hingga permukaannya kering dan renyah untuk memberi tekstur seperti daging. Tumis enoki secara terpisah hingga kecokelatan dan harum seperti bawang goreng.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of small frozen-tofu pieces sautéed until dry, crisp and golden in one side of a pan, with finely separated enoki mushrooms browned deeply on the other side. Constraints: strictly vegan; no taro, rice, water, congee, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入芋頭、老薑、醬油及五香粉炒香，再倒入1杯洗淨白米略炒；加入8杯水拌勻煮滾。
instruction.en: Sauté the taro and mature ginger with soy sauce and five-spice until fragrant. Add 1 cup washed rice and stir briefly, then pour in 8 cups water and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tumis talas dan jahe tua bersama kecap asin serta bubuk lima rempah hingga harum. Masukkan 1 cangkir beras yang sudah dicuci dan aduk sebentar, lalu tuang 8 cangkir air dan didihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of cubed taro, ginger and white rice being briefly stir-fried in a deep pot with a light soy-and-five-spice coating just before water is added. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tofu, enoki, finished congee, garnish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 以小火煮20分鐘並間中攪拌，待米粒開花、芋頭軟化及粥身濃稠後，加入炒香的豆腐和金針菇，撒上芹菜粉及胡椒粉。
instruction.en: Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice blooms, the taro is tender and the congee is thick. Fold in the browned tofu and enoki, then finish with celery powder and ground pepper.
instruction.id: Masak dengan api kecil selama 20 menit sambil sesekali diaduk hingga beras mengembang, talas lunak, dan bubur mengental. Masukkan tahu serta enoki yang telah ditumis, lalu taburi bubuk seledri dan lada.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of thick Taiwanese taro congee in a ceramic bowl, with tender purple-speckled taro cubes, crisp golden tofu morsels and browned enoki on top, lightly dusted with celery and pepper. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, egg, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 花椰菜先炒至微焦，再與金黃豆干、香菇、辣豆瓣醬及辛香料大火炒出鍋氣。
description.en: Cauliflower is browned first, then wok-fried over high heat with golden dried tofu, shiitake, spicy bean paste, and aromatics.
description.id: Kembang kol ditumis kecokelatan lalu dimasak api besar bersama tahu kering, shiitake, pasta kacang pedas, dan bumbu aromatik.

instruction.zh: 花椰菜切成小朵，以植物油和鹽炒至邊緣微焦後先盛起。
instruction.en: Cut cauliflower into florets and stir-fry with vegetable oil and salt until lightly browned at the edges, then set aside.
instruction.id: Potong kembang kol menjadi kuntum lalu tumis dengan minyak sayur dan garam hingga tepinya kecokelatan, kemudian sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of white cauliflower florets stir-frying in a lightly oiled dark wok with a pinch of salt, edges visibly browned and slightly charred. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tofu, mushrooms, ginger, chili, sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Fry tofu, mushrooms, and spicy paste
title.id: Tumis tahu, jamur, dan pasta pedas

instruction.zh: 豆干與鮮香菇炒至金黃，再加入老薑、紅辣椒和辣豆瓣醬炒出香氣。
instruction.en: Sauté dried tofu and shiitake until golden, then add ginger, red chili, and spicy bean paste and fry until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu kering dan shiitake hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan jahe, cabai merah, dan pasta kacang pedas hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of golden dried tofu strips and sliced fresh shiitake sizzling in a wok with mature ginger, red chili and glossy spicy bean paste. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cauliflower, soy sauce, sugar, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Return and wok-fry over high heat
title.id: Masukkan kembali dan tumis api besar

instruction.zh: 花椰菜回鍋，加入醬油、糖與白胡椒粉，以大火快速翻炒至醬汁收乾並帶焦香鍋氣。
instruction.en: Return the cauliflower, add soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper, and toss over high heat until the sauce reduces and develops wok aroma.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali kembang kol, tambahkan kecap asin, gula, dan lada putih, lalu tumis api besar hingga saus menyusut dan harum wok.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: finished vegan dry-pot cauliflower in a dark wok, browned cauliflower florets tossed with golden dried tofu, shiitake, red chili, ginger and a reduced glossy spicy soy sauce, visible wok char. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, unrelated ingredients, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 用現成五穀飯吸收高麗菜、菇類、菜脯與豆腐炒出的鮮甜湯汁；金針菇帶出近似櫻花蝦的香氣，做成古早味的低脂純素高麗菜飯。
description.en: Cooked multigrain rice absorbs the sweet savory juices from cabbage, mushrooms, preserved radish, and tofu. Enoki provides an aroma reminiscent of dried sakura shrimp in this low-fat, old-fashioned vegan cabbage rice.
description.id: Nasi multibiji-bijian matang menyerap kuah gurih-manis dari kol, jamur, lobak asin, dan tahu. Enoki memberi aroma yang mengingatkan pada udang sakura kering dalam nasi kol vegan rendah lemak bergaya tradisional ini.

instruction.zh: 準備已煮好的五穀飯；影片說明也可改用糙米、紫米或白米。這樣可避免用生米時水量難抓，也讓蔬菜保留脆口。
instruction.en: Prepare cooked multigrain rice; the video says brown rice, purple rice, or white rice can be used instead. Using cooked rice avoids guessing the water for raw rice and helps the vegetables retain a crisp bite.
instruction.id: Siapkan nasi multibiji-bijian yang sudah matang; video menyebut nasi merah, nasi ungu, atau nasi putih juga dapat digunakan. Nasi matang menghindari kesulitan menakar air untuk beras mentah dan membantu sayuran tetap renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan recipe image of fluffy cooked multigrain rice in a bowl beside fresh cabbage and vegetables, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Prepare the vegetables, mushrooms, and preserved radish
title.id: Siapkan sayuran, jamur, dan lobak asin

instruction.zh: 高麗菜洗淨切條，紅蘿蔔切絲，鮮香菇切片，金針菇切小段，老薑切末。菜脯若偏鹹可先泡水約3分鐘；非常鹹則泡約10分鐘，不鹹只需沖洗。
instruction.en: Wash and shred the cabbage, julienne the carrot, slice the fresh shiitake, cut the enoki into short lengths, and mince the mature ginger. If the preserved radish is salty, soak it for about 3 minutes; if very salty, soak about 10 minutes; if not salty, simply rinse it.
instruction.id: Cuci lalu iris kol memanjang, potong wortel korek api, iris shiitake segar, potong enoki pendek-pendek, dan cincang jahe tua. Jika lobak asin terasa asin, rendam sekitar 3 menit; jika sangat asin, rendam sekitar 10 menit; jika tidak asin, cukup bilas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of shredded cabbage, julienned carrot, sliced shiitake, short enoki pieces, minced ginger and rinsed preserved radish, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Crumble and brown the firm tofu
title.id: Hancurkan dan tumis tahu padat hingga keemasan

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，將板豆腐直接捏碎或壓碎入鍋，炒成類似散蛋的碎粒並煸至金黃。影片指出也可依喜好改用豆乾。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pot, crumble or press the firm tofu directly into it, and fry it into egg-like crumbs until golden. The video notes that firm dried tofu can be substituted according to preference.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke panci, hancurkan atau tekan tahu padat langsung ke dalam panci, lalu tumis menjadi remahan seperti telur orak-arik hingga keemasan. Video menyebut tahu kering dapat digunakan sesuai selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan one-pot cooking image of firm tofu crumbled into golden egg-like bits in a pan with no eggs or meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Soften the cabbage and prepared ingredients
title.id: Lunakkan kol dan bahan yang telah disiapkan

instruction.zh: 將切好的高麗菜、紅蘿蔔、香菇、金針菇、菜脯和薑加入鍋中，拌炒至高麗菜變軟並釋出鮮甜湯汁。
instruction.en: Add the prepared cabbage, carrot, shiitake, enoki, preserved radish, and ginger to the pot. Stir-fry until the cabbage softens and releases sweet savory juices.
instruction.id: Masukkan kol, wortel, shiitake, enoki, lobak asin, dan jahe yang telah disiapkan ke dalam panci. Tumis hingga kol melunak dan mengeluarkan kuah gurih-manis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan one-pot stir-fry image of cabbage, carrot, shiitake, enoki, preserved radish and ginger softening around golden tofu crumbles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Fold in rice to absorb the juices

instruction.zh: 蔬菜炒軟後加入熟五穀飯，拌到每一粒米都吸收鍋中的湯汁。起鍋前試味，需要時才加少量鹽，拌勻即可。
instruction.en: Once the vegetables are soft, add the cooked multigrain rice and mix until every grain absorbs the juices in the pot. Taste before serving and add a little salt only if needed, then mix evenly.
instruction.id: Setelah sayuran lunak, masukkan nasi multibiji-bijian matang dan aduk hingga setiap butir nasi menyerap kuah di panci. Cicipi sebelum disajikan dan tambahkan sedikit garam hanya bila perlu, lalu aduk rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan cabbage rice in a warm bowl, distinct multigrain rice coated in savory cabbage and mushroom juices with golden tofu crumbles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Perkedel Kentang Rendah Lemak yang Sehat

description.zh:
超簡單易做的馬鈴薯煎餅
大人小孩都會愛！！！
超酥脆又香噴噴的
當下午的零嘴也適合
大家趕快動手試試看！！！
description.en: These potato patties are extremely simple to make and loved by adults and children alike. They are wonderfully crisp and fragrant, and are perfect as an afternoon snack. Give them a try!
description.id: Perkedel kentang ini sangat mudah dibuat dan disukai orang dewasa maupun anak-anak. Teksturnya sangat renyah dan harum, juga cocok sebagai camilan sore. Yuk, coba buat!

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔去皮後刨成絲；加入一點鹽，讓蔬菜出水並入味。大辣椒切斜片；也可用青龍椒，留作煎餅表面裝飾。
instruction.en: Peel and shred the potatoes and carrot. Add a little salt to draw out moisture and season them. Slice the large chili on the diagonal; shishito pepper can be used instead and is reserved to decorate the patty surface.
instruction.id: Kupas lalu parut kentang dan wortel. Tambahkan sedikit garam agar sayuran mengeluarkan air dan berbumbu. Iris cabai besar secara diagonal; cabai shishito dapat digunakan sebagai pengganti dan disisihkan untuk hiasan permukaan perkedel.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Shred and salt the vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Squeeze dry and mix the patty mixture
title.id: Peras hingga kering lalu campur adonan perkedel

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔出水後擠乾，移至大碗。刨入全素起司，加入營養酵母、低筋麵粉和胡椒粉，抓拌均勻。影片說明全素起司和營養酵母都可帶來奶香，可同時使用。
instruction.en: Once the potatoes and carrot have released moisture, squeeze them dry and transfer them to a large bowl. Grate in the vegan cheese, add nutritional yeast, cake flour, and ground pepper, then mix by hand until even. The video notes that vegan cheese and nutritional yeast both bring a dairy-like aroma and may be used together.
instruction.id: Setelah kentang dan wortel mengeluarkan air, peras hingga kering lalu pindahkan ke mangkuk besar. Parut keju vegan, tambahkan ragi nutrisi, tepung terigu protein rendah, dan lada bubuk, lalu aduk dengan tangan hingga rata. Video menjelaskan bahwa keju vegan dan ragi nutrisi sama-sama memberi aroma mirip susu dan dapat digunakan bersama.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Squeeze dry and mix the patty mixture”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Pan-fry until golden on both sides
title.id: Goreng pan hingga keemasan di kedua sisi

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加入植物油，放入馬鈴薯煎餅麵糰並壓上辣椒片或青龍椒片。煎至兩面金黃、表面定型且較容易翻面後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a skillet, add the potato-patty mixture, and press chili or shishito slices on top. Fry until both sides are golden and the surface has set enough to turn easily, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan datar, masukkan adonan perkedel kentang, lalu tekan irisan cabai atau shishito di atasnya. Goreng hingga kedua sisi keemasan dan permukaannya cukup padat agar mudah dibalik, lalu angkat dari wajan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry until golden on both sides”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Mix the optional all-purpose dipping sauce

instruction.zh: 若要搭配沾醬，將日式醬油、蘋果醋、味醂、韓式辣椒粉和白芝麻攪拌均勻。影片說明此醬也可搭配水餃、煎餅或冰鎮蕎麥麵。
instruction.en: For the dipping sauce, stir Japanese soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, mirin, Korean chili powder, and white sesame seeds together. The video says this sauce also works with dumplings, pancakes, or chilled soba noodles.
instruction.id: Untuk saus celup, aduk kecap asin Jepang, cuka apel, mirin, bubuk cabai Korea, dan biji wijen putih hingga rata. Video menyebut saus ini juga cocok untuk pangsit, perkedel, atau mi soba dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the optional all-purpose dipping sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 酸辣湯好喝秘訣簡單易學
title.id: Sup Asam Pedas Vegan Satu Panci

description.zh: 以番茄、木耳、菇類與多款豆製品熬煮，蓮藕粉勾芡並以烏醋收尾的暖胃全素酸辣湯。
description.en: A warming vegan hot-and-sour soup with tomato, mushrooms, assorted tofu, lotus-root-starch thickening, and black vinegar.
description.id: Sup asam pedas vegan hangat dengan tomat, jamur, aneka tahu, pengental pati akar teratai, dan cuka hitam.

instruction.zh: 將蔬菜與豆製品切絲或切丁；先把豆干及鮮香菇炒至金黃，再加入番茄、老薑、木耳和紅蘿蔔炒香。
instruction.en: Shred or dice the vegetables and tofu products. Sauté dried tofu and shiitake until golden, then add tomato, ginger, wood ear, and carrot.
instruction.id: Iris atau potong dadu sayur dan produk tahu. Tumis tahu kering serta shiitake hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan tomat, jahe, jamur kuping, dan wortel.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. steps.imagePrompt: Authentic food photography of Sauté peppercorns in oil (then remove), then fry the crispy tofu, mushrooms, and pickled vegetables111112., with accurate cooking textures and no text

instruction.zh: 加入調味料、豆腐片、水和植物奶（「骨湯」顏色濃鬱的秘訣），小火煮 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: . Add seasonings, tofu slices, water, and plant milk (the secret for a rich 'bone broth' color), simmering for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan bumbu, irisan tahu, air, dan susu nabati (rahasia warna 'kaldu tulang' yang kaya), didihkan selama 15 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Authentic food photography of Add seasonings, tofu slices, water, and plant milk (the secret for a rich 'bone broth' color), simmering for 15 minutes112113., with accurate cooking textures and no text

title.id: Nasi Siram Domba Vegan Saus Shacha

description.zh: 用煙燻豆包和鮮香菇梗做出帶嚼勁的全素「羊肉」，以素沙茶、辣豆瓣醬與香料熬成濃香燴汁，再配空心菜淋上白飯。
description.en: Smoked bean-curd sheets and shiitake stems make a chewy vegan “lamb,” simmered in a rich shacha and chili-bean sauce with water spinach and served over rice.
description.id: Lembaran tahu asap dan batang shiitake menjadi “domba” vegan yang kenyal, dimasak dalam saus shacha dan pasta cabai yang kaya rasa bersama kangkung, lalu disiramkan di atas nasi.

title.en: Prepare and marinate the bean curd

instruction.zh: 煙燻豆包用手撕成不規則薄片。鮮香菇去梗，菇傘切片；菇梗對半切後用手撥開但保留相連。豆包與菇梗拌入醃料用的醬油、五香粉和孜然粉，醃 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Tear the smoked bean-curd sheets into irregular thin pieces. Stem the shiitakes and slice the caps; split each stem lengthwise and pull it apart while leaving it partly joined. Mix the bean curd and stems with the marinade soy sauce, five-spice, and cumin, then marinate for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Sobek lembaran tahu asap menjadi potongan tipis tak beraturan. Pisahkan batang shiitake dan iris tudungnya; belah batang memanjang lalu renggangkan tanpa memutuskannya seluruhnya. Campur tahu dan batang jamur dengan kecap asin marinasi, bubuk ngohiong, serta jintan, lalu diamkan 15 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of irregular torn smoked bean-curd sheets and partly split shiitake stems in a shallow bowl, visibly coated with a light brown soy, cumin and five-spice marinade; sliced shiitake caps remain in a separate neat pile nearby. Constraints: strictly vegan; raw marinating stage only, no water spinach, chili, rice, cooked sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 老薑切絲，大辣椒斜切片；空心菜洗淨後切成小段。另將 1 大匙蓮藕粉與 10 大匙水攪勻成勾芡水備用。
instruction.en: Julienne the ginger, slice the chili diagonally, and cut the washed water spinach into short lengths. Separately, mix 1 tablespoon lotus-root starch with 10 tablespoons water to make a slurry.
instruction.id: Iris jahe memanjang tipis, iris cabai secara serong, lalu potong kangkung yang sudah dicuci menjadi ruas pendek. Di wadah terpisah, campur 1 sdm pati akar lotus dengan 10 sdm air hingga rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of neatly prepared julienned mature ginger, diagonally sliced red chili and short water-spinach segments on a cutting board, beside a small bowl of smooth pale lotus-root-starch slurry. Constraints: strictly vegan; prep stage only, no bean curd, mushrooms, rice, pan, cooked sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Brown the bean curd and mushrooms

instruction.zh: 鍋中加入麻油，把醃好的煙燻豆包和菇梗煎至焦黃後先盛起。原鍋放入薑絲和香菇片炒至金黃，再把豆包和菇梗回鍋。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil and brown the marinated bean curd and mushroom stems, then remove them temporarily. In the same pan, sauté the ginger and sliced shiitake until golden, then return the bean curd and stems.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen, kecokelatan tahu asap dan batang jamur yang telah dimarinasi, lalu angkat sementara. Tumis jahe dan irisan shiitake di wajan yang sama hingga keemasan, kemudian masukkan kembali tahu dan batang jamur.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of a black wok containing golden-browned irregular smoked bean-curd pieces, split shiitake stems and sliced shiitake caps with fine ginger strips, all dry-sautéed and lightly glossy with sesame oil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no water spinach, chili, sauce liquid, slurry, rice, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入調味用醬油、醬油膏、素沙茶醬、辣豆瓣醬、糖、胡椒粉和五香粉，以大火炒香。可沿鍋邊嗆入料理米酒，再加入 400 ml 水，熬煮約 5 分鐘。
instruction.en: Add the seasoning soy sauce, thick soy sauce, vegan shacha sauce, chili bean paste, sugar, pepper, and five-spice; stir-fry over high heat until aromatic. Optionally splash the rice wine around the edge, add 400 ml water, and simmer for about 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Masukkan kecap asin untuk bumbu, kecap asin kental, saus shacha vegan, pasta kacang cabai, gula, lada, dan bubuk ngohiong; tumis dengan api besar hingga harum. Jika digunakan, tuangkan arak beras di sisi wajan, tambahkan 400 ml air, lalu masak sekitar 5 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of browned smoked bean-curd pieces, shiitake stems and caps, and ginger simmering in a glossy deep reddish-brown shacha and chili-bean sauce in a black wok. Constraints: strictly vegan; simmering sauce stage only, no water spinach, fresh red chili slices, slurry, rice, finished plate, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Add water spinach, thicken, and serve

instruction.zh: 加入空心菜以大火快炒至軟，再放入辣椒片，邊攪拌邊倒入勾芡水。煮至再次沸騰和燴汁濃亮，淋在白飯上即可。
instruction.en: Add the water spinach and stir-fry over high heat until wilted. Add the chili slices, then stir while pouring in the slurry. Bring back to a boil until the sauce is glossy and thick, then spoon it over cooked rice.
instruction.id: Masukkan kangkung dan tumis dengan api besar hingga layu. Tambahkan irisan cabai, lalu aduk sambil menuangkan larutan pengental. Didihkan kembali sampai saus kental dan mengilap, kemudian siramkan di atas nasi putih.

title.zh: 讓你的親朋好友都對這道菜肴贊不絕口
title.en: A Dish Your Family and Friends Will Praise
title.id: Hidangan yang Akan Dipuji Keluarga dan Teman

description.zh:
經典的梅干扣芋頭料理
融合了鹹香的梅乾菜和香糯的芋頭
絕對是一場味覺盛宴
我們分享如何以新的方式演繹梅干扣芋頭
讓你的親朋好友都對這道菜肴贊不絕口！！
用簡單的材料和步驟
打造出引人垂涎的經典佳餚！
讓你也可以在家輕鬆做出美味的梅干扣芋頭！

description.en: This classic preserved-mustard-greens braised taro dish combines the savory fragrance of preserved mustard greens with tender, waxy taro for a true feast of flavor. We share a new interpretation of this classic dish that will have your family and friends full of praise. With simple ingredients and steps, you can make delicious preserved-mustard-greens braised taro at home. Video chapters: 00:00 highlights; 00:15 introduction; 01:00 ingredients; 01:09 cooking; 05:47 tasting.
description.id: Hidangan klasik talas kukus dengan sawi asin kering ini memadukan aroma gurih sawi asin kering dengan talas yang lembut dan pulen, menjadi sajian yang memanjakan lidah. Kami membagikan cara baru untuk mengolah hidangan klasik ini yang akan membuat keluarga dan teman Anda memujinya. Dengan bahan serta langkah sederhana, Anda dapat membuat talas kukus sawi asin kering yang lezat di rumah. Bab video: 00:00 cuplikan; 00:15 pengantar; 01:00 bahan; 01:09 memasak; 05:47 mencicipi.

instruction.zh: 梅干菜和茶樹菇洗淨；本次使用的梅干菜泡水約 30 分鐘，實際浸泡需求依產品詢問販售者。梅干菜切小段，茶樹菇去蒂後對半切，嫩薑切絲。
instruction.en: Wash the preserved mustard greens and tea tree mushrooms. For the product used here, soak the preserved mustard greens for about 30 minutes; ask the seller about the soaking requirement for your product. Cut the greens into short pieces, trim and halve the mushrooms, and shred the young ginger.
instruction.id: Cuci sawi asin kering dan jamur tea tree. Untuk produk yang digunakan di sini, rendam sawi asin kering sekitar 30 menit; tanyakan kepada penjual mengenai kebutuhan perendaman produk Anda. Potong sawi asin menjadi bagian pendek, buang pangkal jamur lalu belah dua, dan iris jahe muda memanjang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soak and prepare the ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Iris dan panggang talas hingga harum

instruction.zh: 芋頭去皮後切成約 1 公分厚的片。影片建議處理芋頭會發癢時戴手套。用平底鍋將芋頭煎至兩面金黃、煎香。
instruction.en: Peel the taro and cut it into slices about 1 cm thick. The video recommends wearing gloves if handling taro causes itchiness. Pan-fry the taro until both sides are golden and fragrant.
instruction.id: Kupas talas lalu potong menjadi irisan setebal sekitar 1 cm. Video menyarankan memakai sarung tangan bila menangani talas menyebabkan gatal. Panggang talas di wajan hingga kedua sisinya keemasan dan harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Slice and brown the taro”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將梅干菜、茶樹菇、嫩薑和可選乾辣椒炒香。加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉和香油調味，再加一點水，不加蓋熬煮約 3 分鐘。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the preserved mustard greens, tea tree mushrooms, young ginger, and optional dried chili until fragrant. Season with soy sauce, soy sauce paste, sugar, ground pepper, and sesame oil, then add a little water and simmer uncovered for about 3 minutes.
instruction.id: Tumis sawi asin kering, jamur tea tree, jahe muda, dan cabai kering opsional hingga harum. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, dan minyak wijen, lalu tambahkan sedikit air dan didihkan tanpa tutup sekitar 3 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the preserved-mustard-greens sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Assemble and steam in an electric cooker
title.id: Rakit lalu kukus dalam penanak nasi listrik

instruction.zh: 將梅干菜醬汁與煎好的芋頭放入耐熱容器，讓醬汁淋在芋頭上。放入電鍋，外鍋加入 1 杯水蒸煮；電鍋跳起後即可取出享用。
instruction.en: Put the preserved-mustard-greens sauce and browned taro in a heatproof dish, letting the sauce cover the taro. Steam in an electric cooker with 1 cup of water in the outer pot; remove and serve once the cooker switches off.
instruction.id: Masukkan saus sawi asin kering dan talas yang telah dipanggang ke dalam wadah tahan panas, lalu siramkan saus ke atas talas. Kukus dalam penanak nasi listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar; angkat dan sajikan setelah penanak nasi berhenti otomatis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble and steam in an electric cooker”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Tiga Hidangan Dingin Vegan Musim Panas

description.zh: 三道全素夏日涼拌菜：越南春卷皮製成的重慶小涼皮、冰鎮干絲辣拌菜，以及以杏鮑菇和腐皮做成的素食口水雞。
description.en: Three vegan summer cold dishes: Chongqing liangpi made from Vietnamese rice paper, chilled spicy shredded tofu, and vegan mouthwatering ‘chicken’ made with king oyster mushrooms and tofu skin.
description.id: Tiga hidangan dingin vegan musim panas: liangpi Chongqing dari kulit lumpia Vietnam, tahu suwir pedas yang didinginkan, dan ‘ayam mulut berair’ vegan dari jamur king oyster serta kulit tahu.

instruction.zh: 香菜切末備用。將香辣辣椒油、醬油、香油、芝麻水與芝麻醬拌勻。
instruction.en: Finely chop cilantro and set aside. Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame water, and sesame paste.
instruction.id: Cincang halus daun ketumbar dan sisihkan. Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, minyak wijen, air wijen, dan pasta wijen.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix Chongqing liangpi sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 越南春卷皮泡水至稍軟，向上摺三摺後剪成段，直接放入冰水冰鎮至口感Q彈。取出瀝乾後盛碗。
instruction.en: Soak Vietnamese rice paper until slightly soft, fold it upward three times, cut into pieces, and place directly in ice water until springy. Drain and transfer to a bowl.
instruction.id: Rendam kulit lumpia Vietnam hingga agak lunak, lipat ke atas tiga kali, potong-potong, lalu langsung masukkan ke air es hingga kenyal. Tiriskan dan pindahkan ke mangkuk.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the liangpi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 淋上醬汁並撒香菜即可。
instruction.en: Pour over the sauce and top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Tuangkan saus dan beri daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish the Chongqing liangpi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 嫩薑切絲，芹菜切段，香菜切末，辣椒切斜片，紅蘿蔔刨絲。
instruction.en: Julienne young ginger, cut celery into sections, finely chop cilantro, slice chili on the diagonal, and shred carrot.
instruction.id: Iris korek jahe muda, potong seledri, cincang halus daun ketumbar, iris cabai serong, dan serut wortel.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cut spicy shredded tofu ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 汆燙並冰鎮干絲與紅蘿蔔
title.en: Blanch and chill tofu shreds and carrot
title.id: Rebus sebentar dan dinginkan tahu suwir serta wortel

instruction.zh: 滾水加少量鹽，汆燙干絲1分鐘後放入冰水；再汆燙紅蘿蔔，放涼後也冰鎮。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water, blanch shredded dried tofu for 1 minute, then place in ice water. Blanch carrot as well, let it cool, and chill it.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, rebus tahu kering suwir selama 1 menit lalu masukkan ke air es. Rebus sebentar wortel, biarkan dingin, lalu dinginkan juga.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch and chill tofu shreds and carrot”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油、醬油、味醂、香油與少量鹽拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and a little salt.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, mirin, minyak wijen, dan sedikit garam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix spicy shredded tofu sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Toss and chill spicy shredded tofu
title.id: Aduk dan dinginkan tahu suwir pedas

instruction.zh: 將干絲、紅蘿蔔、芹菜、香菜、嫩薑與辣椒放入保鮮盒，倒入醬汁拌勻。可冷藏至隔天，使其更入味。
instruction.en: Put shredded tofu, carrot, celery, cilantro, young ginger, and chili in a storage container; add the sauce and toss. Refrigerate until the next day for deeper flavor if desired.
instruction.id: Masukkan tahu suwir, wortel, seledri, daun ketumbar, jahe muda, dan cabai ke wadah; tambahkan saus lalu aduk. Dinginkan hingga keesokan hari untuk rasa yang lebih meresap bila diinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Toss and chill spicy shredded tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Steam and chill king oyster mushrooms
title.id: Kukus dan dinginkan jamur king oyster

instruction.zh: 將杏鮑菇放入電鍋，以外鍋1杯水蒸煮。電鍋跳起後立刻取出放入冰水，並保留蒸出的菇汁。
instruction.en: Steam king oyster mushrooms in an electric cooker with 1 cup of water in the outer pot. As soon as it switches off, move them to ice water and reserve the mushroom juices.
instruction.id: Kukus jamur king oyster dalam penanak listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar. Segera setelah alat selesai, pindahkan ke air es dan simpan sari jamurnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Steam and chill king oyster mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 腐皮在滾水中燙軟後放入冰水。從杏鮑菇側面邊滾邊切成大片，在表面劃直刀後切成三等份；將腐皮從中間剪開成大片。
instruction.en: Soften tofu skin in boiling water, then place it in ice water. Roll-cut king oyster mushrooms from the side into broad pieces, score them vertically, and cut into thirds; cut tofu skin open down the middle into large sheets.
instruction.id: Lunakkan kulit tahu dalam air mendidih lalu masukkan ke air es. Potong jamur king oyster dari sisi sambil digulirkan menjadi lembaran lebar, buat sayatan vertikal, lalu bagi menjadi tiga; gunting kulit tahu di bagian tengah hingga menjadi lembaran besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare tofu skin and mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油、醬油、白醋、味醂、芝麻醬、香油與保留的杏鮑菇汁拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, white vinegar, mirin, sesame paste, sesame oil, and the reserved king oyster mushroom juices.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, cuka putih, mirin, pasta wijen, minyak wijen, dan sari jamur king oyster yang disimpan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix vegan mouthwatering mushroom sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 盤中放上杏鮑菇與腐皮，淋上醬汁，再放香菜、青龍椒與堅果碎。
instruction.en: Arrange king oyster mushrooms and tofu skin on a plate, pour over the sauce, then top with cilantro, green dragon chili, and crushed nuts.
instruction.id: Susun jamur king oyster dan kulit tahu di piring, tuangkan saus, lalu beri daun ketumbar, cabai naga hijau, dan kacang cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble vegan mouthwatering mushroom”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將食用油燒至180°C後直接淋上。若要提前製作，可冷藏一夜，隔天再進行油潑並加入香菜、青龍椒與堅果碎。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil to 180°C and pour it directly over the dish. If making ahead, refrigerate overnight, then add the hot oil, cilantro, green dragon chili, and crushed nuts the next day.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 180°C lalu tuangkan langsung ke atas hidangan. Jika dibuat lebih awal, dinginkan semalaman, kemudian tambahkan minyak panas, daun ketumbar, cabai naga hijau, dan kacang cincang pada hari berikutnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with hot oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 把全素冷凍水餃變化成三道料理：搭嫩薑烏醋的三杯蒸餃、拌入植物奶白醬的鮮蔬炸餃，以及用麵粉水煎出冰花的三杯煎餃。
description.en: Turn vegan frozen dumplings into three dishes: three-cup steamed dumplings with young ginger and black vinegar, vegetable dumplings tossed in plant-milk white sauce, and three-cup dumplings pan-fried with a flour-water lace.
description.id: Ubah pangsit beku vegan menjadi tiga hidangan: pangsit kukus tiga cangkir dengan jahe muda serta cuka hitam, pangsit sayur goreng dalam saus putih susu nabati, dan pangsit tiga cangkir dengan renda tepung-air dari wajan.

name.id: pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir
pangsit beku daging nabati sayur segar

instruction.zh: 可放入電鍋的盤子墊烘焙紙，放上三杯植物肉冷凍水餃並彼此留間距；若一次蒸較多，可先在紙上抹少量油。外鍋加入1杯水蒸熟，跳起後再燜約10分鐘。
instruction.en: Line an electric-cooker-safe plate with baking parchment, arrange three-cup plant-meat frozen dumplings with space between them, and oil the parchment lightly if steaming a large batch. Steam with 1 cup water in the outer pot, then rest about 10 minutes after it switches off.
instruction.id: Alasi piring yang aman untuk penanak listrik dengan kertas roti, susun pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir dengan jarak di antaranya, dan olesi sedikit minyak bila mengukus banyak pangsit. Kukus dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar, lalu diamkan sekitar 10 menit setelah alat selesai.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Steam three-cup dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Serve with young ginger and black vinegar
title.id: Sajikan dengan jahe muda dan cuka hitam

instruction.zh: 嫩薑切絲放入小碟，倒入少量烏醋；將蒸好的水餃搭配食用。
instruction.en: Julienne young ginger into a small dish and add a little black vinegar; serve with the steamed dumplings.
instruction.id: Iris korek jahe muda ke dalam piring kecil dan tambahkan sedikit cuka hitam; sajikan bersama pangsit kukus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Serve with young ginger and black vinegar”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將油加熱至160°C，放入鮮蔬植物肉冷凍水餃炸至金黃酥脆，期間稍微翻動使上色均勻；起鍋後以餐巾紙吸油。
instruction.en: Heat oil to 160°C and fry fresh-vegetable plant-meat frozen dumplings until golden and crisp, turning them a little for even browning; drain on paper towel.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga 160°C dan goreng pangsit beku daging nabati sayur segar sampai keemasan serta renyah, balik sedikit agar warnanya merata; tiriskan di tisu dapur.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fry vegetable dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，先炒香低筋麵粉，再倒入植物奶；醬汁出現濃稠狀時加少量水，攪拌至無顆粒。加入義式香料、黑胡椒、鹽與全素起司拌勻。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil, toast cake flour, then add plant milk. When the sauce thickens, add a little water and stir until smooth. Mix in Italian seasoning, black pepper, salt, and vegan cheese.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati, sangrai tepung terigu protein rendah, lalu tambahkan susu nabati. Saat saus mengental, tambahkan sedikit air dan aduk hingga halus. Campurkan bumbu Italia, lada hitam, garam, dan keju vegan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook plant-milk white sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將炸好的鮮蔬水餃倒入白醬拌勻後盛盤。
instruction.en: Toss the fried vegetable dumplings in the white sauce and plate.
instruction.id: Aduk pangsit sayur goreng dalam saus putih lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish creamy fried dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Mix flour water for the lace

instruction.zh: 將1大匙低筋麵粉與9大匙水拌勻成麵粉水。
instruction.en: Mix 1 tablespoon cake flour with 9 tablespoons water to make flour water.
instruction.id: Campurkan 1 sdm tepung terigu protein rendah dengan 9 sdm air untuk membuat air tepung.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix flour water for the lace”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少量植物油，整齊排入三杯植物肉冷凍水餃，煎至底部微黃。倒入麵粉水、蓋鍋煮至水分收乾，再開蓋煎至完全乾燥。關火後以盤子倒扣在鍋上翻出。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and arrange three-cup plant-meat frozen dumplings. Fry until the bottoms are lightly yellow, pour in the flour water, cover and cook until the water is absorbed, then uncover and cook until fully dry. Turn off the heat and invert onto a plate.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan datar dan susun pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir. Goreng hingga bagian bawah agak kuning, tuangkan air tepung, tutup dan masak hingga air habis, lalu buka dan masak sampai benar-benar kering. Matikan api dan balikkan ke piring.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry three-cup lacy dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油與少量醬油混合，搭配冰花煎餃食用。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil with a little soy sauce and serve with the lacy pan-fried dumplings.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik dengan sedikit kecap asin dan sajikan bersama pangsit pan-goreng berenda.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make pan-fried dumpling dip”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以汆燙後剪開的炸豆皮取代肉片，醃入日式醬油、胡椒與五香粉，搭配炒成洋蔥口感的白菜梗和高麗菜絲，再用山藥泥製造近似蛋液的滑口醬汁。
description.en: Blanched, split fried tofu skin replaces meat slices and is marinated with Japanese soy sauce, pepper, and five-spice. Napa cabbage stems and shredded cabbage are cooked to an onion-like texture, then Japanese yam puree creates a silky, egg-like sauce.
description.id: Kulit tahu goreng yang direbus lalu dibelah menggantikan irisan daging dan dimarinasi dengan kecap asin Jepang, lada, serta lima rempah. Batang sawi putih dan kol iris dimasak hingga menyerupai bawang, lalu puree ubi Jepang menciptakan saus lembut seperti telur.

name.zh: 炸豆皮（語音轉錄早段作「角蘿」）
name.en: fried tofu skin (early transcript renders it as 'jiao luo')
name.id: kulit tahu goreng (bagian awal transkrip menyebut 'jiao luo')

title.zh: 汆燙、剪開並醃製炸豆皮
title.en: Blanch, split, and marinate the fried tofu skin
title.id: Rebus, belah, dan marinasi kulit tahu goreng

instruction.zh: 準備滾水，將炸豆皮燙軟後從中間剪開，略擠去多餘水分。加入日式醬油、胡椒粉和五香粉抓醃，靜置20分鐘。
instruction.en: Bring water to a boil, soften the fried tofu skin, then cut it open through the middle and gently squeeze away excess water. Toss with Japanese soy sauce, ground pepper, and five-spice powder, then marinate for 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Didihkan air, lunakkan kulit tahu goreng, lalu belah di bagian tengah dan peras perlahan air berlebih. Campurkan dengan kecap asin Jepang, lada bubuk, dan lima rempah, lalu marinasi selama 20 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan tutorial image of blanched fried tofu skin opened into flat strips and marinated with Japanese soy sauce and spices, no animal meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 切絲白菜並準備山藥泥
title.en: Shred the cabbages and prepare yam puree
title.id: Iris kol dan siapkan puree ubi Jepang

instruction.zh: 把大白菜梗和高麗菜切成絲；白菜葉可留作煮湯或其他炒菜。將日本山藥磨成山藥泥，另把青紅椒備好。
instruction.en: Shred the napa cabbage stems and cabbage; reserve the napa leaves for soup or another stir-fry. Grate the Japanese yam into a puree and prepare the green and red chili.
instruction.id: Iris batang sawi putih dan kol; simpan daun sawi untuk sup atau tumisan lain. Parut ubi Jepang menjadi puree dan siapkan cabai hijau serta merah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image with shredded napa cabbage stems, shredded cabbage, grated Japanese yam puree, and green-red chili, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 炒出洋蔥般口感並加入薑汁
title.en: Cook to an onion-like texture and add ginger sauce
title.id: Masak hingga menyerupai bawang lalu tambahkan saus jahe

instruction.zh: 將白菜梗和高麗菜絲炒至口感近似洋蔥後，加入影片中預先調好的薑汁拌炒。
instruction.en: Cook the napa cabbage stems and shredded cabbage until their texture resembles onion, then add the pre-mixed ginger sauce mentioned in the video and stir-fry.
instruction.id: Masak batang sawi putih dan kol iris hingga teksturnya menyerupai bawang, lalu tambahkan saus jahe yang telah disiapkan seperti disebutkan dalam video dan tumis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan stir-fry image of shredded cabbage and napa stems becoming glossy and onion-like in a pan with aromatic ginger sauce, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 以山藥泥收成滑口醬汁
title.en: Finish with yam puree for a silky sauce
title.id: Akhiri dengan puree ubi untuk saus lembut

instruction.zh: 鍋底尚留少量薑汁時加入山藥泥拌勻，讓醬汁包住食材並形成近似生蛋液的滑口感。大火炒至收汁發亮，起鍋前加少量香油和水拌勻。
instruction.en: When a little ginger sauce remains in the pan, add the yam puree and mix so the sauce clings to the ingredients with a silky, raw-egg-like texture. Stir-fry over high heat until glossy and reduced, then mix in a little sesame oil and water before serving.
instruction.id: Saat sedikit saus jahe masih tersisa di wajan, tambahkan puree ubi dan aduk hingga saus melapisi bahan dengan tekstur lembut seperti telur mentah. Tumis dengan api besar hingga mengilap dan menyusut, lalu aduk dengan sedikit minyak wijen serta air sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of glossy plant-based ginger yakiniku sauce thickened with pale Japanese yam puree around tofu-skin strips and cabbage, no egg, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 鋪菜絲、盛上燒肉並點綴
title.id: Sajikan di atas kol dan beri hiasan

instruction.zh: 盤中先鋪高麗菜絲，放上純素薑汁燒肉，撒白芝麻和青紅椒即可完成。
instruction.en: Lay shredded cabbage on a plate, add the vegan ginger yakiniku, and finish with white sesame seeds and green-red chili.
instruction.id: Letakkan kol iris di piring, tambahkan yakiniku jahe vegan, lalu taburi wijen putih dan cabai hijau-merah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan ginger yakiniku on shredded cabbage, glossy tofu-skin strips with white sesame and green-red chili garnish, no animal meat, no egg, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 先煎香冬瓜與老薑，再加入玉米、黃豆芽及溫補藥材熬成清甜全素湯。
description.en: Winter melon and ginger are lightly browned, then simmered with corn, soybean sprouts, and Chinese herbs into a clear sweet vegan soup.
description.id: Labu putih dan jahe ditumis kecokelatan, lalu direbus bersama jagung, tauge kedelai, dan herbal Tiongkok menjadi sup vegan bening yang manis.

title.en: Brown the winter melon and ginger

instruction.zh: 將薑和冬瓜炒至微焦，以提香。
instruction.en: Sauté ginger and winter melon until lightly browned to build fragrance.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan winter melon hingga agak kecoklatan untuk menambah aroma.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of thick peeled winter-melon chunks and sliced mature ginger sautéing in a soup pot until their edges are lightly golden, with only a small amount of vegetable oil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no corn, soybean sprouts, herbs, broth, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入玉米、黃豆芽、水、中藥（枸杞、紅棗、當歸、黃耆）。
instruction.en: Add corn, soybean sprouts, water, goji berries, red dates, Chinese angelica, and astragalus.
instruction.id: Tambahkan jagung, tauge kedelai, air, goji, kurma merah, dang gui, dan astragalus.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close three-quarter food photograph of a clear vegan soup pot just after adding corn rounds, soybean sprouts, goji berries, red dates, angelica root and astragalus slices to lightly browned winter melon and ginger in water, ingredients visibly distinct. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cilantro garnish, sesame oil, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 小火煮 20 分鐘，然後用鹽、香菜和芝麻油調味，形成清爽甘甜的湯汁。
instruction.en: Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, then season with salt, cilantro, and sesame oil for a refreshing sweet broth.
instruction.id: Rebus api kecil selama 20 menit, lalu bumbui dengan garam, daun ketumbar, dan minyak wijen hingga kuah terasa segar dan manis.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image.
