Strictly vegan; no people, labels, watermark, logos, or text. No text.

description.zh: 以柚子皮、果肉、蘋果泥和檸檬汁熬成低糖保存醬。
description.en: A lower-sugar pomelo preserve cooked with peel, pulp, apple purée, and lemon juice.
description.id: Selai pomelo rendah gula yang dimasak dari kulit, daging buah, pure apel, dan jus lemon.

instruction.zh: 取10克去除白囊的柚子皮切絲；取果肉並去除白膜。
instruction.en: Remove the white pith and finely julienne 10 g pomelo peel. Separate 600 g pulp from the membranes.
instruction.id: Buang empulur putih lalu iris halus 10 g kulit pomelo. Pisahkan 600 g daging buah dari selaputnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of finely julienned green-yellow pomelo peel with all white pith removed, beside a bowl of clean pale pomelo pulp separated from its membranes. Constraints: strictly vegan; no sugar, apple, lemon, cooking pot, finished preserve, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 柚子皮以鹽水煮三次，每次換水。
instruction.en: Boil the pomelo peel in salted water three times, replacing the water after each boil to remove bitterness.
instruction.id: Rebus kulit pomelo dalam air garam sebanyak tiga kali, ganti air setiap selesai merebus untuk mengurangi rasa pahit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of fine pomelo-peel strips simmering in clear salted water in a small stainless saucepan, the first bitterness-removal boil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no fruit pulp, sugar, apple, lemon, finished preserve, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 先煮柚子皮與200克糖至軟香，加入600克果肉、蘋果泥、檸檬汁，熬至濃稠。
instruction.en: Cook the drained peel with 200 g sugar until soft and fragrant. Add 600 g pomelo pulp, apple purée, and lemon juice, then simmer until thick.
instruction.id: Masak kulit yang telah ditiriskan bersama 200 g gula hingga lunak dan harum. Tambahkan 600 g daging pomelo, pure apel, dan jus lemon, lalu masak hingga kental.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of golden pomelo preserve bubbling gently and thickening in a saucepan, with visible translucent peel strands and pale citrus pulp. Constraints: strictly vegan; no jarred finish, toast, tea, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 裝入滾水殺菌的玻璃罐，趁熱鎖緊倒扣，放涼。
instruction.en: Fill boiled, sterilized glass jars while the preserve is hot. Seal tightly, invert the jars, and leave them to cool.
instruction.id: Isi stoples kaca yang telah disterilkan dengan selai selagi panas. Tutup rapat, balikkan stoples, lalu biarkan dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: clean editorial food photograph of golden homemade pomelo preserve hot-filled into small sterilized clear glass jars, one sealed jar inverted for cooling and another upright showing translucent peel strands. Constraints: no branding, printed labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 杏鮑菇以豆腐乳醃漬、玉米粉煎出酥脆外皮的全素小食。
description.en: King oyster mushroom slices marinated with fermented tofu and pan-fried in cornstarch until crisp.
description.id: Irisan jamur king oyster dimarinasi tahu fermentasi lalu digoreng tepung jagung.

instruction.zh: 去除杏鮑菇頭部，切成約0.3公分厚的片；菇頭保留作其他料理。
instruction.en: Trim the mushroom caps and slice the stems about 0.3 cm thick; reserve caps for another dish.
instruction.id: Potong bagian tudung jamur king oyster, lalu iris batangnya setebal sekitar 0,3 cm. Simpan bagian tudung untuk masakan lain.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of four king oyster mushroom stems on a clean wooden cutting board, their caps trimmed off and stems cut into evenly spaced 0.3 cm slices, with the reserved mushroom caps nearby for another dish. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, soy sauce, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將菇片拌醬油、豆腐乳、糖和五香粉；4條杏鮑菇使用半塊豆腐乳，醃10分鐘。
instruction.en: Toss slices with soy sauce, fermented tofu, sugar, and five-spice; use half a tofu piece for four mushrooms and marinate 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Aduk irisan jamur dengan kecap asin, tahu fermentasi, gula, dan bubuk lima rempah. Gunakan setengah potong tahu fermentasi untuk empat jamur, lalu marinasi selama 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of thin king oyster mushroom slices in a mixing bowl, evenly coated in a glossy marinade of soy sauce, mashed fermented tofu, sugar, and five-spice powder, resting to marinate. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, cornstarch coating, frying pan, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 兩面裹玉米粉，中火以足量熱油煎至兩面金黃酥脆；油不足可補加。
instruction.en: Coat both sides in cornstarch and pan-fry over medium heat in sufficient hot oil until both sides are golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Balur kedua sisi irisan jamur dengan tepung maizena. Goreng dalam minyak panas yang cukup dengan api sedang hingga kedua sisinya keemasan dan renyah; tambahkan minyak bila perlu.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of cornstarch-coated king oyster mushroom slices pan-frying in a shallow skillet over medium heat, both sides turning evenly golden and crisp in hot cooking oil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, finished serving plate, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 放在餐巾紙上吸去多餘油脂後食用。
instruction.en: Drain on kitchen paper before serving.
instruction.id: Letakkan irisan jamur yang sudah renyah di atas kertas dapur untuk menyerap minyak berlebih, lalu sajikan selagi hangat.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: appetizing close food photograph of finished golden crisp king oyster mushroom slices draining on a plain paper-towel-lined plate, with the crunchy cornstarch crust clearly visible. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, sauce bowl, garnish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 自製發酵麵皮包入豆腐、冬粉、茄子與四季豆餡，以麵粉水燜煎出金黃冰花的全素水煎包。
description.en: Homemade fermented dough wraps tofu, vermicelli, eggplant, and green bean filling, then steams and fries with flour water to form crisp golden vegan pan-fried buns.
description.id: Adonan fermentasi buatan sendiri membungkus isian tahu, soun, terong, dan buncis, lalu dikukus-goreng dengan air tepung hingga membentuk bakpao goreng vegan berkulit emas renyah.

instruction.zh: 冬粉泡水至軟；四季豆、茄子和豆腐切小丁，冬粉剪成短段。
instruction.en: Soak vermicelli until soft. Dice green beans, eggplant, and tofu, then cut vermicelli into short lengths.
instruction.id: Rendam soun hingga lunak. Potong dadu buncis, terong, dan tahu, lalu gunting soun menjadi pendek-pendek.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked vermicelli, diced tofu, eggplant, and green beans prepared for vegan bun filling, no text.

instruction.zh: 將酵母先融入水，與麵包專用粉、泡打粉、鹽、糖和溫水拌成麵絮，揉約5分鐘；醒10分鐘後再揉光滑，覆濕布發酵至兩倍大。
instruction.en: Dissolve yeast in water, combine with bread flour blend, baking powder, salt, sugar, and warm water, then knead about 5 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, knead smooth again, cover with a damp cloth, and proof until doubled.
instruction.id: Larutkan ragi dalam air, campur dengan campuran tepung roti, baking powder, garam, gula, dan air hangat, lalu uleni sekitar 5 menit. Istirahatkan 10 menit, uleni hingga halus, tutup kain lembap, dan fermentasikan hingga dua kali lipat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of smooth proofed dough rising under a damp cloth in a mixing bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中先把豆腐煎至金黃，加入四季豆與茄子略炒；以醬油、醬油膏、胡椒粉、花椒粉、五香粉、辣椒粉、鹽和糖調味，加入冬粉與少量水收至濕潤不乾。
instruction.en: Brown tofu in a pan, then briefly sauté green beans and eggplant. Season with soy sauce, soy paste, pepper, Sichuan pepper, five-spice, chili powder, salt, and sugar; add vermicelli and a little water, reducing until moist but not dry.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu hingga keemasan, lalu tumis sebentar buncis dan terong. Bumbui kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, merica, lada Sichuan, bubuk lima rempah, bubuk cabai, garam, dan gula; tambahkan soun serta sedikit air, masak hingga lembap namun tidak kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of glossy vermicelli tofu filling with eggplant and green beans cooking in a skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 發好的麵團排氣後分成8等分，擀成圓皮，包入餡料並收緊封口；放在撒粉盤上避免黏住。
instruction.en: Deflate the proofed dough and divide into 8 portions. Roll into rounds, fill, and seal tightly; place on a floured plate to prevent sticking.
instruction.id: Kempiskan adonan yang sudah mengembang lalu bagi menjadi 8 bagian. Gilas bulat, isi, dan rekatkan rapat; letakkan di piring bertabur tepung agar tidak lengket.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands wrapping and sealing vegan pan-fried buns on a floured board, no text.

instruction.zh: 麵粉與約250毫升水拌勻。平底鍋加少量油放入包子並留間隔，底部起泡後倒入麵粉水並撒芝麻，蓋鍋小火燜至水分蒸發，再煎至底部金黃。
instruction.en: Mix flour with about 250 ml water. Oil a skillet, arrange buns with space, and when bases blister, pour in flour water and scatter sesame. Cover and steam over low heat until water evaporates, then fry until bottoms are golden.
instruction.id: Campur tepung dengan sekitar 250 ml air. Olesi wajan, susun bakpao berjarak, dan saat bagian bawah bergelembung, tuang air tepung serta taburi wijen. Tutup dan kukus api kecil hingga air menguap, lalu goreng sampai bagian bawah keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan pan-fried buns with a lacy flour-water crust and white sesame in a skillet, no text.

description.zh: 以老薑榨汁，拌入紅糖與糯米粉蒸熟，再以炒香的糯米粉防沾並切成一口大小的全素薑汁軟糖。
description.en: A vegan ginger soft candy made by juicing mature ginger, combining it with brown sugar and glutinous rice flour, steaming it, then coating and cutting it with toasted glutinous rice flour.
description.id: Permen lunak jahe vegan yang dibuat dengan memeras jahe tua, mencampurnya dengan gula merah dan tepung ketan, mengukusnya, lalu melapisi serta memotongnya dengan tepung ketan sangrai.

instruction.zh: 老薑去皮後切成塊，放入調理機打碎；以豆漿布或細布包住薑泥，用力擠出薑汁並備用。
instruction.en: Peel and chunk the mature ginger, then blend it until crushed. Wrap the ginger pulp in a nut-milk bag or fine cloth and squeeze firmly to collect the ginger juice.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong jahe tua, lalu haluskan dengan blender. Bungkus ampas jahe dalam kain penyaring halus dan peras kuat-kuat untuk mengumpulkan jus jahe.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead-close preparation photograph of peeled mature ginger chunks, freshly blended fibrous ginger pulp gathered inside a plain fine cloth, and a small bowl collecting opaque golden ginger juice on a clean wooden work surface. Constraints: strictly vegan; raw ginger preparation only, no sugar, flour, cooked syrup, candy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Melt brown sugar with ginger juice
title.id: Lelehkan gula merah dengan jus jahe

instruction.zh: 鍋中放入150克紅糖與約40克剛榨的薑汁，以小火攪拌至紅糖完全融化，隨即關火。
instruction.en: Put 150 g brown sugar and about 40 g of the freshly squeezed ginger juice in a pan. Stir over low heat until the sugar fully melts, then turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Masukkan 150 g gula merah dan sekitar 40 g jus jahe segar ke dalam panci. Aduk dengan api kecil sampai gula larut sepenuhnya, lalu matikan api.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of deep brown sugar gently dissolving into freshly pressed ginger juice in a small stainless saucepan over low heat, forming a smooth glossy amber syrup with no vigorous boil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no flour, dough, finished candy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 大碗中放入150克糯米粉與150克薑汁攪勻，再倒入溫熱的紅糖薑汁，拌至沒有乾粉的均勻濕糰。
instruction.en: Mix 150 g glutinous rice flour with 150 g ginger juice in a large bowl, then pour in the warm brown-sugar ginger syrup and stir until an even wet dough has no dry flour.
instruction.id: Campur 150 g tepung ketan dengan 150 g jus jahe dalam mangkuk besar, lalu tuang sirup jahe gula merah hangat dan aduk hingga menjadi adonan basah merata tanpa tepung kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of a large mixing bowl where white glutinous rice flour and golden ginger juice are being combined with warm amber brown-sugar ginger syrup into a uniform wet pale-tan dough with no dry flour. Constraints: strictly vegan; no steamer, toasted flour, finished candy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Steam the dough and toast the dusting flour
title.id: Kukus adonan dan sangrai tepung pelapis

instruction.zh: 將麵糰放入電鍋或蒸鍋，外鍋加兩杯水蒸約30分鐘；同時以小火乾炒約50克糯米粉約5分鐘，作為手粉。
instruction.en: Steam the dough in an electric cooker or steamer with two cups of water in the outer pot for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, dry-toast about 50 g glutinous rice flour over low heat for about 5 minutes for dusting.
instruction.id: Kukus adonan dalam rice cooker listrik atau kukusan dengan dua cangkir air pada panci luar selama sekitar 30 menit. Sementara itu, sangrai kering sekitar 50 g tepung ketan dengan api kecil selama sekitar 5 menit untuk pelapis.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: editorial split preparation photograph showing only two simultaneous processes: a covered electric cooker steaming the smooth ginger glutinous dough, and a separate dry skillet over low heat toasting a thin layer of white glutinous rice flour until fragrant. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cut candy, storage container, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Shape, cut, and coat for storage
title.id: Bentuk, potong, dan lapisi untuk penyimpanan

instruction.zh: 砧板鋪上炒熟手粉，取出蒸好的軟糖並在表面撒粉，輕揉至光滑後擀至約1公分厚；放涼後切成一口大小，每面沾滿手粉再裝入保鮮罐。
instruction.en: Cover a board with toasted dusting flour, turn out the steamed candy and dust its surface, then gently knead until smooth and roll to about 1 cm thick. Cool, cut into bite-size pieces, coat every side with flour, and store in an airtight container.
instruction.id: Taburi papan dengan tepung pelapis sangrai, keluarkan permen kukus dan taburi permukaannya, lalu uleni perlahan hingga halus dan gilas setebal sekitar 1 cm. Dinginkan, potong seukuran sekali gigit, lapisi semua sisi dengan tepung, lalu simpan dalam wadah kedap udara.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: appetizing close food photograph of cooled vegan ginger soft candy rolled to one-centimetre thickness, cut into neat bite-size golden-brown squares, and thoroughly dusted on every surface with pale toasted glutinous rice flour on a simple wooden board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no jar, tea, fruit, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 以薑末、辣椒爆香大白菜，加入雙醋醬油芡汁快炒收汁，最後以香油提味的開胃全素家常菜。
description.en: A tangy vegan home-style napa cabbage stir-fry, scented with ginger and chili, cooked with a two-vinegar soy sauce slurry and finished with sesame oil.
description.id: Tumis sawi putih vegan yang segar, diberi aroma jahe dan cabai, dimasak dengan saus kecap asin dua jenis cuka, lalu diakhiri minyak wijen.

instruction.zh: 大白菜洗淨，將梗和葉疊好，以斜刀每約兩公分切成粗長條；老薑切末，辣椒切小段。
instruction.en: Wash the napa cabbage, stack its stems and leaves, and cut on the bias into thick strips about 2 cm apart. Mince the mature ginger and cut the chili into small pieces.
instruction.id: Cuci sawi putih, tumpuk batang dan daunnya, lalu iris serong menjadi potongan tebal dengan jarak sekitar 2 cm. Cincang jahe tua dan potong cabai kecil-kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of thick diagonally cut napa cabbage strips with minced ginger and chopped red chili on a prep board, no text.

title.en: Mix the hot and sour slurry

instruction.zh: 碗中加入醬油、醬油膏、烏醋、白醋、鹽、糖與少許太白粉，充分攪拌至澱粉沒有結塊。
instruction.en: Combine soy sauce, soy sauce paste, black vinegar, white vinegar, salt, sugar, and a little potato starch in a bowl. Stir thoroughly until the starch has no lumps.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, cuka hitam, cuka putih, garam, gula, dan sedikit tepung kentang dalam mangkuk. Aduk rata hingga tepung tidak menggumpal.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a glossy dark hot and sour sauce being whisked in a small bowl beside seasonings, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少許植物油，以中火將薑末與辣椒炒出香氣；喜歡蒜味可在此加入蒜片或蒜苗同炒。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and sauté the minced ginger and chili over medium heat until fragrant. Add sliced garlic or garlic sprouts here if desired.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan tumis jahe cincang serta cabai dengan api sedang hingga harum. Tambahkan irisan bawang putih atau daun bawang putih di tahap ini bila diinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up wok photography of ginger mince and red chili sizzling in vegetable oil, fragrant steam, no text.

title.en: Stir-fry cabbage and reduce the sauce

instruction.zh: 放入大白菜大火翻炒至略軟，倒入酸辣芡汁持續翻炒，讓白菜均勻裹上醬汁並收至喜歡的濃度。
instruction.en: Add the napa cabbage and stir-fry over high heat until slightly softened. Pour in the hot and sour slurry and keep tossing until the cabbage is evenly coated and the sauce reduces to your preferred consistency.
instruction.id: Masukkan sawi putih dan tumis dengan api besar hingga agak lunak. Tuang saus asam pedas, lalu terus aduk sampai sawi terlapisi merata dan saus menyusut sesuai kekentalan yang diinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of napa cabbage stir-frying in a wok, coated in glossy dark hot and sour sauce with chili pieces, no text.

title.en: Finish with sesame oil and plate
title.id: Akhiri dengan minyak wijen dan sajikan

instruction.zh: 關火前淋少許香油提味，快速翻勻後盛盤，趁熱搭配白飯享用。
instruction.en: Just before turning off the heat, drizzle in a little sesame oil for aroma. Toss quickly, plate, and serve hot with rice.
instruction.id: Menjelang api dimatikan, siram sedikit minyak wijen untuk aroma. Aduk cepat, sajikan, dan nikmati hangat dengan nasi.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished hot and sour napa cabbage in a ceramic bowl, glossy sauce and red chili accents, warm food photography, no text.

description.zh: 將豆包煸香後與番茄熬成濃湯，加入生麵條以燜煮方式吸收醬汁，做成全素番茄蛋風味麵。
description.en: Vegan tomato egg-style braised noodles: crisped tofu skin and tomatoes are simmered into a rich broth, then fresh noodles are gently braised to absorb the sauce.
description.id: Mi braise tomat gaya telur vegan: kulit tahu digoreng harum bersama tomat menjadi kuah kental, lalu mi segar dibraise perlahan agar menyerap saus.

title.en: Cut tomatoes and tear tofu skin
title.id: Potong tomat dan sobek kulit tahu

instruction.zh: 番茄切成塊，老薑切末；將豆包用手剝成大小不一的小片，讓後續煸炒時形成較有層次的口感。
instruction.en: Cut the tomatoes into chunks and mince the mature ginger. Tear the tofu skin by hand into uneven small pieces so it develops more varied texture during frying.
instruction.id: Potong tomat menjadi potongan besar dan cincang jahe tua. Sobek kulit tahu dengan tangan menjadi potongan kecil tidak beraturan agar teksturnya lebih bervariasi saat ditumis.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of tomato chunks, minced ginger, and irregular hand-torn tofu skin pieces on a prep board, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少許植物油，先煸香薑末，再放入豆包煸炒至香酥並帶些焦色。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok, sauté the minced ginger until fragrant, then add tofu skin and fry until aromatic, crisp, and lightly browned.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan, tumis jahe cincang hingga harum, lalu masukkan kulit tahu dan goreng hingga harum, renyah, serta sedikit kecokelatan.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of hand-torn tofu skin crisping with minced ginger in a wok, golden browned edges, no text.

title.en: Soften tomatoes and simmer a rich broth
title.id: Lunakkan tomat dan didihkan kuah kental

instruction.zh: 加入番茄炒至軟爛，放入醬油、糖、胡椒粉與辣豆瓣醬炒勻；加水後蓋鍋熬煮約10分鐘，讓湯頭變得濃郁。
instruction.en: Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Stir in soy sauce, sugar, ground pepper, and spicy doubanjiang; add water, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes to develop a rich broth.
instruction.id: Masukkan tomat dan masak hingga lunak. Tambahkan kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, dan doubanjiang pedas; tambahkan air, tutup, lalu didihkan sekitar 10 menit agar kuah menjadi kaya rasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of tomatoes and tofu skin simmering in a rich reddish-brown broth in a covered wok, no text.

title.en: Reserve broth and braise fresh noodles
title.id: Sisihkan kuah lalu braise mi segar

instruction.zh: 開蓋先舀出一碗湯備用，將生麵條放入鍋中以較少湯汁燜煮；期間不時開蓋用筷子翻動，避免麵條黏底或結團。
instruction.en: Uncover and reserve one bowl of broth, then add fresh noodles to braise in the remaining smaller amount of liquid. Open the lid occasionally and turn the noodles with chopsticks to prevent sticking or clumping.
instruction.id: Buka tutup dan sisihkan satu mangkuk kuah, lalu masukkan mi segar untuk dibraise dalam sisa cairan yang lebih sedikit. Sesekali buka tutup dan aduk mi dengan sumpit agar tidak lengket atau menggumpal.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of fresh noodles gently braising in a shallow tomato broth, chopsticks lifting and separating strands, no text.

title.id: Kembalikan kuah dan masak hingga matang

instruction.zh: 麵條外層變軟但中心仍略白時，倒回保留的湯汁繼續煮；試吃確認沒有白色麵心後即可盛盤享用。
instruction.en: When the noodle exterior has softened but its center is still slightly white, pour back the reserved broth and continue cooking. Taste to confirm no white core remains, then plate and serve.
instruction.id: Saat bagian luar mi telah lunak tetapi bagian tengah masih sedikit putih, tuang kembali kuah yang disisihkan dan lanjutkan memasak. Cicipi untuk memastikan tidak ada inti putih, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan tomato braised noodles with rich glossy sauce and crisp tofu skin pieces in a deep bowl, no text.

description.zh: 將四季豆與茄子炒軟，再以薑香五香醬油芡汁收汁的快速全素便當菜。
description.en: A quick vegan lunchbox dish of green beans and eggplant, stir-fried until tender and reduced in a ginger-scented five-spice soy sauce slurry.
description.id: Lauk bekal vegan cepat berupa buncis dan terong yang ditumis hingga lunak lalu disusutkan dalam saus kecap asin berbumbu jahe dan lima rempah.

title.zh: 切好茄子四季豆與辛香料

instruction.zh: 茄子和四季豆切成段；老薑切末，辣椒切斜片。可選細四季豆或長豆，皆切成容易入口的長度。
instruction.en: Cut eggplant and green beans into segments. Mince the mature ginger and slice the chili diagonally. Either slender green beans or long beans can be cut into bite-size lengths.
instruction.id: Potong terong dan buncis menjadi ruas. Cincang jahe tua dan iris cabai serong. Buncis ramping atau kacang panjang dapat dipotong sepanjang ukuran sekali gigit.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of cut eggplant segments, green beans, minced ginger, and diagonal chili slices on a wooden cutting board, no text.

instruction.zh: 碗中加入醬油、醬油膏、五香粉、胡椒粉、糖、太白粉與水，攪拌至澱粉完全散開且醬汁均勻。
instruction.en: Combine soy sauce, soy sauce paste, five-spice powder, ground pepper, sugar, potato starch, and water in a bowl. Stir until the starch is fully dispersed and the sauce is uniform.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, bubuk lima rempah, lada bubuk, gula, tepung kentang, dan air dalam mangkuk. Aduk sampai tepung terlarut dan saus merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a dark glossy five-spice soy sauce slurry being whisked in a small bowl, no text.

title.en: Sauté ginger and green beans first
title.id: Tumis jahe dan buncis terlebih dahulu

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入少許香油爆香薑末，接著放入四季豆先炒約兩分鐘，因四季豆比茄子較慢熟。
instruction.en: Add a little sesame oil to a wok and sauté the minced ginger until fragrant. Add the green beans and stir-fry them first for about two minutes because they cook more slowly than eggplant.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak wijen ke wajan dan tumis jahe cincang hingga harum. Masukkan buncis dan tumis terlebih dahulu sekitar dua menit karena matang lebih lambat daripada terong.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up wok photography of green beans and minced ginger stir-frying in sesame oil, bright green and sizzling, no text.

title.en: Add eggplant and cook until tender
title.id: Masukkan terong dan masak hingga lunak

instruction.zh: 加入茄子與四季豆一同翻炒至茄子變軟、四季豆接近熟透；茄子吸油較多時，可視情況補少許食用油。
instruction.en: Add the eggplant and toss with the green beans until the eggplant softens and the beans are nearly cooked through. If the eggplant absorbs too much oil, add a little more cooking oil as needed.
instruction.id: Masukkan terong dan aduk bersama buncis hingga terong lunak dan buncis hampir matang sepenuhnya. Jika terong menyerap terlalu banyak minyak, tambahkan sedikit minyak goreng sesuai kebutuhan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of eggplant and green beans stir-frying in a wok, eggplant softening and glossy, no text.

instruction.zh: 倒入調好的醬汁與辣椒，持續翻炒至醬汁稍微收乾並均勻包裹蔬菜，即可關火盛盤。
instruction.en: Pour in the prepared sauce and chili, then keep tossing until the sauce has slightly reduced and evenly coats the vegetables. Turn off the heat and plate.
instruction.id: Tuang saus yang telah disiapkan dan cabai, lalu terus aduk hingga saus agak menyusut dan melapisi sayuran secara merata. Matikan api dan sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished braised eggplant and green beans coated in glossy dark five-spice sauce with red chili on a ceramic plate, no text.

description.zh: 將焦香五香豆腐碎、冰鎮麵條和番茄小黃瓜，搭配花生醬豆漿醬汁的清爽全素冷麵。
description.en: A refreshing vegan cold noodle bowl with crisped five-spice tofu crumbles, chilled noodles, tomato and cucumber, and a creamy peanut-soy-milk sauce.
description.id: Mi dingin vegan yang menyegarkan dengan remahan tahu lima rempah yang digoreng garing, mi dingin, tomat, mentimun, serta saus krim selai kacang dan susu kedelai.

instruction.zh: 番茄切片，小黃瓜切絲；將豆腐用手剝成不規則小碎塊，增加後續煎炒的焦香表面。
instruction.en: Slice the tomato and shred the cucumber. Tear the tofu by hand into uneven small crumbles to create more surface for browning later.
instruction.id: Iris tomat dan serut mentimun. Sobek tahu dengan tangan menjadi remahan kecil tidak beraturan agar lebih banyak permukaan yang kecokelatan nanti.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of sliced tomato, shredded cucumber, and hand-torn tofu crumbles on a clean prep board, no text.

title.id: Masak tahu lima rempah hingga garing

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒少許植物油，放入豆腐碎炒至焦黃；加入醬油、五香粉和少許糖，翻炒均勻後關火備用。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pan and fry the tofu crumbles until browned and crisp. Add soy sauce, five-spice powder, and a little sugar, toss evenly, then turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan goreng remahan tahu hingga kecokelatan serta garing. Tambahkan kecap asin, bubuk lima rempah, dan sedikit gula, aduk rata, lalu matikan api.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of golden crisp tofu crumbles coated in soy sauce and five-spice seasoning in a skillet, no text.

title.en: Mix the peanut soy milk sauce

instruction.zh: 碗中加入花生醬、日式醬油、蘋果醋、鹽、糖與豆漿，充分攪拌至花生醬完全化開、醬汁滑順。
instruction.en: Combine peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, salt, sugar, and soy milk in a bowl. Whisk thoroughly until the peanut butter dissolves and the sauce is smooth.
instruction.id: Campurkan selai kacang, kecap asin Jepang, cuka apel, garam, gula, dan susu kedelai dalam mangkuk. Kocok hingga selai kacang larut sepenuhnya dan saus halus.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of creamy pale soy milk and peanut sauce being whisked smooth in a ceramic bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，放入麵條煮至熟；撈出立即放進冰水冰鎮，待麵條變涼後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water with a little salt to a boil and cook the noodles until tender. Transfer immediately to ice water, then drain once the noodles are cold.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air dengan sedikit garam dan masak mi hingga matang. Segera pindahkan ke air es, lalu tiriskan setelah mi dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of cooked noodles being plunged into a bowl of ice water, glossy chilled strands, no text.

title.en: Assemble the soy milk cold noodles

instruction.zh: 將冰鎮麵條放入碗中，倒入花生豆漿醬汁，擺上番茄、小黃瓜與炒豆腐；撒白芝麻並加一顆冰塊即可享用。
instruction.en: Place chilled noodles in a bowl and pour over the peanut soy milk sauce. Arrange tomato, cucumber, and fried tofu on top, then finish with white sesame seeds and an ice cube.
instruction.id: Letakkan mi dingin dalam mangkuk dan tuang saus susu kedelai kacang. Susun tomat, mentimun, dan tahu goreng di atasnya, lalu akhiri dengan biji wijen putih serta satu es batu.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished Korean soy milk cold noodles topped with tomato, cucumber, crisp tofu crumbles, sesame seeds, and an ice cube, no text.

description.zh: 以冰鎮粉絲、香菇、紅蘿蔔、櫛瓜與木耳，拌入熱油潑香的辣椒芝麻醬汁的開胃全素涼拌菜。
description.en: An appetizing vegan Taiwanese chilled glass noodle salad with mushrooms, carrot, zucchini, and wood ear mushrooms, tossed in a chili-sesame sauce bloomed with hot oil.
description.id: Salad soun dingin Taiwan vegan yang menggugah selera dengan jamur, wortel, zukini, dan jamur kuping, diaduk dalam saus cabai wijen yang disiram minyak panas.

instruction.zh: 將紅蘿蔔、香菇、櫛瓜與木耳切成細絲；老薑、香菜和辣椒切末，分別備用。
instruction.en: Julienne the carrot, mushrooms, zucchini, and wood ear mushrooms. Finely chop the mature ginger, cilantro, and chili, and keep them separate.
instruction.id: Iris tipis wortel, jamur, zukini, dan jamur kuping. Cincang halus jahe tua, daun ketumbar, serta cabai, lalu sisihkan terpisah.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of julienned carrot, shiitake, zucchini, wood ear mushrooms, and small piles of minced ginger, chili, and cilantro, no text.

title.en: Bloom chili and sesame with hot oil
title.id: Siram cabai dan wijen dengan minyak panas

instruction.zh: 耐熱碗中放入薑末、辣椒末、辣椒粉和白芝麻；加熱80克植物油至筷子前端入油會冒小泡，約120至140°C，分2至3次沖入並邊攪拌，避免燒焦。
instruction.en: Place minced ginger, chili, chili powder, and white sesame in a heatproof bowl. Heat 80 g vegetable oil until a chopstick tip bubbles in it, about 120 to 140°C, then pour it in 2 to 3 additions while stirring to prevent scorching.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe cincang, cabai, bubuk cabai, dan wijen putih ke mangkuk tahan panas. Panaskan 80 g minyak hingga ujung sumpit membentuk gelembung kecil, sekitar 120 hingga 140°C, lalu tuang dalam 2 hingga 3 tahap sambil diaduk agar tidak gosong.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of hot oil being carefully poured over chili powder, minced ginger, chili, and sesame in a heatproof bowl, dramatic sizzling, no text.

instruction.zh: 在油潑辣椒芝麻中加入醬油、醬油膏、烏醋與少許糖，攪拌均勻成香辣酸甜的涼拌醬汁。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, soy sauce paste, black vinegar, and a little sugar to the bloomed chili-sesame mixture. Stir until it becomes a fragrant hot, tangy, and lightly sweet dressing.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, cuka hitam, dan sedikit gula ke campuran cabai wijen yang telah disiram minyak. Aduk hingga menjadi saus yang harum, pedas, asam, dan sedikit manis.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of glossy red-brown chili sesame dressing being stirred in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Cook and chill noodles and vegetables
title.id: Masak dan dinginkan soun serta sayuran

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，粉絲煮熟後立刻放入冰水冰鎮；接著將香菇、紅蘿蔔和木耳煮熟，也撈入冰水冰鎮，瀝乾備用。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water with a little salt to a boil. Cook the glass noodles, then immediately chill them in ice water. Next cook the mushrooms, carrot, and wood ear mushrooms, chill them in ice water as well, and drain.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dengan sedikit garam. Masak soun lalu segera dinginkan dalam air es. Berikutnya masak jamur, wortel, dan jamur kuping, dinginkan juga dalam air es, lalu tiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of glass noodles and colorful julienned vegetables cooling in bowls of ice water after blanching, no text.

title.en: Toss the Taiwanese glass noodle salad

instruction.zh: 將冰鎮瀝乾的粉絲和蔬菜放入大碗，倒入調好的辣椒芝麻醬汁，撒香菜後徹底拌勻，讓每條粉絲和蔬菜都裹上醬汁。
instruction.en: Put the chilled, drained glass noodles and vegetables in a large bowl. Pour over the prepared chili-sesame dressing, add cilantro, and toss thoroughly so every strand and vegetable is coated.
instruction.id: Masukkan soun dan sayuran yang sudah dingin serta ditiriskan ke mangkuk besar. Tuang saus cabai wijen, tambahkan daun ketumbar, lalu aduk hingga setiap helai soun dan sayuran terlapisi saus.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished Taiwanese chilled glass noodle salad with colorful crisp vegetables, chili sesame dressing, and cilantro in a wide bowl, no text.

description.zh: 以浸泡生花生打成細漿、過濾後加入米粉與玉米粉煮至凝結，冷藏成形並佐醬油膏與香菜的清爽全素小點。
description.en: A refreshing vegan peanut tofu pudding made by blending soaked raw peanuts, straining them, thickening with rice flour and corn flour, chilling until set, and serving with soy sauce paste and cilantro.
description.id: Puding tahu kacang vegan yang menyegarkan, dibuat dengan menghaluskan kacang tanah mentah yang direndam, menyaringnya, mengentalkan dengan tepung beras dan tepung jagung, mendinginkannya hingga set, lalu disajikan dengan pasta kecap asin serta daun ketumbar.

instruction.zh: 將帶皮生花生洗淨後泡水至少6小時；天氣炎熱時放入冰箱浸泡，完成後瀝乾泡水。
instruction.en: Wash the raw skin-on peanuts and soak them for at least 6 hours. In hot weather, soak them in the refrigerator, then drain the soaking water.
instruction.id: Cuci kacang tanah mentah berkulit lalu rendam setidaknya 6 jam. Saat cuaca panas, rendam di lemari es, lalu tiriskan air rendamannya.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of raw skin-on peanuts soaking in clear water in a covered glass bowl, no text.

title.zh: 分次加水打成細滑花生漿
title.en: Blend a smooth peanut slurry in batches
title.id: Haluskan kacang menjadi bubur halus bertahap

instruction.zh: 將150克泡好花生放入調理機，分次慢慢加入共750克水，每次約200克，攪打至非常細滑均勻。
instruction.en: Put the 150 g soaked peanuts in a blender and slowly add a total of 750 g water in batches of about 200 g each, blending until very smooth and even.
instruction.id: Masukkan 150 g kacang yang telah direndam ke blender, lalu tambahkan total 750 g air perlahan dalam beberapa tahap sekitar 200 g setiap kali, dan haluskan hingga sangat lembut serta merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of creamy pale peanut slurry blending in a high-speed blender, water being added gradually, no text.

title.zh: 過濾花生漿並拌入粉類
title.en: Strain peanut slurry and mix in flours
title.id: Saring bubur kacang dan campurkan tepung

instruction.zh: 在鍋上鋪豆漿布，將花生漿過濾；濾液加入再來米粉、玉米粉、鹽與糖，攪拌至完全無顆粒。
instruction.en: Line a pot with a nut-milk bag and strain the peanut slurry. Add rice flour, corn flour, salt, and sugar to the strained liquid, then whisk until completely lump-free.
instruction.id: Lapisi panci dengan kain penyaring susu kacang lalu saring bubur kacang. Tambahkan tepung beras, tepung jagung, garam, dan gula ke cairan saringan, lalu aduk hingga benar-benar tanpa gumpalan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of pale peanut milk being strained through cloth into a pot, with rice flour and corn flour whisked smooth, no text.

title.en: Heat and stir until thick and set
title.id: Panaskan dan aduk hingga kental serta set

instruction.zh: 將混合液移至爐上持續攪拌加熱，直到明顯濃稠、冒泡並開始凝結；成品會非常燙，後續容器需耐高溫。
instruction.en: Move the mixture to the stove and heat while stirring continuously until it becomes noticeably thick, bubbles, and begins to set. The mixture is very hot, so use a heat-safe container next.
instruction.id: Pindahkan campuran ke kompor dan panaskan sambil terus diaduk hingga jelas mengental, berbuih, dan mulai set. Campuran sangat panas, jadi gunakan wadah tahan panas pada tahap berikutnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of thick glossy peanut pudding mixture bubbling in a saucepan while being stirred with a spatula, no text.

instruction.zh: 玻璃耐熱保鮮盒薄薄抹油，快速倒入熱漿並輕震排出氣泡、整平表面；放涼後冷藏一天，切片並淋醬油膏、撒香菜享用。
instruction.en: Lightly oil a heat-safe glass storage container, quickly pour in the hot mixture, and gently tap out bubbles and level the surface. Cool, refrigerate for one day, then slice and serve with soy sauce paste and cilantro.
instruction.id: Olesi tipis wadah kaca tahan panas, cepat tuang adonan panas, lalu ketukkan perlahan untuk mengeluarkan gelembung dan meratakan permukaan. Dinginkan, simpan di lemari es satu hari, kemudian iris dan sajikan dengan pasta kecap asin serta daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished chilled peanut tofu pudding sliced into neat pieces, topped with glossy soy sauce paste and cilantro on a small plate, no text.

description.zh: 以板豆腐、凍豆腐與香菇調成五香內餡，填入蝴蝶切蓮藕後煎至金黃的全素蓮藕鑲肉。
description.en: A vegan stuffed lotus root dish with a five-spice filling of firm tofu, frozen tofu, and mushrooms, packed into butterfly-cut lotus root and pan-fried until golden.
description.id: Hidangan akar teratai isi vegan dengan isian lima rempah dari tahu padat, tahu beku, dan jamur, diisi ke akar teratai potongan kupu-kupu lalu digoreng hingga keemasan.

title.id: Kupas dan potong kupu-kupu akar teratai

instruction.zh: 蓮藕洗淨削皮後，先泡入加少許白醋的水中防氧化；以蝴蝶刀切法切約0.3至0.5公分厚、中央仍相連的蓮藕片。
instruction.en: Wash and peel the lotus root, then keep it in water with a little white vinegar to prevent browning. Butterfly-cut it into slices about 0.3 to 0.5 cm thick that remain joined at the center.
instruction.id: Cuci dan kupas akar teratai, lalu simpan dalam air dengan sedikit cuka putih agar tidak menghitam. Potong gaya kupu-kupu setebal sekitar 0,3 hingga 0,5 cm sehingga bagian tengahnya tetap menyatu.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of peeled lotus root butterfly-cut into hinged slices resting in lightly vinegared water, no text.

title.zh: 切香菇薑末並擠乾豆腐

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇切小丁，老薑切末；凍豆腐充分擠乾，板豆腐則輕壓去除部分水分。
instruction.en: Dice the fresh shiitake mushrooms and mince the mature ginger. Squeeze the frozen tofu very dry, and gently press out some moisture from the firm tofu.
instruction.id: Potong dadu kecil jamur shiitake segar dan cincang jahe tua. Peras tahu beku hingga sangat kering, lalu tekan tahu padat perlahan untuk mengurangi sebagian airnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of diced shiitake, minced ginger, squeezed frozen tofu, and lightly pressed firm tofu prepared for filling, no text.

instruction.zh: 將兩種豆腐放入調理機，加入低筋麵粉、五香粉、花椒粉、胡椒粉、味噌、醬油膏、香油和糖，打成可塑形內餡；拌入香菇丁和薑末。
instruction.en: Put both tofus in a blender with cake flour, five-spice powder, Sichuan pepper powder, ground pepper, miso, soy sauce paste, sesame oil, and sugar. Blend into a moldable filling, then fold in diced mushrooms and minced ginger.
instruction.id: Masukkan kedua jenis tahu ke blender bersama tepung terigu protein rendah, bubuk lima rempah, bubuk lada Sichuan, lada bubuk, miso, pasta kecap asin, minyak wijen, dan gula. Haluskan menjadi isian yang dapat dibentuk, lalu aduk bersama jamur dadu serta jahe cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of savory tofu filling being blended smooth then folded with diced shiitake and ginger in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Fill lotus root and coat in starches
title.id: Isi akar teratai dan balut dua tepung

instruction.zh: 在每片蝴蝶蓮藕內側抹太白粉，填入豆腐內餡並合起；外側再均勻裹上地瓜粉，完成後先放盤中備用。
instruction.en: Dust the inner faces of each butterfly lotus root slice with potato starch, fill with tofu mixture, and close. Coat the outside evenly with sweet potato starch, then set aside on a plate.
instruction.id: Taburi sisi dalam setiap irisan akar teratai kupu-kupu dengan tepung kentang, isi dengan campuran tahu, lalu tutup. Lapisi bagian luar secara merata dengan tepung ubi jalar, kemudian sisihkan di piring.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of lotus root sandwiches filled with tofu mixture and coated in pale starch on a tray, no text.

title.id: Goreng dangkal kedua sisi hingga keemasan

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入足以接觸每片底部的一層植物油，中火將蓮藕鑲肉兩面煎至金黃酥脆後盛出。
instruction.en: Pour a shallow layer of vegetable oil into a skillet so every piece touches oil. Pan-fry both sides of the stuffed lotus root over medium heat until golden and crisp, then remove.
instruction.id: Tuang lapisan tipis minyak nabati ke wajan agar setiap potongan menyentuh minyak. Goreng dangkal kedua sisi akar teratai isi dengan api sedang hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished golden pan-fried vegan stuffed lotus root slices with crisp edges and visible tofu mushroom filling on a ceramic plate, no text.

title.zh: 全素韓式炸雞只要一樣食材就可以完成

description.zh: 以白花椰菜裹粉油炸成酥脆口感，再拌上自製味噌韓式辣醬的全素追劇小食。
description.en: A vegan Korean fried chicken snack made from crispy battered cauliflower tossed in a homemade miso Korean chili sauce.
description.id: Camilan ayam goreng Korea vegan dari kembang kol berbalut tepung yang renyah, lalu diaduk dengan saus cabai Korea miso buatan sendiri.

instruction.zh: 將洗淨的白花椰菜從靠近花朵處切成小朵，保留花朵完整不散開；較粗的梗可留作其他料理。
instruction.en: Cut the washed cauliflower into small florets close to the flower heads, keeping each floret intact. Reserve the thicker stems for another dish.
instruction.id: Potong kembang kol yang sudah dicuci menjadi kuntum kecil dekat bagian bunganya, sambil menjaga setiap kuntum tetap utuh. Simpan batang yang lebih tebal untuk masakan lain.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of clean cauliflower cut into compact bite-size florets on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 大碗中加入植物奶、檸檬汁、營養酵母、辣椒粉、花椒粉和少許鹽，攪拌均勻後放入花椰菜醃製約1小時。
instruction.en: Combine plant milk, lemon juice, nutritional yeast, chili powder, Sichuan pepper powder, and a little salt in a large bowl. Mix well, add cauliflower, and marinate for about 1 hour.
instruction.id: Campurkan susu nabati, jus lemon, ragi nutrisi, bubuk cabai, bubuk lada Sichuan, dan sedikit garam dalam mangkuk besar. Aduk rata, masukkan kembang kol, lalu marinasi sekitar 1 jam.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of cauliflower florets soaking in a creamy spiced plant-milk marinade in a large bowl, no text.

title.id: Lapisi dua kali dengan tepung renyah

instruction.zh: 將酥炸粉與少許鹽、胡椒粉拌勻；醃好的花椰菜瀝起後裹乾粉，再回沾醃汁一次，最後再裹乾粉形成較厚的外殼。
instruction.en: Mix crispy frying flour with a little salt and ground pepper. Drain the marinated cauliflower, coat it in dry flour, dip it back into the marinade once, then coat it again to form a thicker crust.
instruction.id: Campur tepung pelapis renyah dengan sedikit garam dan lada bubuk. Tiriskan kembang kol yang dimarinasi, balut dengan tepung kering, celupkan sekali lagi ke marinasi, lalu balut kembali untuk membentuk kulit yang lebih tebal.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of cauliflower florets being double-coated in seasoned crispy flour, craggy batter texture, no text.

instruction.zh: 將油鍋加熱至約160°C，分批放入裹好的花椰菜炸至金黃酥脆，撈出瀝油。
instruction.en: Heat frying oil to about 160°C. Fry the coated cauliflower in batches until golden and crisp, then remove and drain.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga sekitar 160°C. Goreng kembang kol berlapis tepung secara bertahap sampai keemasan dan renyah, lalu angkat serta tiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of craggy cauliflower florets frying golden and crisp in hot oil, no text.

title.zh: 煮濃韓式辣醬後關火裹勻
title.en: Reduce Korean chili sauce, then toss off heat
title.id: Kental-kan saus cabai Korea lalu aduk setelah api mati

instruction.zh: 味噌、韓國辣椒粉、蘋果醋、味醂和少許水拌勻後入鍋煮滾至微濃稠；關火才放入炸花椰菜快速翻裹，撒白芝麻即可。
instruction.en: Mix miso, Korean chili powder, apple cider vinegar, mirin, and a little water, then simmer until it boils and thickens slightly. Turn off the heat before quickly tossing in fried cauliflower, then finish with white sesame seeds.
instruction.id: Campurkan miso, bubuk cabai Korea, cuka apel, mirin, dan sedikit air, lalu didihkan sampai agak mengental. Matikan api sebelum cepat mengaduk kembang kol goreng ke dalam saus, lalu akhiri dengan biji wijen putih.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan Korean fried cauliflower coated in glossy red chili sauce and white sesame seeds in a dark bowl, no text.

description.zh: 以紅地瓜、紫地瓜和芋頭分別揉入地瓜粉粉漿與乾粉製成三色芋圓，搭配仙草、植物奶和黑糖水的全素甜品。
description.en: A vegan three-color taro-ball dessert: red sweet potato, purple sweet potato, and taro are each kneaded with sweet-potato-starch slurry and dry flour, then served with grass jelly, plant milk, and brown sugar syrup.
description.id: Hidangan bola talas tiga warna vegan: ubi jalar merah, ubi jalar ungu, dan talas masing-masing diuleni dengan bubur tepung ubi serta tepung kering, lalu disajikan bersama cincau, susu nabati, dan sirup gula merah.

title.en: Simmer brown sugar syrup and cool
title.id: Didihkan sirup gula merah lalu dinginkan

instruction.zh: 鍋中加入黑糖和少許水，煮滾後再熬約5分鐘，離火放涼備用。
instruction.en: Combine brown sugar and a little water in a pot. Bring to a boil, simmer for about 5 more minutes, then remove from heat and cool.
instruction.id: Campurkan gula merah dan sedikit air dalam panci. Didihkan, masak sekitar 5 menit lagi, lalu angkat dari api dan dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of glossy brown sugar syrup simmering gently in a small saucepan, no text.

title.en: Cut and steam three root vegetables

instruction.zh: 紅地瓜、紫地瓜和芋頭削皮切小塊，芋頭切得比地瓜更小；紫地瓜單獨分開以免染色，電鍋外鍋加2杯水蒸約30分鐘，再燜10分鐘。
instruction.en: Peel and cut red sweet potato, purple sweet potato, and taro into chunks, cutting taro smaller than the sweet potatoes. Keep purple sweet potato separate to prevent staining; steam with 2 cups water in the outer pot for about 30 minutes, then rest 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong ubi jalar merah, ubi jalar ungu, serta talas, dengan talas dipotong lebih kecil. Pisahkan ubi ungu agar tidak meluntur; kukus dengan 2 cangkir air pada panci luar sekitar 30 menit, lalu diamkan 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of red sweet potato, purple sweet potato, and taro chunks arranged separately for steaming, no text.

title.zh: 分別壓泥並揉成三色麵糰
title.en: Mash and knead three colored doughs
title.id: Haluskan dan uleni tiga adonan warna

instruction.zh: 各色根莖趁熱以叉子壓成泥；紅地瓜可依甜度加少許蔗糖，加入地瓜粉與水調成的粉漿，再逐量加入地瓜粉和太白粉乾粉，揉至不黏手光滑，其他兩色同法完成。
instruction.en: Mash each cooked root vegetable while warm with a fork. Add a little cane sugar to red sweet potato if needed, mix in a sweet-potato-starch-and-water slurry, then gradually add dry sweet potato starch and potato starch until smooth and not sticky; repeat for the other colors.
instruction.id: Haluskan setiap umbi matang saat masih hangat dengan garpu. Tambahkan sedikit gula tebu ke ubi merah bila perlu, campurkan bubur tepung ubi dan air, lalu tambahkan bertahap tepung ubi serta tepung kentang kering hingga halus dan tidak lengket; ulangi untuk warna lainnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of three colorful sweet potato and taro doughs being kneaded in separate bowls, no text.

title.zh: 醒麵後搓條切圓並冷凍
title.en: Rest, roll, cut, and freeze the balls
title.id: Istirahatkan, gulung, potong, dan bekukan bola

instruction.zh: 三色麵糰蓋布醒10分鐘保濕；各自分半搓成長條和細條，切成小塊後放入撒太白粉的盤中滾圓防沾，可立即煮或收入保鮮盒冷凍。
instruction.en: Cover the three doughs with a cloth and rest 10 minutes to retain moisture. Divide each, roll into ropes, cut small pieces, and round them on a potato-starch-dusted tray to prevent sticking; cook immediately or freeze in a container.
instruction.id: Tutup tiga adonan dengan kain dan istirahatkan 10 menit agar lembap. Bagi masing-masing, gulung menjadi tali, potong kecil-kecil, lalu bulatkan di nampan bertabur tepung kentang agar tidak lengket; masak segera atau bekukan dalam wadah.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of red, purple, and taro-colored dough ropes cut into small round balls on a starch-dusted tray, no text.

instruction.zh: 滾水下芋圓時持續輕攪防黏，浮起後再煮1分鐘；撈入冰水冰鎮，再與仙草、植物奶和黑糖水一同盛碗享用。
instruction.en: When adding taro balls to boiling water, stir gently to prevent sticking. After they float, cook 1 more minute; transfer to ice water, then serve with grass jelly, plant milk, and brown sugar syrup.
instruction.id: Saat memasukkan bola talas ke air mendidih, aduk perlahan agar tidak lengket. Setelah mengapung, masak 1 menit lagi; pindahkan ke air es, lalu sajikan dengan cincau, susu nabati, dan sirup gula merah.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished three-color taro balls with grass jelly, plant milk, ice, and brown sugar syrup in a glass dessert bowl, no text.

description.zh: 以凍豆腐做成全素氣炸雞塊，搭配酪梨莎莎沾醬、香蕉燕麥脆片與鹽胡椒烤時蔬的複合下午茶。
description.en: A composed vegan snack of air-fryer ‘chicken’ made from frozen tofu, avocado salsa dip, banana oat clusters, and salt-and-pepper roasted vegetables.
description.id: Camilan vegan lengkap berupa ‘ayam’ air fryer dari tahu beku, saus celup salsa alpukat, granola pisang oat, dan sayuran panggang garam-lada.

name.zh: 香菇昆布高湯或蔬菜高湯

instruction.zh: 將櫛瓜、茄子和紅黃甜椒切成適當大小，撒鹽與胡椒粉並噴油。放入氣炸鍋，以180°C烤15分鐘。
instruction.en: Cut zucchini, eggplant, and red and yellow bell peppers into suitable pieces. Season with salt and pepper, spray with oil, and air-fry at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Potong zucchini, terong, serta paprika merah dan kuning sesuai ukuran. Bumbui dengan garam serta lada, semprot minyak, lalu masak dengan air fryer pada 180°C selama 15 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Air-fry vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將燕麥片、綜合堅果、香草精與少量鹽拌勻。香蕉打成泥後倒入燕麥混合物，輕輕拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix rolled oats, mixed nuts, vanilla extract, and a little salt. Blend banana into a purée, pour it into the oat mixture, and fold gently.
instruction.id: Campurkan oat, kacang campur, ekstrak vanila, dan sedikit garam. Haluskan pisang menjadi purée, tuang ke campuran oat, lalu aduk perlahan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix banana oat clusters”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 氣炸鍋底部鋪烤盤紙，將混合物均勻鋪平。200°C烤10分鐘後翻面，再以200°C烤10分鐘；接著降至150°C再烤10分鐘。若仍偏軟，每次可再烤10分鐘至完全乾燥，放涼後保存。
instruction.en: Line the air-fryer base with baking paper and spread the mixture evenly. Air-fry at 200°C for 10 minutes, flip and air-fry at 200°C for another 10 minutes, then reduce to 150°C for 10 minutes. If still soft, continue in 10-minute intervals until fully dry, then cool before storing.
instruction.id: Alasi dasar air fryer dengan kertas panggang dan ratakan campuran. Masak pada 200°C selama 10 menit, balik lalu masak lagi pada 200°C selama 10 menit, kemudian turunkan ke 150°C selama 10 menit. Jika masih lunak, lanjutkan setiap 10 menit hingga benar-benar kering, lalu dinginkan sebelum disimpan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Bake banana oat clusters”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 凍豆腐退冰後擠乾水分，剝成雞塊大小。加入香菇昆布高湯或蔬菜高湯、胡椒粉、五香粉、醬油、香油與少量鹽拌勻，醃約30分鐘。
instruction.en: Thaw frozen tofu, squeeze it dry, and tear it into chicken-nugget-size pieces. Mix with mushroom-kelp broth or vegetable broth, ground pepper, five-spice powder, soy sauce, sesame oil, and a little salt; marinate about 30 minutes.
instruction.id: Cairkan tahu beku, peras hingga kering, lalu sobek seukuran nugget ayam. Campurkan dengan kaldu jamur-kombu atau kaldu sayuran, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, kecap asin, minyak wijen, dan sedikit garam; marinasi sekitar 30 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Marinate frozen tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 香菜與辣椒去蒂；取出酪梨果肉，番茄去蒂對半切，檸檬榨汁。將全部材料打碎，加入鹽、義式香料、胡椒與少量橄欖油拌勻，冷藏備用。
instruction.en: Remove stems from cilantro and chili, scoop avocado flesh, stem and halve tomato, and juice the lemon. Chop the ingredients together, then mix with salt, Italian seasoning, pepper, and a little olive oil; chill until needed.
instruction.id: Buang tangkai daun ketumbar dan cabai, ambil daging alpukat, buang tangkai tomat lalu belah dua, dan peras lemon. Cincang semua bahan bersama, lalu campurkan garam, bumbu Italia, lada, dan sedikit minyak zaitun; dinginkan hingga digunakan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make avocado salsa”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Prepare wet batter and dry coating
title.id: Siapkan adonan basah dan pelapis kering

instruction.zh: 將植物奶、少量檸檬汁與營養酵母拌勻成濕漿。另將酥炸粉、低筋麵粉、少量鹽與胡椒粉混合成乾粉。
instruction.en: Mix plant milk, a little lemon juice, and nutritional yeast into a wet batter. Separately combine crispy frying flour mix, cake flour, a little salt, and ground pepper for the dry coating.
instruction.id: Campurkan susu nabati, sedikit air lemon, dan ragi nutrisi menjadi adonan basah. Secara terpisah, gabungkan campuran tepung goreng renyah, tepung terigu protein rendah, sedikit garam, dan lada bubuk sebagai pelapis kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare wet batter and dry coating”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Lapisi dan masak ‘ayam’ vegan dengan air fryer

instruction.zh: 將醃好的凍豆腐稍微擠去高湯，依序沾乾粉、濕漿、再沾乾粉，抖去多餘粉後放入氣炸鍋並噴油。
instruction.en: Squeeze a little broth from the marinated frozen tofu, coat it in dry mix, wet batter, then dry mix again. Shake off excess coating, place in the air fryer, and spray with oil.
instruction.id: Peras sedikit kaldu dari tahu beku yang sudah dimarinasi, lapisi berurutan dengan campuran kering, adonan basah, lalu campuran kering lagi. Kibaskan pelapis berlebih, masukkan ke air fryer, dan semprot minyak.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Coat and air-fry vegan ‘chicken’”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
素食寶寶的營養均衡很重要
繼上次的寶寶蘿蔔糕
這次來做超簡單的蔬菜丸
不用加油跟鹽巴
也可以做出香甜軟糯的蔬菜丸
我相信寶寶們一定會喜歡的
趕快動手做給他們吃吧！
description.en: Balanced nutrition is important for vegan babies. After the previous baby radish cake, this is a very simple vegetable-ball recipe. It makes sweet, soft, chewy vegetable balls without oil or salt.
description.id: Nutrisi seimbang penting bagi bayi vegan. Setelah kue lobak bayi sebelumnya, kali ini dibuat bola sayur yang sangat sederhana. Tanpa minyak atau garam, hasilnya tetap manis dan lembut kenyal.

instruction.zh: 準備馬鈴薯、花椰菜、紅蘿蔔、麵粉與營養酵母。
instruction.en: Prepare the potato, broccoli, carrot, flour, and nutritional yeast.
instruction.id: Siapkan kentang, brokoli, wortel, tepung, dan ragi nutrisi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將紅蘿蔔和花椰菜切成細末。
instruction.en: Finely chop the carrot and broccoli.
instruction.id: Cincang halus wortel dan brokoli.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finely chop the vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
現在炎熱的天氣
很適合自製冰涼美乃滋
不管是搭配沙拉還是吐司
甚至做成白醬義大利麵都超完美
這次使用九陽k9S免清洗多功能破壁調理機
讓美乃滋做起來不僅超快速而且口感很滑順
同時還可以蒸煮蔬菜
讓一餐變得輕鬆簡單又美味
你們也趕快一起動手試試看吧！
＃素食＃全素美乃滋＃九陽k9S免清洗多功能破壁調理機
description.en: Hot weather is perfect for homemade chilled mayonnaise. It is wonderful with salad or toast, and even as a white sauce for pasta. This recipe uses a Joyoung K9S self-cleaning multifunction blender to make the mayonnaise quickly and smoothly while also steaming vegetables, making a meal easy, simple, and delicious. Give it a try! #vegetarian #veganmayonnaise #JoyoungK9S
description.id: Cuaca panas sangat cocok untuk membuat mayones dingin sendiri. Mayones ini sangat pas untuk salad atau roti panggang, bahkan sebagai saus putih pasta. Resep ini menggunakan blender multifungsi Joyoung K9S yang dapat membersihkan sendiri agar mayones cepat dan lembut sekaligus dapat mengukus sayuran, sehingga satu hidangan menjadi mudah, sederhana, dan lezat. Yuk, coba buat! #vegetarian #mayonesvegan #JoyoungK9S

instruction.zh: 將生腰果、檸檬汁、全素法式芥末醬、橄欖油、鹽、糖和水放入調理機，打至滑順。試吃後若覺得不夠甜，可再加少量楓糖漿；放涼後冷藏。若使用料理棒等設備，腰果需先泡水至少 4 小時或泡一晚。
instruction.en: Put raw cashews, lemon juice, vegan Dijon mustard, olive oil, salt, sugar, and water in a blender and blend until smooth. Taste it and add a little maple syrup if it is not sweet enough; cool and refrigerate. When using an immersion blender or similar equipment, soak the cashews for at least 4 hours or overnight first.
instruction.id: Masukkan kacang mete mentah, air lemon, mustard Dijon vegan, minyak zaitun, garam, gula, dan air ke dalam blender, lalu haluskan hingga lembut. Cicipi dan tambahkan sedikit sirup maple bila kurang manis; dinginkan lalu simpan di lemari es. Jika memakai blender tangan atau alat serupa, rendam kacang mete setidaknya 4 jam atau semalaman terlebih dahulu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blend the vegan mayonnaise”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Soak and steam the red quinoa

instruction.zh: 紅藜麥先泡水約 10 分鐘，再放入蒸籠蒸熟。蒸好後取出、稍微拌開並放涼。
instruction.en: Soak the red quinoa for about 10 minutes, then steam it in a steamer until cooked. Remove it, fluff it lightly, and let it cool.
instruction.id: Rendam quinoa merah sekitar 10 menit, lalu kukus hingga matang. Angkat, aduk perlahan agar terurai, lalu biarkan dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soak and steam the red quinoa”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 地瓜、南瓜和花椰菜切塊；洗淨小番茄後對半切。生菜切段並洗淨。將要蒸的蔬菜放入蒸籠，蒸 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Cut the sweet potato, pumpkin, and broccoli into chunks. Wash and halve the cherry tomatoes. Cut and wash the lettuce. Put the vegetables to be steamed in a steamer and steam for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Potong ubi jalar, labu kuning, dan brokoli menjadi potongan. Cuci lalu belah dua tomat ceri. Potong dan cuci selada. Masukkan sayuran yang akan dikukus ke dalam kukusan dan kukus selama 15 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare and steam the vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 盤中放入切好的生菜和蒸熟的蔬菜，加入全素美乃滋拌勻，最後放上紅藜麥和小番茄即可享用。
instruction.en: Put the cut lettuce and steamed vegetables on a plate, add the vegan mayonnaise and toss evenly, then finish with the red quinoa and cherry tomatoes.
instruction.id: Letakkan selada yang telah dipotong dan sayuran kukus di atas piring, tambahkan mayones vegan lalu aduk hingga rata, kemudian beri quinoa merah dan tomat ceri di atasnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble the salad”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 高麗菜蒸軟後捲起，以兩張千張包裹並煎至金黃，最後拌入醬油、糖、香油、蘋果醋與水調成的醬燒醬汁。
description.en: Cabbage leaves are steamed until soft, rolled up, wrapped in two sheets of tofu skin, and pan-fried golden before being coated in a soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, and water sauce.
description.id: Daun kol dikukus hingga lunak, digulung, dibungkus dengan dua lembar kulit tahu, lalu digoreng hingga keemasan sebelum dilapisi saus dari kecap asin, gula, minyak wijen, cuka apel, dan air.

title.en: Separate, wash, and steam the cabbage

instruction.zh: 準備一顆高麗菜，從底部根部附近略切後逐片剝下，盡量保持完整；洗淨後放入碗中，以電鍋外鍋半杯水蒸至變軟，取出放涼。
instruction.en: Prepare one head of cabbage. Make a small cut near the base and separate the leaves one by one, keeping them intact as much as possible. Wash, place in a bowl, and steam in an electric cooker with half a cup of water in the outer pot until soft; let cool.
instruction.id: Siapkan satu buah kol. Buat sedikit sayatan dekat pangkal lalu lepaskan daunnya satu per satu sambil menjaga agar tetap utuh. Cuci, taruh dalam mangkuk, dan kukus dalam penanak listrik dengan setengah cangkir air di panci luar hingga lunak; biarkan dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of intact cabbage leaves being carefully separated from a whole cabbage, with clean washed leaves in a bowl beside an electric steamer; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將放涼的高麗菜葉兩片疊在一起，先向上捲緊，再將左右兩側往內折捲，做成緊實的菜卷。
instruction.en: Stack two cooled cabbage leaves together. Roll them tightly upward, then fold and roll both sides inward to make a firm cabbage roll.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua daun kol yang telah dingin. Gulung rapat ke atas, lalu lipat dan gulung kedua sisinya ke dalam hingga menjadi gulungan kol yang padat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of two softened cabbage leaves stacked and rolled into a compact cabbage roll on a clean board; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Wrap the roll in tofu skin

instruction.zh: 取兩張千張疊在一起，表面撒少量麵粉後放上菜卷。像包春捲般捲起並將左右兩側向內折；以麵粉和水隨意調成不太濃稠的麵糊，塗在尾端封口黏住。
instruction.en: Stack two tofu skin sheets, sprinkle on a little flour, and place the cabbage roll on top. Roll it up like a spring roll and fold both sides inward. Mix flour and water into a loose, not-too-thick slurry, then use it to seal the end.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua lembar kulit tahu, taburi sedikit tepung, lalu letakkan gulungan kol di atasnya. Gulung seperti lumpia dan lipat kedua sisi ke dalam. Campurkan tepung dan air menjadi adonan encer yang tidak terlalu kental, lalu gunakan untuk merekatkan ujungnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of a cabbage roll being wrapped in two pale tofu skin sheets like a spring roll, with a small bowl of thin flour slurry for sealing; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將醬油、糖、香油、少量蘋果醋與水混合，攪拌均勻成醬燒醬汁。
instruction.en: Combine soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, a little apple cider vinegar, and water, then stir until evenly mixed for the braising sauce.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, gula, minyak wijen, sedikit cuka apel, dan air, lalu aduk hingga rata menjadi saus panggang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of a small bowl of glossy brown soy sauce mixture being stirred with sugar, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar and water nearby; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入少量植物油，將包好的菜卷煎至兩面金黃。蓋上鍋蓋燜約兩分鐘後即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pan and fry the wrapped rolls until golden on both sides. Cover and cook for about two minutes, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu goreng gulungan yang telah dibungkus hingga kedua sisinya keemasan. Tutup dan masak selama sekitar dua menit, kemudian angkat dari wajan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of tofu-skin-wrapped cabbage rolls turning golden on both sides in a lightly oiled pan under a lid; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將菜卷切成約三公分長的段狀後上桌，搭配調好的醬燒醬汁享用。
instruction.en: Cut the cabbage rolls into pieces about 3 cm long and serve with the prepared braising sauce.
instruction.id: Potong gulungan kol menjadi bagian sepanjang sekitar 3 cm, lalu sajikan dengan saus panggang yang telah disiapkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan dish image of golden tofu-skin cabbage roll pieces cut into about 3 cm segments and served with glossy brown dipping sauce; no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 煎香大塊豆腐，搭配青椒、青花椒、薑、辣椒和檸檬打成的青醬，收濃後淋在熱砂鍋豆腐上。
description.en: Large tofu pieces are pan-fried until golden and topped with a reduced green sauce blended from green pepper, green Sichuan pepper, ginger, chili, and lemon.
description.id: Potongan tahu besar digoreng hingga keemasan lalu disiram saus hijau kental dari paprika hijau, lada Sichuan hijau, jahe, cabai, dan lemon.

instruction.zh: 青椒切段，老薑切片；辣椒按需要去除籽後備用。
instruction.en: Cut green pepper into sections and slice the ginger; remove chili seeds if desired and set aside.
instruction.id: Potong paprika hijau menjadi beberapa bagian dan iris jahe; buang biji cabai bila diinginkan lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan mise en place with chopped green pepper, sliced ginger, fresh chili, lemon and green Sichuan peppercorns on a wooden board, bright natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加植物油，放入豆腐後以湯匙隨意分成大塊，將每一面煎至金黃色後取出。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, add tofu, and use a spoon to break it into large irregular pieces. Fry every side until golden, then remove.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan, masukkan tahu, lalu gunakan sendok untuk membaginya menjadi potongan besar tidak beraturan. Goreng setiap sisi hingga keemasan, lalu angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Large irregular tofu pieces pan-frying until golden in a wok, crisp browned sides and a little vegetable oil, vegan Chinese home cooking, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把青椒、老薑、辣椒、青花椒、檸檬汁和少許植物油放入調理機，打碎成青醬。
instruction.en: Put green pepper, ginger, chili, green Sichuan pepper, lemon juice, and a little vegetable oil into a blender and blend into a green sauce.
instruction.id: Masukkan paprika hijau, jahe, cabai, lada Sichuan hijau, jus lemon, dan sedikit minyak sayur ke blender, lalu haluskan menjadi saus hijau.

steps.imagePrompt: Vibrant green vegan pepper sauce blending in a countertop blender with ginger, chili, lemon and green Sichuan pepper, clean kitchen scene, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把青醬倒入鍋中，以小火煮至原有水分幾乎收乾、呈泥狀但不全乾。加入水、鹽、糖和胡椒粉；以太白粉或蓮藕粉加水調成勾芡水，邊倒邊攪拌至微濃稠後關火。
instruction.en: Pour the green sauce into a pan and cook over low heat until its original moisture is nearly gone and it is pasty but not dry. Add water, salt, sugar, and pepper; make a slurry with potato starch or lotus-root starch and water, then stir it in until slightly thick before turning off the heat.
instruction.id: Tuang saus hijau ke wajan dan masak dengan api kecil hingga air alaminya hampir habis dan menjadi seperti pasta namun tidak kering. Tambahkan air, garam, gula, dan lada; buat larutan tepung kentang atau tepung akar teratai dengan air, lalu tuang sambil diaduk hingga sedikit mengental sebelum mematikan api.

steps.imagePrompt: Thick vibrant green pepper sauce gently simmering in a wok, glossy texture with a wooden spatula stirring, vegan cooking scene, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 砂鍋稍微加熱後放入煎豆腐，淋上青椒醬即可上桌；沒有砂鍋可直接把豆腐與醬汁拌勻食用。
instruction.en: Warm a claypot gently, add the fried tofu, and pour the green pepper sauce over it. Without a claypot, simply toss tofu with sauce and serve.
instruction.id: Hangatkan claypot perlahan, masukkan tahu goreng, lalu siram saus paprika hijau di atasnya. Jika tanpa claypot, cukup aduk tahu dengan saus dan sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan green pepper tofu in a warm claypot, golden tofu pieces covered in vibrant green sauce, fragrant steam, elegant Asian home food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 以熱油激發薑、白芝麻和辣椒粉香氣，再拌入日式醬油、烏醋、香油、素蠔油和雪碧，配冰鎮細麵做成酸辣清爽拌麵。
description.en: Hot oil blooms ginger, sesame, and chili powder, then Japanese soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, and Sprite make a tangy sauce for chilled thin noodles.
description.id: Minyak panas membangkitkan aroma jahe, wijen, dan bubuk cabai; lalu kecap Jepang, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, saus tiram vegan, dan Sprite menjadi saus asam pedas untuk mi tipis dingin.

name.en: instant noodle cake or thin noodles

instruction.zh: 把老薑和香菜切末，小黃瓜和紅甜椒切絲。配菜可依喜好換成豆芽菜或小白菜等。
instruction.en: Mince ginger and cilantro; julienne cucumber and red bell pepper. You may substitute toppings such as bean sprouts or bok choy as preferred.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe dan daun ketumbar; iris tipis timun serta paprika merah. Pelengkap dapat diganti dengan tauge atau pakcoy sesuai selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan noodle topping preparation with julienned cucumber, red bell pepper, minced ginger, cilantro, lemon and sesame on a wooden board, bright natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 耐熱碗中放入薑末、白芝麻和辣椒粉。植物油加熱至約 160°C 後倒入碗中激發香氣，拌入日式醬油、烏醋、香油、素蠔油和雪碧；加入檸檬片拌勻後冷藏冰鎮。
instruction.en: Place ginger, white sesame, and chili powder in a heatproof bowl. Heat vegetable oil to about 160°C and pour it over to bloom the aromatics, then stir in Japanese soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, and Sprite. Add lemon slices, mix, and chill.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe, wijen putih, dan bubuk cabai ke mangkuk tahan panas. Panaskan minyak sayur hingga sekitar 160°C lalu siramkan untuk mengeluarkan aroma, kemudian aduk kecap Jepang, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, saus tiram vegan, dan Sprite. Tambahkan irisan lemon, aduk, lalu dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Hot oil blooming ginger, white sesame and chili powder in a heatproof bowl, with lemon slices and tangy vegan noodle sauce ingredients nearby, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水，將王子麵或任意細麵煮熟。先準備冰水，麵煮好後立刻放入冰水冰鎮，再撈出瀝乾。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook instant noodles or any thin noodles. Prepare ice water; transfer cooked noodles to it immediately, then drain well.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dan rebus mi instan atau mi tipis apa pun hingga matang. Siapkan air es; segera masukkan mi matang ke air es, lalu tiriskan hingga baik.

steps.imagePrompt: Thin noodles being transferred from boiling water into a bowl of ice water, refreshing vegan noodle preparation, clean bright kitchen scene, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把冰鎮瀝乾的麵放入大碗，放上小黃瓜、紅甜椒和香菜，按麵量淋入冰鎮醬汁，檸檬片一同拌入後即可享用。
instruction.en: Put chilled, drained noodles in a large bowl. Add cucumber, red bell pepper, and cilantro; pour in chilled sauce to suit the noodle amount, tossing the lemon slices through before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan mi yang sudah dingin dan ditiriskan ke mangkuk besar. Tambahkan timun, paprika merah, dan daun ketumbar; tuang saus dingin sesuai jumlah mi, lalu aduk bersama irisan lemon sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished chilled vegan sweet-sour Sprite noodles in a bowl with cucumber, red bell pepper, cilantro and lemon, glossy chili sesame sauce, vibrant natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 馬鈴薯、櫛瓜、蘑菇與豆腐搭配番茄和香料油燉煮成濃郁的全素印度蔬菜咖喱，不加椰奶、酸奶或奶油。
description.en: Potato, zucchini, mushrooms, and tofu are cooked with tomato and an aromatic spiced oil into a rich vegan Indian vegetable curry, without coconut milk, yogurt, or butter.
description.id: Kentang, zukini, jamur, dan tahu dimasak bersama tomat serta minyak rempah menjadi kari sayuran India vegan yang kaya rasa, tanpa santan, yoghurt, atau mentega.

instruction.zh: 將馬鈴薯、櫛瓜、蘑菇與豆腐切成塊；番茄切小丁，老薑切片。影片使用的澳洲馬鈴薯皮薄可保留外皮；若使用皮較厚的馬鈴薯則削皮。
instruction.en: Cut the potatoes, zucchini, mushrooms, and tofu into chunks. Dice the tomato and slice the mature ginger. The video leaves the thin skin on Australian potatoes; peel potatoes with thicker skin.
instruction.id: Potong kentang, zukini, jamur, dan tahu menjadi potongan besar. Potong tomat dadu kecil dan iris jahe tua. Video membiarkan kulit kentang Australia yang tipis; kupas kentang dengan kulit yang lebih tebal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the vegetables and tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 烤香馬鈴薯、蘑菇與豆腐
title.en: Roast the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu

instruction.zh: 將馬鈴薯、蘑菇與豆腐拌少量油和鹽，放入烤箱以 200°C 烤 15 分鐘至香；也可用氣炸鍋處理。
instruction.en: Toss the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu with a little oil and salt. Roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until fragrant; an air fryer can also be used.
instruction.id: Aduk kentang, jamur, dan tahu dengan sedikit minyak dan garam. Panggang pada 200°C selama 15 menit hingga harum; penggoreng udara juga dapat digunakan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Roast the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入植物油，冷油放入芹菜、香菜和薑片，煸至金黃後撈起。接著放入月桂葉、八角、桂皮、陳皮、丁香、小茴香、孜然與花椒煸香；將可夾起的大型香料先取出，保留小茴香、丁香和花椒。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a pot and, while cold, add celery, cilantro, and ginger slices. Fry until golden, then remove. Add bay leaves, star anise, cinnamon bark, dried tangerine peel, cloves, fennel, cumin, and Sichuan peppercorns until aromatic; remove the larger whole spices first, leaving the fennel, cloves, and peppercorns.
instruction.id: Masukkan minyak sayur ke dalam panci dan, saat minyak masih dingin, tambahkan seledri, daun ketumbar, serta irisan jahe. Tumis hingga keemasan lalu angkat. Tambahkan daun salam, bunga lawang, kayu manis, kulit jeruk kering, cengkih, biji adas, jintan putih, dan lada Sichuan hingga harum; angkat rempah utuh yang besar terlebih dahulu, sisakan biji adas, cengkih, dan lada Sichuan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Infuse the spiced oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在香料油中加入番茄炒至變軟，再加入蒜頭。
instruction.en: Add the tomato to the spiced oil and cook until softened, then add the garlic.
instruction.id: Masukkan tomat ke minyak rempah dan masak hingga lunak, lalu tambahkan bawang putih.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soften the tomato and garlic”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 咖喱開蓋後，加入剩下的櫛瓜，以及先前取出的月桂葉、桂皮和煸香的香菜、芹菜，再熬煮 5 分鐘即可盛盤。
instruction.en: After uncovering the curry, add the remaining zucchini along with the reserved bay leaves, cinnamon bark, and browned cilantro and celery. Simmer for 5 more minutes, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah kari dibuka, tambahkan sisa zukini bersama daun salam, kayu manis, serta daun ketumbar dan seledri yang telah ditumis. Didihkan lagi selama 5 menit, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish the curry with zucchini”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以原粒香料、薑黃、咖哩粉與菇類堆疊香氣的全素印度風味飯；影片明確說明不加鹽。
description.en: A vegan Indian-style rice dish layered with whole spices, turmeric, curry powder, and mushrooms; the source explicitly says no salt is added.
description.id: Nasi vegan gaya India dengan rempah utuh, kunyit, bubuk kari, dan jamur; sumber secara jelas menyatakan tanpa garam.

instruction.zh: 洗淨長米，第一遍洗米水迅速倒掉；將蘑菇和老薑切片。
instruction.en: Wash the long-grain rice and discard the first rinse promptly; slice the mushrooms and mature ginger.
instruction.id: Cuci beras bulir panjang dan segera buang air cucian pertama; iris jamur dan jahe tua.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photograph of rinsed long-grain rice, sliced mushrooms, and sliced ginger arranged in small bowls on a warm kitchen worktop, no text, no people

instruction.zh: 冷油下芹菜、香菜和薑，小火煸至焦黃後撈起；再將蘑菇煸至金黃並撈起。
instruction.en: Start celery, cilantro, and ginger in cold oil and fry gently until browned, then remove; fry mushrooms until golden and remove.
instruction.id: Masukkan seledri, daun ketumbar, dan jahe ke minyak dingin, tumis perlahan hingga kecokelatan lalu angkat; tumis jamur hingga keemasan dan angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photograph of golden mushrooms and browned aromatics sizzling in a shallow pan with glistening oil, no text, no people

instruction.zh: 將月桂葉、花椒、小茴香、桂皮、八角與陳皮煸香；夾出部分大塊香料後，加入薑黃粉、印度咖哩粉和孜然粒炒香。
instruction.en: Toast bay leaves, Sichuan pepper, fennel, cinnamon, star anise, and dried citrus peel; remove some larger spices, then bloom turmeric, Indian curry powder, and cumin seeds.
instruction.id: Tumis daun salam, lada Sichuan, adas, kayu manis, bunga lawang, dan kulit jeruk kering; angkat sebagian rempah besar, lalu tumis kunyit, bubuk kari India, dan biji jintan.

steps.imagePrompt: Cinematic overhead food photograph of yellow turmeric rice being stirred with whole spices in a dark pan, steam and warm golden light, no text

instruction.zh: 加入水；來源說明米水比例約為 1:1.1，蓋鍋後小火煮 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Add water; the source gives an approximate rice-to-water ratio of 1:1.1, then cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan air; sumber menyebut rasio beras dan air sekitar 1:1,1, lalu tutup dan masak dengan api kecil selama 15 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photograph of a covered pot of fragrant yellow spiced rice gently steaming on a stovetop, warm kitchen lighting, no text, no people

instruction.zh: 檢查熟度；想要鍋巴可再煮約 2 分鐘。撒回蘑菇與新鮮香菜，夾出香料後拌勻食用。
instruction.en: Check doneness; cook about 2 more minutes for crust if desired. Return mushrooms and fresh cilantro, remove whole spices, and toss before serving.
instruction.id: Periksa kematangan; masak sekitar 2 menit lagi bila menginginkan kerak nasi. Kembalikan jamur dan daun ketumbar segar, keluarkan rempah utuh, lalu aduk sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Appetizing food photograph of fluffy golden vegan Indian spiced rice topped with browned mushrooms and fresh cilantro in a rustic bowl, no text, no people

description.zh: 烤小番茄配低溫香料橄欖油的冰箱常備品。
description.en: Roasted cherry tomatoes preserved in gently infused olive oil.
description.id: Tomat ceri panggang yang diawetkan dalam minyak zaitun berbumbu.

instruction.zh: 番茄去蒂對半切，切面朝上，加橄欖油、鹽、胡椒、義式香料和迷迭香；160°C 烤 40 分鐘，第 30 分鐘檢查。
instruction.en: Halve stemmed tomatoes cut-side up, season, then roast at 160°C for 40 minutes; check at 30 minutes.
instruction.id: Belah tomat, bumbui, lalu panggang 160°C selama 40 menit dan periksa pada menit ke-30.

instruction.zh: 冷橄欖油下月桂葉、小茴香、薑片和乾辣椒，小火出香立刻關火放涼。
instruction.en: Start bay leaves, fennel, ginger, and dried chili in cold olive oil; heat gently until fragrant, then cool.
instruction.id: Masukkan daun salam, adas, jahe, dan cabai ke minyak dingin; panaskan perlahan lalu dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of bay leaves, fennel seeds, mature ginger slices and dried red chili gently infusing in golden olive oil over very low heat in a small saucepan, spices visibly distinct. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tomatoes, rosemary, jar, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 玻璃罐滾水燙 10 分鐘並晾乾；放入冷卻番茄和冷卻香料油，油需高過番茄至少 1 公分，冷藏隔日食用。
instruction.en: Sterilize a glass jar in boiling water for 10 minutes; cover cooled tomatoes with cooled infused oil by at least 1 cm and refrigerate overnight.
instruction.id: Sterilkan stoples 10 menit; tutupi tomat dingin dengan minyak minimal 1 cm dan dinginkan semalaman.

Constraints: strictly vegan; jar has no label; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh:
無澱粉料理
