description.en: A starch-free dish that lets you enjoy a fat-loss meal while still feeling full. Using the qualities of cauliflower rice, it is full of texture and protein, so losing weight can be easy too. Try making it along with the video!
description.id: Masakan tanpa pati yang membuat Anda tetap bisa menikmati menu pengurangan lemak sambil merasa kenyang. Dengan karakter nasi kembang kol, hidangan ini kaya tekstur dan protein sehingga menurunkan berat badan juga bisa lebih mudah. Yuk, coba buat mengikuti video!

instruction.zh: 將稍微沖洗過的白花椰菜花部切成細小顆粒，做成花椰菜米，再沖洗一次後瀝乾備用。
instruction.en: Cut the florets of the rinsed cauliflower into small granules to make cauliflower rice. Rinse it once more, drain, and set aside.
instruction.id: Potong kuntum kembang kol yang sudah dibilas menjadi butiran kecil untuk membuat nasi kembang kol. Bilas sekali lagi, tiriskan, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan cooking prep image of finely chopped cauliflower rice in a bowl beside cauliflower florets, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將豆干、紅蘿蔔、新鮮香菇和小黃瓜切成小丁；豆包用手撕成不規則的小塊，不要太大塊。
instruction.en: Dice the dried tofu, carrot, fresh shiitake mushrooms, and cucumber. Tear the tofu skin by hand into small, irregular pieces rather than large pieces.
instruction.id: Potong tahu kering, wortel, jamur shiitake segar, dan mentimun menjadi dadu kecil. Sobek kulit tahu dengan tangan menjadi potongan kecil tidak beraturan, jangan terlalu besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan cooking prep image of diced dried tofu, carrot, shiitake mushrooms, cucumber, and torn tofu skin in separate piles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 熱鍋後加入少量植物油，先下豆包拌炒，煸至金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a wok with a little vegetable oil. Add the tofu skin first and stir-fry until golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan dengan sedikit minyak nabati. Masukkan kulit tahu terlebih dahulu dan tumis hingga keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok image of torn tofu skin stir-frying in a little oil until golden, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Stir-fry the cauliflower rice and ingredients
title.id: Tumis nasi kembang kol dan bahan lainnya

instruction.zh: 加入花椰菜米炒香，炒至乾爽；接著拌入豆干丁、紅蘿蔔丁和香菇丁，持續拌炒。
instruction.en: Add the cauliflower rice and stir-fry until fragrant and dry. Stir in the diced dried tofu, carrot, and shiitake mushrooms, continuing to toss.
instruction.id: Masukkan nasi kembang kol dan tumis hingga harum serta kering. Tambahkan tahu kering, wortel, dan jamur shiitake yang telah dipotong dadu, lalu terus aduk.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok image of dry cauliflower rice tossed with golden tofu skin, diced dried tofu, carrot, and shiitake mushrooms, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 以胡椒粉、黑胡椒粉和鹽調味。最後加入小黃瓜丁，快速拌炒均勻，保留脆口後即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Season with ground pepper, ground black pepper, and salt. Add the diced cucumber last, toss quickly and evenly to keep it crisp, then serve.
instruction.id: Bumbui dengan merica bubuk, lada hitam bubuk, dan garam. Masukkan mentimun dadu paling akhir, aduk cepat hingga rata agar tetap renyah, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan cauliflower fried rice with diced carrot, shiitake, tofu, golden tofu skin, and crisp cucumber, no rice grains, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 冷凍後的豆乾先汆燙，再以香料油、兩種醬油和冰糖小火滷 40 分鐘，特別入味。
description.en: Frozen dried tofu is blanched, then braised for 40 minutes over low heat with spiced oil, two soy sauces, and rock sugar.
description.id: Tahu kering beku direbus sebentar lalu dibraise 40 menit dengan api kecil bersama minyak rempah, dua kecap asin, dan gula batu.

instruction.zh: 冷凍豆乾退冰後，放入滾水汆燙約 2 分鐘，去除雜質與豆腥味；冷凍再退冰能增加孔隙，較易入味。
instruction.en: After thawing frozen dried tofu, blanch it in boiling water for about 2 minutes to remove impurities and bean aroma. Freezing and thawing makes it more porous and flavorful.
instruction.id: Setelah tahu kering beku dicairkan, rebus sekitar 2 menit untuk menghilangkan kotoran dan aroma kedelai. Pembekuan lalu pencairan membuatnya lebih berpori agar mudah menyerap rasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Frozen dried tofu cubes blanching in a pot of boiling water, vegan Chinese home cooking, clean natural light, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.en: Infuse spiced oil and caramelize sugar
title.id: Buat minyak rempah dan karamel gula

instruction.zh: 小火以油煸香香菜、芹菜、薑和辣椒至焦黃後撈起。再小火煸香月桂葉、乾辣椒、八角、小茴香和花椒，撈起備用；鍋中以冰糖炒香，再加入兩種醬油。
instruction.en: Over low heat, fry cilantro, celery, ginger, and chili in oil until browned, then remove. Infuse the oil with bay leaf, dried chili, star anise, fennel, and Sichuan pepper, then set them aside. Caramelize rock sugar in the pot and add both soy sauces.
instruction.id: Dengan api kecil, tumis daun ketumbar, seledri, jahe, dan cabai dalam minyak hingga kecokelatan lalu angkat. Rendam minyak dengan daun salam, cabai kering, bunga lawang, biji adas, dan lada Sichuan, lalu sisihkan. Karamelkan gula batu dan tambahkan kedua kecap asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Aromatic vegan Chinese braising spices toasting gently in oil with star anise, fennel, dried chili and Sichuan pepper, warm food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把豆乾裹上醬色，加水及剛撈起的香料，蓋鍋煮滾後轉小火滷 40 分鐘。
instruction.en: Coat tofu with the soy sauce color, add water and the reserved spices, cover and bring to a boil, then braise over low heat for 40 minutes.
instruction.id: Balut tahu dengan warna kecap, tambahkan air dan rempah yang disisihkan, tutup dan didihkan, lalu braise dengan api kecil selama 40 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan braised dried tofu simmering in dark fragrant soy broth with whole spices in a covered pot, gentle steam, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 金針菇汆燙冰鎮後，以熱香料油潑上辣椒粉及調味料，拌成香辣開胃的冷盤。
description.en: Blanched and chilled enoki mushrooms are dressed with hot aromatic oil, chili powder, and seasonings for a spicy cold dish.
description.id: Jamur enoki direbus sebentar dan didinginkan, lalu disiram minyak rempah panas, bubuk cabai, dan bumbu menjadi hidangan dingin pedas.

instruction.zh: 去除金針菇蒂頭，剝成小束並洗淨；糯米椒切斜片。金針菇和糯米椒分別汆燙約 1 分鐘後放入冰水，保留爽脆口感，再瀝乾金針菇大部分水分。
instruction.en: Trim enoki, separate into small bundles, and wash; slice mild green chili diagonally. Blanch enoki and chili separately for about 1 minute, chill in ice water for crispness, then drain most water from the enoki.
instruction.id: Potong pangkal enoki, pisahkan menjadi ikatan kecil dan cuci; iris serong cabai hijau mild. Rebus enoki dan cabai terpisah sekitar 1 menit, dinginkan dalam air es agar renyah, lalu tiriskan sebagian besar air enoki.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan preparation with enoki mushroom bundles and sliced green chili beside ice water, crisp fresh texture, bright natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把冰鎮瀝乾的金針菇放入碗中，依序撒上辣椒粉、醬油、醬油膏、芝麻、五香粉、鹽和糖，先不要攪拌。
instruction.en: Place chilled, drained enoki in a bowl and top with chili powder, soy sauce, thick soy sauce, sesame, five-spice, salt, and sugar. Do not mix yet.
instruction.id: Masukkan enoki dingin yang sudah ditiriskan ke mangkuk, lalu tambahkan bubuk cabai, kecap asin, kecap asin kental, wijen, bubuk lima rempah, garam, dan gula. Jangan diaduk dahulu.

steps.imagePrompt: Chilled enoki mushrooms in a bowl topped with colorful chili powder, sesame and vegan seasonings before mixing, clean overhead food photo, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 植物油以中小火加入芹菜段、香菜、老薑、乾辣椒和花椒粒，煸至香料焦黃後撈起。把香料油分 2 至 3 次集中澆在辣椒粉上，避免燒焦，再拌勻。
instruction.en: Over medium-low heat, infuse vegetable oil with celery, cilantro, ginger, dried chili, and Sichuan peppercorns until golden-brown, then remove the aromatics. Pour the oil over the chili powder in 2 to 3 batches to prevent burning, then mix evenly.
instruction.id: Dengan api sedang-kecil, masukkan seledri, daun ketumbar, jahe, cabai kering, dan lada Sichuan ke minyak sayur hingga kecokelatan, lalu angkat bumbunya. Siram minyak ke bubuk cabai dalam 2 hingga 3 tahap agar tidak gosong, lalu aduk rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Fragrant red chili oil being poured in stages over seasoned enoki mushrooms, aromatic spices in a small pan, vivid vegan cold dish, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 拌勻後裝入密封罐或保鮮盒，最後把紅油倒在表面形成油封。可立即食用，冷藏約半天後會更入味；上桌可再撒白芝麻。
instruction.en: Transfer the mixed dish to an airtight jar or container and pour red oil over the surface. It can be eaten immediately, but tastes more seasoned after about half a day chilled; add white sesame to serve.
instruction.id: Setelah tercampur rata, pindahkan ke wadah kedap udara dan tuang minyak cabai di atas permukaan. Bisa langsung dimakan, tetapi lebih meresap setelah didinginkan sekitar setengah hari; taburi wijen putih saat disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan red oil enoki mushrooms in a glass container, glossy chili oil layer and sesame garnish, refreshing cold appetizer, natural editorial food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 煎香豆包，以汆燙娃娃菜包住蔬菜餡，搭配清爽芥末沾醬。
description.en: Pan-fried tofu skin and blanched baby cabbage wrap fresh vegetables, served with a light wasabi dipping sauce.
description.id: Kulit tahu goreng dan sawi putih muda rebus membungkus sayuran segar, disajikan dengan saus wasabi ringan.

title.en: Fry tofu skin and blanch vegetables
title.id: Goreng kulit tahu dan rebus sayuran

instruction.zh: 豆包煎至金黃。滾水加鹽，娃娃菜燙 1 至 2 分鐘至變軟；紅蘿蔔及豆芽菜分別燙軟。
instruction.en: Pan-fry tofu skin until golden. Add salt to boiling water; blanch baby cabbage 1–2 minutes until soft, then blanch carrot and bean sprouts separately.
instruction.id: Goreng kulit tahu hingga keemasan. Tambahkan garam ke air mendidih; rebus sawi putih muda 1–2 menit hingga lunak, lalu rebus wortel dan tauge secara terpisah.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan cabbage roll ingredients with golden tofu skin and blanched baby cabbage, carrot and bean sprouts, bright natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 取一片娃娃菜，在底部約 1 至 2 公分處放上準備好的餡料，捲緊成菜卷。
instruction.en: Take one baby-cabbage leaf, place prepared filling about 1–2 cm from its base, and roll tightly.
instruction.id: Ambil selembar sawi putih muda, letakkan isian sekitar 1–2 cm dari pangkalnya, lalu gulung rapat.

steps.imagePrompt: Hands rolling a vegan baby cabbage leaf around tofu skin, carrot, cucumber and bean sprout filling, clean natural kitchen light, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 拌勻日式醬油、蘋果醋、香油、味醂、芝麻及少許 wasabi；不吃辣可省略 wasabi。以菜卷沾醬享用。
instruction.en: Mix Japanese soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, sesame oil, mirin, sesame, and a little wasabi; omit wasabi if avoiding heat. Serve with the rolls.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap Jepang, cuka apel, minyak wijen, mirin, wijen, dan sedikit wasabi; hilangkan wasabi bila tidak suka pedas. Sajikan bersama gulungan.

steps.imagePrompt: Fresh vegan cabbage rolls arranged with a small bowl of sesame wasabi dipping sauce, crisp colorful vegetables visible, elegant food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.zh: 南瓜新吃法香甜軟Q的口感，越吃越香啊

description.zh: 南瓜泥與糯米粉做成、裹芝麻後小火煎至外脆內Q的全素點心。
description.en: Vegan pumpkin and glutinous-rice cakes coated in sesame and pan-fried until crisp and chewy.
description.id: Kue vegan dari labu dan tepung ketan, berlapis wijen dan digoreng perlahan.

instruction.zh: 南瓜去皮去籽切薄片，電鍋外鍋加一杯水蒸軟，壓成泥。
instruction.en: Peel, seed, and thinly slice pumpkin; steam with one outer-pot cup of water, then mash.
instruction.id: Kupas dan iris labu, kukus dengan satu cangkir air, lalu haluskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Steamed orange pumpkin slices being mashed in a bowl, warm natural food photography, no text

instruction.zh: 南瓜泥加糖，糯米粉分次加入，依南瓜水分揉至不黏手。
instruction.en: Add sugar and glutinous rice flour gradually, adjusting for pumpkin moisture until the dough is not sticky.
instruction.id: Tambahkan gula dan tepung ketan bertahap hingga adonan tidak lengket.

steps.imagePrompt: Soft orange pumpkin dough being kneaded by hands on a wooden board, no text

instruction.zh: 每份約 25 克搓圓，裹芝麻後壓扁；可包紅豆餡。
instruction.en: Roll about 25 g portions, coat with sesame, and flatten; red bean filling is optional.
instruction.id: Bulatkan porsi sekitar 25 g, balur wijen, lalu pipihkan; isian kacang merah opsional.

steps.imagePrompt: Round sesame-coated pumpkin cake patties arranged on a tray, no text

instruction.zh: 少量油小火慢煎，翻面約 2–3 次，兩面金黃、按壓回彈即熟。
instruction.en: Pan-fry in a little oil over low heat, turning 2–3 times until golden and springy.
instruction.id: Goreng dengan sedikit minyak api kecil, balik 2–3 kali hingga keemasan dan kenyal.

description.en: The baby-food series is here. This simple, nutritious vegan daikon cake is intended for babies, while adults and children can enjoy it too.
description.id: Seri makanan bayi hadir. Kue lobak vegan yang sederhana dan bergizi ini ditujukan untuk bayi, tetapi orang dewasa dan anak-anak juga dapat menikmatinya.

instruction.zh: 白蘿蔔去皮後刨成細絲；金針菇切成小段。
instruction.en: Peel the daikon and shred it finely; cut the enoki mushrooms into short pieces.
instruction.id: Kupas lobak putih lalu serut halus; potong jamur enoki menjadi bagian pendek.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the daikon and enoki”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋水，水滾後放入白蘿蔔和香菇，煮約 3 分鐘。過冷水降溫後，擠乾水分。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the daikon and shiitake mushrooms and cook for about 3 minutes. Cool under water, then squeeze out the moisture.
instruction.id: Didihkan sepanci air. Masukkan lobak putih dan jamur shiitake, masak sekitar 3 menit. Dinginkan dengan air lalu peras hingga airnya keluar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch and squeeze dry”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將汆燙後的香菇切小丁。鍋中放少量橄欖油，先炒金針菇和香菇至香味出來，再倒入白蘿蔔中。
instruction.en: Dice the blanched shiitake. Add a little olive oil to a pan and sauté the enoki and shiitake until fragrant, then add them to the daikon.
instruction.id: Potong dadu kecil shiitake yang telah direbus. Tambahkan sedikit minyak zaitun ke wajan, tumis enoki dan shiitake hingga harum, lalu masukkan ke dalam lobak putih.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Sauté the mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入低筋麵粉、在來米粉及少量鹽後拌勻；未滿一歲的孩子可不加鹽。用手塑形成小圓餅，放到鋪有烘焙紙或蒸籠紙的盤子上。
instruction.en: Mix in cake flour, rice flour, and a little salt; salt may be omitted for children under one year old. Shape by hand into small round patties and place on a tray lined with baking or steaming paper.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung protein rendah, tepung beras, dan sedikit garam; garam dapat dihilangkan untuk anak di bawah satu tahun. Bentuk dengan tangan menjadi patty bulat kecil dan letakkan di loyang berlapis kertas roti atau kertas kukus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix and shape”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將小圓餅蒸約 10 分鐘，讓其定型。
instruction.en: Steam the small patties for about 10 minutes so they set.
instruction.id: Kukus patty kecil sekitar 10 menit hingga bentuknya set.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Steam until set”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 蒸好後可在平底鍋放少量植物油，煎至兩面金黃。若給一歲以下的孩子食用，來源建議蒸好即可、不必煎。
instruction.en: After steaming, optionally add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and cook until both sides are golden. For children under one year old, the source suggests serving after steaming without pan-frying.
instruction.id: Setelah dikukus, secara opsional tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan masak hingga kedua sisi keemasan. Untuk anak di bawah satu tahun, sumber menyarankan disajikan setelah dikukus tanpa digoreng di wajan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Optionally pan-fry”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以油條、馬鈴薯與豆包組合成全素排骨，炸至金黃後拌入以番茄醬、醬油與白醋調製的糖醋醬。
description.en: Youtiao, potato, and tofu skin are assembled into vegan ribs, fried golden, then coated in a sweet-and-sour sauce of ketchup, soy sauce, and white vinegar.
description.id: Cakue, kentang, dan kulit tahu dirangkai menjadi iga vegan, digoreng keemasan, lalu dilapisi saus asam manis dari saus tomat, kecap asin, dan cuka putih.

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯去皮後切成約 2 公分寬的長條。紅、黃甜椒各切半顆成小塊，老薑切末。油條去除頭尾，切成比馬鈴薯約三分之二長的小段。
instruction.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into sticks about 2 cm wide. Cut half each of the red and yellow bell peppers into small pieces and mince the ginger. Trim the ends from the youtiao and cut it into pieces about two-thirds the length of the potato sticks.
instruction.id: Kupas kentang lalu potong memanjang dengan lebar sekitar 2 cm. Potong masing-masing setengah paprika merah dan kuning menjadi potongan kecil, lalu cincang jahe. Buang kedua ujung cakue dan potong menjadi bagian sekitar dua pertiga panjang batang kentang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of potato sticks, small red and yellow bell pepper pieces, minced ginger, and trimmed youtiao pieces prepared on a cutting board, no text, labels, logos, watermark, or people.

instruction.zh: 將低筋麵粉、少量橄欖油、鹽、糖、五香粉、胡椒粉和花椒粉混合，加入水攪拌均勻成麵糊。
instruction.en: Combine cake flour with a little olive oil, salt, sugar, five-spice powder, ground pepper, and ground Sichuan pepper. Add water and mix into a smooth batter.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung terigu protein rendah dengan sedikit minyak zaitun, garam, gula, bubuk lima rempah, lada bubuk, dan bubuk lada Sichuan. Tambahkan air lalu aduk hingga menjadi adonan pelapis yang rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of a smooth seasoned batter being mixed in a bowl with a whisk, no meat, eggs, dairy, text, labels, logos, or watermark.

instruction.zh: 在油條中央戳出可穿過馬鈴薯的孔，將馬鈴薯條穿入。豆包攤開後撕成長條，略沾麵糊，黏在包著馬鈴薯的油條外層。
instruction.en: Open a hole through the center of each youtiao piece so a potato stick can pass through, then insert the potato. Unfold the tofu skin and tear it into long strips; lightly dip the strips in batter and attach them around the potato-filled youtiao.
instruction.id: Buat lubang di tengah setiap potong cakue agar batang kentang dapat melewatinya, lalu masukkan kentang. Bentangkan kulit tahu dan sobek memanjang; celupkan tipis ke adonan lalu tempelkan mengelilingi cakue yang berisi kentang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of a potato stick inserted through a youtiao piece and wrapped with a thin strip of tofu skin, no text, labels, logos, watermark, or people.

instruction.zh: 油鍋加熱至筷子放入會冒小泡泡，約 160°C。下鍋前再將素排骨完整裹上麵糊，炸至金黃色；期間用筷子翻動，讓各面均勻上色。
instruction.en: Heat the oil until chopsticks make small bubbles, about 160°C. Just before frying, coat each vegan rib completely in batter and fry until golden; turn with chopsticks so all sides brown evenly.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga sumpit yang dicelupkan mengeluarkan gelembung kecil, sekitar 160°C. Tepat sebelum menggoreng, balut iga vegan sepenuhnya dengan adonan lalu goreng hingga keemasan; balik dengan sumpit agar semua sisi berwarna merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of battered tofu-skin-wrapped youtiao and potato vegan ribs frying evenly in hot oil until golden, no text, labels, logos, watermark, or people.

title.zh: 調製糖醋醬與太白粉水
title.en: Mix the sweet-and-sour sauce and starch slurry
title.id: Buat saus asam manis dan larutan pati

instruction.zh: 碗中加入番茄醬、醬油、白醋、鹽、糖和水，攪拌均勻成糖醋醬。另將太白粉與水調成太白粉水，留作勾芡。
instruction.en: Stir ketchup, soy sauce, white vinegar, salt, sugar, and water together in a bowl for the sweet-and-sour sauce. In a separate bowl, mix potato starch with water for a thickening slurry.
instruction.id: Aduk saus tomat, kecap asin, cuka putih, garam, gula, dan air dalam mangkuk hingga menjadi saus asam manis. Di mangkuk terpisah, campurkan tepung pati kentang dengan air untuk larutan pengental.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of a red sweet-and-sour sauce and a clear potato-starch slurry in two small bowls, no text, labels, logos, watermark, or people.

title.en: Cook the sauce and coat to finish
title.id: Masak saus lalu balut hingga selesai

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放少量植物油，爆香薑末後加入糖醋醬，煮至冒泡。慢慢倒入太白粉水並持續攪拌至濃稠，再放入彩椒和炸好的素排骨，裹勻醬汁後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and fry the minced ginger until fragrant. Add the sweet-and-sour sauce and cook until bubbling. Slowly pour in the starch slurry while stirring until thickened, then add the bell peppers and fried vegan ribs; toss until evenly coated and remove from the heat.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu tumis jahe cincang hingga harum. Masukkan saus asam manis dan masak hingga berbuih. Tuangkan larutan pati perlahan sambil terus diaduk hingga mengental, lalu masukkan paprika dan iga vegan goreng; aduk hingga saus melapisi rata lalu angkat dari api.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of fried vegan ribs and red and yellow bell peppers being evenly coated in glossy sweet-and-sour sauce in a wok, no text, labels, logos, watermark, or people.

title.en: Vegan Pickled Mustard Green and Shredded Pork-Style Noodles
title.id: Mi Vegan Acar Sawi dan Suwiran Daging Nabati

description.zh: 以榨菜、雪裡紅、百頁豆腐、杏鮑菇和辣椒製作的全素榨菜肉絲麵；雪裡紅與榨菜為湯頭帶來鮮甜風味。
description.en: A vegan pickled-mustard-green and shredded pork-style noodle dish with snow vegetable, hundred-page tofu, king oyster mushrooms, and chili; the snow vegetable and pickled mustard green give the broth a savory-sweet flavor.
description.id: Mi vegan bergaya suwiran daging dengan acar sawi, sayur asin, tahu seratus halaman, jamur tiram raja, dan cabai; sayur asin serta acar sawi memberi rasa gurih-manis pada kuah.

title.en: Shred the pickled mustard green and mushrooms

instruction.zh: 將榨菜和杏鮑菇切成絲；若買到的榨菜已是絲狀，則不用再切。
instruction.en: Cut the pickled mustard green and king oyster mushrooms into shreds. If the pickled mustard green is already shredded, leave it as is.
instruction.id: Iris acar sawi dan jamur tiram raja memanjang. Jika acar sawi yang dibeli sudah berbentuk irisan, tidak perlu diiris lagi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of shredded pickled mustard greens and king oyster mushrooms on a cutting board, with a chef's knife, no text, labels, logos, watermark, meat, eggs, dairy, or people.

instruction.zh: 將大辣椒切成斜片。
instruction.en: Slice the large chili on the diagonal.
instruction.id: Iris cabai besar secara serong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of a large chili being sliced diagonally on a clean cutting board, no text, labels, logos, watermark, meat, eggs, dairy, or people.

title.en: Adjust the saltiness of the pickled vegetables

instruction.zh: 若雪裡紅或榨菜偏鹹，先泡水並洗去部分鹹味；再依其鹹度調整湯的比例，並試喝確認。
instruction.en: If the snow vegetable or pickled mustard green is very salty, soak and rinse it first to remove some salt. Adjust the broth ratio to their saltiness and taste before serving.
instruction.id: Jika sayur asin salju atau acar sawi sangat asin, rendam dan bilas terlebih dahulu untuk mengurangi garamnya. Sesuaikan perbandingan kuah dengan tingkat asinnya, lalu cicipi sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of pickled mustard greens and snow vegetable being rinsed in clear water in separate bowls, no text, labels, logos, watermark, meat, eggs, dairy, or people.

title.en: Cook the noodles and add broth

instruction.zh: 將細麵條煮至自己喜歡的熟度後撈起並淋上湯頭；影片主持人偏好煮至約七、八分熟。
instruction.en: Cook the thin noodles to your preferred doneness, remove them, and pour over the broth. The presenters prefer the noodles at about 70–80% cooked.
instruction.id: Masak mi tipis hingga tingkat kematangan yang diinginkan, angkat, lalu siram dengan kuah. Pembawa acara menyukai mi yang dimasak sekitar 70–80% matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of thin noodles lifted from boiling water into a bowl as clear savory broth is poured over them, no text, labels, logos, watermark, meat, eggs, dairy, or people.

description.zh: 青椒填入以煎香的油豆腐與乾豆包製成的全素餡料，切段煎至金黃後，以醬油、醬油膏與太白粉勾成的醬汁收乾完成。
description.en: Green peppers are filled with a vegan mixture of browned fried tofu and dried tofu skin, cut into pieces, pan-fried golden, and finished in a reduced soy sauce and starch-thickened sauce.
description.id: Paprika hijau diisi adonan vegan dari tahu goreng dan kulit tahu kering yang ditumis hingga harum, dipotong, digoreng sampai keemasan, lalu dimasak hingga saus kecap yang dikentalkan pati mengental.

instruction.zh: 從青椒蒂頭下方約1.5公分處劃一圈但不要切斷，旋轉取下蒂頭；沖洗青椒內外並刮除籽，洗淨後備用。
instruction.en: About 1.5 cm below the stem, cut a circle without cutting all the way through, then twist off the top. Rinse the peppers inside and out, scrape out the seeds, and set aside.
instruction.id: Sekitar 1,5 cm di bawah tangkai, iris melingkar tanpa memotong sampai putus, lalu putar untuk melepaskan bagian atasnya. Bilas paprika bagian dalam dan luar, keruk bijinya, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the green peppers”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇、去皮茄子與老薑切小丁；大辣椒切片。油豆腐與乾豆包用手撕成小塊。
instruction.en: Dice the fresh shiitake mushrooms, peeled eggplant, and mature ginger; slice the large chili. Tear the fried tofu and dried tofu skin into small pieces by hand.
instruction.id: Potong dadu kecil jamur shiitake segar, terong yang sudah dikupas, dan jahe tua; iris cabai besar. Sobek tahu goreng dan kulit tahu kering menjadi potongan kecil dengan tangan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the filling ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加少量植物油，先將油豆腐和乾豆包煎至金黃。加入香菇、茄子和老薑炒香，再加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、五香粉、花椒粉和胡椒粉炒出香氣；加少量水後炒至熟並收乾汁液，盛起。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok and brown the fried tofu and dried tofu skin first. Add the mushrooms, eggplant, and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant. Add soy sauce, soy sauce paste, sugar, five-spice, Sichuan pepper powder, and ground pepper; add a little water and cook until done and the liquid has reduced, then remove from the wok.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati dalam wajan dan tumis tahu goreng serta kulit tahu kering hingga keemasan. Masukkan jamur, terong, dan jahe, lalu tumis hingga harum. Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, bubuk lima rempah, bubuk lada Sichuan, dan lada bubuk; tambahkan sedikit air dan masak hingga matang serta cairannya menyusut, lalu angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the vegan filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在餡料中加入麵粉、太白粉和少量水拌勻，調成略帶黏性的質地。青椒內側抹太白粉，將餡料填入並壓緊；填好後切成約3至4公分長的段，備用。
instruction.en: Mix flour, tapioca starch, and a little water into the filling until it becomes slightly sticky. Dust the inside of each pepper with tapioca starch, pack in the filling firmly, then cut the stuffed peppers into pieces about 3 to 4 cm long and set aside.
instruction.id: Aduk tepung terigu, tepung tapioka, dan sedikit air ke dalam isian hingga sedikit lengket. Lapisi bagian dalam setiap paprika dengan tepung tapioka, padatkan isian di dalamnya, lalu potong paprika isi menjadi bagian sepanjang sekitar 3 hingga 4 cm dan sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Bind and stuff the peppers”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉、太白粉和水混合，攪拌均勻成醬汁。
instruction.en: Combine soy sauce, soy sauce paste, sugar, ground pepper, tapioca starch, and water, then stir until the finishing sauce is smooth.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, tepung tapioka, dan air, lalu aduk hingga saus akhir halus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the finishing sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少量植物油，將青椒鑲肉段煎至兩面金黃。倒入調好的醬汁，熬煮至收汁、醬汁變稠並均勻附著在食材上後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and pan-fry the stuffed pepper pieces until golden on both sides. Pour in the prepared sauce and simmer until it reduces, thickens, and coats the pieces evenly, then serve.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan datar dan goreng potongan paprika isi hingga kedua sisinya keemasan. Tuang saus yang telah disiapkan dan didihkan hingga menyusut, mengental, serta melapisi potongan secara merata, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry and reduce the sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
以前常常在川菜館看到上海炒麵
但是都一直以為只是普通的炒麵
沒想到這麼好吃
就只是簡單醬油
卻讓整個味道跟鍋氣滿滿
在家裡也可以炒出餐廳等級的炒麵
大家一定要試試看！
description.en: I often saw Shanghai fried noodles at Sichuan restaurants and assumed they were ordinary fried noodles. I did not expect them to be so delicious: simple soy sauce gives the dish full flavor and wok hei. You can also make restaurant-quality fried noodles at home—give them a try!
description.id: Saya sering melihat mi goreng Shanghai di restoran Sichuan dan mengira itu hanya mi goreng biasa. Ternyata sangat lezat: kecap asin sederhana membuat rasanya kaya dan penuh aroma wok hei. Anda juga bisa membuat mi goreng setara restoran di rumah—cobalah!

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇和豆干切片；洗淨的青江菜切成四等份。
instruction.en: Slice the fresh shiitake mushrooms and dried tofu. Cut the washed bok choy into four portions.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake segar dan tahu kering. Potong pakcoy yang sudah dicuci menjadi empat bagian.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Cook until 80% done and rinse cold
title.id: Rebus hingga 80% matang lalu bilas dingin

instruction.zh: 滾水加鹽後煮新鮮粗麵條約 1 分鐘，加入 1 匙冷水；再煮約 1 分鐘後再加 1 匙冷水。煮滾後，在麵心仍有些白色時撈起，並沖冷水。
instruction.en: Add salt to boiling water and cook the fresh thick noodles for about 1 minute, then add 1 spoonful of cold water. Cook about 1 more minute and add another 1 spoonful of cold water. Once it returns to a boil, lift the noodles while a little white core remains and rinse them with cold water.
instruction.id: Tambahkan garam ke air mendidih dan rebus mi tebal segar sekitar 1 menit, lalu tambahkan 1 sendok air dingin. Rebus sekitar 1 menit lagi dan tambahkan 1 sendok air dingin lagi. Setelah mendidih kembali, angkat mi saat masih ada sedikit bagian putih di tengahnya lalu bilas dengan air dingin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook until 80% done and rinse cold”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將沖冷水後的麵條加入香油、醬油、醬油膏和糖，拌勻至麵條上色。
instruction.en: Add sesame oil, soy sauce, soy sauce paste, and sugar to the cold-rinsed noodles, then toss until the noodles are evenly colored.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak wijen, kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, dan gula ke mi yang sudah dibilas dingin, lalu aduk hingga warna mi merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Toss with the seasonings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Tumis tahu dan jamur hingga harum

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入植物油，先將豆干煸至金黃色，再加入香菇炒香。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a wok. Brown the dried tofu until golden, then add the mushrooms and stir-fry until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan. Tumis tahu kering hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan jamur dan tumis hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown the tofu and mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 加入青江菜和麵條拌炒
title.en: Stir-fry the bok choy and noodles

instruction.zh: 香菇炒香後加入青江菜，炒至變軟；加一點鹽，再加入調味過的麵條拌炒。
instruction.en: Once the mushrooms are fragrant, add the bok choy and stir-fry until softened. Add a little salt, then add the seasoned noodles and stir-fry together.
instruction.id: Setelah jamur harum, masukkan pakcoy dan tumis hingga layu. Tambahkan sedikit garam, lalu masukkan mi yang sudah dibumbui dan tumis bersama.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Stir-fry the bok choy and noodles”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 以胡椒和辣椒快炒完成

instruction.zh: 起鍋前加入較多胡椒粉和少量辣椒粉，或以新鮮辣椒代替；不吃辣可省略辣椒。快速拌炒至香氣出來、青江菜變軟後盛盤。若食用米酒，可在此時嗆入少量米酒。
instruction.en: Before serving, add more ground pepper and a little chili powder, or use fresh chili instead; omit the chili if you do not eat spicy food. Toss quickly until fragrant and the bok choy is soft, then plate. If you use rice wine, splash in a little at this point.
instruction.id: Sebelum disajikan, tambahkan lebih banyak lada bubuk dan sedikit bubuk cabai, atau gunakan cabai segar; cabai dapat dihilangkan bila tidak makan pedas. Tumis cepat hingga harum dan pakcoy lunak, lalu sajikan. Bila memakai arak beras, percikkan sedikit pada tahap ini.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with pepper and chili”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
一口小素包真的簡單又好吃
不需要揉麵糰、桿麵皮等等
就可以吃到超Ｑ外皮
餡料更是扎實滿滿
很適合當作早餐的輕食喔！
description.en: These one-bite vegan mini buns are simple and delicious. You can enjoy a wonderfully chewy wrapper and a substantial filling without kneading dough or rolling pastry. They make a great light breakfast!
description.id: Bun mini vegan sekali gigit ini sangat mudah dan lezat. Tanpa perlu menguleni adonan atau menggiling kulit, Anda tetap bisa menikmati kulit yang kenyal dan isian yang padat. Cocok sebagai sarapan ringan!

instruction.zh: 紅蘿蔔、木耳、豆乾和泡好的乾香菇切成絲；四季豆去頭去尾，切成小粒。
instruction.en: Cut the carrot, wood ear mushrooms, dried tofu, and soaked dried shiitake mushrooms into thin strips. Trim the green beans and cut them into small pieces.
instruction.id: Potong wortel, jamur kuping, tahu kering, dan jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam menjadi irisan tipis. Buang kedua ujung buncis lalu potong kecil-kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan prep with sliced carrot, mushrooms, tofu, and green beans, no text or watermark.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加植物油，先將豆乾煸香。加入紅蘿蔔、木耳、四季豆和泡好的乾香菇，炒至全部變軟；再以素蠔油、鹽、胡椒粉和香菇粉調味並炒香。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a wok and brown the dried tofu first. Add the carrot, wood ear mushrooms, green beans, and soaked dried shiitake mushrooms, then stir-fry until all are softened. Season with vegetarian oyster sauce, salt, ground pepper, and mushroom seasoning powder, and stir-fry until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan dan tumis tahu kering terlebih dahulu hingga harum. Masukkan wortel, jamur kuping, buncis, dan jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam, lalu tumis hingga semuanya lunak. Bumbui dengan saus tiram vegetarian, garam, lada bubuk, dan kaldu jamur bubuk, lalu tumis hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan vegetable and tofu filling stir-frying in a wok, no text or watermark.

instruction.zh: 以餛飩皮製作一口大小的小素包，並用電鍋蒸熟。影片說明此做法不需要揉麵糰或擀麵皮。
instruction.en: Use the wonton wrappers to make one-bite vegan mini buns, then steam them in an electric cooker. The video notes that this method needs no dough kneading or pastry rolling.
instruction.id: Gunakan kulit pangsit untuk membuat bun mini vegan sekali gigit, lalu kukus dalam penanak nasi listrik. Video menjelaskan bahwa cara ini tidak memerlukan menguleni adonan atau menggiling kulit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan vegetable-filled mini dumplings steaming in a bamboo steamer, no text or watermark.

description.zh:
以前都覺得蓮藕只能煮湯
甚至煮湯的蓮藕因為會有黏稠的口感
導致很多人不敢吃
但其實蓮藕的吃法真的非常多
煎煮炒炸都可以
還會有不同的口感呈現
蓮藕做成煎餅就是一個超棒的做法
大家也趕快跟著影片做做看吧～
description.en: I used to think lotus root could only be made into soup, and its slippery texture in soup can put many people off. But lotus root can be pan-fried, simmered, stir-fried, or deep-fried for different textures. Turning it into a pancake is a wonderful method—try making it along with the video!
description.id: Dulu saya mengira akar teratai hanya bisa dimasak menjadi sup, dan teksturnya yang licin dalam sup membuat banyak orang enggan memakannya. Padahal akar teratai bisa dipanggang di wajan, direbus, ditumis, atau digoreng untuk menghasilkan tekstur berbeda. Menjadikannya perkedel adalah cara yang sangat baik—yuk, coba buat mengikuti video!

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水，將菠菜略為汆燙後夾起，用冷水沖洗；擰乾水分，再切碎備用。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil and briefly blanch the spinach. Lift it out, rinse it with cold water, squeeze out the moisture, and chop it for later.
instruction.id: Didihkan sepanci air lalu blansir bayam sebentar. Angkat, bilas dengan air dingin, peras hingga kering, lalu cincang untuk digunakan kemudian.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch and chop the spinach”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 洗淨蓮藕後去皮並切成薄片；切好後放入水中，避免氧化變黑。
instruction.en: Wash and peel the lotus root, then cut it into thin slices. Put the slices in water after cutting to prevent oxidation and browning.
instruction.id: Cuci dan kupas akar teratai, lalu iris tipis. Setelah diiris, masukkan ke dalam air untuk mencegah oksidasi dan perubahan warna menjadi cokelat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the lotus root”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 大碗中加入中筋麵粉、營養酵母和水攪拌均勻；加入少量鹽、義式香料、花椒粉和辣椒粉後，再拌勻。不能吃辣可不加辣椒粉。
instruction.en: In a large bowl, mix all-purpose flour, nutritional yeast, and water until smooth. Add a little salt, Italian seasoning, ground Sichuan pepper, and chili powder, then mix again. Omit the chili powder if you do not eat spicy food.
instruction.id: Dalam mangkuk besar, campurkan tepung terigu serbaguna, ragi nutrisi, dan air hingga rata. Tambahkan sedikit garam, bumbu Italia, lada Sichuan bubuk, dan bubuk cabai, lalu aduk kembali hingga rata. Bubuk cabai dapat dihilangkan bila tidak makan pedas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the seasoned batter”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Goreng pan perkedel akar teratai dan bayam

instruction.zh: 將料理製成蓮藕菠菜煎餅並煎熟。影片說明成品可先煎好冷凍，之後再以煎或氣炸方式加熱；也可選擇搭配醬油膏。
instruction.en: Make the mixture into lotus-root spinach patties and pan-fry them until cooked. The video says the cooked patties can be frozen, then reheated by pan-frying or air-frying; soy sauce paste may be served with them.
instruction.id: Bentuk adonan menjadi perkedel akar teratai dan bayam lalu goreng di wajan hingga matang. Video menjelaskan bahwa perkedel yang sudah dimasak dapat dibekukan, kemudian dipanaskan kembali dengan menggoreng di wajan atau air fryer; dapat disajikan dengan pasta kecap asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry the lotus-root spinach patties”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
我們超愛吃川味料理
又麻又辣的口味
真的可以讓人胃口大開
上次用餛飩做成鮮肉餛飩湯
這次做成川菜必備的紅油抄手
絕對讓你白飯一碗接一碗
趕快跟著影片試試看吧！
description.en: We love Sichuan cuisine for its numbing, spicy flavor. After making a vegan wonton soup previously, this recipe uses the wontons for the classic Sichuan dish red-oil wontons.
description.id: Kami menyukai masakan Sichuan karena rasa pedas dan menggigitnya. Setelah sebelumnya membuat sup pangsit vegan, resep ini memakai pangsit tersebut untuk hidangan klasik Sichuan, pangsit minyak cabai merah.

instruction.zh: 月桂葉、八角、小茴香和青花椒用乾鍋炒香，香氣出來後取出。
instruction.en: Dry-toast the bay leaves, star anise, cumin, and green Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Sangrai daun salam, bunga lawang, jintan, dan lada Sichuan hijau hingga harum, lalu angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Toast the spices”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Grind and mix the chili base

instruction.zh: 將炒香的香料研磨成粉。與粗辣椒粉、細辣椒粉、胡椒粉和白芝麻混合均勻，備用。
instruction.en: Grind the toasted spices to a powder. Mix evenly with coarse chili powder, fine chili powder, ground pepper, and white sesame seeds; set aside.
instruction.id: Giling rempah sangrai menjadi bubuk. Campurkan rata dengan bubuk cabai kasar, bubuk cabai halus, lada bubuk, dan wijen putih; sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Grind and mix the chili base”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 使用高發煙點食用油，加熱至約 170°C 後放入香料油炸；約 1 分鐘後加入芹菜段、香菜段和薑片。
instruction.en: Use a high-smoke-point oil. Heat it to about 170°C, fry the spices, then after about 1 minute add celery pieces, cilantro pieces, and ginger slices.
instruction.id: Gunakan minyak bertitik asap tinggi. Panaskan hingga sekitar 170°C, goreng rempah, lalu setelah sekitar 1 menit tambahkan potongan seledri, ketumbar daun, dan irisan jahe.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the infused oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Siram untuk membuat minyak cabai merah

instruction.zh: 香料油加熱至約 180°C。將熱油一匙一匙倒入辣椒粉混合物中；每次待泡泡變小後，再倒下一匙，以免溫度過高而發苦。
instruction.en: Heat the infused oil to about 180°C. Ladle it into the chili mixture one spoonful at a time, waiting for the bubbles to shrink before the next spoonful so it does not become bitter from excessive heat.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak rempah hingga sekitar 180°C. Sendokkan minyak panas ke campuran cabai sedikit demi sedikit, tunggu gelembung mengecil sebelum sendokan berikutnya agar tidak pahit karena suhu terlalu tinggi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Bloom the red chili oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將做好的紅油淋在熟全素餛飩上，最後撒上芹菜末和香菜末。
instruction.en: Pour the finished red chili oil over cooked vegan wontons, then finish with chopped celery and cilantro.
instruction.id: Siram minyak cabai merah yang sudah jadi ke atas pangsit vegan matang, lalu taburi seledri cincang dan ketumbar daun cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble the wontons”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 古早味甜點紅糖酥餅，以低筋麵粉、植物油與紅糖製作；以平底鍋中火煎至兩面金黃。
description.en: A traditional brown sugar crisp pastry made with cake flour, vegetable oil, and brown sugar, then pan-fried over medium heat until golden on both sides.
description.id: Kue renyah gula merah tradisional yang dibuat dengan tepung terigu protein rendah, minyak nabati, dan gula merah, lalu dipanaskan di wajan dengan api sedang hingga kedua sisi keemasan.

instruction.zh: 大碗中放入低筋麵粉，倒入足滾開水，以蓋子攪拌成麵絮。加入植物油後用手拌勻，整理成麵糰。
instruction.en: Put cake flour in a large bowl, pour in fully boiling water, and stir with a lid into shaggy dough. Add vegetable oil, mix by hand, and form into a dough.
instruction.id: Masukkan tepung terigu protein rendah ke mangkuk besar, tuangkan air yang benar-benar mendidih, lalu aduk dengan penutup hingga menjadi adonan berbutir. Tambahkan minyak nabati, aduk dengan tangan, dan bentuk menjadi adonan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make hot-water dough”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Roll the dough and make oil paste
title.id: Gilas adonan dan buat pasta minyak

instruction.zh: 將麵糰擀成大的長方形薄片。以低筋麵粉與植物油調成較稠油酥，塗抹在麵片上。
instruction.en: Roll the dough into a large thin rectangle. Mix cake flour and vegetable oil into a thick oil paste and spread it over the dough.
instruction.id: Gilas adonan menjadi lembaran persegi panjang yang besar dan tipis. Campurkan tepung terigu protein rendah dan minyak nabati menjadi pasta minyak yang kental, lalu oleskan pada adonan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Roll the dough and make oil paste”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將麵皮整理成外薄中厚的大片圓形，包入紅糖餡，像包包子般封口並整理成圓形。
instruction.en: Shape the dough skin into a large round with thinner edges and a thicker center, fill with brown sugar, seal like a bun, and shape into a round.
instruction.id: Bentuk kulit adonan menjadi bulatan besar dengan tepi lebih tipis dan tengah lebih tebal, isi dengan gula merah, tutup seperti bakpao, lalu bentuk bulat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fill with brown sugar”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將包好的酥餅輕輕擀成扁圓形，兩面都擀以使厚度較均勻。
instruction.en: Gently roll the filled pastry into a flat round, rolling both sides for more even thickness.
instruction.id: Gilas perlahan kue yang sudah diisi menjadi bulatan pipih, gilas kedua sisi agar ketebalannya lebih merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Flatten the pastry”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入少量植物油並稍微加熱，放入紅糖酥餅，以中火煎至兩面金黃即可。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and heat it slightly. Add the brown sugar pastries and pan-fry over medium heat until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan datar dan panaskan sebentar. Masukkan kue gula merah lalu goreng dengan api sedang hingga kedua sisi keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry until golden”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
過年一定要做這道料理🔥
你會成為最快秒殺的那盤！
真的太刷嘴了！！！
而且只要一樣食材
就可以做出來
簡單快速又好吃
趕快跟著影片一起學做看看吧！
description.en: This quick, tasty Lunar New Year dish uses just one main ingredient and is meant to disappear fast from the table.
description.id: Hidangan Tahun Baru Imlek yang cepat dan lezat ini memakai satu bahan utama saja dan akan cepat habis dari meja.

name.en: Japanese seven-spice powder or pepper salt
name.id: bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang atau garam lada

instruction.zh: 切除鮮香菇梗並保留。煮一鍋滾水，加少量鹽，放入鮮香菇煮約 5 分鐘；取出放涼。
instruction.en: Remove and reserve the fresh shiitake stems. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add a little salt, and cook the mushrooms for about 5 minutes; remove and cool.
instruction.id: Potong dan sisihkan tangkai shiitake segar. Didihkan air, tambahkan sedikit garam, lalu masak jamur sekitar 5 menit; angkat dan dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香菇以螺旋方式剪成長條，連同香菇梗放入紗布、棉布或以手擠出水分。
instruction.en: Use scissors to cut the mushrooms into long spiral strips. Put them and the stems in cheesecloth or a clean cloth, or use your hands, to squeeze out moisture.
instruction.id: Gunakan gunting untuk memotong jamur menjadi strip spiral panjang. Masukkan bersama tangkainya ke kain kasa atau kain bersih, atau peras dengan tangan, untuk mengeluarkan air.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cut into strips and squeeze”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將擠好的香菇與香菇梗放入碗中，加入香油、醬油、醬油膏、鹽和糖，輕輕按摩拌勻後靜置 10 分鐘。
instruction.en: Put the squeezed mushrooms and stems in a bowl. Add sesame oil, soy sauce, soy paste, salt, and sugar; massage gently to combine, then rest for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Masukkan jamur dan tangkai yang telah diperas ke mangkuk. Tambahkan minyak wijen, kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, garam, dan gula; pijat perlahan hingga tercampur lalu diamkan 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Marinate the mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將炸粉、營養酵母、鹽、五香粉與水拌勻至沒有顆粒；來源明示水 180 克、粉 100 克。
instruction.en: Whisk the frying flour mix, nutritional yeast, salt, five-spice powder, and water until lump-free; the source specifies 180 g water to 100 g flour mix.
instruction.id: Aduk tepung goreng, ragi nutrisi, garam, bubuk lima rempah, dan air hingga tidak bergerindil; sumber menyebut 180 g air untuk 100 g tepung.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the batter”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將處理好的香菇下油鍋炸約 40 秒後起鍋，最後撒上七味粉或胡椒鹽享用。
instruction.en: Fry the prepared mushrooms for about 40 seconds, then remove and finish with Japanese seven-spice powder or pepper salt.
instruction.id: Goreng jamur yang telah disiapkan sekitar 40 detik, lalu angkat dan taburi bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang atau garam lada.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fry and season”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Panek Daun Bawang dari Kulit Pangsit

description.zh:
有時想要自己做蔥油餅
常常因為太麻煩而放棄
這次告訴你餃子皮的超強吃法
讓你過年也能秀兩手
不僅超酥脆又有層次
做法又爆炸簡單
不學起來真的太可惜了！
趕快跟著影片做做看吧～
description.en: Making scallion pancakes from scratch can feel too troublesome. This recipe uses dumpling wrappers for a very simple, crisp, layered version that is suitable for Lunar New Year.
description.id: Membuat panek daun bawang sendiri kadang terasa terlalu merepotkan. Resep ini memakai kulit pangsit untuk hasil yang sangat sederhana, renyah, dan berlapis, cocok untuk Tahun Baru Imlek.

instruction.zh: 可選擇韭菜、香菜或青蔥作為餡料，全部切成末；青蔥只取蔥綠部分。
instruction.en: Choose Chinese chives, cilantro, or scallion greens for the filling and finely chop them; use only the green part of the scallion.
instruction.id: Pilih kucai, ketumbar daun, atau bagian hijau daun bawang untuk isian lalu cincang halus; gunakan hanya bagian hijau daun bawang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finely chop the herbs”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 分別在三種切末香草中加入鹽、胡椒粉、五香粉和橄欖油，攪拌均勻。
instruction.en: For each chopped-herb filling, add salt, ground pepper, five-spice powder, and olive oil, then mix evenly.
instruction.id: Untuk setiap isian herba cincang, tambahkan garam, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, dan minyak zaitun, lalu aduk rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 砧板撒少量低筋麵粉，放上一張水餃皮並均勻鋪少量餡料，再蓋上一張水餃皮，稍微壓合後擀成長形。
instruction.en: Dust a board with cake flour. Place one dumpling wrapper on it, spread on a small, even amount of filling, cover with a second wrapper, press lightly, and roll into an oblong shape.
instruction.id: Taburi papan dengan sedikit tepung protein rendah. Letakkan satu kulit pangsit, ratakan sedikit isian, tutup dengan kulit kedua, tekan ringan, lalu gilas menjadi bentuk lonjong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fill and roll out”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在麵皮上劃三刀，從外側往內捲，再往下捲並捏緊收口，形成花朵狀。
instruction.en: Make three cuts in the dough, roll from the outside inward, roll downward, and pinch the seam closed to form a flower-like shape.
instruction.id: Buat tiga sayatan pada adonan, gulung dari luar ke dalam, lalu gulung ke bawah dan cubit sambungan hingga tertutup untuk membentuk bunga.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Roll into shape”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 表面撒白芝麻，先用手掌壓平，再擀成手掌大小並盡量壓薄。
instruction.en: Sprinkle with white sesame seeds, flatten first with your palm, then roll to about palm size and as thin as possible.
instruction.id: Taburi wijen putih, pipihkan terlebih dahulu dengan telapak tangan, lalu gilas hingga kira-kira seukuran telapak tangan dan setipis mungkin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Add sesame and flatten”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋放少量植物油，以小火慢煎至兩面金黃。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and pan-fry slowly over low heat until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan datar dan goreng perlahan dengan api kecil hingga kedua sisinya keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry over low heat”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 發現一款全素麻辣鍋底醬而且還超萬用
title.en: Vegan Sichuan Mala Hot Pot and Dry Pot
title.id: Hot Pot Mala Sichuan Vegan dan Dry Pot

description.zh: 以全素四川麻辣鍋底醬製作兩道料理：先炒高麗菜、加入根莖類熬煮的麻辣火鍋，以及煎香豆包與蔬菜後拌入鍋底醬的麻辣乾鍋。
description.en: Two dishes made with a vegan Sichuan mala hot-pot base: a mala hot pot that starts with stir-fried cabbage and root vegetables, and a mala dry pot with browned tofu skin and vegetables.
description.id: Dua hidangan dari bumbu dasar hot pot mala Sichuan vegan: hot pot mala yang dimulai dengan kol tumis dan sayuran akar, serta dry pot mala dengan kulit tahu dan sayuran yang ditumis hingga kecokelatan.

name.id: bumbu dasar hot pot mala Sichuan vegan

unit.id: ml (per pouch bumbu dasar hot pot)

name.en: hot-pot items, soy products, or vegetables
name.id: isian hot pot, produk kedelai, atau sayuran

instruction.zh: 一包濃縮全素四川麻辣鍋底醬加入1000毫升水，約可供3至4人食用。
instruction.en: Dilute one pouch of concentrated vegan Sichuan mala hot-pot base with 1000 ml water; the source says this serves about 3–4 people.
instruction.id: Encerkan satu pouch bumbu dasar hot pot mala Sichuan vegan yang pekat dengan 1000 ml air; sumber menyebut porsi ini untuk sekitar 3–4 orang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Dilute the hot-pot base”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 先將高麗菜或大白菜炒軟，加入麻辣鍋底醬炒香，再倒入水。
instruction.en: Stir-fry cabbage or napa cabbage until soft, add the mala hot-pot base and cook until fragrant, then add water.
instruction.id: Tumis kol atau sawi putih hingga lunak, tambahkan bumbu dasar hot pot mala dan masak hingga harum, lalu tambahkan air.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Build the mala hot-pot base”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入較難煮熟的根莖類，例如紅白蘿蔔、玉米與蓮藕，蓋鍋熬煮；再依喜好加入火鍋料、豆製品或蔬菜。
instruction.en: Add slower-cooking root vegetables such as carrot, daikon, corn, and lotus root, cover and simmer; then add preferred hot-pot items, soy products, or vegetables.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sayuran akar yang lebih lama matang seperti wortel, daikon, jagung, dan akar teratai, tutup lalu rebus; kemudian tambahkan isian hot pot, produk kedelai, atau sayuran sesuai selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Simmer the mala hot pot”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 煎香乾鍋豆包與杏鮑菇
title.en: Brown tofu skin and king oyster mushrooms
title.id: Tumis hingga kecokelatan kulit tahu dan jamur king oyster

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，先將豆包煎至金黃，再加入杏鮑菇同樣煎至金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil, brown the tofu skin sheets until golden, then add king oyster mushrooms and brown them as well.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati, tumis lembaran kulit tahu hingga keemasan, lalu tambahkan jamur king oyster dan tumis hingga keemasan juga.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown tofu skin and king oyster mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Tumis sayuran dry pot dan bumbu dasar

instruction.zh: 加入紅蘿蔔、甜豆與木耳，以大火炒至稍軟。加入保留的麻辣鍋底醬爆炒。
instruction.en: Add carrot, snow peas, and wood ear mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat until slightly tender. Add the reserved mala hot-pot base and stir-fry briskly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan wortel, kacang kapri, dan jamur kuping lalu tumis dengan api besar hingga agak lunak. Tambahkan bumbu dasar hot pot mala yang disisihkan dan tumis cepat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Stir-fry dry-pot vegetables and base”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在鍋邊淋醬油、撒胡椒粉炒香，再加水略燜；可接受料理米酒者可加入少量料理米酒。
instruction.en: Pour soy sauce around the edge of the pan, add ground pepper and cook until fragrant, then add water and briefly braise. Add a little cooking rice wine if desired.
instruction.id: Tuangkan kecap asin di tepi wajan, tambahkan lada bubuk dan masak hingga harum, lalu tambahkan air dan rebus sebentar. Tambahkan sedikit arak masak beras bila diinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season and briefly braise”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入茄子、芹菜與豆包，拌炒至完成。可依喜好加入香菜；可食五辛者可加洋蔥。
instruction.en: Add eggplant, celery, and tofu skin sheets, then stir-fry until finished. Add cilantro if desired; add onion if suitable for your diet.
instruction.id: Tambahkan terong, seledri, dan lembaran kulit tahu, lalu tumis hingga selesai. Tambahkan daun ketumbar bila diinginkan; tambahkan bawang bombai bila sesuai dengan pola makan Anda.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Add final ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
烤飯糰是居酒屋的必備料理
也是日本家庭給孩子的便當料理
不僅快速簡單
又非常有飽足感
對於料理新手非常友善拉！！
趕快看影片學起來吧！！
description.en: Grilled rice balls are a staple of izakaya cuisine and a Japanese family lunchbox dish. They are quick, simple, filling, and friendly for cooking beginners.
description.id: Onigiri panggang adalah hidangan wajib di izakaya dan bekal keluarga Jepang. Hidangan ini cepat, sederhana, mengenyangkan, dan ramah bagi pemula memasak.

instruction.zh: 茄子切成小滾刀塊。炒鍋放少量植物油，將茄子炒軟；加入少量日式醬油嗆鍋後盛出備用。
instruction.en: Cut the eggplant into small roll-cut chunks. Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and cook until soft; splash in a little Japanese soy sauce, then set aside.
instruction.id: Potong terong menjadi potongan kecil. Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan masak hingga lunak; tambahkan sedikit kecap asin Jepang, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the eggplant filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在剛煮好的熱白飯中拌入素鬆和少量鹽。可依喜好加入七味粉或芝麻調味。
instruction.en: Mix vegan meat floss and a little salt into freshly cooked hot rice. Japanese seven-spice powder or sesame may be added to taste.
instruction.id: Campurkan abon vegan dan sedikit garam ke dalam nasi panas yang baru matang. Bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang atau wijen dapat ditambahkan sesuai selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season the rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將味噌、味醂、醬油、少量糖與少量熱水攪拌均勻，作為刷在飯糰上的醬料。
instruction.en: Mix miso, mirin, soy sauce, a little sugar, and a little hot water until even for the rice-ball glaze.
instruction.id: Aduk miso, mirin, kecap asin, sedikit gula, dan sedikit air panas hingga rata untuk saus oles onigiri.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the miso glaze”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在烘焙紙上鋪一層米飯，放上茄子餡，再鋪一層米飯。用烘焙紙捏成三角形；先捏緊，讓米飯的黏性帶出來。
instruction.en: Layer rice, eggplant filling, then rice on baking paper. Use the paper to shape a triangle, pressing firmly at first so the rice becomes sticky enough to hold its form.
instruction.id: Di atas kertas roti, susun nasi, isian terong, lalu nasi. Gunakan kertas untuk membentuk segitiga dan tekan rapat terlebih dahulu agar nasi cukup lengket untuk mempertahankan bentuk.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Form triangular rice balls”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋以中小火預熱 1 至 2 分鐘並刷少量油。放入飯糰，第一面煎約 5 分鐘且不要移動；翻面後再煎約 5 分鐘。
instruction.en: Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes and brush with a little oil. Add the rice ball and cook the first side for about 5 minutes without moving it; flip and cook the other side for about 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan datar dengan api sedang-kecil selama 1 hingga 2 menit dan olesi sedikit minyak. Masukkan onigiri dan masak sisi pertama sekitar 5 menit tanpa digerakkan; balik lalu masak sisi lainnya sekitar 5 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry both sides”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 關火後，以餘溫將每個側面各煎約 30 秒。飯糰煎好後撒上海苔酥或七味粉即可享用。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat and use the residual heat to sear each side for about 30 seconds. Finish with nori flakes or Japanese seven-spice powder.
instruction.id: Matikan api dan gunakan panas sisa untuk memanggang setiap sisi sekitar 30 detik. Setelah matang, taburi serpihan nori atau bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Sear the sides and finish”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
大家常常敲碗的電鍋料理來啦
從小我就超愛吃炊飯
一碗搞定真的很方便
全部得營養都在裡面了
尤其所有蔬菜的甜味都鎖在白米裡面
真的讓人意猶未盡啊
大家也跟著影片學起來吧～
食材：
毛豆 20顆
高麗菜 1/5顆
秀珍菇 30g
乾香菇 8朵
番茄 2顆
茄子 1支
菜脯 15g
白米 2杯
紅藜麥 10g
調味料：
醬油 3大匙
糖 2大匙
胡椒粉 1小匙
鹽巴 2小匙
description.en: Here is the electric-cooker dish you have often requested. I have loved mixed rice since childhood: one bowl is convenient and contains all the nutrition, while the vegetables' sweetness is locked into the white rice. Learn it along with the video! Ingredients: 20 edamame beans, 1/5 head cabbage, 30 g oyster mushrooms, 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, 2 tomatoes, 1 eggplant, 15 g preserved radish, 2 cups white rice, and 10 g red quinoa. Seasonings: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper, and 2 tsp salt.
description.id: Inilah hidangan penanak nasi listrik yang sering diminta. Sejak kecil saya sangat menyukai nasi campur: satu mangkuk sangat praktis dan berisi semua gizi, sementara manis sayuran terkunci di dalam nasi putih. Yuk, pelajari bersama video! Bahan: 20 butir edamame, 1/5 bonggol kubis, 30 g jamur tiram, 8 jamur shiitake kering, 2 tomat, 1 terong, 15 g lobak asin kering, 2 cangkir beras putih, dan 10 g quinoa merah. Bumbu: 3 sdm kecap asin, 2 sdm gula, 1 sdt lada bubuk, dan 2 sdt garam.

instruction.zh: 高麗菜、秀珍菇、茄子和泡好的乾香菇切絲。番茄底部劃十字但不切斷。從毛豆莢取出毛豆；若使用已剝好的毛豆可直接使用。
instruction.en: Shred the cabbage, oyster mushrooms, eggplant, and soaked dried shiitake mushrooms. Score a cross in the bottom of each tomato without cutting through it. Remove the edamame from the pods, or use already-shelled edamame.
instruction.id: Iris tipis kubis, jamur tiram, terong, dan jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam. Buat sayatan silang pada bagian bawah setiap tomat tanpa memotongnya hingga putus. Keluarkan edamame dari polongnya, atau gunakan edamame yang sudah dikupas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the vegetables and mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Wash the rice and reserve the soaking liquid
title.id: Cuci beras dan simpan air rendaman

instruction.zh: 白米和紅藜麥洗淨；洗紅藜麥時可用小篩網擋住，避免瀝水時流失。保留泡香菇的水，煮飯時加入使用。
instruction.en: Wash the white rice and red quinoa. Use a small sieve when draining the quinoa so it does not escape. Reserve the shiitake soaking liquid to use when cooking the rice.
instruction.id: Cuci beras putih dan quinoa merah. Gunakan saringan kecil saat meniriskan quinoa agar tidak ikut terbuang. Simpan air rendaman shiitake untuk digunakan saat memasak nasi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Wash the rice and reserve the soaking liquid”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 煸香菇類和菜脯並調味
title.en: Brown the mushrooms and preserved radish, then season
title.id: Tumis jamur dan lobak asin hingga harum lalu bumbui

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入植物油，將乾香菇、秀珍菇和菜脯煸至金黃。加入醬油、糖、胡椒粉和鹽調味。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a wok and brown the dried shiitake mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and preserved radish until golden. Season with soy sauce, sugar, ground pepper, and salt.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan dan tumis jamur shiitake kering, jamur tiram, serta lobak asin kering hingga keemasan. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, dan garam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown the mushrooms and preserved radish, then season”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Cook the mixed rice in an electric cooker
title.id: Masak nasi campur dalam penanak nasi listrik

instruction.zh: 將洗好的白米和紅藜麥與備好的食材放入電鍋，加入保留的香菇水後煮熟。影片說明只有電鍋時，也可將所有食材一起放入蒸煮。
instruction.en: Put the washed white rice and red quinoa with the prepared ingredients into an electric cooker, add the reserved shiitake soaking liquid, and cook until done. The video notes that, when only an electric cooker is available, all ingredients may be put in together to steam-cook.
instruction.id: Masukkan beras putih dan quinoa merah yang sudah dicuci bersama bahan yang telah disiapkan ke dalam penanak nasi listrik, tambahkan air rendaman shiitake yang disimpan, lalu masak hingga matang. Video menjelaskan bahwa bila hanya tersedia penanak nasi listrik, semua bahan dapat dimasukkan bersama untuk dikukus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the mixed rice in an electric cooker”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炊飯完成後撒上芝麻即可享用。
instruction.en: Once the mixed rice is cooked, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.
instruction.id: Setelah nasi campur matang, taburi dengan biji wijen lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with sesame and serve”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
全素披薩自己來真的很簡單
從麵團、醬料到椒鹽粉
全部都可以一起搞定
這次因為百靈的料理機
讓整個過程輕鬆不少
甚至醬料跟椒鹽粉
都可以變成家裡的常備調味料
趕快一起學起來吧！！
description.en: This vegan pizza makes the dough, sauce, and pepper salt from scratch; the sauce and seasoning can also be kept as pantry staples.
description.id: Pizza vegan ini membuat adonan, saus, dan garam lada dari awal; saus serta bumbunya juga dapat disimpan sebagai stok dapur.

instruction.zh: 乾酵母與約35°C的一杯溫水拌勻。高筋麵粉、鹽、糖和少量橄欖油混合後加入酵母水，攪拌約2分鐘，整形成圓團並發酵約1.5小時至2至3倍大。
instruction.en: Mix dry yeast with 1 cup warm water at about 35°C. Combine bread flour, salt, sugar, and a little olive oil, add the yeast water, mix about 2 minutes, shape into a ball, and proof about 1.5 hours until 2 to 3 times larger.
instruction.id: Campurkan ragi kering dengan 1 cangkir air hangat sekitar 35°C. Campurkan tepung roti, garam, gula, dan sedikit minyak zaitun, tambahkan air ragi, aduk sekitar 2 menit, bentuk bulat, lalu fermentasikan sekitar 1,5 jam hingga 2–3 kali lebih besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make and proof the dough”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 番茄對半切，蘑菇與杏鮑菇切小丁。以少量植物油將兩種菇煸至金黃，加入番茄炒出茄紅素，以鹽、糖和黑胡椒調味；加入番茄糊和義式香料後打勻。
instruction.en: Halve the tomatoes and dice the mushrooms and king oyster mushrooms. Brown both mushrooms in a little oil, add tomatoes and cook until their color develops, season with salt, sugar, and black pepper, then blend with tomato paste and Italian seasoning.
instruction.id: Belah tomat, lalu potong dadu jamur dan jamur tiram raja. Kecokelatan kedua jamur dengan sedikit minyak, tambahkan tomat dan masak hingga warnanya keluar, bumbui garam, gula, dan lada hitam, lalu haluskan bersama pasta tomat dan bumbu Italia.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the red sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 乾鍋炒香花椒、小茴香、白芝麻和黑胡椒粒；加入鹽炒至微黃。平鋪放涼後研磨成粉。
instruction.en: Dry-toast Sichuan peppercorns, cumin, white sesame, and black peppercorns. Add salt and toast until lightly yellow; spread out to cool, then grind to a powder.
instruction.id: Sangrai lada Sichuan, jintan, wijen putih, dan merica hitam. Tambahkan garam dan sangrai hingga sedikit kuning; ratakan hingga dingin, lalu giling menjadi bubuk.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the pepper salt”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 麵團排氣後拉至約直徑25公分，邊緣向內捲，放在鋪烘焙紙的烤盤上並以叉子戳洞。抹紅醬、放素起司和秀珍菇、青椒、黑橄欖等配料；邊緣塗橄欖油。
instruction.en: Deflate the dough, stretch to about 25 cm in diameter, roll the edges inward, place on a parchment-lined tray, and prick with a fork. Spread red sauce, add vegan cheese and oyster mushrooms, green bell pepper, black olives, and other toppings; brush the edge with olive oil.
instruction.id: Keluarkan udara dari adonan, rentangkan hingga diameter sekitar 25 cm, gulung tepi ke dalam, letakkan di loyang berlapis kertas roti, lalu tusuk dengan garpu. Olesi saus merah, tambahkan keju vegan serta jamur tiram, paprika hijau, zaitun hitam, dan topping lain; olesi tepi dengan minyak zaitun.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Shape and top”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 烤箱上下火200°C預熱10分鐘後，披薩烤15分鐘。烤好切成8等份，撒上自製椒鹽粉。
instruction.en: Preheat the oven with top and bottom heat at 200°C for 10 minutes, then bake the pizza for 15 minutes. Cut into 8 pieces and sprinkle with the homemade pepper salt.
instruction.id: Panaskan oven dengan panas atas-bawah 200°C selama 10 menit, lalu panggang pizza 15 menit. Potong menjadi 8 bagian dan taburi garam lada buatan sendiri.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Bake and finish”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

最近不知道為什麼
一直很想喝餛飩湯

總是特別溫暖
吃素之後許多素餛飩都覺得味道不對
或是沒有口感等等
直到現在研發出來

description.en: A warm bowl of wonton soup recalls childhood. This recipe develops a vegan wonton with a satisfying texture.
description.id: Semangkuk sup pangsit hangat mengingatkan pada masa kecil. Resep ini mengembangkan pangsit vegan dengan tekstur yang memuaskan.

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇、節瓜、茄子、芹菜和木耳切小丁；老薑切末。油豆腐剝成小碎塊。
instruction.en: Dice the fresh shiitake, zucchini, eggplant, celery, and wood ear mushrooms; mince the ginger. Tear the fried tofu into small pieces.
instruction.id: Potong dadu shiitake segar, zucchini, terong, seledri, dan jamur kuping; cincang jahe. Suwir tahu goreng menjadi potongan kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 先煸油豆腐上色，撥至鍋邊後加入其餘切好的食材炒香。出水後加入鹽、胡椒粉、五香粉、醬油和水；加入味噌並煮約 1 分鐘，讓水分略收乾。
instruction.en: Brown the fried tofu first, push it to the side, and sauté the remaining chopped ingredients. Once they release water, add salt, ground pepper, five-spice powder, soy sauce, and water; add miso and cook about 1 minute until the moisture reduces slightly.
instruction.id: Kecokelatan tahu goreng terlebih dahulu, sisihkan ke tepi wajan, lalu tumis bahan cincang lainnya. Setelah mengeluarkan air, tambahkan garam, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, kecap asin, dan air; tambahkan miso dan masak sekitar 1 menit hingga cairan sedikit menyusut.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook and season the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 關火後拌入低筋麵粉至均勻，作為餛飩餡。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat and mix in cake flour evenly to make the wonton filling.
instruction.id: Matikan api dan campurkan tepung protein rendah hingga rata untuk membuat isian pangsit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix in flour”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在餛飩皮中央放少量餡料，四周抹水後對半折，壓出空氣並封緊；兩側向中間折，再用食指與拇指在中間捏緊。
instruction.en: Place a little filling in the center of a wrapper, wet the edges, fold in half, press out air and seal. Fold both sides inward, then pinch the center with index fingers and thumbs.
instruction.id: Letakkan sedikit isian di tengah kulit pangsit, basahi pinggirnya, lipat dua, keluarkan udara dan rekatkan. Lipat kedua sisi ke tengah, lalu cubit bagian tengah dengan telunjuk dan ibu jari.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fold the wontons”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 若要冷凍，盤底先撒麵粉，將包好的餛飩冷凍約 1 小時定型後再放入保鮮袋；現包現煮則不需要撒粉。
instruction.en: For freezing, dust the tray with flour, freeze the folded wontons about 1 hour to set, then transfer to a storage bag; flour is unnecessary when cooking immediately.
instruction.id: Untuk dibekukan, taburi loyang dengan tepung, bekukan pangsit yang telah dilipat sekitar 1 jam hingga set, lalu pindahkan ke kantong penyimpanan; tepung tidak diperlukan bila langsung dimasak.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Optionally freeze”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 湯中加入紫菜、喜歡的蔬菜（來源使用小白菜）、鹽與胡椒粉，再放入餛飩。餛飩浮起後加入腐皮，淋少量香油，關火盛盤並撒芹菜末。
instruction.en: Add nori, preferred vegetables (the source uses bok choy), salt, and ground pepper to the soup, then add the wontons. When they float, add tofu skin, drizzle with a little sesame oil, turn off the heat, and finish with chopped celery.
instruction.id: Tambahkan nori, sayuran pilihan (sumber memakai pakcoy), garam, dan lada bubuk ke dalam sup, lalu masukkan pangsit. Saat pangsit mengapung, tambahkan kulit tahu, beri sedikit minyak wijen, matikan api, dan taburi seledri cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the wonton soup”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以燕麥奶、低筋麵粉、香草精、泡打粉及營養酵母調製，靜置10分鐘後煎成濃香鬆軟的無蛋奶早餐鬆餅。
description.en: Oat milk, cake flour, vanilla, baking powder and nutritional yeast make these rich, fluffy egg-free and dairy-free breakfast pancakes after a 10-minute batter rest.
description.id: Susu oat, tepung rendah protein, vanila, baking powder, dan ragi nutrisi menghasilkan panekuk sarapan tanpa telur dan susu yang lembut setelah adonan didiamkan 10 menit.

instruction.zh: 混合100g低筋麵粉、1小匙泡打粉、3大匙營養酵母及1小匙鹽；加入2大匙香草精和80g燕麥奶拌勻，再按濃稠度逐少加入約80g水，攪至順滑無顆粒。
instruction.en: Combine 100 g cake flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 tbsp nutritional yeast and 1 tsp salt. Mix in 2 tbsp vanilla extract and 80 g oat milk, then gradually add up to about 80 g water as needed for a smooth, lump-free batter.
instruction.id: Campurkan 100 g tepung rendah protein, 1 sdt bubuk pengembang, 3 sdm ragi nutrisi, dan 1 sdt garam. Masukkan 2 sdm ekstrak vanila serta 80 g susu oat, lalu tambahkan hingga sekitar 80 g air sedikit demi sedikit sampai adonan halus tanpa gumpalan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead-close preparation photograph of smooth pale vegan pancake batter being whisked in a ceramic bowl, with a thick but pourable ribbon and no dry flour lumps. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cooked pancakes, syrup, fruit, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 讓麵糊靜置10分鐘，使泡打粉作用並讓成品更蓬鬆。
instruction.en: Rest the batter for 10 minutes so the baking powder can act and the pancakes become fluffier.
instruction.id: Diamkan adonan 10 menit agar baking powder bekerja dan panekuk lebih mengembang.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of vegan pancake batter resting undisturbed in a clean bowl, with small baking-powder bubbles forming across the smooth surface. Constraints: no skillet, cooked pancakes, toppings, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋抹極少植物油，以圓湯匙從約5至10公分高度將麵糊垂直倒入，讓鬆餅自然成圓形；表面冒泡、邊緣定型後翻面，煎至兩面金黃熟透。
instruction.en: Wipe a flat pan with only a trace of vegetable oil. Pour the batter straight down from a round ladle held about 5–10 cm above the pan so it forms a circle. Flip when bubbles appear and the edge sets, then cook until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Olesi wajan datar dengan sangat sedikit minyak nabati. Tuang adonan lurus dari sendok bulat setinggi sekitar 5–10 cm agar membentuk lingkaran. Balik saat muncul gelembung dan pinggirannya mengeras, lalu masak hingga kedua sisi keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: appetizing close food photograph of round vegan pancakes cooking in a lightly oiled flat skillet, one pancake covered in set bubbles ready to flip and one showing an evenly golden underside. Constraints: no egg, dairy, syrup, fruit, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.zh: 全素韓式辣炒年糕泡麵
title.en: Vegan Korean Spicy Rice Cakes with Ramen

description.zh: 一鍋到底的全素韓式辣炒年糕泡麵：豆包煎至金黃後與香菇、蔬菜、年糕和韓式辣醬同煮，最後加入青龍椒與全素王子麵。
description.en: A one-pot vegan Korean spicy rice-cake ramen: tofu puffs are browned, then simmered with shiitake, vegetables, rice cakes and Korean chili paste before green chilies and vegan instant noodles are added.
description.id: Tteokbokki mi instan Korea vegan satu panci: tahu puff digoreng keemasan, lalu direbus bersama shiitake, sayuran, kue beras, dan pasta cabai Korea sebelum cabai hijau serta mi instan vegan ditambahkan.

instruction.zh: 將乾香菇與紅蘿蔔切片；高麗菜洗淨後剝成小片；豆包切成粗條再切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the dried shiitake and carrot, wash and tear the cabbage into small pieces, then cut the tofu puffs into thick strips and short pieces.
instruction.id: Iris shiitake kering dan wortel, cuci lalu sobek kol menjadi potongan kecil, kemudian potong tahu puff menjadi strip tebal dan potongan pendek.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of raw preparation on a wooden board: sliced rehydrated shiitake, thin carrot slices, torn bite-size cabbage leaves, and tofu-puff sheets cut first into thick strips then short pieces. Constraints: strictly vegan; raw mise en place only, no rice cakes, noodles, sauce, cooking pot, finished dish, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 湯鍋中倒入少量香油，先把豆包煎至金黃酥脆；再加入香菇與紅蘿蔔炒香，最後放入高麗菜炒軟。
