title.en: Vegan Three Dishes and One Soup
title.id: Tiga Hidangan dan Satu Sup Vegan

description.zh: 用客家桔醬與香茅冬炎醬完成四道全素料理：桔醬燴豆腐、菠菜捲佐桔醬、泰式炒河粉與泰式酸辣湯。
description.en: Four vegan dishes using Hakka kumquat sauce and lemongrass tom-yum sauce: braised kumquat tofu, spinach rolls, Pad Thai, and Thai sour-spicy soup.
description.id: Empat hidangan vegan memakai saus kumquat Hakka dan saus tom yum serai: tahu kumquat, gulung bayam, Pad Thai, serta sup asam pedas Thailand.

name.en: enoki, shimeji, and dried tofu skin
name.id: enoki, shimeji, dan kulit tahu kering

instruction.zh: 板豆腐切片煎至金黃。炒香薑末與辣椒末，加入客家桔醬、醬油、糖、少許鹽與200毫升水煮滾；放回豆腐熬煮至收汁，最後撒香菜。
instruction.en: Slice and brown firm tofu. Sauté minced ginger and chili, add Hakka kumquat sauce, soy sauce, sugar, a little salt, and 200 ml water; return tofu and simmer until reduced, then top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Iris dan kecokelatan tahu padat. Tumis jahe cincang dan cabai, tambahkan saus kumquat Hakka, kecap asin, gula, sedikit garam, dan 200 ml air; masukkan kembali tahu dan rebus hingga menyusut, lalu beri daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Braised kumquat tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 菠菜汆燙至軟後放入冰水冰鎮，擠去水分，取約三小撮扭轉成捲並切成一口大小；擺盤後點上客家桔醬。
instruction.en: Blanch spinach until soft, chill in ice water, squeeze dry, twist about three small pinches into rolls and cut into bite-size pieces; plate and dot with Hakka kumquat sauce.
instruction.id: Rebus sebentar bayam hingga lunak, dinginkan dalam air es, peras, pilin sekitar tiga cubitan kecil menjadi gulungan dan potong sekali makan; tata lalu beri saus kumquat Hakka.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Spinach rolls with kumquat sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Cook noodles and prepare Pad Thai ingredients
title.id: Masak mi dan siapkan bahan Pad Thai

instruction.zh: 豆包切條，小白菜與香菜切段，杏鮑菇和紅蘿蔔切絲。河粉在加鹽滾水中煮至約八分熟後撈起；菜脯先泡水後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Cut tofu skin into strips, bok choy and cilantro into sections, and king oyster mushroom and carrot into shreds. Cook rice noodles in salted boiling water until about 80% done, then drain; soak and drain preserved radish first.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu menjadi strip, pakcoy dan daun ketumbar menjadi potongan, serta jamur king oyster dan wortel menjadi serutan. Masak mi beras dalam air mendidih bergaram hingga sekitar 80% matang lalu tiriskan; rendam dan tiriskan lobak asin terlebih dahulu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook noodles and prepare Pad Thai ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 煎香豆包與菜脯，加入杏鮑菇、紅蘿蔔和荷蘭豆炒至出水；加入河粉、小白菜和由香茅冬炎醬、醬油、水、白胡椒、檸檬汁與辣椒粉調成的醬汁拌炒。搭配豆芽、香菜與花生碎。
instruction.en: Brown tofu skin and preserved radish, add king oyster mushroom, carrot, and snow peas until they release moisture; add noodles and bok choy and toss with a sauce of lemongrass tom-yum sauce, soy sauce, water, white pepper, lemon juice, and chili powder. Serve with bean sprouts, cilantro, and crushed peanuts.
instruction.id: Tumis kulit tahu dan lobak asin hingga harum, tambahkan jamur king oyster, wortel, dan kacang kapri hingga mengeluarkan air; masukkan mi serta pakcoy dan aduk dengan saus dari tom yum serai, kecap asin, air, lada putih, air lemon, dan bubuk cabai. Sajikan dengan tauge, daun ketumbar, dan kacang tanah cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish vegan Pad Thai”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 番茄炒至出汁後加入娃娃菜，加入香茅冬炎醬、辣椒粉與水；放入絲瓜、豆腐和腐竹熬煮10分鐘。加入金針菇、鴻喜菇、椰奶、檸檬汁與胡椒粉，盛盤後撒香菜。
instruction.en: Cook tomatoes until juicy, add baby napa cabbage, then lemongrass tom-yum sauce, chili powder, and water. Add luffa, tofu, and dried tofu skin and simmer for 10 minutes. Add enoki, shimeji, coconut milk, lemon juice, and pepper; top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Masak tomat hingga berair, tambahkan sawi putih mini, lalu saus tom yum serai, bubuk cabai, dan air. Tambahkan oyong, tahu, dan kulit tahu kering lalu rebus 10 menit. Masukkan enoki, shimeji, santan, air lemon, dan lada; beri daun ketumbar.

description.zh: 帶殼煎烤的茭白筍，刷上味增醬並鋪上薑與蘿蔔製成的全素金沙。
description.en: Halved water bamboo shoots are seared, brushed with miso glaze, topped with a vegan golden crumble of ginger and radishes, then baked.
description.id: Bambu air yang dibelah dipanggang, diolesi saus miso, diberi taburan emas vegan dari jahe dan lobak, lalu dipanggang dalam oven.

instruction.zh: 洗淨茭白筍，去頭去尾後剖半並在切面劃花刀。
instruction.en: Wash and trim the water bamboo shoots. Halve them lengthwise and score the cut surfaces.
instruction.id: Cuci dan rapikan bambu air. Belah memanjang, lalu kerat permukaan potongannya.

instruction.zh: 以小火持續攪拌味增、味醂、糖、昆布醬油、醋、油、太白粉與水，煮至微稠。
instruction.en: Stir miso, mirin, sugar, kombu soy sauce, vinegar, oil, starch, and water over low heat until slightly thickened.
instruction.id: Aduk miso, mirin, gula, kecap kombu, cuka, minyak, tepung, dan air dengan api kecil hingga sedikit kental.

instruction.en: Finely grate the carrot, daikon and mature ginger, then squeeze out excess moisture. Stir-fry over low heat until dry, loose and golden to make the vegan crumble.
instruction.id: Parut halus wortel, lobak putih, dan jahe tua, lalu peras kelebihan airnya. Tumis dengan api kecil hingga kering, terurai, dan keemasan untuk membuat taburan vegan.

instruction.en: Dry-sear the cut sides of the water bamboo until lightly golden. Brush with miso glaze, top with the vegan golden crumble, and bake at 180°C with top and bottom heat for 10 minutes. Finish with sesame if desired.
instruction.id: Panggang kering sisi potongan bambu air hingga agak keemasan. Olesi saus miso, beri taburan emas vegan, lalu panggang dengan panas atas-bawah 180°C selama 10 menit. Taburi wijen bila suka.

description.zh: 以水餃皮包入咖哩、雙豆腐、四季豆和冬粉餡，再煎至兩面金黃的純素塔香肉餅。
description.en: Dumpling wrappers are filled with a curry mixture of two tofus, green beans, vermicelli, and basil, then pan-fried until golden on both sides.
description.id: Kulit pangsit diisi campuran kari dari dua jenis tahu, buncis, soun, dan kemangi, lalu digoreng hingga kedua sisinya keemasan.

title.en: Press tofu and chop the filling

instruction.zh: 板豆腐以豆漿布擠乾水分；泡軟冬粉與四季豆切小段，九層塔去梗切末，油豆腐沖洗後剝成小塊。
instruction.en: Squeeze the firm tofu dry in a cheesecloth. Cut soaked vermicelli and green beans into short pieces, strip and mince the Thai basil, and rinse then tear the fried tofu puffs into small pieces.
instruction.id: Peras tahu padat hingga kering dengan kain saring. Potong soun yang sudah direndam dan buncis menjadi pendek, petiki lalu cincang kemangi Thailand, serta bilas dan sobek tahu puff goreng menjadi kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of pressed tofu, cut green beans, soaked vermicelli, torn fried tofu puffs, and minced Thai basil, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋中將板豆腐與油豆腐煸至表面金黃，讓雙豆腐先帶出香氣與口感。
instruction.en: Brown the firm tofu and fried tofu puffs in a wok until their surfaces turn golden, building fragrance and texture before adding the sauce.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu padat dan tahu puff goreng dalam wajan hingga permukaannya keemasan untuk membangun aroma dan tekstur sebelum saus ditambahkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of crumbled firm tofu and torn fried tofu puffs browning in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 將兩塊純素咖哩塊放入碗中，沖入300毫升熱水並攪拌至均勻融化。
instruction.en: Place the two vegan curry roux blocks in a bowl, pour in 300 ml hot water, and stir until the roux dissolves evenly.
instruction.id: Masukkan dua blok roux kari vegan ke dalam mangkuk, tuang 300 ml air panas, lalu aduk hingga roux larut merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of two curry roux blocks dissolving into a glossy brown sauce in a bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 將咖哩湯汁倒入金黃豆腐中，加入四季豆與冬粉，以小火持續攪拌炒約3分鐘；再加入咖哩粉和胡椒鹽炒約1分鐘至餡料收乾。
instruction.en: Pour the curry sauce over the golden tofu, add green beans and vermicelli, and stir continuously over low heat for about 3 minutes. Add curry powder and pepper salt, then cook about 1 minute more until the filling is dry.
instruction.id: Tuang saus kari ke tahu yang telah keemasan, tambahkan buncis dan soun, lalu aduk terus dengan api kecil sekitar 3 menit. Masukkan bubuk kari dan garam lada, masak sekitar 1 menit lagi sampai isian mengering.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thick curry vermicelli filling with tofu and green beans being stirred in a wok, no text.

title.en: Fold in basil and cool the filling

instruction.zh: 餡料收乾後關火，拌入九層塔末約10秒，保留塔香的清新香氣，再放至可包餡的溫度。
instruction.en: When the filling is dry, turn off the heat and fold in minced Thai basil for about 10 seconds to preserve its fresh aroma, then cool until safe to fill.
instruction.id: Saat isian mengering, matikan api dan aduk kemangi cincang sekitar 10 detik agar aromanya tetap segar, lalu dinginkan sampai aman untuk diisi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of fresh minced Thai basil being folded into a finished curry tofu filling, no text.

instruction.zh: 每張水餃皮放入咖哩餡，外圈沾水後蓋上第二張皮並壓緊，以叉子壓出花邊；平底鍋煎至兩面金黃。
instruction.en: Place curry filling on one dumpling wrapper, wet the edge, cover with a second wrapper, seal firmly, and crimp with a fork; pan-fry until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Letakkan isian kari di atas satu kulit pangsit, basahi tepinya, tutup dengan kulit kedua, rekatkan rapat, dan tekan dengan garpu; goreng hingga kedua sisi keemasan.

description.en: Korean glass noodles tossed with vegetables and seared tofu, suitable warm or chilled.
description.id: Soun Korea dengan sayuran dan tahu tumis, nikmat disajikan hangat atau dingin.

instruction.zh: 將香菇、木耳、胡蘿蔔與甜椒切細絲，薑切末，菠菜切段，豆腐切條。
instruction.en: Slice mushrooms, wood ear, carrot, and pepper; mince ginger; cut spinach and tofu into strips.
instruction.id: Iris jamur, jamur kuping, wortel, dan paprika; cincang jahe; potong bayam dan tahu memanjang.

title.en: Vegan Dragon Fruit Snow Skin Mooncakes
title.id: Kue Bulan Kulit Salju Buah Naga Vegan

description.zh: 火龍果、嫩豆腐與糯米粉揉成粉紅冰皮，包入蒸地瓜後壓模蒸熟，完全不加糖與油的全素月餅。
description.en: Dragon fruit, silken tofu, and glutinous rice flour become a pink snow skin wrapped around steamed sweet potato, then molded and steamed into vegan mooncakes without added sugar or oil.
description.id: Buah naga, tahu sutra, dan tepung ketan menjadi kulit merah muda yang membungkus ubi kukus, lalu dicetak dan dikukus menjadi kue bulan vegan tanpa gula atau minyak tambahan.

instruction.zh: 地瓜去皮切塊，放入電鍋，外鍋加1杯水蒸熟備用。
instruction.en: Peel and cube the sweet potato, place it in an electric cooker, and steam it with 1 outer-pot cup of water until tender.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong ubi jalar, masukkan ke penanak listrik, lalu kukus dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar hingga empuk.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of peeled sweet potato cubes in a steaming dish beside an electric cooker, no text.

instruction.zh: 火龍果與嫩豆腐切小塊，將約四分之一顆火龍果和半盒嫩豆腐放入大碗拌勻。
instruction.en: Cut the dragon fruit and silken tofu into small pieces, then combine about one quarter of the dragon fruit with half a box of silken tofu in a large bowl.
instruction.id: Potong buah naga dan tahu sutra menjadi kecil, lalu campurkan sekitar seperempat buah naga dengan setengah kotak tahu sutra di dalam mangkuk besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of vivid pink dragon fruit cubes and silken tofu pieces in a large mixing bowl, no text.

title.en: Knead the snow-skin dough in stages

instruction.zh: 糯米粉分兩次加入火龍果豆腐糊；第一次拌勻後再加入第二次，揉到不黏手，若水果或豆腐水分較多再少量補粉。
instruction.en: Add the glutinous rice flour to the dragon fruit tofu mixture in two additions. Mix the first addition evenly before the second, then knead until no longer sticky, adding a little more flour only if the fruit or tofu is wetter.
instruction.id: Tambahkan tepung ketan ke campuran buah naga dan tahu dalam dua tahap. Aduk tahap pertama hingga rata sebelum tahap kedua, lalu uleni sampai tidak lengket; tambahkan sedikit tepung hanya bila buah atau tahu lebih berair.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of pink glutinous rice dough being kneaded by hand in a mixing bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 工作面撒少量糯米粉防沾，取約45至50克冰皮壓扁，包入一塊蒸地瓜，收口朝上搓成微橢圓形。
instruction.en: Dust the work surface with a little glutinous rice flour. Flatten about 45 to 50 g of snow-skin dough, wrap it around a piece of steamed sweet potato, seal side up, and shape it into a slightly oval ball.
instruction.id: Taburi permukaan kerja dengan sedikit tepung ketan. Pipihkan sekitar 45 hingga 50 g adonan kulit, bungkus sepotong ubi kukus, rapatkan dengan sambungan di atas, lalu bentuk agak oval.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a pink dragon fruit dough round being wrapped around a yellow sweet potato cube on a floured board, no text.

instruction.zh: 月餅模具內薄薄抹橄欖油，將收口朝上的麵糰放入壓出花紋；排在盤上，電鍋外鍋加1杯水蒸熟後取出。
instruction.en: Lightly coat a mooncake mold with olive oil, place the dough seam-side up inside, and press out the pattern. Arrange on a plate and steam in an electric cooker with 1 outer-pot cup of water, then remove.
instruction.id: Olesi cetakan kue bulan tipis dengan minyak zaitun, masukkan adonan dengan sambungan menghadap atas, lalu tekan hingga berpola. Tata di piring dan kukus dalam penanak listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar, lalu angkat.

description.zh: 把炒香的泡菜香菇與米飯、素鬆和海苔拌勻後捏成一口大小飯糰。
description.en: Stir-fried kimchi and mushrooms are mixed with rice, vegan floss, and seaweed, then shaped into bite-size rice balls.
description.id: Kimchi dan jamur tumis dicampur dengan nasi, abon vegan, dan rumput laut lalu dibentuk menjadi bola nasi kecil.

instruction.zh: 將香菇切丁，泡菜擠乾切碎並保留泡菜汁；炒香香菇與泡菜，加入醬油和胡椒後關火。
instruction.en: Dice mushrooms; squeeze and chop kimchi while reserving its juice. Stir-fry mushrooms and kimchi, season with soy sauce and pepper, then turn off heat.
instruction.id: Potong dadu jamur; peras dan cincang kimchi sambil menyimpan airnya. Tumis jamur dan kimchi, bumbui kecap asin dan lada, lalu matikan api.

instruction.en: Combine cooked rice, vegan floss, corn, seaweed flakes, sesame, and the stir-fry in a bowl; mix in sesame oil, mayonnaise, and reserved kimchi juice.
instruction.id: Campurkan nasi matang, abon vegan, jagung, serpihan rumput laut, wijen, dan tumisan; aduk dengan minyak wijen, mayones, dan air kimchi.

description.en: Eggplant, mushrooms, okra, green peppers, and squash are coated in a lumpy ice-water batter, fried crisp, and served with a bright Japanese dipping sauce.
description.id: Terong, jamur, okra, cabai hijau, dan labu dilapisi adonan air es yang masih berbutir, digoreng renyah, lalu disajikan dengan saus cocol Jepang yang segar.

instruction.zh: 將茄子切成扇形；金針菇撥成小束，並把香菇、秋葵、青龍椒與南瓜切成適合油炸的大小。
instruction.en: Cut the eggplant into a fan shape, separate enoki into small bundles, and cut the shiitake, okra, green chilies, and squash into frying-size pieces.
instruction.id: Potong terong berbentuk kipas, pisahkan enoki menjadi ikatan kecil, lalu potong shiitake, okra, cabai hijau, dan labu seukuran untuk digoreng.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of fan-cut eggplant, enoki bundles, okra, green peppers, mushrooms, and squash on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 所有蔬菜先均勻沾上低筋麵粉，再拍掉多餘乾粉，讓後續麵糊更容易附著。
instruction.en: Coat every vegetable evenly with cake flour, then tap off the excess so the wet batter will adhere more securely.
instruction.id: Balut semua sayuran secara merata dengan tepung rendah protein, lalu tepuk kelebihan tepung agar adonan basah melekat lebih kuat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of assorted vegetables being dusted with white flour on a shallow tray, no text.

instruction.zh: 將100克低筋麵粉、50克酥炸粉、鹽、白胡椒粉與300克冰塊水輕輕拌勻；保留小顆粒，不要攪拌到產生筋性。
instruction.en: Gently combine 100 g cake flour, 50 g crispy frying flour, salt, white pepper, and 300 g ice water; leave small lumps and do not overmix into a glutenous batter.
instruction.id: Aduk perlahan 100 g tepung rendah protein, 50 g tepung goreng renyah, garam, lada putih, dan 300 g air es; sisakan butiran kecil dan jangan mengaduk berlebihan hingga berstruktur gluten.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a pale lumpy tempura batter with ice water in a metal mixing bowl, no text.

title.en: Test the oil and fry in batches

instruction.zh: 油鍋加熱後，以少量麵糊測試：麵糊入油後立刻浮起約為170°C；蔬菜沾麵糊後分批下鍋，每次約4件，避免油溫下降。
instruction.en: Heat the frying oil and test it with a little batter: when it floats immediately, the oil is about 170°C. Dip the vegetables in batter and fry in batches of about four pieces to avoid lowering the oil temperature.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dan uji dengan sedikit adonan: bila langsung mengapung, minyak sekitar 170°C. Celupkan sayuran ke adonan lalu goreng bertahap sekitar empat potong agar suhu minyak tidak turun.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of battered vegetable tempura pieces entering hot oil with bubbles in a deep frying pan, no text.

instruction.zh: 蔬菜表面略呈金黃色先撈出；完成第一輪後再回鍋搶酥，炸至外皮金黃酥脆後瀝油。
instruction.en: Lift the vegetables out once the surface is lightly golden; after the first round, return them to the oil briefly to crisp the coating, then drain when deep golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Angkat sayuran saat permukaannya mulai keemasan; setelah putaran pertama, kembalikan sebentar ke minyak untuk membuat lapisan renyah, lalu tiriskan saat berwarna keemasan dan garing.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of crisp golden vegetable tempura draining on a wire rack above a tray, no text.

title.en: Stir together the Japanese dipping sauce

instruction.zh: 將日式醬油、味醂、蘋果醋、白芝麻與少量芥末攪拌均勻，作為天婦羅沾醬。
instruction.en: Stir Japanese soy sauce, mirin, apple cider vinegar, white sesame seeds, and a little wasabi together for the tempura dipping sauce.
instruction.id: Aduk kecap asin Jepang, mirin, cuka apel, wijen putih, dan sedikit wasabi hingga rata sebagai saus cocol tempura.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a small bowl of dark tempura dipping sauce with sesame and wasabi beside golden vegetables, no text.

description.zh: 將醋飯鋪在海苔外側，捲入煎香豆包、茄子、玉米筍、小黃瓜及紅蘿蔔，切片後配上酪梨，做成餐廳級全素花壽司。
description.en: Vinegared rice is spread outside the nori and rolled around seared tofu skin, eggplant, baby corn, cucumber and carrot, then sliced and topped with avocado.
description.id: Nasi cuka diratakan di sisi luar nori lalu digulung bersama kulit tahu, terong, jagung muda, mentimun, dan wortel, kemudian dipotong serta diberi alpukat.

instruction.zh: 煮熟壽司米，趁熱加入壽司醋，以切拌方式輕輕拌勻，攤開放涼備用。
instruction.en: Cook the sushi rice, add sushi vinegar while hot, and fold gently with cutting motions. Spread the rice out and leave it to cool.
instruction.id: Masak beras sushi, tambahkan cuka sushi selagi panas, lalu aduk perlahan dengan gerakan memotong. Ratakan dan biarkan nasi dingin.

instruction.zh: 豆包、茄子及小黃瓜切長條，玉米筍縱切；以少量油煎香豆包、玉米筍和茄子，紅蘿蔔切條後汆燙，酪梨切片。
instruction.en: Cut the tofu skin, eggplant and cucumber into long strips and halve the baby corn lengthwise. Sear the tofu skin, baby corn and eggplant in a little oil; blanch carrot strips and slice the avocado.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu, terong, dan mentimun memanjang, lalu belah jagung muda. Tumis kulit tahu, jagung muda, dan terong dengan sedikit minyak; rebus singkat wortel yang dipotong memanjang dan iris alpukat.

instruction.zh: 竹簾鋪上海苔及醋飯後翻面，把內餡放在下方三分之一處並捲緊。靜置2分鐘定型，以醋水沾濕刀身後切片，最後鋪上酪梨。
instruction.en: Place nori and vinegared rice on a bamboo mat, then flip it over. Arrange the fillings across the lower third and roll tightly. Rest for 2 minutes, slice with a knife moistened with vinegar water, and top with avocado.
instruction.id: Letakkan nori dan nasi cuka di atas tikar bambu lalu balikkan. Susun isian pada sepertiga bagian bawah dan gulung rapat. Diamkan 2 menit, potong dengan pisau yang dibasahi air cuka, lalu beri irisan alpukat.

description.zh: 煮熟冰鎮的義大利麵搭配小黃瓜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒與可選辣椒，拌入白芝麻醬、花生醬、日式醬油與檸檬調成的清爽全素麻醬。
description.en: Fully cooked and chilled spaghetti is paired with cucumber, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and optional chili, then dressed in a refreshing vegan sauce of white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, and lemon.

instruction.zh: 小黃瓜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒與可選辣椒全部切成細條，分開備好。
instruction.en: Cut the cucumber, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and optional chili into fine strips and keep them ready separately.
instruction.id: Iris mentimun, wortel, paprika kuning, dan cabai opsional menjadi batang tipis, lalu sisihkan secara terpisah.

instruction.zh: 混合白芝麻醬、花生醬、日式醬油、黑麻油、花椒粉、味醂、果醋、檸檬汁、少許鹽和開水，拌至濃滑均勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Mix white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, black sesame oil, Sichuan pepper powder, mirin, fruit vinegar, lemon juice, a little salt, and boiling water until smooth, then chill the sauce.
instruction.id: Campurkan pasta wijen putih, selai kacang, kecap asin Jepang, minyak wijen hitam, bubuk lada Sichuan, mirin, cuka buah, air lemon, sedikit garam, dan air mendidih hingga lembut, lalu dinginkan sausnya.

instruction.zh: 滾水加少許鹽後放入義大利麵；這道冷麵將麵煮至全熟，約依包裝時間九分鐘，撈起放入冰水約一分鐘至冰涼後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water and cook the spaghetti fully for this cold noodle dish, about nine minutes according to the package; transfer it to ice water for about one minute until cold, then drain.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih lalu masak spageti hingga matang penuh untuk hidangan mi dingin ini, sekitar sembilan menit sesuai petunjuk kemasan; pindahkan ke air es sekitar satu menit hingga dingin, lalu tiriskan.

instruction.zh: 使用剛煮麵的熱水，將切細的紅蘿蔔汆燙約30秒，保留半生熟的爽脆口感後撈起。
instruction.en: Use the hot pasta water to blanch the finely cut carrot for about 30 seconds, then remove it while it remains pleasantly crisp-tender.

title.en: Blanch the silken tofu in salt water
title.id: Blansir tahu sutra dalam air garam

instruction.zh: 嫩豆腐先對半切開，放入加少許鹽的滾水煮約1分鐘，讓蛋白質凝結、後續裹粉時較不易破。
instruction.en: Cut the silken tofu in half and cook it in lightly salted boiling water for about 1 minute so its proteins set and it is less likely to break during coating.
instruction.id: Potong tahu sutra menjadi dua, lalu masak dalam air mendidih yang diberi sedikit garam sekitar 1 menit agar proteinnya mengeras dan tidak mudah hancur saat dilapisi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of silken tofu halves blanching gently in a pot of lightly salted boiling water, no text.

title.en: Marinate the tofu in soy sauce

instruction.zh: 將燙好的嫩豆腐撈起放入碗中，加入日式醬油後以輕搖方式讓醬油均勻包覆，稍微醃製。
instruction.en: Lift out the blanched tofu, place it in a bowl, add Japanese soy sauce, and gently shake the bowl to coat it evenly before a brief marinade.
instruction.id: Angkat tahu yang sudah diblansir, masukkan ke mangkuk, tambahkan kecap asin Jepang, lalu goyangkan mangkuk perlahan agar terlapisi rata sebelum dimarinasi sebentar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of tender tofu pieces gently coated in dark Japanese soy sauce in a shallow bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 將120克低筋麵粉與200克水拌至無顆粒，再加入1小匙鹽、少許黑胡椒粉和少許五香粉調味。
instruction.en: Whisk 120 g cake flour with 200 g water until lump-free, then season the batter with 1 teaspoon salt, a little black pepper, and a little five-spice powder.
instruction.id: Kocok 120 g tepung rendah protein dengan 200 g air hingga tidak bergerindil, lalu bumbui adonan dengan 1 sendok teh garam, sedikit lada hitam, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of smooth pale batter being whisked with pepper and five-spice beside a bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 嫩豆腐依序沾乾低筋麵粉、麵糊與麵包粉，完成乾粉、濕糊、麵包粉的三層外衣。
instruction.en: Coat each tofu piece in dry cake flour, then the batter, and finally breadcrumbs to form the three-layer crust of flour, wet batter, and crumbs.
instruction.id: Balut setiap potong tahu dengan tepung rendah protein kering, lalu adonan basah, dan terakhir tepung roti untuk membentuk tiga lapisan kulit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of tofu pieces being coated in flour, pale batter, and breadcrumbs in three separate bowls, no text.

instruction.zh: 裹好的豆腐分開下鍋，第一次炸至蛋黃色即可撈出，不要炸到深金黃，避免彼此黏住。
instruction.en: Lower the coated tofu into oil with space between pieces and fry only until pale egg-yellow on the first pass; do not fry it deep golden yet, and keep pieces from sticking.
instruction.id: Masukkan tahu berlapis ke minyak dengan jarak antarpotong, lalu goreng pertama hanya hingga kuning pucat; jangan sampai cokelat tua dan cegah potongan saling menempel.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of pale golden breaded tofu pieces frying separately in bubbling oil, no text.

instruction.zh: 第一輪全數炸完後將油溫升至約180°C，再次下鍋搶酥至金黃，瀝油後趁熱沾芥末椒鹽粉享用。
instruction.en: After every piece has been fried once, raise the oil to about 180°C and fry again until golden and crisp; drain well, then season with wasabi pepper salt while hot.
instruction.id: Setelah semua potong selesai digoreng pertama, naikkan suhu minyak hingga sekitar 180°C lalu goreng lagi sampai keemasan dan renyah; tiriskan baik-baik, kemudian bumbui garam lada wasabi saat masih panas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of crisp golden vegan fried silken tofu dusted with wasabi pepper salt, no text.

description.zh: 嫩豆腐、凍豆腐與豆乾以自製花椒油、辣豆瓣和香料燉煮，再分次勾芡，呈現麻香濃郁的全素麻婆豆腐。
description.en: Silken tofu, frozen tofu, and pressed tofu are simmered with homemade Sichuan pepper oil, chili bean paste, and spices, then thickened in stages for a fragrant vegan mapo tofu.
description.id: Tahu sutra, tahu beku, dan tahu padat direbus dengan minyak lada Sichuan buatan sendiri, pasta kacang cabai, serta rempah, lalu dikentalkan bertahap untuk mapo tofu vegan yang harum.

instruction.zh: 凍豆腐退冰洗淨後反覆擠水並剝小塊；嫩豆腐與豆乾切塊，薑和辣椒切末，青龍椒切細圈。
instruction.en: Thaw and rinse the frozen tofu, squeeze out water repeatedly, and tear it into small pieces. Cube the silken tofu and pressed tofu, mince ginger and chili, and slice the green chili into thin rings.
instruction.id: Cairkan dan bilas tahu beku, peras airnya berulang kali lalu sobek kecil. Potong tahu sutra dan tahu padat, cincang jahe serta cabai, lalu iris cabai hijau tipis-tipis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of three prepared tofu textures with minced ginger, chili, and sliced green pepper on a board, no text.

title.en: Blanch silken tofu in salt water
title.id: Blansir tahu sutra dalam air garam

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋加鹽的滾水，將嫩豆腐煮1分鐘後撈起，減少豆腥味並讓豆腐較不易燉碎。
instruction.en: Bring salted water to a boil and cook the silken tofu for 1 minute, then lift it out to reduce beaniness and help it hold together while braising.
instruction.id: Didihkan air bergaram dan masak tahu sutra selama 1 menit, lalu angkat untuk mengurangi aroma kacang serta membuatnya tidak mudah hancur saat direbus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of silken tofu cubes blanching gently in a pot of salted water, no text.

instruction.zh: 以小火用較平常多的香油煸花椒，聞到濃郁香氣後再煸1至2分鐘，濾出花椒並將花椒油留在鍋中；花椒切碎備用。
instruction.en: Over low heat, fry the Sichuan peppercorns in a little more sesame oil than usual. Once fragrant, continue 1 to 2 minutes, strain out the peppercorns while keeping the oil in the wok, and finely chop the peppercorns for later.
instruction.id: Dengan api kecil, tumis lada Sichuan dalam minyak wijen sedikit lebih banyak dari biasanya. Setelah harum, lanjutkan 1 hingga 2 menit, saring lada sambil menyisakan minyak di wajan, lalu cincang halus lada untuk nanti.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of Sichuan peppercorns infusing in golden sesame oil in a small wok, no text.

title.en: Brown tofu and fry the chili paste

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐與豆乾放入花椒油煸至金黃酥脆，加入薑末和辣椒末炒香；加入辣豆瓣醬、辣椒粉、花椒粉、胡椒粉與醬油炒出醬香。
instruction.en: Brown frozen tofu and pressed tofu in the Sichuan pepper oil until golden and crisp, then sauté ginger and chili. Add chili bean paste, chili powder, Sichuan pepper powder, pepper, and soy sauce, frying until the sauce smells fragrant.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu beku dan tahu padat dalam minyak lada Sichuan hingga keemasan serta renyah, lalu tumis jahe dan cabai. Tambahkan pasta kacang cabai, bubuk cabai, bubuk lada Sichuan, merica, dan kecap asin hingga saus harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden tofu pieces and red chili bean paste sizzling in a wok with aromatic spices, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入300克水與糖，以中火熬煮約5分鐘；放入燙好的嫩豆腐和一半花椒碎，中火燉煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Add 300 g water and sugar, then simmer over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the blanched silken tofu and half the chopped Sichuan peppercorns, then braise over medium heat for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 300 g air dan gula, lalu rebus api sedang sekitar 5 menit. Masukkan tahu sutra yang sudah diblansir dan setengah lada Sichuan cincang, lalu masak api sedang selama 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of silken tofu cubes simmering in a deep red mapo sauce with golden tofu pieces, no text.

instruction.zh: 蓮藕粉與3大匙水調成勾芡水，分3次倒入，每次推勻後再加下一次；最後從鍋邊淋白醋，盛盤後放青龍椒圈與剩餘花椒碎。
instruction.en: Mix lotus root starch with 3 tablespoons water. Add the slurry in 3 additions, stirring smooth before each next addition; drizzle white vinegar around the pan edge, then top with green chili rings and remaining chopped Sichuan peppercorns.
instruction.id: Campur pati akar teratai dengan 3 sendok makan air. Tambahkan larutan pengental dalam 3 tahap sambil mengaduk rata sebelum tahap berikutnya; tuang cuka putih di tepi wajan, lalu taburi cabai hijau dan sisa lada Sichuan cincang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of glossy vegan mapo tofu topped with green chili rings and crushed Sichuan peppercorns, no text.

title.id: Jamur Surai Singa Tiga Cangkir Vegan

description.zh: 猴頭菇先煸至金黃，再以黑麻油、薑、醬油和素蠔油燒煮吸飽醬汁，最後以九層塔提香的全素三杯料理。
description.en: Lion’s mane mushrooms are browned first, then braised in black sesame oil, ginger, soy sauce, and vegan oyster sauce until juicy, with Thai basil added for a vegan three-cup dish.
description.id: Jamur surai singa ditumis hingga keemasan, lalu dibraise dalam minyak wijen hitam, jahe, kecap asin, dan saus tiram vegan hingga berair, dengan kemangi Thailand sebagai penutup.

instruction.zh: 猴頭菇退冰後剝成小塊；老薑與大辣椒切片，九層塔去梗備用。
instruction.en: Thaw the lion’s mane mushrooms and tear them into small pieces. Slice the mature ginger and large chili, then remove the Thai basil stems.
instruction.id: Cairkan jamur surai singa lalu sobek kecil-kecil. Iris jahe tua dan cabai besar, kemudian petiki daun kemangi Thailand dari batangnya.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. title.id: Tumis jamur surai singa hingga keemasan

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入植物油，將猴頭菇煸至金黃後先取出；這一步讓菇體後續更能吸收醬汁。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok and brown the lion’s mane mushrooms until golden, then set them aside; this helps the mushrooms absorb more sauce later.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan dan tumis jamur surai singa hingga keemasan, lalu sisihkan; langkah ini membantu jamur menyerap lebih banyak saus nantinya.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. title.en: Fragrance the ginger in black sesame oil
title.id: Tumis jahe dengan minyak wijen hitam

instruction.zh: 原鍋倒入黑麻油，以小火慢慢爆香薑片，避免麻油過熱發苦；薑片捲曲後加入煸好的猴頭菇稍微拌炒。
instruction.en: Pour black sesame oil into the same wok and gently fry the ginger over low heat so the oil does not turn bitter. When the ginger curls, return the browned lion’s mane mushrooms and toss briefly.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen hitam ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe perlahan dengan api kecil agar minyak tidak pahit. Saat jahe melengkung, masukkan kembali jamur surai singa yang sudah ditumis lalu aduk sebentar.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no chili, basil, sauce, finished plating, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Add the three-cup sauce and braise
title.id: Tambahkan saus tiga cangkir lalu braise

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、素蠔油、胡椒粉和糖炒香，再倒入約250毫升水，以中火燒煮，讓猴頭菇吸飽湯汁。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, ground pepper, and sugar and cook until fragrant, then pour in about 250 ml water and braise over medium heat so the mushrooms absorb the sauce.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus tiram vegan, merica bubuk, dan gula lalu masak hingga harum; tuang sekitar 250 ml air dan braise dengan api sedang agar jamur menyerap saus.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. title.en: Reduce the sauce and fold in basil

instruction.zh: 水量可略蓋過猴頭菇，先以大火收汁；醬汁濃稠時轉小火拌入大部分九層塔，最後再放剩餘九層塔和辣椒片，保留香氣。
instruction.en: The water may nearly cover the mushrooms; first reduce it over high heat. Once the sauce thickens, switch to low heat and fold in most of the Thai basil, then add the remaining basil and chili slices at the end to preserve their aroma.
instruction.id: Air boleh hampir menutupi jamur; mula-mula susutkan dengan api besar. Saat saus mengental, kecilkan api dan aduk sebagian besar kemangi Thailand, lalu tambahkan sisa kemangi serta irisan cabai di akhir agar aromanya tetap segar.

description.zh: 以豆製品、菇類、青江菜與隔夜飯炒成的快速全素上海菜飯。
description.en: Quick vegan Shanghai-style vegetable rice with tofu products, mushrooms, bok choy, and day-old rice.
description.id: Nasi sayur gaya Shanghai vegan yang cepat dibuat dengan produk tahu, jamur, pakcoy, dan nasi semalam.

instruction.zh: 將豆乾、豆包、紅蘿蔔、杏鮑菇與金針菇切丁；青江菜加鹽抓出水分後擠乾。
instruction.en: Dice tofu, tofu skin, carrot, king oyster mushroom, and enoki; salt bok choy, then squeeze it dry.
instruction.id: Potong dadu tahu, kulit tahu, wortel, jamur tiram raja, dan enoki; garami pakcoy lalu peras hingga kering.

instruction.en: Sear tofu and tofu skin in sesame oil until golden and dry, then stir-fry mushrooms, carrot, and squeezed bok choy.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu dan kulit tahu dengan minyak wijen hingga keemasan dan kering, lalu tambahkan jamur, wortel, dan pakcoy peras.

instruction.en: Add soy sauce, pepper, bok choy juice, and water; toss in day-old rice and stir-fry until dry, then serve in a heated clay pot if desired.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, lada, jus pakcoy, dan air; masukkan nasi semalam dan tumis hingga kering, lalu sajikan dalam panci tanah liat panas bila diinginkan.

description.zh: 中筋麵粉以一比二水量調成麵糊，拌入泡菜與多種蔬菜，煎至兩面金黃、邊緣酥脆的純素韓式煎餅。
description.en: All-purpose flour and water at a one-to-two ratio form the batter for kimchi and vegetables, pan-fried until golden with crisp edges in this vegan Korean pancake.
description.id: Tepung serbaguna dan air dengan rasio satu banding dua menjadi adonan untuk kimchi serta sayuran, lalu digoreng hingga keemasan dan bertepi renyah sebagai pajeon vegan.

instruction.zh: 將鮮香菇、紅蘿蔔、小黃瓜和甜椒切成絲；節瓜切片，辣椒切片備用。
instruction.en: Julienne the fresh shiitake, carrot, cucumber, and bell pepper; slice the zucchini and chili for arranging later.
instruction.id: Iris memanjang shiitake segar, wortel, mentimun, dan paprika; iris zucchini serta cabai untuk ditata kemudian.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of julienned vegetables, sliced zucchini, chili, and fresh shiitake arranged on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 將100克中筋麵粉與200克水攪拌至沒有顆粒，形成有彈性且適合煎餅的麵糊。
instruction.en: Whisk 100 g all-purpose flour with 200 g water until no lumps remain, making an elastic batter suited for Korean pancakes.
instruction.id: Kocok 100 g tepung serbaguna dengan 200 g air hingga tidak ada gumpalan, menghasilkan adonan elastis untuk pajeon Korea.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of smooth pale pancake batter being whisked in a ceramic bowl, no text.

title.en: Fold kimchi and vegetables into batter
title.id: Aduk kimchi dan sayuran ke adonan

instruction.zh: 將泡菜、紅蘿蔔、小黃瓜和甜椒絲拌入麵糊，使配料均勻分布。
instruction.en: Fold kimchi, carrot, cucumber, and bell-pepper strips into the batter so the ingredients are evenly distributed.
instruction.id: Aduk kimchi, wortel, mentimun, dan irisan paprika ke dalam adonan agar bahan tersebar merata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of kimchi and colorful vegetable strips being folded through pancake batter, no text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入適量香油，舀兩大匙蔬菜麵糊攤平；趁麵糊未凝固時，在表面擺上節瓜、辣椒和香菇。
instruction.en: Pour sesame oil into a flat pan and spread two tablespoons of vegetable batter thinly. Before it sets, arrange zucchini, chili, and mushrooms across the surface.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen ke wajan datar lalu ratakan dua sendok makan adonan sayuran. Sebelum mengeras, susun zucchini, cabai, dan jamur di permukaannya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of a Korean vegetable pancake with zucchini, chili, and mushrooms arranged on the uncooked batter in a skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 待底部定型後先掀起小角確認上色再翻面，將兩面煎至金黃，讓邊緣呈現酥脆焦香即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Once the bottom sets, lift a small corner to check the color before flipping. Cook both sides until golden with crisp, lightly browned edges, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah bagian bawah mengeras, angkat sedikit sudut untuk memeriksa warna sebelum dibalik. Masak kedua sisi hingga keemasan dengan tepi yang renyah dan kecokelatan, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of a golden vegan Korean vegetable pancake with crisp browned edges, sliced into wedges, no text.

description.zh: 高麗菜、香菇、豆乾、豆包和冬粉炒香後調味成餡，一半拌入剝皮辣椒，包成原味與微辣兩種純素水餃。
description.en: Cabbage, mushrooms, pressed tofu, tofu puffs, and vermicelli are sautéed and seasoned for a filling; half is mixed with peeled chili for two vegan dumpling flavors.
description.id: Kol, jamur, tahu padat, tahu puff, dan soun ditumis serta dibumbui sebagai isian; separuh isian dicampur cabai kupas untuk dua rasa pangsit vegan.

instruction.zh: 泡軟冬粉切成細短段；香菇、豆乾和豆包切小丁，薑切末，剝皮辣椒切末。
instruction.en: Cut soaked vermicelli into fine short lengths; dice the mushrooms, pressed tofu, and tofu puffs, mince the ginger, and finely chop the peeled chili peppers.
instruction.id: Potong soun yang sudah direndam menjadi pendek dan halus; dadu jamur, tahu padat, serta tahu puff, cincang jahe, dan cincang halus cabai kupas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of finely chopped vermicelli, mushrooms, tofu puffs, pressed tofu, ginger, and peeled chili on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 高麗菜切細後加鹽抓醃，靜置出水後擠乾，讓餡料不會過濕。
instruction.en: Finely chop the cabbage, massage it with salt, let it release water, then squeeze it dry so the filling will not become wet.
instruction.id: Cincang halus kol, remas dengan garam, diamkan hingga mengeluarkan air, lalu peras kering agar isian tidak basah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of shredded cabbage being squeezed dry by hand over a bowl, no text.

title.id: Tumis tahu dan jamur hingga harum

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放油，先將豆乾與豆包煎至金黃，再加入薑末與香菇炒香，淋少量醬油拌炒後盛入大碗。
instruction.en: Heat oil in a wok, brown the pressed tofu and tofu puffs, then sauté ginger and mushrooms. Add a little soy sauce, toss until fragrant, and transfer to a large bowl.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dalam wajan, tumis tahu padat dan tahu puff hingga keemasan, lalu tumis jahe serta jamur. Tambahkan sedikit kecap asin, aduk hingga harum, lalu pindahkan ke mangkuk besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden diced tofu puffs, pressed tofu, mushrooms, and ginger sautéing in a wok, no text.

title.en: Mix plain and chili dumpling fillings

instruction.zh: 將擠乾高麗菜與冬粉加入炒料，拌入香油、醬油、糖、鹽和胡椒粉。取一半餡料加入剝皮辣椒末，另一半保留原味。
instruction.en: Add squeezed cabbage and vermicelli to the sautéed filling, then mix in sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper. Mix chopped peeled chili into half of the filling and keep the other half plain.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kol peras dan soun ke isian tumis, lalu campur minyak wijen, kecap asin, gula, garam, serta merica. Campurkan cabai kupas cincang ke separuh isian dan sisakan separuh lainnya polos.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of two bowls of vegan dumpling filling, one plain and one mixed with chopped peeled chili, no text.

instruction.zh: 水餃皮外圈沾水，放入適量餡料後對折，再沿邊緣以打褶方式壓緊封口，避免餡料外漏。
instruction.en: Wet the edge of a wrapper, add a suitable amount of filling, fold it in half, then pleat and firmly seal the edge to prevent filling from escaping.
instruction.id: Basahi tepi kulit pangsit, isi secukupnya, lipat menjadi dua, lalu lipat-lipat dan tekan rapat pinggirannya agar isian tidak keluar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands pleating a vegan dumpling with a cabbage and tofu filling, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中水滾後放入包好的水餃，煮約5至8分鐘至餃皮熟透、餡料熱透，即可撈起享用。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the wrapped dumplings, and cook for about 5 to 8 minutes until the wrappers and filling are fully cooked, then serve.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dalam panci, masukkan pangsit yang sudah dibungkus, lalu masak sekitar 5 hingga 8 menit sampai kulit dan isi matang sepenuhnya, kemudian sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of boiled vegan dumplings, including plain cabbage and peeled-chili versions, in a ceramic bowl, no text.

description.zh:
大家對於＃台灣小吃第一個會想到什麼呢？
老實說比起滷肉飯 我更喜歡＃米糕
就是有一種說不上來的純樸感
並且充滿著濃濃家鄉味
也有可能因為老家在高雄
就會有小時候的記憶
覺得米糕才有台灣味！！
這次使用＃真老白麻油一起入菜
清香撲鼻
趕快跟著影片一起做吧！
description.en: Compared with braised pork rice, the creator prefers sticky rice for its simple, nostalgic Taiwanese character. This version cooks with white sesame oil for a light fragrance.
description.id: Dibanding nasi babi kecap, pembuat resep lebih menyukai ketan karena kesan Taiwan yang sederhana dan nostalgik. Versi ini dimasak dengan minyak wijen putih untuk aroma yang ringan.

name.id: beras ketan panjang yang telah direndam
jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam

instruction.zh: 香菇切絲；豆乾、金針菇與芋頭切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the shiitake; cut the firm tofu, enoki mushrooms, and taro into small pieces.
instruction.id: Iris shiitake; potong tahu padat, enoki, dan talas menjadi bagian kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放適量白麻油，放入芋頭和豆乾煸至金黃；加入金針菇、香菇和菜脯炒香。
instruction.en: Heat an appropriate amount of white sesame oil in a wok. Brown the taro and firm tofu, then add enoki, shiitake, and preserved radish and sauté until fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen putih secukupnya dalam wajan. Masak talas dan tahu padat hingga keemasan, lalu tambahkan enoki, shiitake, dan lobak asin hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Sauté the fillings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、素蠔油、糖、胡椒粉、五香粉與白麻油炒香。倒入水和香菇水，蓋鍋煮約 10 分鐘。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, vegetarian oyster sauce, sugar, ground pepper, five-spice powder, and white sesame oil, then stir-fry until fragrant. Add the water and mushroom-soaking liquid, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus tir vegetarian, gula, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, dan minyak wijen putih, lalu tumis hingga harum. Tambahkan air dan air rendaman jamur, tutup, dan masak sekitar 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season and simmer”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 來源最後建議淋上甜辣醬，放上素鬆、香菜和醃製小黃瓜後享用。
instruction.en: The source finishes by drizzling sweet chili sauce and adding vegan meat floss, cilantro, and pickled cucumber.
instruction.id: Sumber menyelesaikan hidangan dengan saus cabai manis, abon vegan, ketumbar daun, dan mentimun acar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with toppings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 三道可冷藏備用的全素涼拌菜：橄欖油素蠔油芥蘭、日式醬油蘋果醋大頭菜，及薑香雲耳。
description.en: Three make-ahead vegan cold dishes: Chinese kale with olive oil and vegetarian oyster sauce, kohlrabi with Japanese soy sauce and apple vinegar, and ginger cloud ear mushrooms.
description.id: Tiga hidangan dingin vegan yang dapat disiapkan sebelumnya: kailan dengan minyak zaitun serta saus tiram vegetarian, kohlrabi dengan kecap asin Jepang dan cuka apel, serta jamur kuping awan beraroma jahe.

instruction.zh: 芥蘭洗淨，粗梗可削去外皮。滾水加少許鹽，放入芥蘭煮滾後約30秒取出，切段。與橄欖油和素蠔油拌勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Wash Chinese kale and peel tough stems if desired. Add a little salt to boiling water, cook the kale for about 30 seconds after it returns to a boil, then cut into sections. Toss with olive oil and vegetarian oyster sauce, then chill.
instruction.id: Cuci kailan dan kupas batang keras bila diinginkan. Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, masak kailan sekitar 30 detik setelah mendidih kembali, lalu potong. Aduk dengan minyak zaitun dan saus tiram vegetarian, kemudian dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make Chinese kale salad”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 大頭菜洗淨後深削去較粗纖維的外皮，先切薄片再切絲。加鹽抓醃20分鐘至出水，倒掉水分。
instruction.en: Wash kohlrabi and peel deeply to remove coarse outer fibers, then slice thinly and cut into shreds. Toss with salt for 20 minutes until it releases water, then drain.
instruction.id: Cuci kohlrabi dan kupas dalam untuk menghilangkan serat luar yang kasar, lalu iris tipis dan potong serut. Aduk dengan garam selama 20 menit hingga mengeluarkan air, lalu tiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare kohlrabi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香菜切末、辣椒切斜段，與日式醬油、香油、蘋果醋和味醂加入大頭菜拌勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Chop cilantro, slice chili diagonally, and toss with kohlrabi, Japanese soy sauce, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, and mirin; chill.
instruction.id: Cincang daun ketumbar, iris cabai serong, lalu aduk dengan kohlrabi, kecap asin Jepang, minyak wijen, cuka apel, dan mirin; dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Dress the kohlrabi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 雲耳放入滾水，煮滾後再煮1分鐘。
instruction.en: Place cloud ear mushrooms in boiling water; once it returns to a boil, cook 1 more minute.
instruction.id: Masukkan jamur kuping awan ke air mendidih; setelah mendidih kembali, masak 1 menit lagi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch cloud ear mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香油、味醂、日式醬油、白醋和白芝麻加入保鮮盒；放入薑絲與雲耳拌勻後冷藏。白醋可依個人口味調整。
instruction.en: Put sesame oil, mirin, Japanese soy sauce, white vinegar, and white sesame in a storage container. Add ginger shreds and cloud ear mushrooms, toss, and chill. Adjust white vinegar to taste.
instruction.id: Masukkan minyak wijen, mirin, kecap asin Jepang, cuka putih, dan wijen putih ke wadah. Tambahkan serutan jahe serta jamur kuping awan, aduk, lalu dinginkan. Sesuaikan cuka putih menurut selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Dress and chill cloud ears”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Vegan Hong Kong-Style Stir-Fried Rice Noodles
title.id: Kwetiau Goreng Gaya Hong Kong Vegan

description.zh: 板條先煎上色，豆包泥替代雞蛋、麵腸煎脆，再與芥蘭、豆芽及沙茶醬汁拌炒完成的全素港式炒河粉。
description.en: Flat rice noodles are seared, tofu-skin mince replaces egg, and crisp wheat gluten joins Chinese kale, bean sprouts, and satay sauce in this vegan Hong Kong-style stir-fry.
description.id: Kwetiau ditumis, cincangan kulit tahu menggantikan telur, dan gluten gandum renyah dipadukan dengan kailan, tauge, serta saus sate dalam tumisan gaya Hong Kong vegan.

instruction.zh: 麵腸切斜片，芥蘭斜切段，老薑與紅蘿蔔切絲，辣椒切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the wheat gluten rolls on a diagonal, cut Chinese kale into diagonal segments, julienne the ginger and carrot, and cut the chili into short pieces.
instruction.id: Iris gulungan gluten gandum secara serong, potong kailan serong, iris jahe serta wortel memanjang, dan potong cabai pendek-pendek.

title.en: Sear and season the rice noodles

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量香油，放入板條煎至微黃，再加入部分醬油拌炒至均勻上色後盛出備用。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok, sear the flat rice noodles until lightly yellowed, then add part of the soy sauce and toss until evenly colored before setting aside.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan, tumis kwetiau hingga agak kekuningan, lalu tambahkan sebagian kecap asin dan aduk sampai warnanya merata sebelum disisihkan.

title.en: Crisp the tofu-skin mince and wheat gluten
title.id: Renyahkan cincangan kulit tahu dan gluten

instruction.zh: 將豆包泥煸炒至焦脆後取出；麵腸放入鍋中以小火慢慢煎至焦脆，盡量少翻動後取出。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the tofu-skin mince until crisp and set it aside. Cook the wheat gluten over low heat until crisp, turning it as little as possible, then remove.
instruction.id: Tumis cincangan kulit tahu hingga renyah lalu sisihkan. Masak gluten gandum dengan api kecil hingga renyah, sesedikit mungkin membaliknya, lalu angkat.

instruction.zh: 鍋中炒香薑絲和紅蘿蔔，加入煎好的麵腸、醬油、醬油膏、糖、沙茶醬、烏醋和胡椒粉，倒入約200毫升水煮滾。
instruction.en: Sauté ginger and carrot until fragrant, then add the crisp wheat gluten, soy sauce, soy paste, sugar, satay sauce, black vinegar, and pepper. Pour in about 200 ml water and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan wortel hingga harum, lalu tambahkan gluten gandum renyah, kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, saus sate, cuka hitam, dan merica. Tuang sekitar 200 ml air lalu didihkan.

instruction.zh: 醬汁煮滾後加入芥蘭炒勻，再放回板條、豆芽和豆包泥快速拌炒，讓河粉均勻吸附醬汁後起鍋。
instruction.en: Once the sauce boils, add Chinese kale and toss, then return the rice noodles and add bean sprouts plus tofu-skin mince. Stir-fry quickly until the noodles are evenly coated, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah saus mendidih, masukkan kailan dan aduk, lalu kembalikan kwetiau serta tambahkan tauge dan cincangan kulit tahu. Tumis cepat hingga kwetiau terlapisi saus merata, lalu sajikan.

description.zh: 大白菜取代洋蔥甜味、千張製造蛋花般滑順口感，搭配煎豆腐與蔬菜燴料淋在白飯上的全素日式丼飯。
description.en: Chinese cabbage provides onion-like sweetness while tofu skin creates an egg-drop texture in this vegan Japanese rice bowl with pan-fried tofu and vegetables.
description.id: Sawi putih memberi rasa manis seperti bawang, sementara kulit tahu menciptakan tekstur telur orak-arik dalam donburi vegan dengan tahu goreng dan sayuran.

instruction.zh: 千張與板豆腐切片；薑和大白菜切絲，茄子與秋葵切小段，鴻禧菇去蒂後撥小朵。
instruction.en: Slice tofu skin and firm tofu. Julienne ginger and Napa cabbage, cut eggplant and okra into small pieces, and remove the shimeji bases before separating the clusters.
instruction.id: Iris kulit tahu dan tahu padat. Iris memanjang jahe serta sawi putih, potong terong dan okra kecil-kecil, lalu buang pangkal shimeji dan pisahkan gerombolannya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced tofu skin, firm tofu, Napa cabbage, eggplant, okra, and shimeji arranged on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量香油，將板豆腐兩面煎至金黃後取出備用。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok and pan-fry the firm tofu until both sides are golden, then set it aside.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan dan goreng tahu padat hingga kedua sisi keemasan, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden firm tofu slices searing in a wok with a crisp browned surface, no text.

instruction.zh: 原鍋煸香薑絲，先加入大白菜梗炒至半透明，利用其甜味取代洋蔥；再放茄子與鴻禧菇以大火快炒。
instruction.en: In the same wok, sauté ginger, then cook the Napa cabbage stems until partly translucent to replace onion sweetness. Add eggplant and shimeji mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis jahe, lalu masak batang sawi putih hingga agak transparan untuk menggantikan rasa manis bawang. Tambahkan terong dan jamur shimeji, lalu tumis dengan api besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of Napa cabbage stems, eggplant, and shimeji mushrooms stir-frying with julienned ginger in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入日式醬油、味醂、糖、胡椒粉、七味粉和足量水，水量約蓋過食材；放入秋葵與白菜葉，蓋鍋以小火熬煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Add Japanese soy sauce, mirin, sugar, pepper, seven-spice chili powder, and enough water to nearly cover the ingredients. Add okra and cabbage leaves, cover, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin Jepang, mirin, gula, merica, bubuk shichimi, dan air hingga hampir menutupi bahan. Masukkan okra serta daun sawi, tutup, lalu rebus api kecil selama 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan Japanese donburi vegetables and tofu simmering in a light brown broth with bright green okra, no text.

title.en: Fold in tofu skin for egg-drop texture
title.id: Masukkan kulit tahu untuk tekstur telur

instruction.zh: 試味後依個人口味補少許鹽，將千張撕成小片放入鍋中輕拌，讓它形成蛋花般滑順口感後關火。
instruction.en: Taste and add a little salt if needed. Tear tofu skin into small pieces, fold it gently into the pot to create an egg-drop-like silky texture, then turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Cicipi lalu tambahkan sedikit garam bila perlu. Sobek kulit tahu kecil-kecil, aduk perlahan ke dalam panci hingga membentuk tekstur lembut seperti telur orak-arik, lalu matikan api.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of torn tofu skin ribbons folded through a silky vegan Japanese vegetable broth, no text.

title.en: Assemble and garnish the rice bowls

instruction.zh: 兩碗白飯分別盛入碗中，淋上日式豆腐燴料與湯汁，放上煎豆腐，最後以海苔絲和白芝麻點綴。
instruction.en: Divide cooked white rice between two bowls, spoon over the tofu and vegetable stew with its broth, add the pan-fried tofu, then garnish with shredded nori and white sesame.
instruction.id: Bagi nasi putih matang ke dua mangkuk, sendokkan rebusan tahu serta sayuran bersama kuahnya, tambahkan tahu goreng, lalu hias dengan nori iris dan wijen putih.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of a vegan Japanese tofu rice bowl topped with tofu, vegetables, shredded nori, and white sesame, no text.

description.zh: 以茄子模擬肥肉滑潤、煸脆豆乾模擬瘦肉，和青江菜包入千張，氣炸成薄脆的全素鮮肉餛飩。
description.en: Eggplant supplies a rich fatty texture while crisp pressed tofu mimics lean meat; both are wrapped with bok choy in tofu skin and air-fried into crunchy vegan wontons.
description.id: Terong memberi tekstur lembut seperti lemak, sedangkan tahu padat renyah meniru daging tanpa lemak; keduanya dibungkus dengan pakcoy dalam kulit tahu dan dimasak air fryer menjadi pangsit vegan renyah.

title.en: Chop ingredients and salt the bok choy

instruction.zh: 千張與青江菜洗淨後切小段，青江菜加鹽抓醃至出水；薑切末，茄子和豆乾切小丁。
instruction.en: Wash and cut the tofu skin and bok choy into small pieces, then massage the bok choy with salt until it releases water. Mince the ginger and dice the eggplant and pressed tofu.
instruction.id: Cuci lalu potong kulit tahu dan pakcoy kecil-kecil, kemudian remas pakcoy dengan garam hingga mengeluarkan air. Cincang jahe dan potong dadu terong serta tahu padat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of chopped bok choy, diced eggplant, pressed tofu, ginger, and tofu skin sheets on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 將30克麵粉與20克水攪拌成濃稠麵粉糊，放在一旁作為封口黏著劑。
instruction.en: Stir 30 g flour with 20 g water into a thick paste and set it aside as the wrapper-sealing adhesive.
instruction.id: Aduk 30 g tepung dengan 20 g air hingga menjadi pasta kental, lalu sisihkan sebagai perekat penutup kulit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of thick flour paste being stirred in a small bowl beside tofu skin wrappers, no text.

title.en: Crisp the tofu and season the eggplant

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加少量油，將豆乾煸至金黃酥脆；加入薑末和茄子炒香，再放醬油、胡椒粉與少許五香粉，補少量水燒至收乾後放涼。
instruction.en: Heat a little oil in a wok and brown the pressed tofu until crisp. Add minced ginger and eggplant, then season with soy sauce, pepper, and a little five-spice; add a small amount of water and cook until dry, then cool.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak dalam wajan dan tumis tahu padat hingga keemasan serta renyah. Tambahkan jahe cincang dan terong, lalu bumbui kecap asin, merica, serta sedikit bubuk lima rempah; tambahkan sedikit air dan masak hingga kering, lalu dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of diced eggplant and crisp pressed tofu cooking in a savory brown sauce in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 將出水青江菜擠乾，與放涼的茄子豆乾餡拌勻；豆乾提供瘦肉般嚼感，茄子提供滑潤口感。
instruction.en: Squeeze the water from the bok choy and mix it with the cooled eggplant-tofu filling. The crisp tofu adds a lean-meat chew while eggplant provides a rich silky texture.
instruction.id: Peras air dari pakcoy lalu campurkan dengan isian terong dan tahu yang sudah dingin. Tahu renyah memberi gigitan seperti daging tanpa lemak, sedangkan terong memberi tekstur lembut kaya rasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a mixed vegan wonton filling with bok choy, diced eggplant, and crisp pressed tofu in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Fill and seal the tofu-skin wontons
title.id: Isi dan tutup pangsit kulit tahu

instruction.zh: 取一張千張，周圍抹麵粉糊，放入適量餡料後折起封緊；若使用大張千張，可先剪成正方形。
instruction.en: Take one tofu skin sheet, brush flour paste around the edge, add a suitable amount of filling, and fold tightly to seal. Cut larger tofu skin sheets into squares first if needed.
instruction.id: Ambil satu lembar kulit tahu, olesi tepinya dengan pasta tepung, isi secukupnya, lalu lipat dan rekatkan rapat. Jika menggunakan lembar besar, potong menjadi persegi terlebih dahulu bila perlu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands folding a tofu skin wonton around a vegetable and tofu filling, no text.

title.id: Masak air fryer hingga renyah keemasan

instruction.zh: 氣炸鍋底部薄抹植物油，放入餛飩以160°C氣炸8分鐘；小心翻面後再以160°C氣炸5分鐘，至外皮金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Lightly oil the air-fryer basket, add the wontons, and air-fry at 160°C for 8 minutes. Turn them carefully, then air-fry at 160°C for 5 more minutes until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Olesi tipis keranjang air fryer dengan minyak sayur, masukkan pangsit, lalu masak pada 160°C selama 8 menit. Balik dengan hati-hati dan masak lagi pada 160°C selama 5 menit hingga keemasan serta renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of crisp golden vegan tofu-skin wontons with a thin crunchy wrapper on a ceramic plate, no text.

description.zh: 以氣炸定型的杏鮑菇搭配酸菜、薑絲與酸香醬汁的全素客家菜。
description.en: A vegan Hakka dish of air-fried king oyster mushrooms with pickled mustard greens, ginger, and tangy sauce.
description.id: Hidangan Hakka vegan dari jamur tiram raja air fryer, sawi asin, jahe, dan saus asam.

instruction.zh: 杏鮑菇切 0.3–0.5 公分薄片，加鹽與味醂抓醃；電鍋外鍋加一杯水蒸熟，保留菇汁並放涼捲起。
instruction.en: Slice mushrooms 0.3–0.5 cm thick, season with salt and mirin, steam with one cup water, reserve the juices, cool, and roll.
instruction.id: Iris jamur setebal 0,3–0,5 cm, bumbui garam dan mirin, kukus dengan satu cangkir air, simpan sarinya, dinginkan, lalu gulung.

instruction.en: Mist mushroom rolls with a little oil and air-fry at 160°C for eight minutes, then cool.
instruction.id: Semprot gulungan jamur dengan sedikit minyak dan masak dalam air fryer 160°C selama delapan menit, lalu dinginkan.

instruction.en: Stir-fry ginger and pickled greens in sesame oil; add bean paste, mushroom juices, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Add rolls and chili, stir-fry over high heat, then thicken and serve.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan sawi asin dengan minyak wijen; tambahkan pasta kacang, sari jamur, cuka, gula, dan garam. Masukkan gulungan dan cabai, tumis api besar, lalu kentalkan dan sajikan.

description.zh: 茄子以覆蓋水與少量油加蓋燜熟保留紫色，再與煸脆素雞、辣豆瓣醬和四季豆快速拌炒，做成少油的素食魚香茄子。
description.en: Eggplant is covered with water and a little oil, then steamed in a covered wok to preserve its purple color before a quick stir-fry with crisp vegetarian chicken, chili bean paste, and green beans creates a lighter vegan fish-fragrant dish.
description.id: Terong dikukus tertutup dengan air dan sedikit minyak untuk menjaga warna ungunya, lalu ditumis cepat bersama ayam vegetarian renyah, pasta kacang cabai, dan buncis menjadi hidangan yu xiang vegan yang lebih ringan.

instruction.zh: 茄子切約5公分段再對半切；素雞與香菇切小丁，薑切末，大辣椒切斜片，四季豆去梗洗淨。
instruction.en: Cut eggplant into roughly 5 cm pieces and halve them. Dice vegetarian chicken and shiitake, mince ginger, slice the chili on a diagonal, and trim the green beans.
instruction.id: Potong terong sekitar 5 cm lalu belah dua. Potong dadu ayam vegetarian dan shiitake, cincang jahe, iris cabai serong, lalu buang ujung buncis.

instruction.en: Stir potato starch with 4 tablespoons water until smooth to make a slurry, then set it aside.
instruction.id: Aduk pati kentang dengan 4 sendok makan air hingga rata untuk membuat larutan pengental, lalu sisihkan.

title.en: Steam eggplant to preserve its color
title.id: Kukus terong agar warnanya tetap ungu

instruction.zh: 炒鍋中讓茄子外皮朝下，倒入剛蓋過茄子的水與少量植物油，蓋上鍋蓋燜煮5分鐘；關火後立刻取出並倒掉水分。
instruction.en: Place eggplant skin-side down in a wok, add water just to cover it and a little vegetable oil, cover, and steam 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, remove it immediately, and pour off the water.
instruction.id: Letakkan terong dengan kulit menghadap bawah di wajan, tambahkan air hingga terendam dan sedikit minyak sayur, tutup, lalu kukus 5 menit. Matikan api, segera angkat terong, dan buang airnya.

title.en: Crisp vegetarian chicken and fry the sauce
title.id: Renyahkan ayam vegetarian dan tumis saus

instruction.zh: 原鍋開小火倒入香油，將薑末與素雞煸至帶焦脆，再加入香菇炒香；放辣豆瓣醬、醬油、胡椒粉、糖、白醋與花椒粉炒出香氣。
instruction.en: Over low heat in the same wok, add sesame oil and crisp the ginger plus vegetarian chicken, then sauté shiitake. Add chili bean paste, soy sauce, pepper, sugar, white vinegar, and Sichuan pepper powder and fry until aromatic.
instruction.id: Dengan api kecil di wajan yang sama, tambahkan minyak wijen lalu renyahkan jahe dan ayam vegetarian, kemudian tumis shiitake. Masukkan pasta kacang cabai, kecap asin, merica, gula, cuka putih, dan bubuk lada Sichuan hingga harum.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no eggplant, green beans, fresh chili, starch slurry, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 倒入100克水煮滾後轉大火，放回茄子、辣椒和四季豆快速拌炒；倒入勾芡水炒至醬汁附著即刻起鍋，避免久炒令茄子出油。
instruction.en: Pour in 100 g water and bring to a boil, then turn to high heat and quickly toss in eggplant, chili, and green beans. Add the slurry and cook only until the sauce clings, serving immediately to avoid the eggplant releasing oil.
instruction.id: Tuang 100 g air lalu didihkan, kemudian gunakan api besar dan aduk cepat terong, cabai, serta buncis. Tambahkan larutan pengental dan masak hanya sampai saus melekat, lalu segera sajikan agar terong tidak mengeluarkan minyak.

description.zh: 豆乾與豆包煸至金黃焦脆，杏鮑菇保留粗條咬感，再以素蠔油和沙茶醬收汁的全素客家小炒。
description.en: Pressed tofu and tofu puffs are browned until crisp, king oyster mushrooms stay thick for chew, and vegan oyster sauce with satay sauce creates this vegan Hakka stir-fry.
description.id: Tahu padat dan tahu puff ditumis hingga renyah, jamur king oyster dipotong tebal agar kenyal, lalu saus tiram vegan dan saus sate membentuk tumis Hakka vegan.

instruction.zh: 豆乾切片、豆包切段；杏鮑菇與芹菜切長條，其中杏鮑菇保留約8毫米粗度；香菇與薑切絲，辣椒切斜片。
instruction.en: Slice the pressed tofu and cut tofu puffs into sections. Cut king oyster mushrooms and celery into long strips, keeping mushrooms about 8 mm thick; julienne shiitake and ginger, and slice chili diagonally.
instruction.id: Iris tahu padat dan potong tahu puff. Potong jamur king oyster serta seledri memanjang, jaga ketebalan jamur sekitar 8 mm; iris shiitake dan jahe memanjang, lalu iris cabai serong.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放適量香油，將豆乾與豆包慢慢煸至金黃焦脆後先盛出，這樣收醬後仍能保留口感。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok and slowly brown the pressed tofu and tofu puffs until golden and crisp, then set aside so they retain texture after saucing.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan dan tumis perlahan tahu padat serta tahu puff hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu sisihkan agar tetap bertekstur setelah diberi saus.

instruction.en: In the same wok, sauté ginger, shiitake, and thick-cut king oyster mushrooms until fragrant, letting the king oyster shrink slightly while retaining chew.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis jahe, shiitake, dan jamur king oyster potong tebal hingga harum; biarkan jamur sedikit menyusut tetapi tetap kenyal.

instruction.en: Return the pressed tofu and tofu puffs, then add vegan oyster sauce, vegan satay sauce, five-spice, black vinegar, pepper, sugar, and 100 g water. Toss until the sauce coats and is absorbed.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali tahu padat dan tahu puff, lalu tambahkan saus tiram vegan, saus sate vegan, bubuk lima rempah, cuka hitam, merica, gula, dan 100 g air. Aduk hingga saus melapisi dan terserap.

instruction.zh: 最後加入芹菜段與辣椒斜片快速拌炒至芹菜剛熟，立即盛盤，保持蔬菜爽脆和豆製品焦香。
instruction.en: Add celery segments and diagonal chili slices last, stir-fry quickly until celery is just cooked, and plate immediately to preserve crisp vegetables and browned tofu flavor.
instruction.id: Masukkan seledri dan irisan cabai serong terakhir, tumis cepat hingga seledri baru matang, lalu segera sajikan agar sayuran tetap renyah dan tahu tetap harum.

description.zh: 杏鮑菇與金針菇低溫煉成濃香菇油，蒸熟的杏鮑菇撕條鋪在白飯上，搭配醬汁與小黃瓜的全素雞肉飯。
description.en: King oyster and enoki mushrooms are slowly infused into a deeply savory mushroom oil, while steamed shredded king oyster tops rice with sauce and cucumber in this vegan chicken-rice-style bowl.
description.id: Jamur king oyster dan enoki dimasak perlahan menjadi minyak jamur yang gurih, sedangkan king oyster kukus suwir disajikan di atas nasi bersama saus dan mentimun sebagai nasi gaya ayam vegan.

instruction.zh: 將金針菇與一部分杏鮑菇切小丁；另一部分杏鮑菇用手撕成粗條，小黃瓜切薄片。
instruction.en: Dice the enoki and part of the king oyster mushrooms. Tear the remaining king oyster mushrooms into thick strips and slice the cucumber thinly.
instruction.id: Potong dadu enoki dan sebagian jamur king oyster. Suwir sisa king oyster menjadi strip tebal dan iris mentimun tipis-tipis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of diced enoki, diced and shredded king oyster mushrooms, and cucumber slices on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 將撕成條的杏鮑菇以鹽和味醂調味後蒸熟，保留蒸出的鮮甜湯汁備用。
instruction.en: Season the shredded king oyster mushrooms with salt and mirin, then steam until tender, reserving the savory liquid released during steaming.
instruction.id: Bumbui suwir jamur king oyster dengan garam dan mirin, lalu kukus hingga empuk sambil menyimpan cairan gurih yang keluar saat dikukus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of shredded king oyster mushrooms steaming in a heat-safe bowl with clear savory juices, no text.

instruction.zh: 冷鍋倒入較多植物油，放入切丁的杏鮑菇和金針菇，以小火慢慢煉至菇丁轉深褐色，濾出菇油和酥香菇丁。
instruction.en: Pour a generous amount of vegetable oil into a cold wok, add the diced king oyster and enoki, and cook slowly over low heat until deeply brown; strain out the mushroom oil and crisp mushroom bits.
instruction.id: Tuang cukup banyak minyak sayur ke wajan dingin, masukkan king oyster dan enoki potong dadu, lalu masak perlahan dengan api kecil hingga cokelat tua; saring minyak jamur dan remah jamur renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of deeply browned diced mushrooms slowly infusing oil in a small wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 小碗中混合醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉與少許五香粉，攪拌成鹹甜醬汁。
instruction.en: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, soy paste, sugar, ground pepper, and a little five-spice powder into a savory-sweet sauce.
instruction.id: Dalam mangkuk kecil, campurkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, merica bubuk, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah menjadi saus gurih manis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of dark glossy vegan rice-bowl sauce being stirred in a small bowl with spices, no text.

instruction.zh: 兩碗白飯各放上蒸杏鮑菇條，淋少量蒸汁、菇香油和調製醬汁，再撒上酥香菇丁並搭配小黃瓜片。
instruction.en: Top two bowls of rice with steamed king oyster strips, drizzle with some steaming liquid, mushroom oil, and sauce, then add crisp mushroom bits and cucumber slices.
instruction.id: Tata dua mangkuk nasi dengan suwir king oyster kukus, siram sedikit cairan kukusan, minyak jamur, dan saus, lalu tambahkan remah jamur renyah serta irisan mentimun.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of vegan mushroom chicken rice topped with shredded king oyster, crisp mushroom bits, sauce, and cucumber slices, no text.

description.zh: 以煎香芋頭、豆乾、菇類與米粉熬煮的暖胃全素湯麵。
description.en: A warming vegan rice vermicelli soup with seared taro, tofu, mushrooms, and vegetables.
description.id: Sup bihun vegan yang menghangatkan dengan talas, tahu, jamur, dan sayuran.

instruction.zh: 香油將芋頭與豆乾煎至金黃後取出。
instruction.en: Sear taro and tofu in sesame oil until golden, then remove.
instruction.id: Tumis talas dan tahu dengan minyak wijen hingga keemasan, lalu angkat.

instruction.zh: 炒香香菇與薑，再加入菇類、紅蘿蔔與高麗菜炒至軟化；加入調味、水、芋頭與豆乾，蓋鍋煮二十分鐘。
instruction.en: Sauté shiitake and ginger, add mushrooms, carrot, and cabbage until soft; add seasonings, water, taro, and tofu, then simmer covered 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Tumis shiitake dan jahe, tambahkan jamur, wortel, dan kubis hingga lunak; masukkan bumbu, air, talas, dan tahu, lalu didihkan tertutup 20 menit.

title.zh: 三機植物腳肉 經典系列

description.zh: 醃漬植物絞肉包住牛蒡條冷凍定型，裹千張兩次炸脆，再以照燒醬收汁的全素棒棒腿年菜。
description.en: Marinated plant mince wraps burdock sticks and freezes firm, then tofu skin creates a twice-fried crisp shell before a teriyaki glaze finishes these vegan drumsticks.
description.id: Cincangan daging nabati yang dimarinasi membungkus batang burdock lalu dibekukan, kemudian kulit tahu membentuk lapisan renyah goreng dua kali sebelum diselesaikan dengan glasir teriyaki.

instruction.zh: 退冰後的植物絞肉加入糖、半顆檸檬汁、孜然粉和少許五香粉拌勻備用。
instruction.en: Mix thawed plant-based mince with sugar, juice of half a lemon, cumin powder, and a little five-spice powder, then set aside.
instruction.id: Campur cincangan daging nabati yang sudah dicairkan dengan gula, perasan setengah lemon, bubuk jintan, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of seasoned plant-based mince with lemon and spices in a glass bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 牛蒡去皮後切約10公分段，修成略方正再一分為三，製成6條適合當棒棒腿骨柄的牛蒡條。
instruction.en: Peel the burdock, cut it into about 10 cm lengths, square the sides slightly, then split each length into thirds to make six bone-handle sticks.
instruction.id: Kupas burdock, potong sekitar 10 cm, rapikan sisi agar agak persegi, lalu belah tiap potong menjadi tiga untuk membuat enam batang pegangan tulang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of peeled burdock root cut into six neat rectangular sticks on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 麵粉與75克水調成無顆粒麵糊。醃肉分6份，每根牛蒡條先抹麵糊，再以一份植物肉包住前端二分之一，冷凍至少2小時。
instruction.en: Mix flour with 75 g water until smooth. Divide the marinated mince into six portions; brush each burdock stick with paste, wrap one portion around the front half, and freeze at least 2 hours.
instruction.id: Campur tepung dengan 75 g air hingga halus. Bagi cincangan termarinasi menjadi enam; olesi tiap batang burdock dengan pasta, bungkus setengah bagian depan dengan satu porsi, lalu bekukan minimal 2 jam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of six plant-meat drumsticks with burdock handles arranged on a tray ready for freezing, no text.

instruction.zh: 油溫加熱至140°C，將冷凍定型的植物肉棒棒腿炸至焦黃後取出。
instruction.en: Heat frying oil to 140°C and fry the frozen, shaped plant-meat drumsticks until browned, then remove.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 140°C lalu goreng drumstick daging nabati beku yang sudah berbentuk sampai kecokelatan, kemudian angkat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of plant-meat drumsticks with burdock handles frying at low temperature in bubbling oil, no text.

title.en: Wrap in tofu skin and fry again
title.id: Balut kulit tahu lalu goreng lagi

instruction.zh: 炸好的棒棒腿再沾麵粉糊，以剪成長條的千張包裹，回鍋炸至金黃酥脆後取出。
instruction.en: Dip the fried drumsticks in flour paste again, wrap them with tofu skin cut into strips, and return them to the oil until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Celupkan kembali drumstick yang sudah digoreng ke pasta tepung, balut dengan kulit tahu yang dipotong memanjang, lalu goreng lagi sampai keemasan serta renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of tofu skin strips wrapping a crisp plant-meat drumstick before the second fry, no text.

title.en: Glaze with teriyaki sauce and serve

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放醬油、糖、味醂、番茄醬與5大匙水煮滾收濃，放入炸棒棒腿拌至均勻裹醬；撒白芝麻，搭配汆燙花椰菜與檸檬上桌。
instruction.en: Bring soy sauce, sugar, mirin, ketchup, and 5 tablespoons water to a boil and reduce until thick. Toss in the fried drumsticks until glazed; finish with sesame, blanched broccoli, and lemon.
instruction.id: Didihkan kecap asin, gula, mirin, saus tomat, dan 5 sendok makan air lalu susutkan hingga kental. Aduk drumstick goreng hingga terlapisi glasir; akhiri dengan wijen, brokoli blansir, dan lemon.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of glossy teriyaki vegan drumsticks with broccoli, lemon wedges, and white sesame, no text.

title.en: Vegan Ten-Herb Buddha Jumps Over the Wall
title.id: Buddha Jumps Over the Wall Vegan Sepuluh Rempah

description.zh: 根莖蔬菜、菇類、豆製品與十全中藥材分層放入電鍋蒸煮，成為湯頭濃郁清甜的全素佛跳牆。
description.en: Root vegetables, mushrooms, tofu products, and ten Chinese herbs are layered in an electric cooker to create a rich yet sweet vegan Buddha Jumps Over the Wall soup.
description.id: Sayuran akar, jamur, produk tahu, dan sepuluh herbal Tiongkok disusun dalam penanak listrik untuk membuat sup Buddha Jumps Over the Wall vegan yang kaya namun manis.

instruction.zh: 玉米、白蘿蔔、芋頭、南瓜與杏鮑菇切塊；薑與蓮藕切片，芹菜切段，高麗菜切小片，泡軟乾香菇切絲，油豆腐切小塊。
instruction.en: Cut corn, daikon, taro, pumpkin, and king oyster mushroom into chunks. Slice ginger and lotus root, cut celery into sections and cabbage into small pieces, slice soaked shiitake, and cut fried tofu small.
instruction.id: Potong jagung, lobak putih, talas, labu, dan jamur king oyster menjadi potongan. Iris jahe serta akar teratai, potong seledri dan kol, iris shiitake yang direndam, lalu potong kecil tahu goreng.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. This is the preparation stage for an entirely vegan Buddha Jumps Over the Wall soup. title.en: Brown taro and king oyster mushroom
title.id: Tumis talas dan jamur king oyster

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量植物油，先將芋頭煎至焦黃取出，再把杏鮑菇煎至焦黃，增加湯頭焦香。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, brown taro until golden and remove it, then brown the king oyster mushroom to build roasted flavor for the broth.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan, tumis talas hingga keemasan lalu angkat, kemudian tumis jamur king oyster hingga keemasan untuk memberi rasa panggang pada kuah.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. title.en: Sauté ginger and shiitake in sesame oil

instruction.zh: 原鍋倒入適量麻油，放入薑片和泡軟後切絲的乾香菇爆香；再加入醬油、烏醋與胡椒粉炒香。上述調味料份量在現有證據中未標明。
instruction.en: Add an unspecified amount of sesame oil to the same wok and sauté the ginger slices with soaked, sliced dried shiitake until fragrant. Add soy sauce, black vinegar, and ground pepper and stir-fry until aromatic; the available evidence does not specify their amounts.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen dalam jumlah yang tidak disebutkan ke wajan yang sama, lalu tumis irisan jahe dan shiitake kering yang telah direndam serta diiris hingga harum. title.en: Layer ingredients and seal the pot

instruction.zh: 將所有蔬菜、煎香食材、腰果、鴻禧菇、油豆腐與豆皮放入內鍋，上層放十全中藥材，倒入900克水至約八分滿；以紗布或豆漿布覆蓋，再用盤子倒扣壓緊。
instruction.en: Layer all vegetables, browned ingredients, cashews, shimeji, fried tofu, and tofu skin in the inner pot, place the ten herbs on top, and add 900 g water to about 80 percent full. Cover with cloth and press it closed with an inverted plate.
instruction.id: Susun semua sayuran, bahan yang ditumis, kacang mete, shimeji, tahu goreng, dan kulit tahu di panci dalam, letakkan sepuluh herbal di atasnya, lalu tambahkan 900 g air hingga sekitar 80 persen penuh. Tutup dengan kain dan tekan rapat memakai piring terbalik.

A clean white cloth and inverted plate wait beside it for sealing. Strictly vegan, no hands, no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, packaging, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Steam in the electric cooker and season
title.id: Kukus dengan penanak listrik lalu bumbui

instruction.zh: 外鍋加入4杯水蒸煮，電鍋跳起後續燜20分鐘；開蓋試味，依個人口味加入適量鹽巴即可上桌。
instruction.en: Add 4 cups of water to the outer pot and cook. After the electric cooker switches off, rest it for 20 minutes; taste and add salt to preference before serving.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 4 cangkir air ke panci luar lalu masak. Setelah penanak listrik mati, diamkan 20 menit; cicipi dan tambahkan garam sesuai selera sebelum disajikan.
