description.zh: 馬鈴薯、凍豆腐與金針菇做成素蒲燒鰻，搭配麻油香菇油飯，是一道費工但豐盛的全素年菜。
description.en: Potato, frozen tofu, and enoki become vegan kabayaki eel, served over fragrant sesame-oil mushroom sticky rice in this elaborate vegan New Year dish.
description.id: Kentang, tahu beku, dan enoki menjadi belut kabayaki vegan yang disajikan di atas nasi ketan jamur beraroma minyak wijen sebagai hidangan Tahun Baru vegan yang istimewa.

name.id: bubuk lima rempah untuk nasi ketan

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯去皮切丁蒸15分鐘後壓成泥；凍豆腐擠乾剝小塊，金針菇切段，與馬鈴薯、醬油、味醂和黑胡椒拌勻。
instruction.en: Peel and dice the potato, steam 15 minutes, then mash. Squeeze and tear frozen tofu, cut enoki, and mix with potato, soy sauce, mirin, and black pepper.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong dadu kentang, kukus 15 menit lalu haluskan. Peras serta sobek tahu beku, potong enoki, lalu campur dengan kentang, kecap asin, mirin, dan lada hitam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of mashed potato, torn frozen tofu, enoki, and seasonings being mixed into a vegan eel filling, no text.

title.en: Wrap and pan-fry the vegan eel

instruction.zh: 低筋麵粉與水拌成麵糊。豆包攤開鋪餡煎至兩面金黃，再以麵糊黏上千張與海苔，包緊開口後半煎炸至金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Mix cake flour and water into batter. Spread filling on tofu puff sheet and pan-fry both sides golden, then use batter to attach tofu skin and nori, seal tightly, and shallow-fry until crisp.
instruction.id: Campur tepung rendah protein dan air menjadi adonan. Ratakan isian pada lembar tahu puff lalu goreng kedua sisi hingga keemasan, kemudian gunakan adonan untuk menempelkan kulit tahu dan nori, rapatkan, lalu goreng dangkal hingga renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of a tofu-skin and nori wrapped vegan eel slab frying golden in a skillet, no text.

title.en: Glaze and bake the kabayaki eel

instruction.zh: 醬油、味醂、糖和胡椒粉煮滾成蒲燒醬，塗在煎好的素鰻上，以160°C烤10分鐘。
instruction.en: Boil soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and pepper into kabayaki glaze, brush it over the fried vegan eel, and bake at 160°C for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Didihkan kecap asin, mirin, gula, dan merica menjadi glasir kabayaki, oleskan pada belut vegan goreng, lalu panggang pada 160°C selama 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of glossy kabayaki-glazed vegan eel baking on a tray with caramelized sauce, no text.

instruction.zh: 長糯米先泡水2小時，內鍋加2杯水、外鍋加1杯水，以電鍋蒸熟備用。
instruction.en: Soak long-grain glutinous rice for 2 hours, then steam it in an electric cooker with 2 cups water in the inner pot and 1 cup in the outer pot.
instruction.id: Rendam beras ketan panjang selama 2 jam, lalu kukus dalam penanak listrik dengan 2 cangkir air di panci dalam dan 1 cangkir di panci luar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked glutinous rice in an electric-cooker inner pot ready for steaming, no text.

instruction.zh: 香菇、金針菇、紅蘿蔔與豆乾切配後，麻油中先煸香豆乾，再放薑絲、香菇、金針菇和紅蘿蔔炒香。
instruction.en: Prepare shiitake, enoki, carrot, and pressed tofu. In sesame oil, brown pressed tofu first, then sauté ginger, shiitake, enoki, and carrot until fragrant.
instruction.id: Siapkan shiitake, enoki, wortel, dan tahu padat. Dalam minyak wijen, tumis tahu padat terlebih dahulu, lalu tumis jahe, shiitake, enoki, serta wortel hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of shiitake, enoki, carrot, ginger, and pressed tofu sautéing in fragrant sesame oil, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、素蠔油、五香粉、胡椒粉與糖調味，拌入蒸熟糯米後再蒸至入味；將蒲燒素鰻切段鋪在油飯上，撒白芝麻與香菜。
instruction.en: Season with soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, five-spice, pepper, and sugar, fold in steamed sticky rice and steam again until flavored. Slice the kabayaki vegan eel over the rice, then garnish with sesame and cilantro.
instruction.id: Bumbui dengan kecap asin, saus tiram vegan, bubuk lima rempah, merica, dan gula, lalu aduk dengan nasi ketan kukus dan kukus lagi hingga meresap. Iris belut kabayaki vegan di atas nasi, lalu hiasi wijen dan daun ketumbar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of vegan kabayaki eel slices over glossy mushroom sticky rice with white sesame and cilantro, no text.

description.zh: 豆包煎脆後，香菇、杏鮑菇與木耳以味噌、豆腐乳、燕麥奶和水熬成濃郁湯頭，搭配拉麵與蔬菜的全素豚骨拉麵。
description.en: Crisp tofu skin, mushrooms, miso, fermented tofu, oat milk, and water create a rich vegan tonkotsu-style broth served with ramen and greens.
description.id: Kulit tahu renyah, jamur, miso, tahu fermentasi, susu oat, dan air menjadi kuah gaya tonkotsu vegan yang kaya, disajikan dengan ramen serta sayuran.

instruction.zh: 香菇切片，杏鮑菇與木耳切絲，菠菜洗淨切段，油豆腐切塊；豆芽、芹菜、芝麻與海苔分別備好。
instruction.en: Slice shiitake, julienne king oyster mushroom and wood ear, wash and cut spinach, and cube fried tofu; set aside bean sprouts, celery, sesame, and nori.
instruction.id: Iris shiitake, potong memanjang jamur king oyster serta jamur kuping, cuci dan potong bayam, lalu potong tahu goreng; siapkan tauge, seledri, wijen, dan nori.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced shiitake, julienned king oyster mushrooms, wood ear, spinach, tofu, and ramen toppings on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量植物油，將豆包煎至焦脆後取出，作為拉麵的香脆配料。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok and fry the tofu skin until crisp and browned, then remove it for a crunchy ramen topping.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur dalam wajan dan goreng kulit tahu hingga renyah serta kecokelatan, lalu angkat sebagai pelengkap ramen yang garing.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of a crisp golden tofu skin sheet frying in a skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 原鍋放入香菇、杏鮑菇與木耳炒香，加入味噌、醬油和豆腐乳稍拌；倒入300克燕麥奶與200克水，攪至味噌融化，再放油豆腐，蓋鍋小火熬煮30分鐘。
instruction.en: In the same wok, sauté shiitake, king oyster mushroom, and wood ear. Stir in miso, soy sauce, and fermented tofu, then add 300 g oat milk and 200 g water, dissolving the miso; add fried tofu, cover, and simmer 30 minutes over low heat.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis shiitake, jamur king oyster, dan jamur kuping. Aduk miso, kecap asin, serta tahu fermentasi, lalu tambahkan 300 g susu oat dan 200 g air hingga miso larut; masukkan tahu goreng, tutup, dan rebus api kecil 30 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of creamy oat-milk ramen broth simmering with mushrooms and fried tofu in a covered pot, no text.

instruction.zh: 另起一鍋滾水加少許鹽，拉麵煮至八分熟；利用原鍋熱水分別汆燙豆芽和菠菜後撈起。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook ramen until about 80 percent done; use the hot water to briefly blanch bean sprouts and spinach, then drain.
instruction.id: Didihkan air bergaram ringan dalam panci terpisah dan masak ramen hingga sekitar 80 persen matang; gunakan air panas untuk memblansir tauge serta bayam sebentar, lalu tiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of ramen noodles, bean sprouts, and spinach blanching in separate sections of a pot of boiling water, no text.

instruction.zh: 將拉麵放入碗中，倒入熬好的濃湯，放上煎豆包、豆芽、菠菜、海苔與芹菜，最後撒芝麻即可享用。
instruction.en: Place ramen in a bowl and pour over the rich broth. Top with crisp tofu skin, bean sprouts, spinach, nori, and celery, then scatter sesame before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan ramen ke mangkuk dan tuang kuah kental. Tambahkan kulit tahu renyah, tauge, bayam, nori, serta seledri, lalu taburi wijen sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of creamy vegan tonkotsu ramen topped with crisp tofu skin, spinach, bean sprouts, nori, celery, and sesame, no text.

title.zh: 全素白醬菌菇松露燉飯
title.en: Vegan White Sauce Mushroom Truffle Risotto
title.id: Risotto Truffle Jamur Saus Putih Vegan

description.zh: 泡軟腰果與鷹嘴豆、植物奶和檸檬汁打成白醬，再以多種煸香菌菇、白飯與松露醬慢煮成濃郁不膩的全素燉飯。
description.en: Soaked cashews, chickpeas, plant milk, and lemon become a white sauce, then browned mushrooms, cooked rice, and truffle paste are gently simmered into a rich yet bright vegan risotto.
description.id: Kacang mete rendam, buncis, susu nabati, dan lemon menjadi saus putih, lalu jamur yang ditumis, nasi matang, serta pasta truffle dimasak perlahan menjadi risotto vegan yang kaya namun tidak enek.

title.id: Rendam kacang mete dan potong jamur

instruction.zh: 生腰果先浸泡至少4小時後瀝乾；蘑菇切片，杏鮑菇、香菇和秀珍菇切絲。
instruction.en: Soak raw cashews for at least 4 hours and drain them. Slice button mushrooms and cut king oyster, shiitake, and oyster mushrooms into strips.
instruction.id: Rendam kacang mete mentah minimal 4 jam lalu tiriskan. Iris jamur kancing dan potong memanjang jamur king oyster, shiitake, serta jamur tiram.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked cashews and sliced mixed mushrooms prepared on a wooden board, no text.

title.en: Brown mushrooms and blend white sauce
title.id: Tumis jamur dan blender saus putih

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放少量植物油，先將蘑菇煸香；把煸香蘑菇、泡軟腰果、鷹嘴豆、植物奶、檸檬汁和調味料放入調理杯打勻成白醬。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil and brown the button mushrooms. Blend them with soaked cashews, chickpeas, plant milk, lemon juice, and seasonings until a smooth white sauce forms.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur lalu tumis jamur kancing hingga harum. Blender bersama kacang mete rendam, buncis, susu nabati, air lemon, dan bumbu hingga menjadi saus putih halus.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of creamy pale cashew mushroom sauce being blended in a tall blender cup, no text.

instruction.zh: 原鍋再放少量植物油，將杏鮑菇、秀珍菇和香菇煸至金黃，加入少許鹽調味，建立濃郁菇香。
instruction.en: In the same pan, add a little oil and brown king oyster, oyster, and shiitake mushrooms until golden, seasoning with a little salt to build deep mushroom flavor.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tambahkan sedikit minyak lalu tumis jamur king oyster, jamur tiram, dan shiitake hingga keemasan, bumbui sedikit garam untuk membangun rasa jamur yang dalam.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of golden mixed mushroom strips browning in a skillet with a wooden spatula, no text.

title.id: Masak perlahan risotto saus putih jamur

instruction.zh: 加入3大匙白醬與適量水，再放入熟白飯拌勻，蓋鍋以小火熬煮10分鐘，使米飯吸收濃郁菇香醬汁。
instruction.en: Add 3 tablespoons white sauce and suitable water, then stir in cooked rice. Cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes so the rice absorbs the rich mushroom sauce.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 3 sendok makan saus putih dan air secukupnya, lalu aduk nasi matang. Tutup dan masak api kecil selama 10 menit agar nasi menyerap saus jamur yang kaya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of creamy white mushroom risotto gently simmering in a covered pan, no text.

title.en: Fold in truffle paste and plate

instruction.zh: 起鍋前加入松露醬與少許鹽拌勻，盛盤後可依喜好刨上素起司，維持雪白主題即可享用。
instruction.en: Before serving, fold in vegan truffle paste and a little salt. Plate the risotto and, if desired, grate vegan cheese over it to keep the snowy white presentation.
instruction.id: Sebelum disajikan, aduk pasta truffle vegan dan sedikit garam. Tata risotto di piring dan, bila diinginkan, parut keju vegan di atasnya untuk mempertahankan tampilan putih seperti salju.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of creamy white vegan mushroom truffle risotto with finely grated vegan cheese, no text.

title.id: Sup Bola Ketan Gurih Hakka Vegan

description.zh: 以湯圓、金針菇與多種可見菇類、蔬菜為主的全素客家鹹湯圓；現有 evidence 未提供可用的完整食材卡或逐字稿份量。
description.en: A vegan Hakka savory rice-ball soup centered on tangyuan, enoki, and the mushrooms and vegetables visible in the source; available evidence does not provide usable full quantities.
description.id: Sup bola ketan gurih Hakka vegan yang berpusat pada tangyuan, enoki, serta jamur dan sayuran yang terlihat di sumber; evidence yang tersedia tidak memberi takaran lengkap yang dapat digunakan.

instruction.zh: 依畫面將全素湯圓備妥；紅蘿蔔、木耳、香菇、杏鮑菇、金針菇、青菜與芹菜分別洗淨並切成容易入口的大小。
instruction.en: Prepare vegan tangyuan rice balls as shown. Wash and cut carrot, wood ear, shiitake, king oyster mushroom, enoki, leafy greens, and celery into bite-size pieces.
instruction.id: Siapkan bola ketan tangyuan vegan seperti pada sumber. Cuci dan potong wortel, jamur kuping, shiitake, jamur king oyster, enoki, sayuran hijau, serta seledri menjadi ukuran sekali makan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of vegan tangyuan rice balls with enoki, carrots, wood ear mushrooms, shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, and greens, no text.

instruction.zh: 將金針菇切成小段；其餘菇類切絲或小塊，讓配料容易與湯圓一同入口。
instruction.en: Cut enoki into short sections. Slice or cut the other mushrooms into small pieces so they can be eaten easily with the rice balls.
instruction.id: Potong enoki menjadi bagian pendek. Iris atau potong kecil jamur lainnya agar mudah dimakan bersama bola ketan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of enoki being cut into short pieces beside sliced shiitake and king oyster mushrooms, no text.

instruction.zh: 湯鍋倒入少量香油，放入金針菇煸至表面焦黃、香氣釋放。
instruction.en: Add a little sesame oil to a soup pot and brown the enoki until its surface turns golden and fragrant.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak wijen ke panci sup lalu tumis enoki hingga permukaannya keemasan dan harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of enoki mushrooms browning in sesame oil in a deep soup pot, no text.

title.en: Add vegetables and make the soup base
title.id: Tambahkan sayuran dan buat kuah dasar

instruction.zh: 在金針菇煸香後加入其餘菇類、紅蘿蔔與可見蔬菜拌炒，再加水煮成湯底；現有 evidence 未明示調味與時間，依食材熟度調整。
instruction.en: After browning enoki, add the remaining mushrooms, carrot, and visible vegetables, sauté briefly, then add water to make the soup base; current evidence does not specify seasoning or timing, so adjust for doneness.
instruction.id: Setelah enoki ditumis, masukkan jamur lain, wortel, dan sayuran yang terlihat, tumis sebentar, lalu tambahkan air untuk membuat kuah dasar; evidence saat ini tidak menyebut bumbu atau waktu, jadi sesuaikan hingga matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of mushrooms, carrot, and leafy greens simmering in a clear savory soup base in a pot, no text.

title.en: Cook rice balls and finish with greens
title.id: Masak bola ketan lalu masukkan sayuran hijau

instruction.zh: 湯底煮滾後加入全素湯圓，煮至湯圓浮起並熟透；最後加入青菜與芹菜，菜色變軟後即可盛碗。
instruction.en: When the soup boils, add vegan tangyuan and cook until the rice balls float and are cooked through. Add leafy greens and celery last, then bowl once the greens soften.
instruction.id: Saat kuah mendidih, masukkan tangyuan vegan dan masak hingga bola ketan mengapung serta matang. Tambahkan sayuran hijau dan seledri terakhir, lalu sajikan setelah sayuran layu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of vegan Hakka savory rice-ball soup with tangyuan, enoki, mushrooms, carrot, and leafy greens, no text.

description.zh: 老菜脯、菇類、蔬菜與熟糙米飯放入電鍋蒸煮，利用食材鮮甜煮成不需額外調味的一鍋全素鹹粥。
description.en: Aged preserved radish, mushrooms, vegetables, and cooked brown rice steam together in an electric cooker, creating a naturally savory vegan porridge without extra seasonings.
description.id: Lobak asin tua, jamur, sayuran, dan nasi merah matang dikukus bersama dalam penanak listrik menjadi bubur vegan gurih alami tanpa bumbu tambahan.

title.en: Soak dried items and prepare vegetables
title.id: Rendam bahan kering dan siapkan sayuran

instruction.zh: 海帶芽、紅棗、枸杞與乾香菇分別泡水；薑切絲，香菇切絲，豆包切塊，紅蘿蔔與杏鮑菇切丁，高麗菜切絲，芹菜切小段。
instruction.en: Soak wakame, red dates, goji berries, and dried shiitake separately. Julienne ginger and shiitake, cut tofu puffs into pieces, dice carrot and king oyster mushrooms, shred cabbage, and cut celery short.
instruction.id: Rendam wakame, kurma merah, goji berry, dan shiitake kering secara terpisah. Iris jahe serta shiitake memanjang, potong tahu puff, dadu wortel dan jamur king oyster, iris kol, lalu potong seledri pendek.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked dried ingredients and neatly cut vegetables arranged for vegan savory porridge, no text.

title.en: Rinse and chop the aged radish
title.id: Bilas dan cincang lobak asin tua

instruction.zh: 老菜脯以清水沖洗後切碎，去除表面鹹味並方便融入粥湯。
instruction.en: Rinse the aged preserved radish under water and chop it finely to remove surface salt and help it blend into the porridge.
instruction.id: Bilas lobak asin tua dengan air lalu cincang halus untuk mengurangi garam di permukaan dan membuatnya menyatu dengan bubur.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of rinsed aged preserved radish being finely chopped on a wooden board, no text.

title.en: Brown ginger, mushrooms, and tofu puffs
title.id: Tumis jahe, jamur, dan tahu puff

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量香油，放入薑絲、香菇絲與豆包煸香至金黃，再加入紅蘿蔔、杏鮑菇和高麗菜炒出香氣。
instruction.en: Heat a little sesame oil in a wok and brown ginger, shiitake, and tofu puffs until golden, then add carrot, king oyster mushrooms, and cabbage and sauté until fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak wijen dalam wajan dan tumis jahe, shiitake, serta tahu puff hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan wortel, jamur king oyster, dan kol hingga harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden tofu puffs, ginger, shiitake, cabbage, carrot, and king oyster mushroom sautéing in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 將炒料放入電鍋內鍋，加入熟糙米飯、泡發紅棗、枸杞、海帶芽、老菜脯和1000毫升水；外鍋加2杯水蒸煮。
instruction.en: Transfer the sautéed ingredients to the electric-cooker inner pot. Add cooked brown rice, soaked red dates, goji berries, wakame, aged radish, and 1000 ml water; add 2 cups water to the outer pot and cook.
instruction.id: Pindahkan bahan tumis ke panci dalam penanak listrik. Tambahkan nasi merah matang, kurma merah, goji berry, wakame, lobak asin tua, dan 1000 ml air; tambahkan 2 cangkir air ke panci luar lalu masak.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a deep electric-cooker pot filled with brown rice, vegetables, wakame, red dates, and broth before steaming, no text.

instruction.zh: 電鍋跳起後續燜20分鐘，最後撒上芹菜末與黑芝麻即可享用；湯頭以食材本身鮮甜為主，無需額外調味。
instruction.en: After the cooker switches off, rest for 20 minutes. Finish with celery and black sesame; the broth relies on natural ingredient sweetness and needs no extra seasoning.
instruction.id: Setelah penanak listrik mati, diamkan 20 menit. Akhiri dengan seledri dan wijen hitam; kuah mengandalkan rasa alami bahan sehingga tidak perlu bumbu tambahan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of nourishing vegan brown-rice savory porridge with vegetables, black sesame, and celery in a ceramic bowl, no text.

description.zh: 先煎粄條製造鍋氣，再與薑、豆乾和脆口蔬菜大火快炒的全素客家料理。
description.en: Vegan Hakka rice noodles are first pan-seared for wok aroma, then quickly stir-fried with ginger, tofu, and crisp vegetables.
description.id: Kwetiau Hakka vegan ditumis terlebih dahulu untuk aroma wajan, lalu ditumis cepat dengan jahe, tahu, dan sayuran renyah.

instruction.zh: 薑切末，芹菜切段，香菇切條，紅蘿蔔與豆乾切絲；粄條切粗條後拌香油。
instruction.en: Mince ginger, cut celery, slice shiitake, julienne carrot and tofu, and toss wide rice noodles with sesame oil.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe, potong seledri, iris shiitake, potong wortel dan tahu memanjang, lalu aduk kwetiau dengan minyak wijen.

instruction.en: Sear oiled rice noodles until lightly golden and set aside; fry ginger and tofu in sesame oil, then add carrot and shiitake.
instruction.id: Panggang kwetiau berminyak hingga sedikit keemasan lalu sisihkan; tumis jahe dan tahu dengan minyak wijen, kemudian tambahkan wortel dan shiitake.

instruction.id: Tumis saus sate vegan, saus kecap, dan lada, tambahkan air rendaman jamur serta tauge dengan api besar; masukkan kembali kwetiau dan aduk dengan seledri saat kuah menyusut.

title.en: Vegan Sesame Oil Rice Blood Cake
title.id: Kue Beras Darah Vegan Minyak Wijen

description.zh: 紫米糕先以麻油煎至外皮焦香，再與薑、米酒、醬油膏和枸杞小火滷煮，是一款Q彈軟嫩的全素麻油米血糕。
description.en: Purple rice cake is first seared in sesame oil, then braised gently with ginger, rice wine, soy paste, and goji berries for a chewy, tender vegan sesame-oil rice blood cake.
description.id: Kue beras ungu ditumis dahulu dengan minyak wijen, lalu dibraise perlahan bersama jahe, arak beras, pasta kecap asin, dan goji berry untuk kue darah vegan yang kenyal serta lembut.

title.en: Soak goji berries and prepare ingredients
title.id: Rendam goji berry dan siapkan bahan

instruction.zh: 枸杞先泡水備用；老薑切片、芹菜切末，素米血糕切成適口塊狀。
instruction.en: Soak goji berries in water. Slice the mature ginger, chop celery, and cut the vegan rice blood cake into bite-size pieces.
instruction.id: Rendam goji berry dalam air. Iris jahe tua, cincang seledri, dan potong kue darah vegan menjadi ukuran sekali makan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced ginger, soaked goji berries, chopped celery, and cubed purple rice cake on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入麻油，放入薑片以中小火煸至金黃，避免麻油過熱發苦。
instruction.en: Pour sesame oil into a pan and cook ginger over medium-low heat until golden, avoiding overheating the sesame oil and making it bitter.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen ke wajan dan tumis jahe dengan api sedang-kecil hingga keemasan, hindari minyak wijen terlalu panas dan pahit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of ginger slices turning golden in fragrant sesame oil in a pan, no text.

title.en: Sear the rice cake until crisp

instruction.zh: 加入素米血糕，將每一面煎至焦香酥脆，先建立外層Q脆口感。
instruction.en: Add the vegan rice blood cake and sear every side until browned and crisp, building a chewy-crisp exterior.
instruction.id: Masukkan kue darah vegan dan tumis setiap sisi hingga kecokelatan serta renyah untuk membentuk bagian luar yang kenyal-garing.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of purple vegan rice cake cubes searing golden-brown in a sesame-oil pan, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入泡軟枸杞、米酒、醬油膏、糖、五香粉與水；水量以約半淹過米血糕為準，蓋鍋小火熬煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Add soaked goji berries, rice wine, soy paste, sugar, five-spice, and water; use enough water to come about halfway up the rice cake. Cover and braise over low heat for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan goji berry rendam, arak beras, pasta kecap asin, gula, bubuk lima rempah, dan air; gunakan air hingga kira-kira setengah tinggi kue beras. Tutup dan braise api kecil selama 10 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan rice blood cake cubes simmering in glossy dark sesame braising sauce with goji berries, no text.

title.en: Reduce the sauce and add celery

instruction.zh: 開蓋後加入芹菜末拌炒至湯汁稍微收乾即可起鍋；放涼一些再吃，米血糕口感會更Q彈。
instruction.en: Uncover, add chopped celery, and stir until the sauce reduces slightly, then serve. Let it cool a little before eating for a chewier rice-cake texture.
instruction.id: Buka tutup, tambahkan seledri cincang, lalu aduk hingga saus sedikit menyusut dan sajikan. Diamkan sebentar sebelum dimakan agar tekstur kue beras lebih kenyal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of glossy vegan sesame oil rice blood cake with celery and goji berries in a shallow bowl, no text.

description.zh: 老薑、香菇與杏鮑菇以香油煸香，加入剝皮辣椒及其湯汁、海帶芽和嫩豆腐熬煮的鮮甜微辣全素菌菇湯。
description.en: Ginger, shiitake, and king oyster mushrooms are sautéed in sesame oil, then simmered with peeled chilies and their brine, wakame, and silken tofu for a naturally savory, gently spicy vegan soup.
description.id: Jahe, shiitake, dan jamur king oyster ditumis dalam minyak wijen, lalu direbus dengan cabai kupas beserta air rendamannya, wakame, dan tahu sutra menjadi sup vegan yang gurih serta sedikit pedas.

instruction.zh: 老薑切片，杏鮑菇與泡發香菇切片；嫩豆腐切塊，嫩海帶芽泡水洗淨。泡香菇前先洗乾淨，以保留可用的香菇水。
instruction.en: Slice ginger, king oyster mushrooms, and soaked shiitake. Cube silken tofu and soak-rinse tender wakame. Wash shiitake before soaking so the soaking liquid can be used in the soup.
instruction.id: Iris jahe, jamur king oyster, dan shiitake yang direndam. Potong tahu sutra, lalu rendam serta bilas wakame muda. Cuci shiitake sebelum direndam agar air rendamannya dapat digunakan untuk sup.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced ginger, king oyster mushrooms, soaked shiitake, silken tofu cubes, wakame, and peeled chilies, no text.

title.en: Brown ginger and mushrooms in sesame oil
title.id: Tumis jahe dan jamur dengan minyak wijen

instruction.zh: 湯鍋倒入少量香油，先放薑片炒香，再加入杏鮑菇煸至金黃。
instruction.en: Add a little sesame oil to a soup pot, sauté ginger until fragrant, then brown king oyster mushrooms until golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak wijen ke panci sup, tumis jahe hingga harum, lalu tumis jamur king oyster hingga keemasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of ginger slices and golden king oyster mushroom pieces browning in sesame oil in a soup pot, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入香菇片與剝皮辣椒一起炒香，讓菇類與辣椒香氣先融入鍋中。
instruction.en: Add sliced shiitake and peeled chilies, sautéing them together so the mushroom and chili aromas bloom in the pot.
instruction.id: Masukkan shiitake iris dan cabai kupas, lalu tumis bersama agar aroma jamur serta cabai keluar di dalam panci.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, and peeled chilies sautéing together in a deep pot, no text.

title.en: Add liquids and simmer the soup

instruction.zh: 加入1000毫升水、約半份剝皮辣椒湯汁與香菇水，再放入海帶芽和嫩豆腐；蓋鍋熬煮約20分鐘。
instruction.en: Add 1000 ml water, about half the peeled-chili brine, and shiitake soaking water, then add wakame and silken tofu. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 1000 ml air, sekitar setengah air rendaman cabai kupas, dan air rendaman shiitake, lalu masukkan wakame serta tahu sutra. Tutup dan rebus sekitar 20 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of a golden mushroom soup simmering with peeled chilies, wakame, and silken tofu in a covered pot, no text.

instruction.zh: 開蓋後先試湯的鹹度；剝皮辣椒與其湯汁本身已有鹹味，確認風味合適後直接盛碗享用。
instruction.en: Uncover and taste the broth for saltiness. Peeled chilies and their brine already provide salt, so serve directly once the flavor is balanced.
instruction.id: Buka tutup dan cicipi tingkat asin kuah. Cabai kupas serta air rendamannya sudah memberi rasa asin, jadi sajikan langsung setelah rasanya seimbang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of golden vegan peeled chili mushroom soup with silken tofu, wakame, and mushroom slices in a ceramic bowl, no text.

description.zh: 豆包煸至金黃焦脆，搭配菜脯、青龍椒、杏鮑菇、高麗菜和白飯大火快炒，做出不加蛋也有焦香口感的全素蛋炒飯。
description.en: Tofu skin is browned until crisp, then stir-fried over high heat with preserved radish, green chilies, king oyster mushroom, cabbage, and rice for an egg-style vegan fried rice.
description.id: Kulit tahu ditumis hingga renyah, lalu digoreng cepat dengan api besar bersama lobak asin, cabai hijau, jamur king oyster, kol, dan nasi menjadi nasi goreng gaya telur vegan.

name.id: nasi putih matang atau nasi semalam

title.en: Soak preserved radish and prepare ingredients
title.id: Rendam lobak asin dan siapkan bahan

instruction.zh: 菜脯泡水10分鐘後瀝乾；豆包撕成小碎片，青龍椒切細，杏鮑菇切丁，高麗菜切成小片。
instruction.en: Soak preserved radish for 10 minutes and drain. Tear tofu skin into small pieces, finely cut green chilies, dice king oyster mushroom, and cut cabbage into small pieces.
instruction.id: Rendam lobak asin selama 10 menit lalu tiriskan. Sobek kulit tahu kecil-kecil, potong halus cabai hijau, dadu jamur king oyster, dan potong kol kecil-kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked preserved radish, torn tofu skin, chopped green chilies, diced king oyster mushroom, and cabbage, no text.

title.en: Brown preserved radish and tofu skin
title.id: Tumis lobak asin dan kulit tahu

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量植物油，先將菜脯煸香，再放豆包煸至金黃色且邊緣帶焦脆。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok, brown the preserved radish until fragrant, then add tofu skin and cook until golden with crisp edges.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur dalam wajan, tumis lobak asin hingga harum, lalu tambahkan kulit tahu dan masak sampai keemasan dengan tepi renyah.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of golden crisp tofu skin pieces and preserved radish browning in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入杏鮑菇與高麗菜炒香，倒入香菇昆布醬油、醬油膏和胡椒粉拌勻，使蔬菜和豆包均勻吸附醬香。
instruction.en: Add king oyster mushroom and cabbage and sauté until fragrant. Pour in mushroom kombu soy sauce, soy paste, and pepper, tossing until vegetables and tofu skin are evenly coated.
instruction.id: Tambahkan jamur king oyster dan kol lalu tumis hingga harum. Tuang kecap asin kombu jamur, pasta kecap asin, dan merica, aduk sampai sayuran serta kulit tahu terlapisi rata.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of king oyster mushroom, cabbage, and crisp tofu skin being tossed with dark savory sauce in a wok, no text.

title.en: Stir-fry the rice over high heat

instruction.zh: 放入熟白飯或隔夜飯，以大火快速將飯粒拌散，讓每粒米飯都裹上醬汁與焦香配料。
instruction.en: Add cooked or day-old rice and stir-fry over high heat, breaking up the grains so every grain becomes coated in sauce and fragrant browned ingredients.
instruction.id: Masukkan nasi matang atau nasi semalam lalu tumis dengan api besar, pisahkan butirannya agar setiap butir terlapisi saus dan bahan yang harum kecokelatan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan fried rice being rapidly tossed over high heat in a wok with visible grains and tofu skin, no text.

instruction.zh: 最後加入青龍椒，大火快炒至青椒變亮、飯粒乾爽分明即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Add green chilies last and stir-fry over high heat until they brighten and the rice grains are dry and separate, then serve.
instruction.id: Masukkan cabai hijau terakhir dan tumis dengan api besar hingga warnanya cerah serta butiran nasi kering terpisah, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of golden vegan egg-style fried rice with crisp tofu skin, green chili pieces, and cabbage, no text.

title.id: Labu Musim Dingin Rebus Jahe Vegan

description.zh: 老薑煸香後，將冬瓜與浸軟麵輪以香菇昆布醬油、素蠔油和糖燜煮至上層脆口、下層軟綿。
description.en: A nostalgic vegan dish in which ginger-scented winter melon and softened fried gluten puffs are braised with mushroom-kelp soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, and sugar.
description.id: Hidangan vegan bernuansa nostalgia: labu musim dingin dan gluten goreng yang telah lunak direbus dengan aroma jahe, kecap jamur-kombu, saus tiram vegan, dan gula.

title.en: Prepare winter melon and gluten puffs

instruction.zh: 冬瓜去皮去籽後切片；老薑切細絲。將麵輪放入滾水煮至軟化，撈出備用。
instruction.en: Peel, seed, and slice the winter melon; cut the mature ginger into fine shreds. Boil the fried gluten puffs until soft, then drain and reserve.
instruction.id: Kupas, buang biji, lalu iris labu musim dingin; iris tipis jahe tua. Rebus bola gluten goreng dalam air mendidih hingga lunak, tiriskan, lalu sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of peeled and seeded pale-green winter-melon slices, fine mature-ginger shreds, and softened golden fried-gluten puffs arranged in distinct groups on a wooden prep board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no sauce, goji berries, finished braise, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入植物油，以小火煸香薑絲；放入冬瓜和煮軟的麵輪，淋入香菇昆布醬油、素蠔油與糖拌勻。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok and gently fry the ginger shreds until fragrant. Add winter melon and softened gluten puffs, then coat with mushroom-kelp soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, and sugar.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak nabati dalam wajan dan tumis irisan jahe dengan api kecil hingga harum. Masukkan labu musim dingin dan bola gluten lunak, lalu aduk dengan kecap asin jamur-kombu, saus tiram vegan, dan gula.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of fine ginger shreds, pale winter-melon slices, and softened golden fried-gluten puffs being gently stir-fried in a wok and coated with glossy mushroom-kelp soy sauce. Constraints: strictly vegan; no goji berries, finished plated dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加水至約淹過冬瓜八分滿，放入泡發枸杞並蓋鍋，以小火燜煮約二十分鐘，待冬瓜軟化後盛盤。
instruction.en: Add water to roughly eighty percent of the winter melon’s height, add the soaked goji berries, cover, and simmer gently for about twenty minutes until the melon is tender before plating.
instruction.id: Tambahkan air hingga kira-kira menutupi delapan puluh persen tinggi labu, masukkan beri goji yang telah direndam, tutup, lalu rebus perlahan sekitar dua puluh menit sampai labu lunak sebelum disajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of finished ginger-braised winter melon and golden fried-gluten puffs in a shallow ceramic bowl, tender translucent melon in a glossy amber-brown savory sauce with red goji berries. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Vegan Black Bean Braised Bitter Melon

description.zh: 白玉苦瓜先煎至微黃，再與豆豉、薑、醬油和香料小火燜煮至入味，是一道鹹香回甘的全素苦瓜料理。
description.en: White bitter melon is first seared until lightly golden, then gently braised with fermented black beans, ginger, soy sauce, and spices for a savory vegan dish with a mellow bitter finish.
description.id: Pare putih ditumis hingga agak keemasan, lalu dibraise perlahan bersama kacang hitam fermentasi, jahe, kecap asin, dan rempah menjadi hidangan vegan gurih dengan akhir rasa pahit lembut.

title.en: Seed and cut the bitter melon

instruction.zh: 白玉苦瓜剖開去籽，切成適口塊狀；老薑切片，大辣椒切段備用。
instruction.en: Halve the white bitter melon, remove seeds, and cut into bite-size pieces. Slice mature ginger and cut the large chili into sections.
instruction.id: Belah pare putih, buang bijinya, lalu potong seukuran sekali makan. Iris jahe tua dan potong cabai besar menjadi beberapa bagian.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of seeded white bitter melon pieces, sliced ginger, fermented black beans, and red chili on a wooden board, no text.

title.en: Sear bitter melon until lightly golden

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入少量植物油，放入苦瓜煎至表面微黃後取出；以煎取代餐廳常用的過油方式。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a pan and sear the bitter melon until lightly golden, then remove it; this replaces the restaurant-style deep-frying method.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur dalam wajan dan tumis pare hingga agak keemasan, lalu angkat; cara ini menggantikan metode menggoreng banyak minyak ala restoran.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of white bitter melon pieces searing lightly golden in a skillet with a wooden spatula, no text.

title.en: Sauté ginger and fermented black beans
title.id: Tumis jahe dan kacang hitam fermentasi

instruction.zh: 原鍋放入薑片與豆豉炒香，讓薑香和豆豉的濃郁風味先釋放。
instruction.en: In the same pan, sauté ginger and fermented black beans until fragrant so their aromatic flavors bloom first.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis jahe dan kacang hitam fermentasi hingga harum agar rasa aromatiknya keluar terlebih dahulu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of ginger slices and fermented black beans sizzling in a dark skillet, no text.

title.en: Add sauce and braise bitter melon

instruction.zh: 放回苦瓜，加入醬油、糖、胡椒粉、五香粉和水，水量約半淹過苦瓜；蓋鍋小火燜煮25分鐘。
instruction.en: Return the bitter melon and add soy sauce, sugar, pepper, five-spice, and water, using enough liquid to come about halfway up the melon. Cover and braise over low heat for 25 minutes.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali pare lalu tambahkan kecap asin, gula, merica, bubuk lima rempah, dan air hingga kira-kira setengah tinggi pare. Tutup dan braise api kecil selama 25 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of bitter melon braising in a glossy dark fermented-black-bean sauce in a covered pan, no text.

instruction.zh: 開蓋後加入大辣椒稍微拌炒即可起鍋；醬汁可一同配白飯，隔夜加熱會更入味。
instruction.en: Uncover, add the large chili, and toss briefly before serving. Serve the sauce with rice; reheating the next day makes the dish even more flavorful.
instruction.id: Buka tutup, masukkan cabai besar, lalu aduk sebentar sebelum disajikan. Sajikan saus bersama nasi; dipanaskan kembali keesokan hari membuat hidangan makin meresap.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of glossy vegan black bean braised bitter melon with red chili in a ceramic dish, no text.

description.zh: 四季豆以不油炸的方式乾煸，搭配煸香豆乾、菜脯與薑，再以醬油膏調味，做出帶有蝦米錯覺的全素熱炒風味。
description.en: Green beans are dry-fried without deep-frying, then paired with crisp tofu, preserved radish, and ginger, finished with soy paste for a vegan stir-fry that evokes dried-shrimp flavor.
description.id: Buncis ditumis kering tanpa digoreng banyak minyak, lalu dipadukan dengan tahu renyah, lobak asin, dan jahe, diselesaikan dengan pasta kecap asin untuk rasa tumisan vegan yang mengingatkan pada udang kering.

title.en: Soak preserved radish and prepare ingredients
title.id: Rendam lobak asin dan siapkan bahan

instruction.zh: 菜脯以熱水泡5至10分鐘去鹹後瀝乾；四季豆去纖維切段，豆乾切小丁，薑切末，大辣椒切段。
instruction.en: Soak preserved radish in hot water for 5 to 10 minutes to reduce saltiness, then drain. Trim and cut green beans, dice pressed tofu, mince ginger, and cut the large chili.
instruction.id: Rendam lobak asin dalam air panas selama 5 hingga 10 menit untuk mengurangi asin, lalu tiriskan. Buang serat buncis dan potong, dadu tahu padat, cincang jahe, dan potong cabai besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of trimmed green beans cut into even segments, diced pressed tofu, drained soaked preserved radish, finely minced mature ginger, and sliced large red chilli arranged separately on a clean wooden board beside a small bowl. Constraints: strictly vegan; ingredients must remain raw and separate, no cooked dish, meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量植物油，將四季豆以中火慢慢煸至表面微皺、熟透且帶焦香，不使用過油炸法。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and dry-fry green beans over medium heat until lightly wrinkled, cooked through, and fragrant without deep-frying.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak sayur ke wajan dan tumis kering buncis dengan api sedang hingga sedikit berkerut, matang, dan harum tanpa digoreng banyak minyak.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of green bean segments dry-frying alone in a dark wok with only a thin sheen of oil, their bright green surfaces becoming lightly blistered, wrinkled, and browned at the edges. Constraints: strictly vegan; no deep-frying oil, tofu, sauce, chilli, meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將豆乾煸至金黃焦脆，再加入薑末與泡軟菜脯炒香，讓菜脯帶出類似蝦米的鹹香。
instruction.en: Brown pressed tofu until golden and crisp, then add minced ginger and soaked preserved radish, sautéing until fragrant so the radish brings a dried-shrimp-like savory note.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu padat hingga keemasan serta renyah, lalu tambahkan jahe cincang dan lobak asin rendam, masak hingga harum agar lobak memberi rasa gurih seperti udang kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of small pressed-tofu cubes browning until crisp and golden in a wok with minced mature ginger and finely chopped soaked preserved radish, visibly aromatic and dry-fried. Constraints: strictly vegan; no green beans or sauce yet, no meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 放回四季豆，加入醬油膏、胡椒粉與糖拌炒，讓醬汁均勻附著並炒至收乾。
instruction.en: Return the green beans and add soy paste, pepper, and sugar. Toss until the sauce coats everything evenly and reduces dry.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali buncis lalu tambahkan pasta kecap asin, merica, dan gula. Aduk hingga saus melapisi rata dan menyusut kering.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of blistered green bean segments and crisp golden tofu cubes being tossed with preserved radish, ginger, ground pepper, sugar, and dark glossy soy paste in a wok, sauce visibly reducing to a thin coating. Constraints: strictly vegan; no red chilli yet, no finished serving plate, meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 最後加入大辣椒快速拌炒，醬汁收乾後立即盛盤，保持四季豆爽脆與豆乾焦香。
instruction.en: Add the large chili last and toss quickly. Plate immediately once the sauce is dry to preserve crisp green beans and browned tofu.
instruction.id: Masukkan cabai besar terakhir lalu aduk cepat. Sajikan segera setelah saus mengering agar buncis tetap renyah dan tahu tetap harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of finished vegan dry-fried green beans plated in a simple ceramic dish, with wrinkled glossy green beans, crisp golden pressed-tofu cubes, tiny preserved-radish pieces, ginger, and bright red chilli slices; sauce fully reduced and no pooling liquid. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Lion’s Mane Mushroom, Daikon and Burdock Soup
title.id: Sup Jamur Surai Singa, Lobak Putih, dan Burdock

description.zh: 以電鍋蒸煮猴頭菇、白蘿蔔、牛蒡、老薑和烘烤腰果的暖胃全素湯品。
description.en: A warming vegan electric-cooker soup of lion’s mane mushroom, daikon, burdock, ginger, and roasted cashews.
description.id: Sup vegan hangat dari jamur surai singa, lobak putih, burdock, jahe, dan kacang mete panggang yang dimasak dengan penanak listrik.

instruction.zh: 白蘿蔔去皮切塊；牛蒡以湯匙輕刮外皮後切片，老薑切片。
instruction.en: Peel and cut the daikon into chunks. Lightly scrape the burdock skin with a spoon before slicing it, then slice the mature ginger.
instruction.id: Kupas lalu potong lobak putih menjadi beberapa bagian. Kerik tipis kulit burdock dengan sendok sebelum mengirisnya, lalu iris jahe tua.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of peeled white daikon chunks, thin burdock-root slices with lightly scraped brown skin, and mature ginger slices arranged in separate groups on a wooden cutting board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no mushrooms, cashews, soup, cooker, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將白蘿蔔、牛蒡、薑片和烘烤腰果放入電鍋內鍋；猴頭菇撕成兩半後加入，倒入一千毫升水。
instruction.en: Place daikon, burdock, ginger slices, and roasted cashews in the electric cooker’s inner pot. Tear the lion’s mane mushroom in half, add it, and pour in one litre of water.
instruction.id: Masukkan lobak putih, burdock, irisan jahe, dan kacang mete panggang ke panci dalam penanak listrik. Sobek jamur surai singa menjadi dua, tambahkan, lalu tuang satu liter air.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of an electric rice-cooker inner pot filled with clear water, chunky white daikon, sliced burdock, ginger, roasted cashews, and torn ivory lion's mane mushroom pieces before cooking. Constraints: strictly vegan; no finished soup bowl, garnish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 外鍋加入兩杯水，啟動電鍋蒸煮至跳起；保溫靜置三十分鐘，開蓋後依個人口味加入鹽與胡椒粉。
instruction.en: Add two cups of water to the outer pot and cook until the electric cooker switches off. Rest on keep-warm for thirty minutes, then season the opened soup with salt and ground pepper to taste.
instruction.id: Tambahkan dua cangkir air ke panci luar dan masak hingga penanak listrik berpindah sendiri. Diamkan pada mode hangat selama tiga puluh menit, lalu bumbui sup dengan garam dan lada bubuk sesuai selera.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of finished clear vegan lion's mane mushroom, daikon and burdock soup in a simple ceramic bowl, with tender ivory mushroom pieces, translucent daikon, burdock slices and visible roasted cashews. Constraints: no meat, dairy, cloudy broth, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.zh: 全素味噌豆乳起司醬年糕
title.en: Vegan Miso Soy Milk Cheese Sauce Rice Cakes
title.id: Kue Beras Saus Keju Miso Susu Kedelai Vegan

description.zh: 味噌以香油炒香後加入無糖豆奶，搭配年糕、油豆腐與莧菜，煮成口感濃郁如起司醬的全素年糕料理。
description.en: Miso is toasted in sesame oil then combined with unsweetened soy milk, rice cakes, tofu puffs, and amaranth greens for a rich vegan dish with a cheese-sauce-like texture.
description.id: Miso ditumis dalam minyak wijen lalu dipadukan dengan susu kedelai tanpa gula, kue beras, tahu puff, dan sayur bayam merah untuk hidangan vegan kaya dengan tekstur seperti saus keju.

instruction.zh: 油豆腐切成小塊，洗淨莧菜後切段；亦可改用容易煮熟的菠菜、小白菜或茼蒿。
instruction.en: Cut fried tofu into small pieces and wash then cut amaranth greens; spinach, bok choy, or garland chrysanthemum may be substituted if they cook quickly.
instruction.id: Potong tahu goreng kecil-kecil dan cuci lalu potong sayur amaranth; bayam, pakcoy, atau krisan daun dapat digunakan bila mudah matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of cubed fried tofu, amaranth greens, rice cakes, miso, and soy milk prepared on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中水煮滾後放入油豆腐汆燙，去除油耗味和表面雜質後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Bring water to a boil and blanch the fried tofu to remove stale oil flavor and surface impurities, then drain.
instruction.id: Didihkan air lalu blansir tahu goreng untuk menghilangkan rasa minyak tengik dan kotoran di permukaan, kemudian tiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of fried tofu pieces blanching in a pot of boiling water, no text.

title.en: Toast miso and add soy milk
title.id: Tumis miso lalu tambahkan susu kedelai

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量香油，以小火將味噌炒至焦香；倒入無糖豆奶攪拌至味噌完全融化成濃郁醬汁。
instruction.en: Add a little sesame oil to a wok and toast miso over low heat until fragrant. Pour in unsweetened soy milk and stir until the miso dissolves into a rich sauce.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak wijen ke wajan dan tumis miso dengan api kecil hingga harum. Tuang susu kedelai tanpa gula dan aduk sampai miso larut menjadi saus kaya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of pale creamy miso soy milk sauce being stirred in a wok, no text.

title.en: Simmer rice cakes and tofu in sauce
title.id: Rebus kue beras dan tahu dalam saus

instruction.zh: 將汆燙油豆腐和年糕放入味噌豆奶醬，小火煮至兩者吸收醬汁，年糕變得Q彈軟嫩。
instruction.en: Add blanched tofu and rice cakes to the miso soy milk sauce and simmer over low heat until both absorb sauce and the rice cakes become tender and chewy.
instruction.id: Masukkan tahu yang sudah diblansir dan kue beras ke saus miso susu kedelai, lalu rebus api kecil hingga menyerap saus dan kue beras menjadi lembut serta kenyal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of rice cakes and tofu puffs simmering in thick creamy vegan miso sauce, no text.

instruction.zh: 最後加入莧菜煮至軟化，盛盤後撒上黑芝麻提香與裝飾即可享用。
instruction.en: Add amaranth greens last and cook until softened, then plate and scatter black sesame seeds for fragrance and garnish.
instruction.id: Masukkan sayur amaranth terakhir dan masak hingga layu, lalu tata di piring serta taburi wijen hitam untuk aroma dan hiasan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of creamy vegan miso soy milk rice cakes with green amaranth and black sesame, no text.

title.zh: 素食廣東炒麵獨創氣炸鍋食譜大公開

description.zh: 油麵以氣炸鍋烤出外脆內Q口感，再淋上麵腸、菇類和蔬菜勾芡濃汁的全素廣東炒麵。
description.en: Oil noodles are air-fried for a crisp-outside, chewy-center texture, then topped with a thick vegan gravy of wheat gluten, mushrooms, and vegetables in this Cantonese-style noodle dish.
description.id: Mi minyak dimasak dengan air fryer hingga luar renyah dan tengah kenyal, lalu disiram kuah kental vegan dari gluten gandum, jamur, serta sayuran gaya Kanton.

instruction.zh: 紅蘿蔔與青江菜切半圓片，木耳切小片，香菇切片；玉米筍、辣椒與麵腸切斜片。
instruction.en: Cut carrot and bok choy into half-moons, wood ear into smaller pieces, and shiitake into slices. Slice baby corn, chili, and wheat gluten on a diagonal.
instruction.id: Potong wortel dan pakcoy setengah lingkaran, jamur kuping kecil-kecil, dan shiitake menjadi irisan. Iris jagung muda, cabai, serta gluten gandum secara serong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced carrots, bok choy, wood ear, shiitake, baby corn, chili, and wheat gluten on a wooden board, no text.

title.id: Masak mi minyak dengan air fryer hingga renyah

instruction.zh: 油麵均勻鋪在氣炸鍋底部，以190°C氣炸約8分鐘；依喜歡的脆度微調，邊緣焦黃、中間仍帶微軟即可取出。
instruction.en: Spread oil noodles evenly in the air fryer and cook at 190°C for about 8 minutes. Adjust for preferred crispness; remove when edges are golden while the center remains slightly soft.
instruction.id: Ratakan mi minyak di dasar air fryer dan masak pada 190°C sekitar 8 menit. Sesuaikan tingkat kerenyahan; angkat saat tepi keemasan tetapi bagian tengah masih sedikit lembut.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of crisp golden air-fried oil noodles with browned edges in an air-fryer basket, no text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入少量植物油，先將麵腸煎至金黃，再放香菇炒香；加入紅蘿蔔、木耳、玉米筍和辣椒，以大火拌炒。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and brown wheat gluten first, then sauté shiitake until fragrant. Add carrot, wood ear, baby corn, and chili and toss over high heat.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak sayur ke wajan dan tumis gluten gandum hingga keemasan terlebih dahulu, lalu tumis shiitake hingga harum. Masukkan wortel, jamur kuping, jagung muda, dan cabai, lalu aduk dengan api besar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden wheat gluten, shiitake, carrots, wood ear, baby corn, and chili stir-frying in a skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入昆布香菇醬油、素蠔油、胡椒粉和糖炒至食材上色；加水與青江菜煮熟，蓮藕粉加水調勻後慢慢倒入，攪拌至醬汁濃稠。
instruction.en: Add kombu mushroom soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, pepper, and sugar, tossing until coated. Add water and bok choy to cook, then slowly pour in lotus root starch mixed with water, stirring until thickened.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin kombu jamur, saus tiram vegan, merica, dan gula, lalu aduk sampai terlapisi. Tambahkan air dan pakcoy hingga matang, kemudian tuang perlahan pati akar teratai yang dilarutkan dengan air sambil mengaduk sampai mengental.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thick glossy vegan Cantonese gravy with bok choy and vegetables bubbling in a pan, no text.

title.id: Siram kuah di atas mi renyah

instruction.zh: 將濃稠蔬菜醬汁倒在氣炸好的油麵上，讓外層保持酥脆、中央逐漸吸附濃汁後即可享用。
instruction.en: Pour the thick vegetable gravy over air-fried oil noodles, keeping the outside crisp while the center gradually absorbs the sauce, then serve.
instruction.id: Siram kuah sayuran kental di atas mi minyak air-fryer, biarkan bagian luar tetap renyah sementara bagian tengah perlahan menyerap saus, lalu sajikan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of crispy vegan Cantonese noodles topped with thick mushroom vegetable gravy and bok choy, no text.

description.zh: 檸檬糖水煮軟蘋果片後，與果醬捲入酥皮做成玫瑰形狀，再烤至金黃酥脆的全素法式蘋果塔。
description.en: Apple slices are softened in lemon sugar water, rolled with jam into pastry roses, and baked until golden and crisp for a vegan French apple tart.
description.id: Irisan apel dilunakkan dalam air gula lemon, digulung bersama selai menjadi mawar dari pastri, lalu dipanggang hingga keemasan dan renyah sebagai tart apel Prancis vegan.

instruction.zh: 碗中加入水、半顆檸檬汁與糖，作為煮軟蘋果並防止氧化的檸檬糖水。
instruction.en: Combine water, juice of half a lemon, and sugar to make lemon sugar water for softening apples and preventing browning.
instruction.id: Campurkan air, perasan setengah lemon, dan gula untuk membuat air gula lemon yang melunakkan apel serta mencegahnya kecokelatan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of lemon juice and sugar being mixed into clear water in a glass bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 洗淨蘋果對半切、去蒂去芯，切成約2至3毫米薄片；放入檸檬糖水加熱至蘋果片稍微軟化，取出放涼。
instruction.en: Wash and halve the apple, remove stem and core, then slice about 2 to 3 mm thin. Heat in lemon sugar water until slightly soft, then remove and cool.
instruction.id: Cuci dan belah apel, buang tangkai serta inti, lalu iris setebal sekitar 2 hingga 3 mm. Panaskan dalam air gula lemon hingga sedikit lunak, lalu angkat dan dinginkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thin apple slices softening in lemon sugar water in a saucepan, no text.

title.en: Flour and join the puff pastry

instruction.zh: 砧板撒少量麵粉，將退冰的兩片酥皮相接成長條後切成三份。
instruction.en: Dust a board lightly with flour, join two thawed puff pastry sheets into a long strip, then cut it into three portions.
instruction.id: Taburi papan dengan sedikit tepung, sambungkan dua lembar pastri puff yang sudah dicairkan menjadi strip panjang, lalu potong menjadi tiga bagian.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of puff pastry sheets being joined and cut into three long strips on a floured board, no text.

instruction.zh: 每條酥皮下半部塗果醬，將蘋果薄片稍微重疊排列；約放5片較容易捲成玫瑰。
instruction.en: Spread jam over the lower half of each pastry strip and arrange overlapping apple slices; about five slices are easier to roll into a rose.
instruction.id: Oleskan selai pada bagian bawah tiap strip pastri lalu susun irisan apel saling tumpang tindih; sekitar lima irisan lebih mudah digulung menjadi mawar.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of overlapping apple slices arranged over raspberry jam on a puff pastry strip, no text.

instruction.zh: 將酥皮上半部折下覆住蘋果底部，輕輕捲成玫瑰並在收口稍壓緊；放入薄抹油的烤模，以180°C烤20分鐘。
instruction.en: Fold the upper pastry half over the apple bases, roll gently into roses, and press the seam lightly. Place in a lightly oiled mold and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Lipat bagian atas pastri menutupi dasar apel, gulung perlahan menjadi mawar, lalu tekan sambungan ringan. Letakkan dalam cetakan yang dioles minyak tipis dan panggang pada 180°C selama 20 menit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of golden vegan rose apple tarts with crisp puff pastry petals, no text.

title.id: Mi Sua Oyong Minyak Wijen Vegan

description.zh: 老薑、金針菇與枸杞以麻油炒香後，和絲瓜、豆包及麵線煮成溫潤湯麵。
description.en: A warming noodle soup where ginger, enoki, and goji are toasted in sesame oil before simmering with loofah, tofu skin, and vermicelli.
description.id: Sup mi hangat dengan jahe, enoki, dan goji ditumis minyak wijen lalu dimasak bersama oyong, kulit tahu, dan mi sua.

title.en: Soak the goji berries and cut the vegetables

instruction.zh: 枸杞用清水沖洗並略微浸泡後瀝乾；老薑切細末，絲瓜削皮切半圓片，金針菇沖洗切短，豆包切成小塊。
instruction.en: Rinse and briefly soak the goji berries, then drain. Mince the ginger, peel and cut the loofah into half-moons, shorten the rinsed enoki, and cut the tofu skin into small pieces.
instruction.id: Bilas dan rendam goji sebentar lalu tiriskan. Cincang jahe, kupas dan potong oyong setengah lingkaran, potong pendek enoki yang telah dicuci, serta potong kulit tahu kecil-kecil.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. Natural daylight, realistic ingredient proportions, tidy composition, hands only if needed, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 熱鍋加入適量植物油，放入豆包以中火煎至兩面金黃、邊緣略脆，盛起備用。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil, pan-fry the tofu skin over medium heat until both sides are golden with lightly crisp edges, then remove and set aside.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati, goreng kulit tahu dengan api sedang hingga kedua sisinya keemasan dan tepinya agak renyah, lalu angkat dan sisihkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. title.zh: 麻油煸香薑末與金針菇
title.en: Toast ginger and enoki in sesame oil
title.id: Tumis jahe dan enoki dengan minyak wijen

instruction.zh: 原鍋轉小火倒入75克麻油，放入薑末和金針菇煸至金黃出香，再加入瀝乾的枸杞翻炒。
instruction.en: Lower the heat in the same pan, add 75 g sesame oil, and sauté the ginger and enoki until golden and aromatic; stir in the drained goji berries.
instruction.id: Kecilkan api pada wajan yang sama, tambahkan 75 g minyak wijen, tumis jahe dan enoki hingga keemasan dan harum, lalu masukkan goji yang telah ditiriskan.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead close three-quarter view. In a clean dark pot over low heat, finely minced mature ginger and short-cut enoki mushrooms are sizzling in glossy amber sesame oil until lightly golden; drained red goji berries are just being added from a small bowl. Realistic steam, food textures and proportions, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 把絲瓜半圓片加入鍋中翻炒，炒到絲瓜剛開始變軟但仍保持完整形狀。
instruction.en: Add the loofah half-moons and stir-fry until they have just started to soften while still holding their shape.
instruction.id: Masukkan potongan oyong setengah lingkaran dan tumis sampai mulai lunak tetapi masih mempertahankan bentuknya.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. Show peeled pale-green loofah half-moon slices being added to a pot containing glossy sesame-oil sauteed ginger, short enoki pieces, and bright red goji berries; a wooden spatula folds the loofah until it is just starting to soften. Natural daylight, realistic steam and textures, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

title.en: Add water and simmer the broth

instruction.zh: 倒入800克水，蓋上鍋蓋熬煮10分鐘，讓絲瓜、薑、金針菇和枸杞的味道融入湯底。
instruction.en: Pour in 800 g water, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes so the loofah, ginger, enoki, and goji flavour the broth.
instruction.id: Tuang 800 g air, tutup panci, dan rebus selama 10 menit agar oyong, jahe, enoki, dan goji memberi rasa pada kuah.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. Show a round pot of clear sesame-ginger broth gently simmering under a partly lifted glass lid, filled with softened pale-green loofah half-moons, short enoki mushrooms, minced ginger, and red goji berries. Visible small bubbles and steam communicate a covered ten-minute simmer. Realistic home cooking, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 開蓋試味，以適量鹽和胡椒粉調味；加入兩坨無鹹麵線，煮約1分鐘至麵線剛熟。
instruction.en: Taste and season the broth with salt and ground pepper, then add two portions of unsalted vermicelli and cook for about 1 minute until just tender.
instruction.id: Cicipi dan bumbui kuah dengan garam serta lada, lalu masukkan dua porsi mi sua tanpa garam dan masak sekitar 1 menit hingga baru matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. Show two compact bundles of plain unsalted wheat vermicelli being lowered into a gently bubbling clear loofah, enoki, ginger and goji broth after salt and ground pepper have been added. The thin noodles are beginning to loosen during their brief one-minute cook. Natural light, realistic steam and food texture, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

title.en: Top with tofu skin and serve

instruction.zh: 關火後把先前煎至金黃的豆包鋪回麵線湯表面，連同絲瓜、金針菇和枸杞一起盛碗。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat, arrange the golden pan-fried tofu skin over the noodle soup, and serve it with the loofah, enoki, and goji berries.
instruction.id: Matikan api, susun kulit tahu goreng keemasan di atas sup mi, lalu sajikan bersama oyong, enoki, dan goji.

steps.imagePrompt: Create one photorealistic editorial food-process image, 16:9 landscape. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, overhead three-quarter view. Show the completed vegan sesame-oil loofah vermicelli soup in a deep ceramic bowl: thin wheat vermicelli in a clear amber sesame-ginger broth, softened pale-green loofah half-moons, short enoki mushrooms and red goji berries, topped at the last moment with crisp golden squares of pan-fried tofu sheet. Appetizing natural light and gentle steam, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

description.zh: 紅藜麥拌炒香菇、杏鮑菇、甜豆與黃甜椒，盛進冰鎮生菜杯並撒上堅果的清爽主食。
description.en: Red quinoa is folded through sautéed mushrooms, snow peas, and yellow bell pepper, then spooned into chilled lettuce cups with crushed nuts.
description.id: Kinoa merah dicampur jamur tumis, kacang polong manis, dan paprika kuning, lalu disendok ke daun selada dingin dengan kacang hancur.

instruction.zh: 紅藜麥以1比1的米水比例煮熟；電鍋外鍋加1杯水，煮好後放在一旁備用。
instruction.en: Cook the red quinoa using a 1:1 grain-to-water ratio; add 1 cup water to the outer cooker pot, then set the cooked quinoa aside.
instruction.id: Masak kinoa merah dengan rasio 1:1; tambahkan 1 cangkir air ke panci luar, lalu sisihkan setelah matang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape. instruction.zh: 薑切細末；西洋芹、香菇、杏鮑菇、甜豆和黃甜椒切小丁；生菜從三分之一處切開，剝成杯狀後泡冰水。
instruction.en: Mince ginger and dice celery, shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, snow peas, and yellow pepper; cut the lettuce at one-third, separate cups, and chill in ice water.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe dan potong dadu sayuran; potong sepertiga selada, pisahkan menjadi mangkuk, lalu rendam dalam air es.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape. instruction.zh: 將綜合堅果壓碎成能均勻撒在生菜包上的小顆粒，先放旁邊備用。
instruction.en: Crush the mixed nuts into small pieces that can scatter evenly over the finished lettuce cups, then set aside.
instruction.id: Hancurkan kacang campur menjadi serpihan kecil untuk ditaburkan merata di atas selada, lalu sisihkan.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油，先下薑末、杏鮑菇丁和香菇丁，炒至菇類金黃並帶出香氣。
instruction.en: Heat oil, then sauté minced ginger with diced king oyster and shiitake mushrooms until the mushrooms turn golden and fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak, lalu tumis jahe cincang dengan dadu jamur king oyster dan shiitake sampai keemasan dan harum.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape. title.id: Tambahkan sayuran renyah dan susutkan kuah

instruction.zh: 加入西洋芹和甜豆翻炒，拌入鹽麴、素蠔油和胡椒粉炒出醬香；加少量水後收汁，讓食材吸收味道。
instruction.en: Add celery and snow peas, then stir in shio koji, vegetarian oyster sauce, and pepper; add a little water and reduce so the vegetables absorb the sauce.
instruction.id: Masukkan seledri dan kacang polong, aduk shio koji, saus tir vegetarian, dan lada; tambahkan sedikit air lalu susutkan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape. Fresh crisp green colour, realistic steam, no faces, no text, no labels, no packaging, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 湯汁收乾後加入黃甜椒丁和煮好的紅藜麥，快速翻拌，讓黃甜椒保持鮮脆。
instruction.en: When the liquid has reduced, fold in diced yellow pepper and cooked red quinoa quickly so the pepper stays crisp.
instruction.id: Saat cairan menyusut, aduk cepat paprika kuning dadu dan kinoa matang agar paprika tetap renyah.

title.en: Fill lettuce cups and add nuts

instruction.zh: 將炒好的紅藜麥餡盛入冰鎮瀝乾的生菜杯，最後撒上壓碎堅果後立即食用。
instruction.en: Spoon the warm red-quinoa filling into drained chilled lettuce cups and finish with crushed nuts before serving immediately.
instruction.id: Sendokkan isian kinoa hangat ke mangkuk selada dingin yang telah ditiriskan, lalu taburi kacang hancur dan sajikan segera.

description.zh: 以生芋頭、冬粉與蔬菜拌餡，用糖水潤濕越南米紙後低溫慢炸的酥脆春捲。
description.en: Raw taro, vermicelli, and vegetables are seasoned, wrapped in sugar-moistened Vietnamese rice paper, then fried slowly until crisp.
